<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Administrasi;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class ActivityLogController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $query = ActivityLog::with('user')->latest();

        // Search Filter
        if ($request->filled('search')) {
            $search = $request->search;
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('user_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('description', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('ip_address', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        // Action Filter
        if ($request->filled('action')) {
            $query->where('action', $request->action);
        }

        // Module Filter
        if ($request->filled('module')) {
            $query->where('module', $request->module);
        }

        // Date Range Filter
        if ($request->filled('date_start')) {
            $query->whereDate('created_at', '>=', $request->date_start);
        }

        if ($request->filled('date_end')) {
            $query->whereDate('created_at', '<=', $request->date_end);
        }

        // Pagination
        $perPage = $request->input('per_page', 15);
        $activityLogs = $query->paginate($perPage)->withQueryString();

        // Available Modules & Actions for Filter Dropdowns
        $modules = ActivityLog::select('module')->distinct()->whereNotNull('module')->pluck('module');
        $actions = ActivityLog::select('action')->distinct()->whereNotNull('action')->pluck('action');

        // Statistics Summary
        $stats = [
            'total_today'  => ActivityLog::whereDate('created_at', today())->count(),
            'total_tambah' => ActivityLog::where('action', 'Tambah')->count(),
            'total_edit'   => ActivityLog::where('action', 'Edit')->count(),
            'total_hapus'  => ActivityLog::where('action', 'Hapus')->count(),
            'total_import' => ActivityLog::where('action', 'Import')->count(),
        ];

        return view('Administrasi.ActivityLog.index', compact('activityLogs', 'modules', 'actions', 'stats'));
    }

    public function show($id)
    {
        $log = ActivityLog::findOrFail($id);

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'data'   => $log,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Administrasi;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Administrasi\Cuti;
use App\Services\ExcelExporter;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class CutiController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        // 1. Dynamic Year Selection & Filters
        $selectedYear = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $dbYears = Cuti::select('tahun')->distinct()->whereNotNull('tahun')->pluck('tahun')->toArray();
        $baseYears = range(date('Y') - 3, date('Y') + 2);
        $years = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_merge($baseYears, $dbYears, [$selectedYear]))));
        sort($years);

        $search = $request->get('search', '');
        $filterJabatan = $request->get('jabatan', '');
        $filterJenisJabatan = $request->get('jenis_jabatan', '');
        $filterStatus = $request->get('status', ''); // 'positif', 'habis', 'minus'

        // Dynamic Year Labels
        $periodeHakCuti = $selectedYear - 1;
        $hakCutiLabel = "Hak Cuti {$periodeHakCuti}";
        $sisaCarryoverStart = $selectedYear - 3;
        $sisaCarryoverEnd = $selectedYear - 2;
        $sisaCarryoverLabel = "Sisa Hak Cuti {$sisaCarryoverStart}–{$sisaCarryoverEnd}";
        $periodePengambilanLabel = "Periode Pengambilan Cuti {$selectedYear}";

        // 3. Query Data
        $query = Cuti::where('tahun', $selectedYear);

        if (!empty($search)) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nik', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('nama', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('jabatan', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('jenis_jabatan', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        if (!empty($filterJabatan)) {
            $query->where('jabatan', $filterJabatan);
        }

        if (!empty($filterJenisJabatan)) {
            $query->where('jenis_jabatan', $filterJenisJabatan);
        }

        // Distinct positions for filter dropdown
        $positions = Cuti::whereNotNull('jabatan')
            ->where('jabatan', '!=', '')
            ->select('jabatan')
            ->distinct()
            ->pluck('jabatan')
            ->toArray();

        $jenisJabatanList = ['Staf', 'Karyawan PBT', 'Karyawan KHT'];

        // Fetch records
        $allYearRecords = (clone $query)->get();

        // Calculate carryover dynamically if not set
        foreach ($allYearRecords as $item) {
            $historicalCarryover = Cuti::getHistoricalCarryover($item->nik, $selectedYear);
            if ($historicalCarryover > 0 && $item->sisa_hak_cuti_carryover == 0) {
                $item->sisa_hak_cuti_carryover = $historicalCarryover;
            }
        }

        // Apply status filter in collection if needed
        if (!empty($filterStatus)) {
            $records = $query->orderedHierarchy()->get();
            if ($filterStatus === 'positif') {
                $records = $records->filter(fn($r) => $r->sisa_cuti > 0);
            } elseif ($filterStatus === 'habis') {
                $records = $records->filter(fn($r) => $r->sisa_cuti === 0);
            } elseif ($filterStatus === 'minus') {
                $records = $records->filter(fn($r) => $r->sisa_cuti < 0);
            }

            $page = (int) $request->get('page', 1);
            $perPage = 50;
            $paginated = new \Illuminate\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator(
                $records->forPage($page, $perPage),
                $records->count(),
                $perPage,
                $page,
                ['path' => $request->url(), 'query' => $request->query()]
            );
            $records = $paginated;
        } else {
            $records = $query->orderedHierarchy()
                ->paginate(50)
                ->withQueryString();
        }

        // 4. Calculate Summary Totals
        $totals = [
            'total_karyawan' => $allYearRecords->count(),
            'total_hak_cuti' => $allYearRecords->sum('hak_cuti'),
            'total_cuti_diambil' => $allYearRecords->sum('cuti_diambil'),
            'total_sisa_cuti' => $allYearRecords->sum(fn($r) => $r->sisa_cuti),
        ];

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Administrasi.cuti', compact(
            'years',
            'selectedYear',
            'periodeHakCuti',
            'hakCutiLabel',
            'sisaCarryoverLabel',
            'periodePengambilanLabel',
            'sisaCarryoverStart',
            'sisaCarryoverEnd',
            'records',
            'totals',
            'positions',
            'jenisJabatanList',
            'search',
            'filterJabatan',
            'filterJenisJabatan',
            'filterStatus'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $this->validateCuti($request);

        // If carryover is 0, attempt auto-fill from 2 years prior
        if ($validated['sisa_hak_cuti_carryover'] === 0) {
            $historical = Cuti::getHistoricalCarryover($validated['nik'], $validated['tahun']);
            if ($historical > 0) {
                $validated['sisa_hak_cuti_carryover'] = $historical;
            }
        }

        // Auto-fill cuti_diambil if monthly sum exists and cuti_diambil is 0
        $monthlySum = array_sum(array_map(fn($m) => (int) ($validated[$m] ?? 0), Cuti::MONTHS));
        if ($validated['cuti_diambil'] === 0 && $monthlySum > 0) {
            $validated['cuti_diambil'] = $monthlySum;
        }

        $cuti = Cuti::updateOrCreate(
            ['nik' => $validated['nik'], 'tahun' => $validated['tahun']],
            $validated
        );

        $message = "Data cuti karyawan {$validated['nama']} ({$validated['nik']}) berhasil disimpan.";

        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => $message,
                'data' => $cuti
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.cuti.index', [
            'year' => $validated['tahun']
        ])->with('success', $message);
    }

    public function import(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate(['file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt,xlsx|max:20480']);
        $file = $request->file('file');
        $rows = $this->readSpreadsheet($file->getRealPath(), $file->getClientOriginalExtension());
        if (count($rows) < 2) return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'File tidak memiliki data.']);

        $rawHeaders = array_shift($rows);
        $headers = array_map(fn ($value) => strtolower(trim(str_replace(["\xEF\xBB\xBF", '"', "'"], '', (string) $value))), $rawHeaders);

        // Check format: Long format (contains 'bulan' or 'pengambilan_cuti') vs Wide format
        $isLongFormat = in_array('bulan', $headers, true) || in_array('pengambilan_cuti', $headers, true);

        $monthMap = [
            1 => 'jan', 2 => 'feb', 3 => 'mar', 4 => 'apr', 5 => 'mei', 6 => 'jun',
            7 => 'jul', 8 => 'agu', 9 => 'sep', 10 => 'okt', 11 => 'nov', 12 => 'des',
            'jan' => 'jan', 'feb' => 'feb', 'mar' => 'mar', 'apr' => 'apr', 'mei' => 'mei', 'jun' => 'jun',
            'jul' => 'jul', 'agu' => 'agu', 'sep' => 'sep', 'okt' => 'okt', 'nov' => 'nov', 'des' => 'des',
            'januari' => 'jan', 'februari' => 'feb', 'maret' => 'mar', 'april' => 'apr', 'mei' => 'mei',
            'juni' => 'jun', 'juli' => 'jul', 'agustus' => 'agu', 'september' => 'sep', 'oktober' => 'okt',
            'november' => 'nov', 'desember' => 'des'
        ];

        $imported = 0;

        DB::transaction(function () use ($rows, $headers, $isLongFormat, $monthMap, &$imported) {
            if ($isLongFormat) {
                // Group by employee and year
                $grouped = [];
                foreach ($rows as $row) {
                    if (empty(array_filter($row, fn($c) => trim((string)$c) !== ''))) continue;
                    $values = array_pad($row, count($headers), null);
                    $data = array_combine($headers, array_slice($values, 0, count($headers)));

                    $nama = trim((string)($data['nama'] ?? ''));
                    if (empty($nama)) continue;

                    $nik = trim((string)($data['nik'] ?? ''));
                    if (empty($nik)) {
                        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9]/', '', strtoupper($nama));
                        $nik = 'FRA-' . substr($sanitized, 0, 12);
                    }

                    $tahun = !empty($data['tahun_cuti']) ? (int)$data['tahun_cuti'] : (!empty($data['tahun']) ? (int)$data['tahun'] : 2026);
                    $key = "{$nik}_{$tahun}";

                    if (!isset($grouped[$key])) {
                        $tmkVal = null;
                        if (!empty($data['tmk'])) {
                            $time = strtotime((string)$data['tmk']);
                            $tmkVal = $time ? date('Y-m-d', $time) : null;
                        }

                        $carryover = 0;
                        if (isset($data['sisa_hak_cuti_carryover'])) {
                            $carryover = (int)$data['sisa_hak_cuti_carryover'];
                        } else {
                            $carryover = Cuti::getHistoricalCarryover($nik, $tahun);
                        }

                        $cutiDiambil = 0;
                        if (isset($data['cuti_yang_sudah_diambil'])) {
                            $cutiDiambil = (int)$data['cuti_yang_sudah_diambil'];
                        } elseif (isset($data['cuti_diambil'])) {
                            $cutiDiambil = (int)$data['cuti_diambil'];
                        }

                        $hakCuti = 12;
                        if (isset($data['hak_cuti']) && is_numeric($data['hak_cuti'])) {
                            $hakCuti = (int)$data['hak_cuti'];
                        } elseif (isset($data['hak_cuti_tahun']) && is_numeric($data['hak_cuti_tahun'])) {
                            $hakCuti = (int)$data['hak_cuti_tahun'];
                        } elseif (isset($data['sisa_cuti']) && is_numeric($data['sisa_cuti'])) {
                            $hakCuti = max(0, (int)$data['sisa_cuti'] - $carryover + $cutiDiambil);
                        }

                        $grouped[$key] = [
                            'nik' => $nik,
                            'nama' => $nama,
                            'jabatan' => !empty($data['jabatan']) ? trim((string)$data['jabatan']) : null,
                            'jenis_jabatan' => !empty($data['jenis_jabatan']) ? trim((string)$data['jenis_jabatan']) : null,
                            'tmk' => $tmkVal,
                            'tahun' => $tahun,
                            'hak_cuti' => $hakCuti,
                            'sisa_hak_cuti_carryover' => $carryover,
                            'cuti_diambil' => $cutiDiambil,
                            'jan' => 0, 'feb' => 0, 'mar' => 0, 'apr' => 0, 'mei' => 0, 'jun' => 0,
                            'jul' => 0, 'agu' => 0, 'sep' => 0, 'okt' => 0, 'nov' => 0, 'des' => 0,
                            'keterangan' => !empty($data['keterangan']) ? trim((string)$data['keterangan']) : null,
                        ];
                    }

                    // Add monthly pengambilan_cuti
                    $bulanRaw = strtolower(trim((string)($data['bulan'] ?? '')));
                    $pengambilan = (int)($data['pengambilan_cuti'] ?? 0);
                    if ($bulanRaw !== '' && isset($monthMap[$bulanRaw])) {
                        $col = $monthMap[$bulanRaw];
                        $grouped[$key][$col] += $pengambilan;
                    }
                }

                foreach ($grouped as $item) {
                    Cuti::updateOrCreate(
                        ['nik' => $item['nik'], 'tahun' => $item['tahun']],
                        $item
                    );
                    $imported++;
                }
            } else {
                // Wide format
                $allowed = ['nik', 'nama', 'jabatan', 'jenis_jabatan', 'tmk', 'tahun', 'hak_cuti', 'sisa_hak_cuti_carryover', 'cuti_diambil', 'jan', 'feb', 'mar', 'apr', 'mei', 'jun', 'jul', 'agu', 'sep', 'okt', 'nov', 'des', 'keterangan'];
                $numericFields = ['tahun', 'hak_cuti', 'sisa_hak_cuti_carryover', 'cuti_diambil', 'jan', 'feb', 'mar', 'apr', 'mei', 'jun', 'jul', 'agu', 'sep', 'okt', 'nov', 'des'];

                foreach ($rows as $row) {
                    if (empty(array_filter($row, fn($c) => trim((string)$c) !== ''))) continue;
                    $values = array_pad($row, count($headers), null);
                    $record = array_combine($headers, array_slice($values, 0, count($headers)));

                    $nama = trim((string)($record['nama'] ?? ''));
                    if (empty($nama)) continue;

                    $nik = trim((string)($record['nik'] ?? ''));
                    if (empty($nik)) {
                        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9]/', '', strtoupper($nama));
                        $nik = 'FRA-' . substr($sanitized, 0, 12);
                    }
                    $record['nik'] = $nik;

                    if (isset($record['hak_cuti_tahun']) && !isset($record['hak_cuti'])) {
                        $record['hak_cuti'] = (int)$record['hak_cuti_tahun'];
                    }
                    if (isset($record['cuti_yang_sudah_diambil']) && !isset($record['cuti_diambil'])) {
                        $record['cuti_diambil'] = (int)$record['cuti_yang_sudah_diambil'];
                    }

                    $record = array_intersect_key($record, array_flip($allowed));

                    foreach ($record as $field => $value) {
                        if ($value === null || strtolower(trim((string)$value)) === 'null' || trim((string)$value) === '') $record[$field] = null;
                    }
                    foreach ($numericFields as $field) {
                        if (array_key_exists($field, $record)) $record[$field] = is_numeric($record[$field]) ? (int)$record[$field] : 0;
                    }
                    if (!empty($record['tmk'])) {
                        $time = strtotime((string)$record['tmk']);
                        $record['tmk'] = $time ? date('Y-m-d', $time) : null;
                    }
                    $record['tahun'] ??= 2026;
                    $record['hak_cuti'] ??= 12;
                    $record['sisa_hak_cuti_carryover'] ??= Cuti::getHistoricalCarryover($record['nik'], $record['tahun']);
                    $record['cuti_diambil'] ??= 0;
                    foreach (Cuti::MONTHS as $month) $record[$month] ??= 0;

                    Cuti::updateOrCreate(['nik' => $record['nik'], 'tahun' => $record['tahun']], $record);
                    $imported++;
                }
            }
        });

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Cuti',
            "Mengimport {$imported} data karyawan Cuti dari file " . $file->getClientOriginalName(),
            ['filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(), 'count' => $imported]
        );

        return back()->with('success', "{$imported} data karyawan Cuti berhasil diproses dan disimpan.");
    }

    private function readSpreadsheet(string $path, string $extension): array
    {
        if (strtolower($extension) !== 'xlsx') {
            $handle = fopen($path, 'rb'); $rows = [];
            while (($row = fgetcsv($handle)) !== false) $rows[] = $row;
            fclose($handle); return $rows;
        }
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($path) !== true) throw new \RuntimeException('File Excel tidak dapat dibaca.');
        $shared = [];
        if (($xml = $zip->getFromName('xl/sharedStrings.xml')) !== false) {
            $doc = simplexml_load_string($xml);
            foreach ($doc->si as $item) $shared[] = (string) ($item->t ?? implode('', array_map('strval', $item->r->t ?? [])));
        }
        $sheet = simplexml_load_string($zip->getFromName('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml')); $rows = [];
        foreach ($sheet->sheetData->row as $xmlRow) {
            $cells = [];
            foreach ($xmlRow->c as $cell) {
                preg_match('/([A-Z]+)/', (string) $cell['r'], $match); $column = 0;
                foreach (str_split($match[1] ?? 'A') as $letter) $column = $column * 26 + ord($letter) - 64;
                $value = (string) ($cell->v ?? '');
                if ((string) $cell['t'] === 's') $value = $shared[(int) $value] ?? $value;
                $cells[$column - 1] = $value;
            }
            ksort($cells); $rows[] = array_values($cells);
        }
        $zip->close(); return $rows;
    }

    /**

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $cuti = Cuti::findOrFail($id);
        $tahun = $cuti->tahun;
        $nama = $cuti->nama;
        $nik = $cuti->nik;

        $cuti->delete();

        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => "Data cuti {$nama} ({$nik}) berhasil dihapus."
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.cuti.index', [
            'year' => $tahun
        ])->with('success', "Data cuti karyawan {$nama} ({$nik}) berhasil dihapus.");
    }

    /**
     * Export Report to CSV
     */
    public function export(Request $request)
    {
        $year = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $periodeHakCuti = $year - 1;
        $sisaStart = $year - 3;
        $sisaEnd = $year - 2;

        $headers = [
            'NIK',
            'Nama Karyawan',
            'Jabatan',
            'Jenis Jabatan',
            'TMK',
            'Periode Hak Cuti',
            "Hak Cuti {$periodeHakCuti}",
            "Sisa Hak Cuti {$sisaStart}-{$sisaEnd}",
            'Cuti yang Diambil',
            'Sisa Cuti',
            'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Agu', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des',
            'Total Rincian Bulanan',
            'Tahun Periode'
        ];

        $data = Cuti::where('tahun', $year)->orderedHierarchy()->get();
        $dataRows = [];

        foreach ($data as $row) {
            $dataRows[] = [
                $row->nik,
                $row->nama,
                $row->jabatan ?? '-',
                $row->jenis_jabatan ?? '-',
                $row->tmk ? $row->tmk->format('d/m/Y') : '-',
                $row->periode_hak_cuti,
                $row->hak_cuti,
                $row->sisa_hak_cuti_carryover,
                $row->cuti_diambil,
                $row->sisa_cuti,
                $row->jan, $row->feb, $row->mar, $row->apr, $row->mei, $row->jun,
                $row->jul, $row->agu, $row->sep, $row->okt, $row->nov, $row->des,
                $row->total_bulanan,
                $row->tahun
            ];
        }

        $filename = "Laporan_Cuti_{$year}.xlsx";
        return ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Laporan Cuti');
    }

    /**
     * Validate common Cuti input request
     */
    private function validateCuti(Request $request): array
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'nik' => 'required|string|max:50',
            'nama' => 'required|string|max:150',
            'jabatan' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'jenis_jabatan' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'tmk' => 'nullable|date',
            'tahun' => 'nullable|integer',
            'hak_cuti' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'sisa_hak_cuti_carryover' => 'nullable|integer',
            'cuti_diambil' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'jan' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'feb' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'mar' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'apr' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'mei' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'jun' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'jul' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'agu' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'sep' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'okt' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'nov' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'des' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        foreach (array_merge(['sisa_hak_cuti_carryover', 'cuti_diambil'], Cuti::MONTHS) as $field) {
            $validated[$field] = isset($validated[$field]) && $validated[$field] !== '' ? (int) $validated[$field] : 0;
        }

        if (empty($validated['tahun'])) {
            $validated['tahun'] = (int) date('Y');
        } else {
            $validated['tahun'] = (int) $validated['tahun'];
        }

        return $validated;
    }

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        // 1. Dynamic Year Selection
        $selectedYear = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $mppYears = Mpp::select('tahun')->distinct()->whereNotNull('tahun')->pluck('tahun')->toArray();
        $baseYears = range(date('Y') - 3, date('Y') + 2);
        $years = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_merge($baseYears, $mppYears, [$selectedYear]))));
        sort($years);

        // 2. Selected Context: Year & Month
        $selectedMonth = (int) $request->get('month', 8); // Default to August (8) per requirement/screenshot
        if ($selectedMonth < 1 || $selectedMonth > 12) {
            $selectedMonth = 8;
        }

        $search = $request->get('search', '');

        // 3. Retrieve Matrix Data
        $data = Mpp::getMatrixData($selectedYear, $selectedMonth, $search);
        $matrix = $data['matrix'];
        $totals = $data['totals'];

        // 4. Existing Jabatan List for Autocomplete Suggestions
        $existingJabatan = Mpp::distinct()->pluck('nama_jabatan')->toArray();

        // Month Names
        $monthInfo = $this->months[$selectedMonth] ?? ['short' => 'Aug', 'full' => 'August'];
        $months = $this->months;

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Administrasi.mpp', compact(
            'years',
            'months',
            'selectedYear',
            'selectedMonth',
            'monthInfo',
            'matrix',
            'totals',
            'existingJabatan',
            'search'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created or batch created MPP data.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'nama_jabatan' => 'required|string|max:100',
            'tahun' => 'required|integer|min:2000|max:2099',
            'bulan' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:12',
            // Option 1: Single type entry
            'jenis_jabatan' => 'nullable|string|in:Staff,PBT,KHT,KHL',
            'jumlah' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            // Option 2: Batch entry for all 4 types
            'staff' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'pbt' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'kht' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'khl' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
        ]);

        $jabatan = trim($validated['nama_jabatan']);
        $tahun = (int) $validated['tahun'];
        $bulan = (int) $validated['bulan'];

        // If batch input is provided
        if ($request->has('staff') || $request->has('pbt') || $request->has('kht') || $request->has('khl')) {
            $types = [
                'Staff' => (int) $request->input('staff', 0),
                'PBT' => (int) $request->input('pbt', 0),
                'KHT' => (int) $request->input('kht', 0),
                'KHL' => (int) $request->input('khl', 0),
            ];

            foreach ($types as $type => $count) {
                Mpp::updateOrCreate(
                    [
                        'nama_jabatan' => $jabatan,
                        'jenis_jabatan' => $type,
                        'tahun' => $tahun,
                        'bulan' => $bulan,
                    ],
                    [
                        'jumlah' => $count,
                    ]
                );
            }

            $message = "Data MPP untuk jabatan '{$jabatan}' periode {$this->months[$bulan]['full']} {$tahun} berhasil disimpan.";
        } else {
            // Single entry fallback
            $jenis = $validated['jenis_jabatan'] ?? 'Staff';
            $jumlah = (int) ($validated['jumlah'] ?? 0);

            Mpp::updateOrCreate(
                [
                    'nama_jabatan' => $jabatan,
                    'jenis_jabatan' => $jenis,
                    'tahun' => $tahun,
                    'bulan' => $bulan,
                ],
                [
                    'jumlah' => $jumlah,
                ]
            );

            $message = "Data MPP {$jabatan} ({$jenis}: {$jumlah}) berhasil disimpan.";
        }

        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => $message,
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.mpp.index', [
            'year' => $tahun,
            'month' => $bulan,
        ])->with('success', $message);
    }

    /**
     * Get MPP record for a specific jabatan, year and month (for AJAX Edit Modal).
     */
    public function showByJabatan(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'nama_jabatan' => 'required|string',
            'tahun' => 'required|integer',
            'bulan' => 'required|integer',
        ]);

        $jabatan = $request->get('nama_jabatan');
        $tahun = (int) $request->get('tahun');
        $bulan = (int) $request->get('bulan');

        $records = Mpp::where('nama_jabatan', $jabatan)
            ->where('tahun', $tahun)
            ->where('bulan', $bulan)
            ->get();

        $counts = [
            'Staff' => 0,
            'PBT' => 0,
            'KHT' => 0,
            'KHL' => 0,
        ];

        foreach ($records as $r) {
            if (isset($counts[$r->jenis_jabatan])) {
                $counts[$r->jenis_jabatan] = $r->jumlah;
            }
        }

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => [
                'nama_jabatan' => $jabatan,
                'tahun' => $tahun,
                'bulan' => $bulan,
                'counts' => $counts,
            ]
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Update MPP data for a specific jabatan.
     */
    public function updateJabatan(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'original_nama_jabatan' => 'required|string',
            'nama_jabatan' => 'required|string|max:100',
            'tahun' => 'required|integer',
            'bulan' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:12',
            'staff' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'pbt' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'kht' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'khl' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
        ]);

        $oldJabatan = $request->input('original_nama_jabatan');
        $newJabatan = trim($request->input('nama_jabatan'));
        $tahun = (int) $request->input('tahun');
        $bulan = (int) $request->input('bulan');

        // Delete old records if name changed
        if ($oldJabatan !== $newJabatan) {
            Mpp::where('nama_jabatan', $oldJabatan)
                ->where('tahun', $tahun)
                ->where('bulan', $bulan)
                ->delete();
        }

        $types = [
            'Staff' => (int) $request->input('staff', 0),
            'PBT' => (int) $request->input('pbt', 0),
            'KHT' => (int) $request->input('kht', 0),
            'KHL' => (int) $request->input('khl', 0),
        ];

        foreach ($types as $type => $count) {
            Mpp::updateOrCreate(
                [
                    'nama_jabatan' => $newJabatan,
                    'jenis_jabatan' => $type,
                    'tahun' => $tahun,
                    'bulan' => $bulan,
                ],
                [
                    'jumlah' => $count,
                ]
            );
        }

        $message = "Data MPP untuk jabatan '{$newJabatan}' berhasil diperbarui.";

        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => $message,
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.mpp.index', [
            'year' => $tahun,
            'month' => $bulan,
        ])->with('success', $message);
    }

    /**
     * Export Report to CSV
     */
    public function export(Request $request)
    {
        $year = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $month = (int) $request->get('month', 8);
        $monthName = $this->months[$month]['full'] ?? 'August';

        $data = Mpp::getMatrixData($year, $month);
        $matrix = $data['matrix'];
        $totals = $data['totals'];

        $headers = ['Nama Jabatan', 'Staff', 'PBT', 'KHT', 'KHL', 'Total'];
        $dataRows = [];

        foreach ($matrix as $row) {
            $rowTotal = $row['Staff'] + $row['PBT'] + $row['KHT'] + $row['KHL'];
            $dataRows[] = [
                $row['nama_jabatan'],
                $row['Staff'],
                $row['PBT'],
                $row['KHT'],
                $row['KHL'],
                $rowTotal
            ];
        }

        $dataRows[] = [
            'TOTAL',
            $totals['Staff'],
            $totals['PBT'],
            $totals['KHT'],
            $totals['KHL'],
            $totals['total_overall']
        ];

        $filename = "Laporan_MPP_Jabatan_{$monthName}_{$year}.xlsx";
        return ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Laporan MPP');
    }

    /**
     * Import CSV File into MPP Database
     */
    public function importCsv(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'csv_file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt,text|max:10240',
            'import_mode' => 'nullable|string|in:append,replace',
            'year' => 'nullable|integer',
            'month' => 'nullable|integer',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('csv_file');
        $filePath = $file->getRealPath();
        $importMode = $request->get('import_mode', 'append');
        $fallbackYear = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $fallbackMonth = (int) $request->get('month', 8);

        // Detect delimiter
        $handle = fopen($filePath, 'r');
        if (!$handle) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Gagal membuka file CSV yang diunggah.');
        }

        $firstLine = fgets($handle);
        rewind($handle);

        $delimiter = ',';
        if (substr_count($firstLine, ';') > substr_count($firstLine, ',')) {
            $delimiter = ';';
        } elseif (substr_count($firstLine, "\t") > substr_count($firstLine, ',')) {
            $delimiter = "\t";
        }

        // Read header
        $rawHeaders = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter);
        if (!$rawHeaders) {
            fclose($handle);
            return back()->with('error', 'Format file CSV tidak valid atau file kosong.');
        }

        // Normalize header mapping
        $headerMap = [];
        $isMatrixFormat = false;

        foreach ($rawHeaders as $index => $header) {
            $clean = strtolower(trim(preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1F\x80-\xFF]/', '', $header)));
            $clean = str_replace([' ', '_', '-', '.', '/'], '', $clean);

            if (in_array($clean, ['namajabatan', 'jabatan', 'position', 'posisi'])) {
                $headerMap['nama_jabatan'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['tahun', 'year', 'thn'])) {
                $headerMap['tahun'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['bulan', 'month', 'bln', 'periode'])) {
                $headerMap['bulan'] = $index;
            } elseif ($clean === 'staff') {
                $headerMap['staff'] = $index;
                $isMatrixFormat = true;
            } elseif ($clean === 'pbt') {
                $headerMap['pbt'] = $index;
                $isMatrixFormat = true;
            } elseif ($clean === 'kht') {
                $headerMap['kht'] = $index;
                $isMatrixFormat = true;
            } elseif ($clean === 'khl') {
                $headerMap['khl'] = $index;
                $isMatrixFormat = true;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['jenisjabatan', 'jenis', 'tipe', 'type'])) {
                $headerMap['jenis_jabatan'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['jumlah', 'count', 'total', 'qty', 'kuota'])) {
                $headerMap['jumlah'] = $index;
            }
        }

        if (!isset($headerMap['nama_jabatan'])) {
            fclose($handle);
            return back()->with('error', 'Header kolom "Nama Jabatan" tidak ditemukan dalam file CSV.');
        }

        // Month text translation helper
        $monthTextMap = [
            'jan' => 1, 'januari' => 1, 'january' => 1,
            'feb' => 2, 'februari' => 2, 'february' => 2,
            'mar' => 3, 'maret' => 3, 'march' => 3,
            'apr' => 4, 'april' => 4,
            'mei' => 5, 'may' => 5,
            'jun' => 6, 'juni' => 6, 'june' => 6,
            'jul' => 7, 'juli' => 7, 'july' => 7,
            'aug' => 8, 'agustus' => 8, 'agu' => 8, 'august' => 8,
            'sep' => 9, 'september' => 9,
            'okt' => 10, 'oktober' => 10, 'oct' => 10, 'october' => 10,
            'nov' => 11, 'november' => 11,
            'des' => 12, 'desember' => 12, 'dec' => 12, 'december' => 12
        ];

        // Replace mode: delete data for active context if replace mode selected
        if ($importMode === 'replace') {
            Mpp::where('tahun', $fallbackYear)->where('bulan', $fallbackMonth)->delete();
        }

        $insertedCount = 0;
        $updatedCount = 0;

        while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
            if (empty(array_filter($row))) {
                continue;
            }

            $jabatan = isset($headerMap['nama_jabatan']) && isset($row[$headerMap['nama_jabatan']]) ? trim($row[$headerMap['nama_jabatan']]) : '';
            if (empty($jabatan) || strtolower($jabatan) === 'total') {
                continue;
            }

            // Determine Year
            $tahun = $fallbackYear;
            if (isset($headerMap['tahun']) && isset($row[$headerMap['tahun']]) && !empty(trim($row[$headerMap['tahun']]))) {
                $tahun = (int) trim($row[$headerMap['tahun']]);
            }

            // Determine Month
            $bulan = $fallbackMonth;
            if (isset($headerMap['bulan']) && isset($row[$headerMap['bulan']]) && !empty(trim($row[$headerMap['bulan']]))) {
                $mRaw = strtolower(trim($row[$headerMap['bulan']]));
                if (is_numeric($mRaw)) {
                    $bulan = (int) $mRaw;
                } else {
                    $bulan = $monthTextMap[$mRaw] ?? $fallbackMonth;
                }
            }

            if ($isMatrixFormat) {
                // Matrix columns: Staff, PBT, KHT, KHL
                $types = [
                    'Staff' => isset($headerMap['staff']) && isset($row[$headerMap['staff']]) ? (int) preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $row[$headerMap['staff']]) : 0,
                    'PBT'   => isset($headerMap['pbt']) && isset($row[$headerMap['pbt']]) ? (int) preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $row[$headerMap['pbt']]) : 0,
                    'KHT'   => isset($headerMap['kht']) && isset($row[$headerMap['kht']]) ? (int) preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $row[$headerMap['kht']]) : 0,
                    'KHL'   => isset($headerMap['khl']) && isset($row[$headerMap['khl']]) ? (int) preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $row[$headerMap['khl']]) : 0,
                ];

                foreach ($types as $type => $count) {
                    $record = Mpp::updateOrCreate(
                        [
                            'nama_jabatan' => $jabatan,
                            'jenis_jabatan' => $type,
                            'tahun' => $tahun,
                            'bulan' => $bulan,
                        ],
                        [
                            'jumlah' => $count,
                        ]
                    );

                    if ($record->wasRecentlyCreated) {
                        $insertedCount++;
                    } else {
                        $updatedCount++;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Row format: nama_jabatan, jenis_jabatan, jumlah
                $jenis = isset($headerMap['jenis_jabatan']) && isset($row[$headerMap['jenis_jabatan']]) ? trim($row[$headerMap['jenis_jabatan']]) : 'Staff';
                $jumlah = isset($headerMap['jumlah']) && isset($row[$headerMap['jumlah']]) ? (int) preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $row[$headerMap['jumlah']]) : 0;

                // Capitalize standard types if match
                $upperJenis = strtoupper($jenis);
                if ($upperJenis === 'STAFF') $jenis = 'Staff';
                elseif ($upperJenis === 'PBT') $jenis = 'PBT';
                elseif ($upperJenis === 'KHT') $jenis = 'KHT';
                elseif ($upperJenis === 'KHL') $jenis = 'KHL';

                $record = Mpp::updateOrCreate(
                    [
                        'nama_jabatan' => $jabatan,
                        'jenis_jabatan' => $jenis,
                        'tahun' => $tahun,
                        'bulan' => $bulan,
                    ],
                    [
                        'jumlah' => $jumlah,
                    ]
                );

                if ($record->wasRecentlyCreated) {
                    $insertedCount++;
                } else {
                    $updatedCount++;
                }
            }
        }

        fclose($handle);

        $msg = "Import CSV MPP berhasil: {$insertedCount} data baru ditambahkan";
        if ($updatedCount > 0) {
            $msg .= ", {$updatedCount} data diperbarui";
        }
        $msg .= ".";

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'MPP',
            "Mengimport data MPP Jabatan dari file " . $file->getClientOriginalName() . " ({$insertedCount} baru, {$updatedCount} diperbarui)",
            ['filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(), 'inserted' => $insertedCount, 'updated' => $updatedCount]
        );

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.mpp.index', [
            'year' => $fallbackYear,
            'month' => $fallbackMonth,
        ])->with('success', $msg);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Administrasi;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Administrasi\Rekrutmen;

class RekrutmenController extends Controller

    public function index()

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Administrasi.rekrutmen');

    /**
     * Get data with filters, summary KPIs, charts aggregation, and distinct lists.
     */
    public function getData(Request $request)
    {
        $query = Rekrutmen::query();

        // 1. Filter Lokasi (Single or Array / Multi-select)
        if ($request->filled('lokasi')) {
            $lokasi = $request->input('lokasi');
            if (is_array($lokasi)) {
                $lokasiClean = array_filter($lokasi, fn($l) => $l !== 'all' && $l !== 'Semua Lokasi' && !empty($l));
                if (!empty($lokasiClean)) {
                    $query->whereIn('lokasi_rekrut', $lokasiClean);
                }
            } elseif ($lokasi !== 'all' && $lokasi !== 'Semua Lokasi') {
                $query->where('lokasi_rekrut', $lokasi);
            }
        }

        // 2. Filter Metode Rekrutmen (Online / Offline / Semua)
        if ($request->filled('metode_rekrutmen') && $request->input('metode_rekrutmen') !== 'all') {
            $metode = ucfirst(strtolower($request->input('metode_rekrutmen')));
            if (in_array($metode, ['Online', 'Offline'])) {
                $query->where('metode_rekrutmen', $metode);
            }
        } elseif ($request->filled('mode') && $request->input('mode') !== 'all') {
            $metode = ucfirst(strtolower($request->input('mode')));
            if (in_array($metode, ['Online', 'Offline'])) {
                $query->where('metode_rekrutmen', $metode);
            }
        }

        // 3. Filter Tahun
        if ($request->filled('tahun')) {
            $tahun = $request->input('tahun');
            if (is_array($tahun)) {
                $tahunClean = array_filter($tahun, fn($t) => $t !== 'all' && !empty($t));
                if (!empty($tahunClean)) {
                    $query->whereIn('tahun', $tahunClean);
                }
            } elseif ($tahun !== 'all' && !empty($tahun)) {
                $query->where('tahun', (int) $tahun);
            }
        }

        // 4. Filter Program
        if ($request->filled('program') && $request->input('program') !== 'all') {
            $query->where('program', $request->input('program'));
        }

        // 5. Filter Keyword Search
        if ($request->filled('search')) {
            $search = trim($request->input('search'));
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('lokasi_rekrut', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('metode_rekrutmen', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('program', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('tanggal', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('tahun', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('no', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        // 6. Filter Tanggal Range (optional)
        if ($request->filled('start_date') && $request->filled('end_date')) {
            $query->whereBetween('tanggal', [$request->input('start_date'), $request->input('end_date')]);
        }

        // Calculate Totals & Summary for the filtered dataset
        $allFiltered = (clone $query)->get();

        $totalHadir = (int) $allFiltered->sum('jumlah_peserta_hadir');
        $totalLolosPsikotest = (int) $allFiltered->sum('jumlah_lolos_psikotest');
        $totalHadirInterviewAwal = (int) $allFiltered->sum('jumlah_hadir_interview_awal');
        $totalLolosInterviewAwal = (int) $allFiltered->sum('jumlah_lolos_interview_awal');
        $totalLolosInterviewUser = (int) $allFiltered->sum('jumlah_lolos_interview_user');
        $totalIkutMcu = (int) $allFiltered->sum('jumlah_ikut_mcu');
        $totalLolosMcu = (int) $allFiltered->sum('jumlah_lolos_mcu');
        $totalJoinFr = (int) $allFiltered->sum('join_fr');
        $batchCount = $allFiltered->count();

        $overallPassRate = $totalHadir > 0 ? round($totalJoinFr / $totalHadir, 6) : 0;
        $avgPassRate = $batchCount > 0 ? round($allFiltered->avg('persen_lulus'), 6) : 0;

        // Funnel calculation with step-by-step conversion percentages
        $funnel = [
            [
                'stage' => 'Peserta Hadir',
                'count' => $totalHadir,
                'pct_of_total' => 100,
                'pct_of_prev' => 100,
            ],
            [
                'stage' => 'Lolos Psikotest',
                'count' => $totalLolosPsikotest,
                'pct_of_total' => $totalHadir > 0 ? round(($totalLolosPsikotest / $totalHadir) * 100, 2) : 0,
                'pct_of_prev' => $totalHadir > 0 ? round(($totalLolosPsikotest / $totalHadir) * 100, 2) : 0,
            ],
            [
                'stage' => 'Hadir Interview Awal',
                'count' => $totalHadirInterviewAwal,
                'pct_of_total' => $totalHadir > 0 ? round(($totalHadirInterviewAwal / $totalHadir) * 100, 2) : 0,
                'pct_of_prev' => $totalLolosPsikotest > 0 ? round(($totalHadirInterviewAwal / $totalLolosPsikotest) * 100, 2) : 0,
            ],
            [
                'stage' => 'Lolos Interview Awal',
                'count' => $totalLolosInterviewAwal,
                'pct_of_total' => $totalHadir > 0 ? round(($totalLolosInterviewAwal / $totalHadir) * 100, 2) : 0,
                'pct_of_prev' => $totalHadirInterviewAwal > 0 ? round(($totalLolosInterviewAwal / $totalHadirInterviewAwal) * 100, 2) : 0,
            ],
            [
                'stage' => 'Lolos Interview User',
                'count' => $totalLolosInterviewUser,
                'pct_of_total' => $totalHadir > 0 ? round(($totalLolosInterviewUser / $totalHadir) * 100, 2) : 0,
                'pct_of_prev' => $totalLolosInterviewAwal > 0 ? round(($totalLolosInterviewUser / $totalLolosInterviewAwal) * 100, 2) : 0,
            ],
            [
                'stage' => 'Ikut MCU',
                'count' => $totalIkutMcu,
                'pct_of_total' => $totalHadir > 0 ? round(($totalIkutMcu / $totalHadir) * 100, 2) : 0,
                'pct_of_prev' => $totalLolosInterviewUser > 0 ? round(($totalIkutMcu / $totalLolosInterviewUser) * 100, 2) : 0,
            ],
            [
                'stage' => 'Lolos MCU',
                'count' => $totalLolosMcu,
                'pct_of_total' => $totalHadir > 0 ? round(($totalLolosMcu / $totalHadir) * 100, 2) : 0,
                'pct_of_prev' => $totalIkutMcu > 0 ? round(($totalLolosMcu / $totalIkutMcu) * 100, 2) : 0,
            ],
            [
                'stage' => 'Join FR',
                'count' => $totalJoinFr,
                'pct_of_total' => $totalHadir > 0 ? round(($totalJoinFr / $totalHadir) * 100, 2) : 0,
                'pct_of_prev' => $totalLolosMcu > 0 ? round(($totalJoinFr / $totalLolosMcu) * 100, 2) : 0,
            ],
        ];

        // Summary & Breakdown per Metode Rekrutmen (Online vs Offline)
        $byMetode = collect(['Online', 'Offline'])->map(function ($metodeName) use ($allFiltered) {
            $items = $allFiltered->where('metode_rekrutmen', $metodeName);
            $hadir = (int) $items->sum('jumlah_peserta_hadir');
            $join = (int) $items->sum('join_fr');
            $psiko = (int) $items->sum('jumlah_lolos_psikotest');
            $intUser = (int) $items->sum('jumlah_lolos_interview_user');
            return [
                'metode' => $metodeName,
                'batch_count' => $items->count(),
                'total_peserta' => $hadir,
                'total_psikotest' => $psiko,
                'total_interview_user' => $intUser,
                'total_join' => $join,
                'persen_lulus' => $hadir > 0 ? round(($join / $hadir) * 100, 2) : 0,
                'persen_lulus_raw' => $hadir > 0 ? round($join / $hadir, 6) : 0,
            ];
        })->values();

        // Group by Lokasi for Bar Chart & Summary Table
        $byLocation = $allFiltered->groupBy('lokasi_rekrut')->map(function ($items, $lokasi) {
            $hadir = (int) $items->sum('jumlah_peserta_hadir');
            $join = (int) $items->sum('join_fr');
            return [
                'lokasi' => $lokasi,
                'batch_count' => $items->count(),
                'total_peserta' => $hadir,
                'total_psikotest' => (int) $items->sum('jumlah_lolos_psikotest'),
                'total_interview_user' => (int) $items->sum('jumlah_lolos_interview_user'),
                'total_join' => $join,
                'persen_lulus' => $hadir > 0 ? round(($join / $hadir) * 100, 2) : 0,
                'persen_lulus_raw' => $hadir > 0 ? round($join / $hadir, 6) : 0,
            ];
        })->values()->sortByDesc('total_peserta')->values();

        // Group by Tahun for Trend Line Chart
        $byYear = $allFiltered->groupBy('tahun')->map(function ($items, $year) {
            $hadir = (int) $items->sum('jumlah_peserta_hadir');
            $join = (int) $items->sum('join_fr');
            return [
                'tahun' => (int) $year,
                'batch_count' => $items->count(),
                'total_peserta' => $hadir,
                'total_psikotest' => (int) $items->sum('jumlah_lolos_psikotest'),
                'total_interview_user' => (int) $items->sum('jumlah_lolos_interview_user'),
                'total_join' => $join,
                'persen_lulus' => $hadir > 0 ? round(($join / $hadir) * 100, 2) : 0,
            ];
        })->values()->sortBy('tahun')->values();

        // Sorting for table
        $sortBy = $request->input('sort_by', 'no');
        $sortOrder = $request->input('sort_order', 'asc');
        $validColumns = [
            'id', 'no', 'lokasi_rekrut', 'metode_rekrutmen', 'program', 'tanggal', 'tahun',
            'jumlah_peserta_hadir', 'jumlah_lolos_psikotest', 'jumlah_hadir_interview_awal',
            'jumlah_lolos_interview_awal', 'jumlah_lolos_interview_user', 'jumlah_ikut_mcu',
            'jumlah_lolos_mcu', 'join_fr', 'persen_lulus',
        ];

        if (in_array($sortBy, $validColumns)) {
            $query->orderBy($sortBy, strtolower($sortOrder) === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            $query->orderBy('no', 'asc');
        }

        // Pagination or All
        $perPage = (int) $request->input('per_page', 25);
        if ($perPage === -1 || $request->input('all') === 'true') {
            $paginated = $query->get();
            $dataItems = $paginated;
            $paginationInfo = [
                'total' => $paginated->count(),
                'per_page' => $paginated->count(),
                'current_page' => 1,
                'last_page' => 1,
            ];
        } else {
            $paginated = $query->paginate($perPage);
            $dataItems = $paginated->items();
            $paginationInfo = [
                'total' => $paginated->total(),
                'per_page' => $paginated->perPage(),
                'current_page' => $paginated->currentPage(),
                'last_page' => $paginated->lastPage(),
            ];
        }

        // Distinct options for dropdowns
        $locations = Rekrutmen::select('lokasi_rekrut')
            ->distinct()
            ->orderBy('lokasi_rekrut')
            ->pluck('lokasi_rekrut');

        $years = Rekrutmen::select('tahun')
            ->whereNotNull('tahun')
            ->distinct()
            ->orderBy('tahun', 'desc')
            ->pluck('tahun');

        $programs = Rekrutmen::select('program')
            ->distinct()
            ->orderBy('program')
            ->pluck('program');

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'data' => $dataItems,
            'pagination' => $paginationInfo,
            'summary' => [
                'total_peserta_hadir' => $totalHadir,
                'total_lolos_psikotest' => $totalLolosPsikotest,
                'total_hadir_interview_awal' => $totalHadirInterviewAwal,
                'total_lolos_interview_awal' => $totalLolosInterviewAwal,
                'total_lolos_interview_user' => $totalLolosInterviewUser,
                'total_ikut_mcu' => $totalIkutMcu,
                'total_lolos_mcu' => $totalLolosMcu,
                'total_join_fr' => $totalJoinFr,
                'overall_pass_rate' => $overallPassRate,
                'overall_pass_rate_pct' => round($overallPassRate * 100, 2),
                'avg_pass_rate' => $avgPassRate,
                'avg_pass_rate_pct' => round($avgPassRate * 100, 2),
                'batch_count' => $batchCount,
            ],
            'funnel' => $funnel,
            'charts' => [
                'by_location' => $byLocation,
                'by_year' => $byYear,
                'by_metode' => $byMetode,
            ],
            'filters' => [
                'locations' => $locations,
                'years' => $years,
                'programs' => $programs,
                'methods' => ['Online', 'Offline'],
            ],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created recruitment batch.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
            'lokasi_rekrut' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'metode_rekrutmen' => 'required|in:Online,Offline,online,offline',
            'program' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'tanggal' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'tahun' => 'required|integer|min:2000|max:2099',
            'jumlah_peserta_hadir' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_lolos_psikotest' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_hadir_interview_awal' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_lolos_interview_awal' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_lolos_interview_user' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_ikut_mcu' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_lolos_mcu' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'join_fr' => 'required|integer|min:0',
        ]);

        if ($validator->fails()) {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Validasi data gagal.',
                'errors' => $validator->errors(),
            ], 422);
        }

        $validated = $validator->validated();
        $validated['metode_rekrutmen'] = ucfirst(strtolower($validated['metode_rekrutmen']));

        // Stage validations (A step can't exceed previous step)
        $stageErrors = $this->validateStages($validated);
        if (!empty($stageErrors)) {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Validasi tahapan seleksi gagal.',
                'errors' => $stageErrors,
            ], 422);
        }

        // Auto determine 'no'
        $nextNo = ((int) Rekrutmen::max('no')) + 1;
        $validated['no'] = $request->input('no', $nextNo);

        $hadir = (int) $validated['jumlah_peserta_hadir'];
        $join = (int) $validated['join_fr'];
        $validated['persen_lulus'] = $hadir > 0 ? round($join / $hadir, 6) : 0;

        $record = Rekrutmen::create($validated);

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'message' => 'Data rekrutmen berhasil ditambahkan!',
            'data' => $record,
        ], 201);
    }

    /**
     * Update an existing recruitment batch.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $record = Rekrutmen::findOrFail($id);

        $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
            'lokasi_rekrut' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'metode_rekrutmen' => 'required|in:Online,Offline,online,offline',
            'program' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'tanggal' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'tahun' => 'required|integer|min:2000|max:2099',
            'jumlah_peserta_hadir' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_lolos_psikotest' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_hadir_interview_awal' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_lolos_interview_awal' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_lolos_interview_user' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_ikut_mcu' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_lolos_mcu' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'join_fr' => 'required|integer|min:0',
        ]);

        if ($validator->fails()) {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Validasi data gagal.',
                'errors' => $validator->errors(),
            ], 422);
        }

        $validated = $validator->validated();
        $validated['metode_rekrutmen'] = ucfirst(strtolower($validated['metode_rekrutmen']));

        $stageErrors = $this->validateStages($validated);
        if (!empty($stageErrors)) {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Validasi tahapan seleksi gagal.',
                'errors' => $stageErrors,
            ], 422);
        }

        $hadir = (int) $validated['jumlah_peserta_hadir'];
        $join = (int) $validated['join_fr'];
        $validated['persen_lulus'] = $hadir > 0 ? round($join / $hadir, 6) : 0;

        if ($request->filled('no')) {
            $validated['no'] = (int) $request->input('no');
        }

        $record->update($validated);

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'message' => 'Data rekrutmen berhasil diperbarui!',
            'data' => $record,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Remove a recruitment batch.
     */
    public function destroy($id)
    {
        $record = Rekrutmen::findOrFail($id);
        $record->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'message' => 'Data rekrutmen berhasil dihapus!',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Remove all recruitment data.
     */
    public function destroyAll()
    {
        $count = Rekrutmen::count();
        Rekrutmen::truncate();

        ActivityLog::log('Hapus', 'Rekrutmen', 'Seluruh data rekrutmen berhasil dikosongkan.', [
            'count' => $count,
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'message' => 'Seluruh data rekrutmen berhasil dikosongkan.',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Import data from CSV file with preview, validation, and mode (append / replace).
     */
    public function importCsv(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt|max:10240',
            'mode' => 'nullable|in:append,replace',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('file');
        $mode = $request->input('mode', 'append');

        $filePath = $file->getRealPath();
        $handle = fopen($filePath, 'r');
        if ($handle === false) {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Gagal membaca file CSV.',
            ], 400);
        }

        $header = fgetcsv($handle, 10000, ',');
        if (!$header) {
            fclose($handle);
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'File CSV kosong atau format tidak valid.',
            ], 400);
        }

        // Clean headers
        $cleanHeader = array_map(function ($col) {
            $clean = trim($col);
            $clean = preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1F\x80-\xFF]/', '', $clean);
            return strtoupper($clean);
        }, $header);

        // Required column signatures
        $requiredSignatures = [
            'LOKASI' => ['LOKASI REKRUT', 'LOKASI', 'LOKASI_REKRUT'],
            'METODE' => ['METODE REKRUTMEN', 'METODE', 'METODE_REKRUTMEN', 'TIPE REKRUTMEN', 'TIPE'],
            'PROGRAM' => ['PROGRAM', 'NAMA PROGRAM', 'BATCH'],
            'TANGGAL' => ['TANGGAL', 'DATE'],
            'HADIR' => ['JUMLAH PESERTA HADIR', 'PESERTA HADIR', 'HADIR'],
            'JOIN' => ['JOIN FR', 'JOIN', 'JOIN_FR', 'LULUS'],
        ];

        // Map column indices
        $columnIndex = [];
        foreach ($cleanHeader as $idx => $name) {
            foreach ($requiredSignatures as $key => $aliases) {
                if (in_array($name, $aliases)) {
                    $columnIndex[$key] = $idx;
                }
            }
            if (str_contains($name, 'PSIKOTEST')) $columnIndex['PSIKOTEST'] = $idx;
            if (str_contains($name, 'HADIR INTERVIEW AWAL') || str_contains($name, 'HADIR INT AWAL')) $columnIndex['HADIR_INT_AWAL'] = $idx;
            if (str_contains($name, 'LOLOS INTERVIEW AWAL') || str_contains($name, 'LOLOS INT AWAL')) $columnIndex['LOLOS_INT_AWAL'] = $idx;
            if (str_contains($name, 'INTERVIEW USER') || str_contains($name, 'INT USER')) $columnIndex['INT_USER'] = $idx;
            if (str_contains($name, 'IKUT MCU')) $columnIndex['IKUT_MCU'] = $idx;
            if (str_contains($name, 'LOLOS MCU')) $columnIndex['LOLOS_MCU'] = $idx;
            if (str_contains($name, 'TAHUN') || str_contains($name, 'YEAR')) $columnIndex['TAHUN'] = $idx;
            if (str_contains($name, 'NO') || str_contains($name, 'NOMOR')) $columnIndex['NO'] = $idx;
        }

        $rowsToInsert = [];
        $errors = [];
        $rowNumber = 1; // 1 is header

        while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 10000, ',')) !== false) {
            $rowNumber++;
            if (empty(array_filter($row, fn($v) => trim($v) !== ''))) {
                continue; // Skip empty row
            }

            // Extract values
            $lokasi = trim($row[$columnIndex['LOKASI'] ?? 1] ?? '');

            // Extract & strictly validate METODE REKRUTMEN
            $metodeRaw = trim($row[$columnIndex['METODE'] ?? 2] ?? '');
            $metodeNormalized = strtolower($metodeRaw);
            if (!in_array($metodeNormalized, ['online', 'offline'])) {
                // If column was not found by name, check if index 2 is indeed Online/Offline or if it's program
                if (!in_array($metodeNormalized, ['online', 'offline'])) {
                    $errors[] = [
                        'row' => $rowNumber,
                        'reason' => 'Kolom METODE REKRUTMEN tidak valid (wajib bernilai "Online" atau "Offline", ditemukan: "' . $metodeRaw . '")'
                    ];
                    continue;
                }
            }
            $metode = ucfirst($metodeNormalized);

            $program = trim($row[$columnIndex['PROGRAM'] ?? 3] ?? '');
            $tanggal = trim($row[$columnIndex['TANGGAL'] ?? 4] ?? '');
            $tahunStr = trim($row[$columnIndex['TAHUN'] ?? 5] ?? '');
            $hadirStr = trim($row[$columnIndex['HADIR'] ?? 6] ?? '0');
            $psikoStr = trim($row[$columnIndex['PSIKOTEST'] ?? 7] ?? '0');
            $hadirIntAwalStr = trim($row[$columnIndex['HADIR_INT_AWAL'] ?? 8] ?? '0');
            $lolosIntAwalStr = trim($row[$columnIndex['LOLOS_INT_AWAL'] ?? 9] ?? '0');
            $intUserStr = trim($row[$columnIndex['INT_USER'] ?? 10] ?? '0');
            $ikutMcuStr = trim($row[$columnIndex['IKUT_MCU'] ?? 11] ?? '0');
            $lolosMcuStr = trim($row[$columnIndex['LOLOS_MCU'] ?? 12] ?? '0');
            $joinStr = trim($row[$columnIndex['JOIN'] ?? 13] ?? '0');
            $noStr = trim($row[$columnIndex['NO'] ?? 0] ?? '');

            // Validations
            if (empty($lokasi)) {
                $errors[] = ['row' => $rowNumber, 'reason' => 'Lokasi rekrut kosong'];
                continue;
            }
            if (empty($program)) {
                $errors[] = ['row' => $rowNumber, 'reason' => 'Program kosong'];
                continue;
            }
            if (empty($tanggal)) {
                $errors[] = ['row' => $rowNumber, 'reason' => 'Tanggal kosong'];
                continue;
            }

            $hadir = (int) round((float) $hadirStr);
            $psiko = (int) round((float) $psikoStr);
            $hadirIntAwal = (int) round((float) $hadirIntAwalStr);
            $lolosIntAwal = (int) round((float) $lolosIntAwalStr);
            $intUser = (int) round((float) $intUserStr);
            $ikutMcu = (int) round((float) $ikutMcuStr);
            $lolosMcu = (int) round((float) $lolosMcuStr);
            $join = (int) round((float) $joinStr);

            $tahun = (int) $tahunStr;
            if ($tahun <= 0 && preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $tanggal, $m)) {
                $tahun = (int) $m[1];
            }
            if ($tahun <= 0) {
                $tahun = (int) date('Y');
            }

            // Stage validation logic check
            if ($hadir < 0 || $join < 0) {
                $errors[] = ['row' => $rowNumber, 'reason' => 'Angka peserta atau join tidak boleh negatif'];
                continue;
            }

            $persenLulus = $hadir > 0 ? round($join / $hadir, 6) : 0;

            $rowsToInsert[] = [
                'no' => !empty($noStr) ? (int) $noStr : $rowNumber - 1,
                'lokasi_rekrut' => $lokasi,
                'metode_rekrutmen' => $metode,
                'program' => $program,
                'tanggal' => $tanggal,
                'tahun' => $tahun,
                'jumlah_peserta_hadir' => $hadir,
                'jumlah_lolos_psikotest' => $psiko,
                'jumlah_hadir_interview_awal' => $hadirIntAwal,
                'jumlah_lolos_interview_awal' => $lolosIntAwal,
                'jumlah_lolos_interview_user' => $intUser,
                'jumlah_ikut_mcu' => $ikutMcu,
                'jumlah_lolos_mcu' => $lolosMcu,
                'join_fr' => $join,
                'persen_lulus' => $persenLulus,
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ];
        }

        fclose($handle);

        if (empty($rowsToInsert) && !empty($errors)) {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Semua baris dalam file CSV gagal diproses karena validasi kolom atau format.',
                'errors' => $errors,
                'success_count' => 0,
                'failed_count' => count($errors),
            ], 422);
        }

        DB::beginTransaction();
        try {
            if ($mode === 'replace') {
                Rekrutmen::truncate();
            }

            // Insert in chunks of 100
            foreach (array_chunk($rowsToInsert, 100) as $chunk) {
                Rekrutmen::insert($chunk);
            }

            DB::commit();

            ActivityLog::log(
                'Import',
                'Rekrutmen',
                "Mengimport " . count($rowsToInsert) . " data rekrutmen dari file " . $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                ['filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(), 'count' => count($rowsToInsert), 'mode' => $mode]
            );

            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'success',
                'message' => "Import CSV berhasil! {$mode} " . count($rowsToInsert) . " data.",
                'success_count' => count($rowsToInsert),
                'failed_count' => count($errors),
                'errors' => $errors,
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Gagal menyimpan data import: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Export filtered data to CSV.
     */
    public function exportCsv(Request $request)
    {
        $query = Rekrutmen::query();

        if ($request->filled('lokasi')) {
            $lokasi = $request->input('lokasi');
            if (is_array($lokasi)) {
                $lokasiClean = array_filter($lokasi, fn($l) => $l !== 'all' && $l !== 'Semua Lokasi' && !empty($l));
                if (!empty($lokasiClean)) {
                    $query->whereIn('lokasi_rekrut', $lokasiClean);
                }
            } elseif ($lokasi !== 'all' && $lokasi !== 'Semua Lokasi') {
                $query->where('lokasi_rekrut', $lokasi);
            }
        }

        if ($request->filled('metode_rekrutmen') && $request->input('metode_rekrutmen') !== 'all') {
            $metode = ucfirst(strtolower($request->input('metode_rekrutmen')));
            if (in_array($metode, ['Online', 'Offline'])) {
                $query->where('metode_rekrutmen', $metode);
            }
        } elseif ($request->filled('mode') && $request->input('mode') !== 'all') {
            $metode = ucfirst(strtolower($request->input('mode')));
            if (in_array($metode, ['Online', 'Offline'])) {
                $query->where('metode_rekrutmen', $metode);
            }
        }

        if ($request->filled('tahun')) {
            $tahun = $request->input('tahun');
            if (is_array($tahun)) {
                $tahunClean = array_filter($tahun, fn($t) => $t !== 'all' && !empty($t));
                if (!empty($tahunClean)) {
                    $query->whereIn('tahun', $tahunClean);
                }
            } elseif ($tahun !== 'all' && !empty($tahun)) {
                $query->where('tahun', (int) $tahun);
            }
        }

        if ($request->filled('program') && $request->input('program') !== 'all') {
            $query->where('program', $request->input('program'));
        }

        if ($request->filled('search')) {
            $search = trim($request->input('search'));
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('lokasi_rekrut', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('metode_rekrutmen', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('program', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('tanggal', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('tahun', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $records = $query->orderBy('no', 'asc')->get();

        $filename = 'Data_Rekrutmen_Export_' . date('Ymd_His') . '.xlsx';
        $headers = [
            'NO', 'LOKASI REKRUT', 'METODE REKRUTMEN', 'PROGRAM', 'TANGGAL', 'TAHUN',
            'JUMLAH PESERTA HADIR', 'JUMLAH LOLOS PSIKOTEST', 'JUMLAH HADIR INTERVIEW AWAL',
            'JUMLAH LOLOS INTERVIEW AWAL', 'JUMLAH LOLOS INTERVIEW USER', 'JUMLAH IKUT MCU',
            'JUMLAH LOLOS MCU', 'JOIN FR', '% LULUS',
        ];

        $totalHadir = 0; $totalPsiko = 0; $totalHadirInt = 0; $totalLolosInt = 0;
        $totalIntUser = 0; $totalIkutMcu = 0; $totalLolosMcu = 0; $totalJoin = 0;

        $dataRows = [];
        foreach ($records as $index => $row) {
            $totalHadir += $row->jumlah_peserta_hadir;
            $totalPsiko += $row->jumlah_lolos_psikotest;
            $totalHadirInt += $row->jumlah_hadir_interview_awal;
            $totalLolosInt += $row->jumlah_lolos_interview_awal;
            $totalIntUser += $row->jumlah_lolos_interview_user;
            $totalIkutMcu += $row->jumlah_ikut_mcu;
            $totalLolosMcu += $row->jumlah_lolos_mcu;
            $totalJoin += $row->join_fr;

            $dataRows[] = [
                $row->no ?? ($index + 1),
                $row->lokasi_rekrut,
                $row->metode_rekrutmen,
                $row->program,
                $row->tanggal,
                $row->tahun,
                $row->jumlah_peserta_hadir,
                $row->jumlah_lolos_psikotest,
                $row->jumlah_hadir_interview_awal,
                $row->jumlah_lolos_interview_awal,
                $row->jumlah_lolos_interview_user,
                $row->jumlah_ikut_mcu,
                $row->jumlah_lolos_mcu,
                $row->join_fr,
                $row->persen_lulus,
            ];
        }

        $totalPersen = $totalHadir > 0 ? round($totalJoin / $totalHadir, 6) : 0;
        $dataRows[] = [
            'TOTAL', '', '', '', '', '',
            $totalHadir, $totalPsiko, $totalHadirInt, $totalLolosInt,
            $totalIntUser, $totalIkutMcu, $totalLolosMcu, $totalJoin, $totalPersen,
        ];

        return ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Data Rekrutmen');
    }

    /**
     * Helper to validate stage logic (Step counts cannot exceed previous steps).
     */
    private function validateStages(array $data): array
    {
        $errors = [];
        $hadir = (int) ($data['jumlah_peserta_hadir'] ?? 0);
        $psiko = (int) ($data['jumlah_lolos_psikotest'] ?? 0);
        $hadirIntAwal = (int) ($data['jumlah_hadir_interview_awal'] ?? 0);
        $lolosIntAwal = (int) ($data['jumlah_lolos_interview_awal'] ?? 0);
        $intUser = (int) ($data['jumlah_lolos_interview_user'] ?? 0);
        $ikutMcu = (int) ($data['jumlah_ikut_mcu'] ?? 0);
        $lolosMcu = (int) ($data['jumlah_lolos_mcu'] ?? 0);
        $join = (int) ($data['join_fr'] ?? 0);

        if ($psiko > $hadir) {
            $errors['jumlah_lolos_psikotest'] = ['Jumlah lolos psikotest (' . $psiko . ') tidak boleh melebihi jumlah peserta hadir (' . $hadir . ').'];
        }
        if ($hadirIntAwal > $hadir) {
            $errors['jumlah_hadir_interview_awal'] = ['Jumlah hadir interview awal (' . $hadirIntAwal . ') tidak boleh melebihi peserta hadir (' . $hadir . ').'];
        }
        if ($lolosIntAwal > $hadirIntAwal && $hadirIntAwal > 0) {
            $errors['jumlah_lolos_interview_awal'] = ['Jumlah lolos interview awal (' . $lolosIntAwal . ') tidak boleh melebihi hadir interview awal (' . $hadirIntAwal . ').'];
        }
        if ($intUser > $hadir) {
            $errors['jumlah_lolos_interview_user'] = ['Jumlah lolos interview user (' . $intUser . ') tidak boleh melebihi peserta hadir (' . $hadir . ').'];
        }
        if ($ikutMcu > $hadir) {
            $errors['jumlah_ikut_mcu'] = ['Jumlah ikut MCU (' . $ikutMcu . ') tidak boleh melebihi peserta hadir (' . $hadir . ').'];
        }
        if ($lolosMcu > $ikutMcu && ikutMcu > 0) {
            $errors['jumlah_lolos_mcu'] = ['Jumlah lolos MCU (' . $lolosMcu . ') tidak boleh melebihi ikut MCU (' . $ikutMcu . ').'];
        }
        if ($join > $hadir) {
            $errors['join_fr'] = ['Jumlah Join FR (' . $join . ') tidak boleh melebihi peserta hadir (' . $hadir . ').'];
        }

        return $errors;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class PushNotificationController extends Controller
{
    public function subscribe(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'endpoint' => 'required',
            'keys.auth' => 'required',
            'keys.p256dh' => 'required'
        ]);

        $trainee = $request->user();
        if (!$trainee) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Unauthorized'], 401);
        }

        $trainee->updatePushSubscription(
            $request->endpoint,
            $request->keys['p256dh'],
            $request->keys['auth']
        );

        return response()->json(['message' => 'Subscription successful'], 200);
    }
}

                          ->whereNull('end_date');
                });
