    public function tasks(Request $request)
    {
        $trainee = $request->user();

        // Ambil daftar tugas untuk program training trainee ini
        $dbTasks = Task::with(['dailyClass', 'submissions' => function($q) use ($trainee) {
            $q->where('trainee_id', $trainee->id);
        }])->whereHas('dailyClass', function($q) use ($trainee) {
            $q->whereHas('attendances', function($subQ) use ($trainee) {
                $subQ->where('trainee_id', $trainee->id)
                     ->whereNotIn('status', ['alpha', 'belum']);
            });
        })->orderBy('deadline', 'desc')->get();

        $tasks = $dbTasks->map(function($task) {
            $sub = $task->submissions->first();
            return [
                'id' => $task->id,
                'title' => $task->title,
                'session' => $task->dailyClass->title,
                'deadline_formatted' => $task->deadline ? $task->deadline->format('d M Y H:i') : '-',
                'deadline_raw' => $task->deadline,
                'status' => $sub && $sub->status == 'sudah' ? 'Sudah' : 'Belum',
                'submission' => $sub ? [
                    'submitted_at' => $sub->submitted_at ? $sub->submitted_at->format('d M Y H:i') : null,
                    'file_paths' => is_array($sub->file_path) ? array_map(fn($f) => Storage::url($f), $sub->file_path) : (is_string($sub->file_path) ? [Storage::url($sub->file_path)] : [])
                ] : null
            ];
        });

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'data' => $tasks
        ]);
    }

    public function submitTask(Request $request, Task $task)
    {
        $trainee = $request->user();

        $request->validate([
            'task_files' => 'required|array',
            'task_files.*' => 'required|file|max:2048' // max 2mb per file
        ], [
            'task_files.required' => 'File tugas wajib diunggah.',
            'task_files.*.max' => 'Ukuran file maksimal adalah 2MB, silakan kompres file Anda.',
        ]);

        $paths = [];
        if ($request->hasFile('task_files')) {
            foreach ($request->file('task_files') as $file) {
                // Check if file is an image
                if (str_starts_with($file->getMimeType(), 'image/')) {
                    $imagePath = $file->getRealPath();
                    $mime = $file->getMimeType();

                    // Create image resource based on type
                    $image = null;
                    if ($mime == 'image/jpeg' || $mime == 'image/jpg') {
                        $image = @imagecreatefromjpeg($imagePath);
                    } elseif ($mime == 'image/png') {
                        $image = @imagecreatefrompng($imagePath);
                    }

                    if ($image) {
                        // Create target directory if not exists
                        $targetDir = storage_path('app/public/task_submissions');
                        if (!file_exists($targetDir)) {
                            mkdir($targetDir, 0755, true);
                        }

                        // Save as highly compressed JPEG
                        $filename = 'task_submissions/' . \Illuminate\Support\Str::random(40) . '.jpg';
                        imagejpeg($image, storage_path('app/public/' . $filename), 50); // 50% quality for high compression
                        imagedestroy($image);

                        $paths[] = $filename;
                        continue;
                    }
                }

                // Fallback for non-images or if GD fails
                $originalName = $file->getClientOriginalName();
                $safeName = time() . '_' . rand(1000, 9999) . '_' . preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\.-]/', '', $originalName);
                $paths[] = $file->storeAs('task_submissions', $safeName, 'public');
            }
        }

        TaskSubmission::updateOrCreate(
            ['task_id' => $task->id, 'trainee_id' => $trainee->id],
            [
                'file_path' => $paths,
                'status' => 'sudah',
                'submitted_at' => now()
            ]
        );

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'message' => 'Tugas berhasil diunggah.'
        ]);
    }

    public function submitAttendance(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'qr_token' => 'nullable|string'
        ]);

        $trainee = $request->user();

        // Trim token untuk menghindari error spasi berlebih dari input manual
        $rawToken = trim($request->qr_token ?? '');

        if (empty($rawToken) || strtolower($rawToken) === 'manual') {
            $today = now()->format('Y-m-d');

            // Cari kelas aktif hari ini seperti di dashboard
            $todayAttendanceRecord = \App\Models\Attendance::where('trainee_id', $trainee->id)
                ->whereHas('dailyClass', function($q) use ($today) {
                    $q->where(function ($query) use ($today) {
                        $query->whereDate('date', '<=', $today)
                              ->whereDate('end_date', '>=', $today);
                    })->orWhere(function ($query) use ($today) {
                        $query->whereDate('date', $today)
                              ->whereNull('end_date');
                    });
                })->first();

            if (!$todayAttendanceRecord) {
                return response()->json([
                    'status' => 'error',
                    'message' => 'Tidak ada jadwal kelas aktif hari ini untuk Anda.'
                ], 404);
            }

            $dailyClass = $todayAttendanceRecord->dailyClass;
            $attendanceDate = $today;
        } else {
            $parts = explode('|', $rawToken);
            $token = $parts[0];
            $attendanceDate = isset($parts[1]) ? $parts[1] : date('Y-m-d');

            // Cari kelas harian berdasarkan token QR
            $dailyClass = \App\Models\DailyClass::where('qr_code_token', $token)
                ->orWhere('qr_code_token', 'like', $token . '%')
                ->first();

            if (!$dailyClass) {
                return response()->json([
                    'status' => 'error',
                    'message' => 'QR Code tidak valid atau sudah kadaluarsa.'
                ], 404);
            }
        }

        // Cek apakah trainee memiliki record absensi di kelas ini (menandakan dia terdaftar di kelas)
        $isRegistered = \App\Models\Attendance::where('daily_class_id', $dailyClass->id)
            ->where('trainee_id', $trainee->id)
            ->exists();

        if (!$isRegistered) {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Anda tidak terdaftar dalam kelas ini.'
            ], 403);
        }

        // Ambil data absensi, atau BUAT OTOMATIS jika belum ada di database
        $attendance = \App\Models\Attendance::firstOrCreate(
            ['daily_class_id' => $dailyClass->id, 'trainee_id' => $trainee->id, 'attendance_date' => $attendanceDate],
            ['status' => 'belum']
        );

        if ($attendance->status === 'hadir') {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Anda sudah melakukan absensi untuk kelas ini sebelumnya.'
            ], 400);
        }

        // Update status absensi
        $attendance->update([
            'status' => 'hadir',
            'scanned_at' => now()
        ]);

        // Dispatch job untuk update/create Training Record langsung secara sync
        \App\Jobs\UpdateTrainingRecordJob::dispatchSync($trainee->id, $dailyClass->id, $attendanceDate);

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'message' => 'Absensi berhasil! Anda tercatat hadir di kelas ' . $dailyClass->title
        ]);
    }
    public function attendances(Request $request)
    {
        $trainee = $request->user();

        $history = \App\Models\Attendance::with('dailyClass')
            ->where('trainee_id', $trainee->id)
            ->orderBy('updated_at', 'desc')
            ->get()->map(function($att) {
                return [
                    'id' => $att->id,
                    'session' => $att->dailyClass ? $att->dailyClass->title : 'Materi',
                    'date' => $att->dailyClass ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($att->dailyClass->date)->format('d M Y') : '-',
                    'status' => ucfirst($att->status)
                ];
            });
        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'data' => $history
        ]);
    }
    public function deleteTaskSubmission(Request $request, \App\Models\Task $task)
    {
        $trainee = $request->user();

        $submission = \App\Models\TaskSubmission::where('task_id', $task->id)
            ->where('trainee_id', $trainee->id)
            ->first();
        if ($submission) {
            // (Opsional) Hapus file fisik dari storage jika ada
            if (is_array($submission->file_path)) {
                foreach ($submission->file_path as $path) {
                    \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage::disk('public')->delete($path);
                }
            } else if (is_string($submission->file_path)) {
                \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage::disk('public')->delete($submission->file_path);
            }
            // Hapus data pengumpulan dari database
            $submission->delete();
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'success',
                'message' => 'Pengumpulan tugas berhasil dibatalkan.'
            ]);
        }
        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'error',
            'message' => 'Tugas belum dikumpulkan.'
        ], 404);
    }

    public function pendingEvaluations()
    {
        $trainee = auth()->user();
        $today = date('Y-m-d');

        // Cari materi/kelas yang evaluasinya sudah dibuka oleh Admin
        // dan trainee hadir (status != alpha/belum),
        // tapi trainee belum mengisi evaluasi.
        $pendingClasses = \App\Models\DailyClass::where('is_evaluation_open', true)
            ->whereHas('attendances', function ($query) use ($trainee) {
                $query->where('trainee_id', $trainee->id)
                      ->whereNotIn('status', ['alpha', 'belum']);
            })
            ->whereDoesntHave('traineeEvaluations', function ($query) use ($trainee) {
                $query->where('trainee_id', $trainee->id);
            })
            ->get(['id', 'title', 'trainer_name', 'date']);

        return response()->json($pendingClasses);
    }

    public function submitEvaluation(Request $request, $dailyClassId)
    {
        $trainee = auth()->user();

        $dailyClass = \App\Models\DailyClass::findOrFail($dailyClassId);

        $exists = \App\Models\TraineeEvaluation::where('trainee_id', $trainee->id)
            ->where('daily_class_id', $dailyClass->id)
            ->exists();

        if ($exists) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Anda sudah mengisi evaluasi untuk sesi ini.'], 400);
        }

        // Verifikasi kehadiran: Pastikan Trainee benar-benar HADIR di setidaknya 1 hari sesi kelas ini
        $hasAttended = \App\Models\Attendance::where('trainee_id', $trainee->id)
            ->where('daily_class_id', $dailyClass->id)
            ->whereNotIn('status', ['alpha', 'belum'])
            ->exists();

        if (!$hasAttended) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Anda tidak dapat mengisi evaluasi karena status Anda tidak hadir di kelas ini.'], 403);
        }

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'answers' => 'required|array|min:12', // 12 questions
            'answers.*' => 'required|in:A,B,C,D,E',
            'explanation_de' => 'nullable|string',
            'kesan_pesan' => 'required|string',
        ]);

        // Validate explanation if D or E is present
        $needsExplanation = in_array('D', $validated['answers']) || in_array('E', $validated['answers']);
        if ($needsExplanation && empty($validated['explanation_de'])) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Penjelasan wajib diisi karena Anda memberikan nilai D atau E.'], 400);
        }

        $evaluation = \App\Models\TraineeEvaluation::create([
            'trainee_id' => $trainee->id,
            'daily_class_id' => $dailyClass->id,
            'answers' => $validated['answers'],
            'explanation_de' => $validated['explanation_de'],
            'kesan_pesan' => $validated['kesan_pesan'],
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Evaluasi berhasil dikirim.',
            'data' => $evaluation
        ], 201);
    }

    public function downloadCertificate(Request $request, $dailyClassId)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $dailyClass = \App\Models\DailyClass::findOrFail($dailyClassId);

        $attendance = $dailyClass->attendances()->where('trainee_id', $user->id)->first();

        if (!$attendance || !$attendance->is_passed) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Sertifikat tidak tersedia.'], 403);
        }

        $pdf = \Barryvdh\DomPDF\Facade\Pdf::loadView('admin.non-reguler.daily_classes.certificate', [
            'traineeName' => $user->name,
            'className' => $dailyClass->title,
            'certDescription' => $dailyClass->cert_description,
            'certSignerName' => $dailyClass->cert_signer_name,
            'certSignerRole' => $dailyClass->cert_signer_role,
            'certDate' => $dailyClass->cert_date ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($dailyClass->cert_date)->translatedFormat('d F Y') : \Carbon\Carbon::now()->translatedFormat('d F Y')
        ])->setPaper('a4', 'landscape');

        return response($pdf->output(), 200)
            ->header('Content-Type', 'application/pdf')
            ->header('Content-Disposition', 'inline; filename="Sertifikat_' . str_replace(' ', '_', $user->name) . '.pdf"');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Program\TrainingRecord;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class TrainingRecordExportController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Export training records for external system integration (e.g. Peta SDM)
     *
     * @param Request $request
     * @return JsonResponse
     */
    public function export(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $perPage = (int) $request->input('per_page', 100);
        if ($perPage < 1) $perPage = 100;
        if ($perPage > 1000) $perPage = 1000;

        $query = TrainingRecord::query()->with(['reguler', 'nonReguler']);

        // Filter by 'since' date parameter (if specified)
        if ($request->filled('since')) {
            try {
                $sinceDate = Carbon::parse($request->input('since'));
                $query->where(function ($q) use ($sinceDate) {
                    $q->where('updated_at', '>=', $sinceDate)
                      ->orWhere('created_at', '>=', $sinceDate);
                });
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                return response()->json([
                    'error' => 'Invalid since date format. Please use ISO date format (e.g. YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).'
                ], 422);
            }
        }

        // Order deterministically
        $query->orderBy('id', 'asc');

        $paginated = $query->paginate($perPage);

        $transformedData = collect($paginated->items())->map(function (TrainingRecord $record) {
            $act = $record->activity();

            // Calculate jml_hari
            $rawJmlHari = $record->jml_hari ?: ($act?->jumlah_hari ?? $act?->total_hari ?? $act?->Total_training_days ?? 0);
            $jmlHari = is_numeric($rawJmlHari) ? (int) $rawJmlHari : 0;

            // Calculate jam_pelatihan (handles both Reguler & Non-Reguler)
            $rawTotalJam = $record->total_jam ?: ($act?->total_jam ?? $act?->Total_training_days ?? $record->activityHoursPerParticipant());
            $jamPelatihan = is_numeric($rawTotalJam) ? (float) $rawTotalJam : 0.0;

            // Resolve NIK as explicit string (prevents scientific notation issues in consumers)
            $nik = (string) ($record->displayNik() ?? $record->participant_identifier ?? '');

            return [
                'nik'                => $nik,
                'nama'               => (string) ($record->participant_name ?? ''),
                'jenis_kelamin'      => (string) ($record->gender ?? ''),
                'nama_pt'            => (string) ($record->company ?? ''),
                'department'         => (string) ($record->department ?? ''),
                'lokasi_kerja'       => (string) ($record->work_location ?? ''),
                'group'              => (string) ($record->group_name ?? ''),
                'region'             => (string) ($record->region ?? ''),
                'gol'                => (string) ($record->gol ?? ''),
                'jabatan'            => (string) ($record->position ?? ''),
                'bulan'              => (string) ($record->bulan ?? ''),
                'tahun'              => (string) ($record->tahun ?? ''),
                'jml_hari'           => $jmlHari,
                'jam_pelatihan'      => $jamPelatihan,
                'nama_pelatihan'     => (string) ($record->activityName() ?? ''),
                'instruktur'         => (string) ($record->instructor ?: ($record->activityTrainer() ?? '')),
                'tempat_pelatihan'   => (string) ($record->program_type === 'reguler' ? ($act?->Lokasi_training ?? '') : ($act?->lokasi_training ?? '')),
                'reg_non_reg'        => $record->program_type === 'reguler' ? 'Reguler' : 'Non Reguler',
                'internal_eksternal' => (string) ($record->internal_external ?? ''),
                'level'              => (string) ($record->level ?? ''),
                'periode'            => (string) ($record->periode ?? ''),
            ];
        });

        return response()->json([
            'data' => $transformedData,
            'meta' => [
                'current_page' => $paginated->currentPage(),
                'last_page'    => $paginated->lastPage(),
                'per_page'     => $paginated->perPage(),
                'total'        => $paginated->total(),
            ],
        ], 200, [], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http; // Tambahkan class Http untuk request API

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    public function showLoginForm()
    {
        return view('auth.login');
    }

    public function login(Request $request)
    {
        // 1. Tambahkan validasi untuk input token Turnstile
        $request->validate([
            'identifier' => ['required', 'string'],
            'password' => ['required', 'string'],
            // 'cf-turnstile-response' => ['required', 'string'],
        ]
        // , [
        //     'cf-turnstile-response.required' => 'Harap selesaikan verifikasi keamanan Cloudflare.'
        // ]
        );

        // 2. Kirim token ke API Cloudflare untuk divalidasi keasliannya
        // $http = Http::asForm();

        // // Bypass verifikasi SSL HANYA saat dijalankan di Localhost/Laragon
        // if (app()->isLocal()) {
        //     $http = $http->withoutVerifying();
        // }

        // $turnstileResponse = $http->post('https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify', [
        //     'secret' => '0x4AAAAAAEzPGKSsKiRsoVbsX1tzF-N7x8k',
        //     'response' => $request->input('cf-turnstile-response'),
        //     'remoteip' => $request->ip(),
        // ]);

        // // 3. Jika validasi dari Cloudflare gagal (bot/token kedaluwarsa)
        // if (! $turnstileResponse->json('success')) {
        //     return back()->withErrors([
        //         'identifier' => 'Sistem mendeteksi aktivitas mencurigakan. Silakan refresh halaman dan coba lagi.',
        //     ])->onlyInput('identifier');
        // }

        // 4. Jika Turnstile sukses, lanjutkan ke proses login asli milikmu
        $identifier = $request->input('identifier');

        $fieldType = filter_var($identifier, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) ? 'email' : 'nik';

        if (Auth::attempt([$fieldType => $identifier, 'password' => $request->input('password')], $request->boolean('remember'))) {
            $request->session()->regenerate();

            $user = Auth::user();
            if ($user->hasRole('Top Management')) {
                return redirect('/Top_Management');
            }

            // Only Superadmin, Admin E-Information, or users with media/user management permissions access Dashboard Overview
            if ($user->hasRole('Superadmin') || $user->hasRole('Admin E-Information') || $user->canAny(['manage_articles', 'manage_users', 'manage_tv_display', 'manage_events'])) {
                return redirect('/admin');
            }

            // All other roles (Administrasi, Staff, Koordinator Mess, Kepala TU, Atasan, Trainer, etc.) go to Dashboard Utama
            return redirect('/administrasi/dashboard-realisasi');
        }

        return back()->withErrors([
            'identifier' => 'Email atau NIK atau password salah.',
        ])->onlyInput('identifier');
    }

    public function logout(Request $request)
    {
        Auth::logout();

        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return redirect('/login');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Cost;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Cost\BiayaRekruit;
use App\Traits\HandlesCsvImports;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class BiayaRekruitController extends Controller
{
    use HandlesCsvImports;

    public const MONTHS = [
        1  => 'Januari',   2  => 'Februari', 3  => 'Maret',
        4  => 'April',     5  => 'Mei',       6  => 'Juni',
        7  => 'Juli',      8  => 'Agustus',   9  => 'September',
        10 => 'Oktober',   11 => 'November',  12 => 'Desember',
    ];

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $search = trim($request->get('search', ''));

        $selectedYear  = $request->get('year', 2026);
        $selectedMonth = $request->get('month', 'all');
        $months        = self::MONTHS;

        // 1. Dynamic Year Selection
        $dbYears = BiayaRekruit::select('tahun')->distinct()->whereNotNull('tahun')->pluck('tahun')->toArray();
        $dateYears = BiayaRekruit::selectRaw('YEAR(tanggal) as yr')->distinct()->whereNotNull('tanggal')->pluck('yr')->toArray();
        $baseYears = range(date('Y') - 3, date('Y') + 2);
        $extraYear = ($selectedYear !== 'all' && is_numeric($selectedYear)) ? [(int)$selectedYear] : [];
        $years = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_merge($baseYears, $dbYears, $dateYears, $extraYear))));
        sort($years);

        // 2. Query records with optional year, month and search filters
        $query = BiayaRekruit::query()
            ->orderBy('jenis_rekruit')
            ->orderBy('penanggung_jawab')
            ->orderBy('tanggal', 'desc');

        if ($selectedYear !== 'all' && !empty($selectedYear)) {
            $yearInt = (int) $selectedYear;
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($yearInt) {
                $q->where('tahun', $yearInt)
                  ->orWhereYear('tanggal', $yearInt);
            });
        }

        if (is_numeric($selectedMonth) && (int)$selectedMonth >= 1 && (int)$selectedMonth <= 12) {
            $monthInt = (int) $selectedMonth;
            $query->whereMonth('tanggal', $monthInt);
        }

        if (!empty($search)) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('jenis_rekruit', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('penanggung_jawab', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $allRecords = $query->get();

        // Group: jenis_rekruit → penanggung_jawab → items
        $grouped = [];
        foreach ($allRecords as $row) {
            $jenis = $row->jenis_rekruit ?: 'Biaya Operasional Rekrutmen';
            $pj    = $row->penanggung_jawab ?: 'Umum / Non-PIC';
            $grouped[$jenis][$pj][] = $row;
        }

        // Summary totals
        $summary = [
            'total_biaya'     => (float) $allRecords->sum('total_biaya'),
            'total_transaksi' => $allRecords->count(),
        ];

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Cost.biaya_rekruit', compact(
            'grouped', 'summary', 'search', 'years', 'selectedYear', 'selectedMonth', 'months'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tanggal' => 'required|date',
            'nama' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'total_biaya' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
            'tahun' => 'nullable|integer',
            'jenis_rekruit' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'penanggung_jawab' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
        ]);

        if (empty($validated['tahun'])) {
            $validated['tahun'] = Carbon::parse($validated['tanggal'])->year;
        }

        if (empty($validated['jenis_rekruit'])) {
            $validated['jenis_rekruit'] = $this->detectJenisRekruit($validated['nama']);
        }

        $record = BiayaRekruit::create($validated);

        (new CostController())->syncAggregatedCosts((int)$validated['tahun']);

        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Biaya rekruit berhasil ditambahkan.',
                'data' => $record
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.biaya-rekruit.index')
            ->with('success', 'Biaya rekruit "' . $validated['nama'] . '" berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified resource.
     */
    public function show($id)
    {
        $record = BiayaRekruit::findOrFail($id);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $record
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $record = BiayaRekruit::findOrFail($id);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tanggal' => 'required|date',
            'nama' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'total_biaya' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
            'jenis_rekruit' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'penanggung_jawab' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
        ]);

        $validated['tahun'] = Carbon::parse($validated['tanggal'])->year;

        if (empty($validated['jenis_rekruit'])) {
            $validated['jenis_rekruit'] = $this->detectJenisRekruit($validated['nama']);
        }

        $record->update($validated);

        (new CostController())->syncAggregatedCosts((int)$validated['tahun']);

        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Biaya rekruit berhasil diperbarui.',
                'data' => $record
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.biaya-rekruit.index')
            ->with('success', 'Biaya rekruit "' . $record->nama . '" berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $record = BiayaRekruit::findOrFail($id);
        $name = $record->nama;
        $tahun = (int) ($record->tahun ?: ($record->tanggal ? $record->tanggal->year : date('Y')));

        $record->delete();

        (new CostController())->syncAggregatedCosts($tahun);

        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => "Biaya rekruit '{$name}' berhasil dihapus."
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.biaya-rekruit.index')
            ->with('success', "Biaya rekruit '{$name}' berhasil dihapus.");
    }

    /**
     * Import CSV file into Biaya Rekruit
     */
    public function importCsv(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'csv_file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt,text|max:10240',
            'import_mode' => 'nullable|string|in:append,replace',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('csv_file');
        $filePath = $file->getRealPath();
        $importMode = $request->get('import_mode', 'append');

        if ($importMode === 'replace') {
            BiayaRekruit::truncate();
        }

        $handle = fopen($filePath, 'r');
        if (!$handle) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Gagal membuka file CSV yang diunggah.');
        }

        $delimiter = $this->detectCsvDelimiter($filePath);
        $rawHeaders = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter);
        if (!$rawHeaders) {
            fclose($handle);
            return back()->with('error', 'Format file CSV tidak valid atau file kosong.');
        }

        $cleanHeaders = $this->cleanCsvHeaders($rawHeaders);

        // Normalize header mapping
        $headerMap = [];
        foreach ($cleanHeaders as $index => $clean) {
            if (in_array($clean, ['costrekruitid', 'idbiayarekruit', 'id', 'no', 'vraid'])) {
                $headerMap['id'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['tanggal', 'date', 'tgl', 'waktu'])) {
                $headerMap['tanggal'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['nama', 'namareferensi', 'referensi', 'uraian', 'keterangan', 'deskripsi', 'transaksi'])) {
                $headerMap['nama'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['picrekruiter', 'pic', 'penanggungjawab', 'penanggung_jawab', 'pj', 'rekruiter', 'picrecruiter'])) {
                $headerMap['penanggung_jawab'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['jenisrekruit', 'jenis', 'kategori', 'kategorirekruit'])) {
                $headerMap['jenis_rekruit'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['totalbiaya', 'biaya', 'total', 'nominal', 'amount', 'harga'])) {
                $headerMap['total_biaya'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['tahun', 'year', 'thn'])) {
                $headerMap['tahun'] = $index;
            }
        }

        $insertedCount = 0;
        $updatedCount = 0;

        while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
            if (empty(array_filter($row))) {
                continue;
            }

            $nama = isset($headerMap['nama']) && isset($row[$headerMap['nama']]) ? trim($row[$headerMap['nama']]) : '';
            if (empty($nama)) {
                continue;
            }

            // Parse Date & derive Year
            $rawDate = isset($headerMap['tanggal']) && isset($row[$headerMap['tanggal']]) ? trim($row[$headerMap['tanggal']]) : '';
            $tanggal = null;
            $tahun = (int) date('Y');

            if (!empty($rawDate)) {
                try {
                    $parsed = Carbon::parse($rawDate);
                    $tanggal = $parsed->format('Y-m-d');
                    $tahun = $parsed->year;
                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                    $tanggal = date('Y-m-d');
                }
            } else {
                $tanggal = date('Y-m-d');
            }

            if (isset($headerMap['tahun']) && !empty($row[$headerMap['tahun']])) {
                $tahun = (int) $row[$headerMap['tahun']];
            }

            $totalBiaya = isset($headerMap['total_biaya']) ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['total_biaya']], 0) : 0;
            $penanggungJawab = isset($headerMap['penanggung_jawab']) && isset($row[$headerMap['penanggung_jawab']]) ? trim($row[$headerMap['penanggung_jawab']]) : '';

            if (empty($penanggungJawab)) {
                $penanggungJawab = 'Umum / Non-PIC';
            }

            $jenisRekruit = isset($headerMap['jenis_rekruit']) && isset($row[$headerMap['jenis_rekruit']]) ? trim($row[$headerMap['jenis_rekruit']]) : '';
            if (empty($jenisRekruit)) {
                $jenisRekruit = $this->detectJenisRekruit($nama);
            }

            // Check existing record
            $existing = null;
            if (isset($headerMap['id']) && !empty($row[$headerMap['id']])) {
                $id = (int)$row[$headerMap['id']];
                $existing = BiayaRekruit::find($id);
            }

            if (!$existing) {
                $existing = BiayaRekruit::where('nama', $nama)
                    ->where('tanggal', $tanggal)
                    ->first();
            }

            $dataArray = [
                'tanggal' => $tanggal,
                'nama' => $nama,
                'total_biaya' => $totalBiaya,
                'tahun' => $tahun,
                'jenis_rekruit' => $jenisRekruit,
                'penanggung_jawab' => $penanggungJawab,
            ];

            if ($existing) {
                $existing->update($dataArray);
                $updatedCount++;
            } else {
                BiayaRekruit::create($dataArray);
                $insertedCount++;
            }
        }

        fclose($handle);

        (new CostController())->syncAggregatedCosts((int)date('Y'));

        $msg = "Import CSV Biaya Rekruit berhasil: {$insertedCount} data baru ditambahkan";
        if ($updatedCount > 0) {
            $msg .= ", {$updatedCount} data diperbarui";
        }
        $msg .= ".";

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Biaya Rekruit',
            "Mengimport data Biaya Rekruit dari file " . $file->getClientOriginalName() . " ({$insertedCount} baru, {$updatedCount} diperbarui)",
            ['filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(), 'inserted' => $insertedCount, 'updated' => $updatedCount]
        );

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.biaya-rekruit.index')->with('success', $msg);
    }

    /**
     * Auto detect Jenis Rekruit category based on description keywords
     */
    private function detectJenisRekruit(string $nama): string
    {
        $upper = strtoupper($nama);

        if (str_contains($upper, 'MCU') || str_contains($upper, 'RS PRIMA') || str_contains($upper, 'KIMIA FARMA') || str_contains($upper, 'LABKLIN')) {
            return 'Medical Check Up (MCU) Calon Karyawan';
        }

        if (str_contains($upper, 'TIKET') || str_contains($upper, 'TRAVEL') || str_contains($upper, 'BUS') || str_contains($upper, 'GRAB') || str_contains($upper, 'GO CAR') || str_contains($upper, 'PANJAR')) {
            return 'Tiket & Transportasi Trainee / Kandidat';
        }

        if (str_contains($upper, 'DINAS REKRUT') || str_contains($upper, 'PERJDIN') || str_contains($upper, 'PERDIN') || str_contains($upper, 'MEETING') || str_contains($upper, 'COWORKING') || str_contains($upper, 'UANG SAKU') || str_contains($upper, 'UANG MAKAN') || str_contains($upper, 'PENGINAPAN') || str_contains($upper, 'HOTEL')) {
            return 'Perjalanan Dinas & Akomodasi Recruiter';
        }

        if (str_contains($upper, 'MESS') || str_contains($upper, 'BELANJA BASAH') || str_contains($upper, 'BELANJA KERING') || str_contains($upper, 'KONSUMSI') || str_contains($upper, 'HIKMAH GROUP') || str_contains($upper, 'INTERVIEW')) {
            return 'Konsumsi & Perlengkapan Mess Rekrutmen';
        }

        return 'Biaya Operasional Rekrutmen';
    }

    /**
     * Export recruitment expenses report.
     */
    public function export(Request $request)
    {
        $selectedYear  = $request->get('year');
        $selectedMonth = $request->get('month', 'all');
        $headers = [
            'cost_rekruit_id',
            'tanggal',
            'nama',
            'pic_rekruiter',
            'jenis_rekruit',
            'total_biaya'
        ];

        $query = BiayaRekruit::orderBy('tanggal', 'desc');

        if ($selectedYear !== 'all' && !empty($selectedYear)) {
            $yearInt = (int) $selectedYear;
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($yearInt) {
                $q->where('tahun', $yearInt)
                  ->orWhereYear('tanggal', $yearInt);
            });
        }

        if (is_numeric($selectedMonth) && (int)$selectedMonth >= 1 && (int)$selectedMonth <= 12) {
            $query->whereMonth('tanggal', (int)$selectedMonth);
        }

        $records = $query->get();
        $dataRows = [];

        foreach ($records as $row) {
            $dataRows[] = [
                $row->id_biaya_rekruit,
                $row->tanggal ? $row->tanggal->format('Y-m-d') : '-',
                $row->nama,
                $row->penanggung_jawab ?? '-',
                $row->jenis_rekruit ?? '-',
                $row->total_biaya
            ];
        }

        $filename = "Biaya_Rekruit_Report_" . date('Y-m-d') . ".xlsx";
        return \App\Services\ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Biaya Rekruit');
    }

    /**
     * Delete all Biaya Rekruit records.
     */
    public function destroyAll(Request $request)
    {
        $deleted = BiayaRekruit::query()->delete();

        (new CostController())->syncAggregatedCosts((int)date('Y'));

        ActivityLog::log('Hapus', 'Biaya Rekruit', "Seluruh data Biaya Rekruit ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.", [
            'count' => $deleted,
        ]);

        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => "Seluruh data Biaya Rekruit ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus."
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.biaya-rekruit.index')
            ->with('success', "Seluruh data Biaya Rekruit ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.");
    }

    public const MONTHS = [
        1  => 'Januari',   2  => 'Februari', 3  => 'Maret',
        4  => 'April',     5  => 'Mei',       6  => 'Juni',
        7  => 'Juli',      8  => 'Agustus',   9  => 'September',
        10 => 'Oktober',   11 => 'November',  12 => 'Desember',
    ];

    /**
     * Display the main CAPEX management page.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        // 1. Dynamic Year Selection
        $selectedYear = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $rabYears = CapexRab::select('tahun')->distinct()->pluck('tahun')->toArray();
        $realisasiYears = CapexRealisasi::select('tahun')->distinct()->pluck('tahun')->toArray();
        $baseYears = range(date('Y') - 3, date('Y') + 2);
        $years = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_merge($baseYears, $rabYears, $realisasiYears, [$selectedYear]))));
        sort($years);

        $selectedMonth = $request->get('month', 'all'); // 'all' or 1..12
        $selectedLocation = $request->get('location', 'all'); // 'all', 'kantor', 'mess'
        $search = trim($request->get('search', ''));
        $months = self::MONTHS;

        // 2. Base Queries for RAB
        $rabKantorQuery = CapexRab::where('tahun', $selectedYear)->where('lokasi', 'kantor');
        $rabMessQuery   = CapexRab::where('tahun', $selectedYear)->where('lokasi', 'mess');

        // 3. Base Queries for Realisasi
        $realisasiKantorQuery = CapexRealisasi::with('rab')->where('tahun', $selectedYear)->where('lokasi', 'kantor');
        $realisasiMessQuery   = CapexRealisasi::with('rab')->where('tahun', $selectedYear)->where('lokasi', 'mess');

        if (is_numeric($selectedMonth) && (int)$selectedMonth >= 1 && (int)$selectedMonth <= 12) {
            $monthInt = (int) $selectedMonth;
            $realisasiKantorQuery->whereMonth('tanggal', $monthInt);
            $realisasiMessQuery->whereMonth('tanggal', $monthInt);
        }

        // Apply Search if provided
        if (!empty($search)) {
            $rabFilter = function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('kel_barang_kapital', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('type', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('satuan', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            };
            $realisasiFilter = function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('kel_barang_kapital', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('nama_barang', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('type', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            };

            $rabKantorQuery->where($rabFilter);
            $rabMessQuery->where($rabFilter);
            $realisasiKantorQuery->where($realisasiFilter);
            $realisasiMessQuery->where($realisasiFilter);
        }

        // 4. Summary Totals (Independent of pagination)
        $rabKantorTotal       = (float) CapexRab::where('tahun', $selectedYear)->where('lokasi', 'kantor')->sum('total_rp');
        $rabMessTotal         = (float) CapexRab::where('tahun', $selectedYear)->where('lokasi', 'mess')->sum('total_rp');

        $realKantorQuery = CapexRealisasi::where('tahun', $selectedYear)->where('lokasi', 'kantor');
        $realMessQuery   = CapexRealisasi::where('tahun', $selectedYear)->where('lokasi', 'mess');

        if (is_numeric($selectedMonth) && (int)$selectedMonth >= 1 && (int)$selectedMonth <= 12) {
            $monthInt = (int) $selectedMonth;
            $realKantorQuery->whereMonth('tanggal', $monthInt);
            $realMessQuery->whereMonth('tanggal', $monthInt);
        }

        $debitKantorTotal     = (float) (clone $realKantorQuery)->sum('debit');
        $kreditKantorTotal    = (float) (clone $realKantorQuery)->sum('kredit');
        $realisasiKantorTotal = (float) (clone $realKantorQuery)->sum('total_rp');

        $debitMessTotal       = (float) (clone $realMessQuery)->sum('debit');
        $kreditMessTotal      = (float) (clone $realMessQuery)->sum('kredit');
        $realisasiMessTotal   = (float) (clone $realMessQuery)->sum('total_rp');

        $totalRab       = $rabKantorTotal + $rabMessTotal;
        $totalDebit     = $debitKantorTotal + $debitMessTotal;
        $totalKredit    = $kreditKantorTotal + $kreditMessTotal;
        $totalRealisasi = $realisasiKantorTotal + $realisasiMessTotal;
        $sisaRab        = $totalRab - $totalRealisasi;

        $summary = compact(
            'rabKantorTotal',
            'rabMessTotal',
            'debitKantorTotal',
            'kreditKantorTotal',
            'realisasiKantorTotal',
            'debitMessTotal',
            'kreditMessTotal',
            'realisasiMessTotal',
            'totalRab',
            'totalDebit',
            'totalKredit',
            'totalRealisasi',
            'sisaRab'
        );

        // 5. Fetch Paginated Data
        $rabKantor = $rabKantorQuery->orderBy('rab_id', 'asc')->paginate(15, ['*'], 'rab_kantor_page')->withQueryString();
        $realisasiKantor = $realisasiKantorQuery->orderBy('realisasi_id', 'asc')->paginate(15, ['*'], 'rel_kantor_page')->withQueryString();
        $rabMess = $rabMessQuery->orderBy('rab_id', 'asc')->paginate(15, ['*'], 'rab_mess_page')->withQueryString();
        $realisasiMess = $realisasiMessQuery->orderBy('realisasi_id', 'asc')->paginate(15, ['*'], 'rel_mess_page')->withQueryString();

        // 6. Available RAB options for dropdown linkage in Realisasi forms
        $availableRabs = CapexRab::where('tahun', $selectedYear)
            ->orderBy('lokasi', 'asc')
            ->orderBy('kel_barang_kapital', 'asc')
            ->get();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Cost.capex', compact(
            'years',
            'selectedYear',
            'selectedMonth',
            'months',
            'selectedLocation',
            'search',
            'rabKantor',
            'realisasiKantor',
            'rabMess',
            'realisasiMess',
            'summary',
            'availableRabs'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created RAB item.
     */
    public function storeRab(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tahun'              => 'required|integer|min:2000|max:2099',
            'lokasi'             => 'required|in:kantor,mess',
            'kel_barang_kapital' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'foto_barang'        => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'foto_file'          => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,gif,webp|max:5120',
            'type'               => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'satuan'             => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'jumlah_unit'        => 'required|numeric|min:0',
            'harga_satuan'       => 'required|numeric|min:0',
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto_file')) {
            $path = $this->handleUpload($request->file('foto_file'));
            $validated['foto_barang'] = $path;
        }

        $validated['total_rp'] = (float) $validated['jumlah_unit'] * (float) $validated['harga_satuan'];

        CapexRab::create($validated);
        (new \App\Http\Controllers\Cost\CostController())->syncAggregatedCosts((int)$validated['tahun']);

        return redirect()
            ->route('administrasi.capex.index', ['year' => $validated['tahun'], 'location' => $validated['lokasi']])
            ->with('success', 'Data RAB CAPEX (' . ucfirst($validated['lokasi']) . ') berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    /**
     * Import CSV file with auto-detection of RAB vs Realisasi.
     */
    public function importCsv(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'csv_file'    => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt,text|max:10240',
            'import_type' => 'nullable|string|in:auto,rab,realisasi',
            'import_mode' => 'nullable|string|in:append,replace',
            'tahun'       => 'nullable|integer|min:2000|max:2099',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('csv_file');
        $filePath = $file->getRealPath();
        $importType = $request->get('import_type', 'auto');
        $importMode = $request->get('import_mode', 'append');
        $defaultYear = (int) $request->get('tahun', date('Y'));

        $handle = fopen($filePath, 'r');
        if (!$handle) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Gagal membaca file CSV yang diunggah.');
        }

        $delimiter = $this->detectCsvDelimiter($filePath);
        $rawHeaders = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter);
        if (!$rawHeaders) {
            fclose($handle);
            return back()->with('error', 'Format file CSV tidak valid atau kosong.');
        }

        $cleanHeaders = $this->cleanCsvHeaders($rawHeaders);

        // Determine if file is RAB or Realisasi
        $detectedType = 'rab';
        if ($importType === 'rab') {
            $detectedType = 'rab';
        } elseif ($importType === 'realisasi') {
            $detectedType = 'realisasi';
        } else {
            // Auto detection based on column tokens
            $hasDebit = in_array('debit', $cleanHeaders);
            $hasKredit = in_array('kredit', $cleanHeaders);
            $hasNamaBarang = in_array('namabarang', $cleanHeaders);
            $hasRealisasiId = in_array('realisasiid', $cleanHeaders);
            $hasHargaSatuan = in_array('hargasatuan', $cleanHeaders);
            $hasJumlahUnit = in_array('jumlahunit', $cleanHeaders);

            if ($hasDebit || $hasKredit || $hasNamaBarang || $hasRealisasiId) {
                $detectedType = 'realisasi';
            } elseif ($hasHargaSatuan || $hasJumlahUnit) {
                $detectedType = 'rab';
            }
        }

        // Map column indices
        $headerMap = [];
        foreach ($cleanHeaders as $idx => $col) {
            // Common
            if (in_array($col, ['tahun', 'year', 'thn', 'periode'])) $headerMap['tahun'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['lokasi', 'location', 'jeniscapex'])) $headerMap['lokasi'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['kelbarangkapital', 'kelompokbarang', 'kelompok', 'kategoribarang'])) $headerMap['kel_barang_kapital'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['fotobarang', 'foto', 'image', 'gambar', 'urlfoto'])) $headerMap['foto_barang'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['type', 'tipe', 'typemerk', 'merk', 'model'])) $headerMap['type'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['totalrp', 'total', 'totalbiaya', 'totalrab'])) $headerMap['total_rp'] = $idx;

            // RAB specific
            if (in_array($col, ['rabid', 'idrab', 'id'])) $headerMap['rab_id'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['satuan', 'unit', 'uom'])) $headerMap['satuan'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['jumlahunit', 'jumlah', 'qty', 'kuantitas', 'unitcount'])) $headerMap['jumlah_unit'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['hargasatuan', 'harga', 'price', 'unitprice'])) $headerMap['harga_satuan'] = $idx;

            // Realisasi specific
            if (in_array($col, ['realisasiid', 'idrealisasi'])) $headerMap['realisasi_id'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['namabarang', 'namatransaksi', 'barang', 'keterangan', 'deskripsi'])) $headerMap['nama_barang'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['tanggal', 'date', 'tgl', 'tgltransaksi', 'bulan', 'month', 'bln'])) $headerMap['tanggal'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['debit', 'pengeluaran', 'masuk', 'debet'])) $headerMap['debit'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['kredit', 'penerimaan', 'keluar'])) $headerMap['kredit'] = $idx;
        }

        // Handle Replace mode
        if ($importMode === 'replace') {
            if ($detectedType === 'rab') {
                // Delete existing RAB and clear foreign key references
                CapexRealisasi::where('tahun', $defaultYear)->update(['rab_id' => null]);
                CapexRab::where('tahun', $defaultYear)->delete();
            } else {
                CapexRealisasi::where('tahun', $defaultYear)->delete();
            }
        }

        $importedCount = 0;
        $updatedCount  = 0;

        DB::beginTransaction();
        try {
            while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
                // Skip empty rows
                if (empty(array_filter($row, fn($v) => trim($v) !== ''))) {
                    continue;
                }

                $getVal = function ($key, $default = null) use ($row, $headerMap) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$key]) && isset($row[$headerMap[$key]])) {
                        return trim($row[$headerMap[$key]]);
                    }
                    return $default;
                };

                $tahun = (int) $getVal('tahun', $defaultYear);
                if ($tahun <= 0) $tahun = $defaultYear;

                $rawLokasi = strtolower((string) $getVal('lokasi', 'kantor'));
                $lokasi = (str_contains($rawLokasi, 'mess') || str_contains($rawLokasi, 'mes')) ? 'mess' : 'kantor';

                $kelBarang = $getVal('kel_barang_kapital', 'Umum');
                $fotoBarang = $getVal('foto_barang', null);
                $type = $getVal('type', null);

                if ($detectedType === 'rab') {
                    $rabId       = $getVal('rab_id');
                    $satuan      = $getVal('satuan', 'Unit');
                    $jumlahUnit  = $this->cleanNumeric($getVal('jumlah_unit', 1), 1);
                    $hargaSatuan = $this->cleanNumeric($getVal('harga_satuan', 0), 0);
                    $totalRp     = $this->cleanNumeric($getVal('total_rp', $jumlahUnit * $hargaSatuan), $jumlahUnit * $hargaSatuan);

                    $data = [
                        'tahun'              => $tahun,
                        'lokasi'             => $lokasi,
                        'kel_barang_kapital' => $kelBarang,
                        'foto_barang'        => $fotoBarang,
                        'type'               => $type,
                        'satuan'             => $satuan,
                        'jumlah_unit'        => $jumlahUnit,
                        'harga_satuan'       => $hargaSatuan,
                        'total_rp'           => $totalRp,
                    ];

                    if ($rabId && is_numeric($rabId)) {
                        $existing = CapexRab::find((int) $rabId);
                        if ($existing) {
                            $existing->update($data);
                            $updatedCount++;
                        } else {
                            $data['rab_id'] = (int) $rabId;
                            CapexRab::create($data);
                            $importedCount++;
                        }
                    } else {
                        CapexRab::create($data);
                        $importedCount++;
                    }
                } else {
                    // Realisasi
                    $realisasiId = $getVal('realisasi_id');
                    $rabId       = $getVal('rab_id');
                    $namaBarang  = $getVal('nama_barang', $kelBarang);
                    $rawDate     = $getVal('tanggal');
                    $debit       = $this->cleanNumeric($getVal('debit', 0), 0);
                    $kredit      = $this->cleanNumeric($getVal('kredit', 0), 0);
                    $totalRp     = ($debit != 0 || $kredit != 0) ? ($debit - $kredit) : $this->cleanNumeric($getVal('total_rp', 0), 0);

                    // Parse Date / Month
                    $tanggal = null;
                    if (!empty($rawDate)) {
                        if (is_numeric($rawDate) && (int)$rawDate >= 1 && (int)$rawDate <= 12) {
                            $mStr = str_pad((int)$rawDate, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                            $tanggal = "{$tahun}-{$mStr}-01";
                        } else {
                            $lowerDate = strtolower($rawDate);
                            $monthNamesMap = [
                                'januari' => 1, 'january' => 1, 'jan' => 1,
                                'februari' => 2, 'february' => 2, 'feb' => 2,
                                'maret' => 3, 'march' => 3, 'mar' => 3,
                                'april' => 4, 'apr' => 4,
                                'mei' => 5, 'may' => 5,
                                'juni' => 6, 'june' => 6, 'jun' => 6,
                                'juli' => 7, 'july' => 7, 'jul' => 7,
                                'agustus' => 8, 'august' => 8, 'aug' => 8,
                                'september' => 9, 'sep' => 9,
                                'oktober' => 10, 'october' => 10, 'okt' => 10, 'oct' => 10,
                                'november' => 11, 'nov' => 11,
                                'desember' => 12, 'december' => 12, 'des' => 12, 'dec' => 12,
                            ];
                            if (isset($monthNamesMap[$lowerDate])) {
                                $mStr = str_pad($monthNamesMap[$lowerDate], 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                                $tanggal = "{$tahun}-{$mStr}-01";
                            } else {
                                try {
                                    $parsedTs = strtotime(str_replace('/', '-', $rawDate));
                                    $tanggal = $parsedTs ? date('Y-m-d', $parsedTs) : null;
                                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                                    $tanggal = null;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    $data = [
                        'rab_id'             => ($rabId && is_numeric($rabId)) ? (int) $rabId : null,
                        'tahun'              => $tahun,
                        'lokasi'             => $lokasi,
                        'kel_barang_kapital' => $kelBarang,
                        'foto_barang'        => $fotoBarang,
                        'nama_barang'        => $namaBarang,
                        'type'               => $type,
                        'tanggal'            => $tanggal,
                        'debit'              => $debit,
                        'kredit'             => $kredit,
                        'total_rp'           => $totalRp,
                    ];

                    if ($realisasiId && is_numeric($realisasiId)) {
                        $existing = CapexRealisasi::find((int) $realisasiId);
                        if ($existing) {
                            $existing->update($data);
                            $updatedCount++;
                        } else {
                            $data['realisasi_id'] = (int) $realisasiId;
                            CapexRealisasi::create($data);
                            $importedCount++;
                        }
                    } else {
                        CapexRealisasi::create($data);
                        $importedCount++;
                    }
                }
            }

            DB::commit();
            fclose($handle);

            $typeLabel = $detectedType === 'rab' ? 'RAB' : 'Realisasi';

            ActivityLog::log(
                'Import',
                'CAPEX',
                "Mengimport data {$typeLabel} CAPEX dari file " . $file->getClientOriginalName() . " ({$importedCount} baru, {$updatedCount} diperbarui)",
                ['filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(), 'imported' => $importedCount, 'updated' => $updatedCount, 'type' => $typeLabel]
            );
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            if (is_resource($handle)) {
                fclose($handle);
            }
            return back()->with('error', 'Terjadi kesalahan saat import data: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }

        $typeLabel = $detectedType === 'rab' ? 'RAB' : 'Realisasi';
        $msg = "Import {$typeLabel} CAPEX berhasil! ({$importedCount} data baru ditambahkan, {$updatedCount} data diperbarui).";

        return redirect()
            ->route('administrasi.capex.index', ['year' => $defaultYear])
            ->with('success', $msg);
    }

    /**
     * Export CAPEX data as CSV.
     */
    public function export(Request $request)
    {
        $year  = (int) $request->get('year', date('Y'));
        $month = $request->get('month', 'all');
        $type  = $request->get('type', 'all'); // 'all', 'rab', 'realisasi'

        $realisasiQuery = CapexRealisasi::where('tahun', $year);
        if (is_numeric($month) && (int)$month >= 1 && (int)$month <= 12) {
            $realisasiQuery->whereMonth('tanggal', (int)$month);
        }

        if ($type === 'realisasi') {
            $headers = ['realisasi_id', 'rab_id', 'tahun', 'lokasi', 'kel_barang_kapital', 'foto_barang', 'nama_barang', 'type', 'tanggal', 'debit', 'kredit', 'total_rp'];
            $records = $realisasiQuery->orderBy('lokasi')->orderBy('realisasi_id')->get();
            $dataRows = [];
            foreach ($records as $rel) {
                $dataRows[] = [
                    $rel->realisasi_id,
                    $rel->rab_id,
                    $rel->tahun,
                    $rel->lokasi,
                    $rel->kel_barang_kapital,
                    $rel->foto_barang,
                    $rel->nama_barang,
                    $rel->type,
                    $rel->tanggal ? $rel->tanggal->format('Y-m-d') : '',
                    $rel->debit,
                    $rel->kredit,
                    $rel->total_rp,
                ];
            }
            $filename = "CAPEX_Realisasi_Report_{$year}.xlsx";
            return \App\Services\ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Realisasi Capex');
        } elseif ($type === 'rab') {
            $headers = ['rab_id', 'tahun', 'lokasi', 'kel_barang_kapital', 'foto_barang', 'type', 'satuan', 'jumlah_unit', 'harga_satuan', 'total_rp'];
            $records = CapexRab::where('tahun', $year)->orderBy('lokasi')->orderBy('rab_id')->get();
            $dataRows = [];
            foreach ($records as $r) {
                $dataRows[] = [
                    $r->rab_id,
                    $r->tahun,
                    $r->lokasi,
                    $r->kel_barang_kapital,
                    $r->foto_barang,
                    $r->type,
                    $r->satuan,
                    $r->jumlah_unit,
                    $r->harga_satuan,
                    $r->total_rp,
                ];
            }
            $filename = "CAPEX_RAB_Report_{$year}.xlsx";
            return \App\Services\ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'RAB Capex');
        } else {
            $headers = ['Tipe Data', 'ID', 'RAB ID', 'Tahun', 'Lokasi', 'Kelompok Barang', 'Foto Barang', 'Nama Barang / Type', 'Satuan / Tanggal', 'Jumlah Unit / Debit', 'Harga Satuan / Kredit', 'Total Rp'];
            $dataRows = [];

            $rabRecords = CapexRab::where('tahun', $year)->orderBy('lokasi')->orderBy('rab_id')->get();
            foreach ($rabRecords as $r) {
                $dataRows[] = [
                    'RAB',
                    $r->rab_id,
                    '-',
                    $r->tahun,
                    $r->lokasi,
                    $r->kel_barang_kapital,
                    $r->foto_barang,
                    $r->type,
                    $r->satuan,
                    $r->jumlah_unit,
                    $r->harga_satuan,
                    $r->total_rp,
                ];
            }

            $realisasiRecords = $realisasiQuery->orderBy('lokasi')->orderBy('realisasi_id')->get();
            foreach ($realisasiRecords as $rel) {
                $dataRows[] = [
                    'REALISASI',
                    $rel->realisasi_id,
                    $rel->rab_id,
                    $rel->tahun,
                    $rel->lokasi,
                    $rel->kel_barang_kapital,
                    $rel->foto_barang,
                    $rel->nama_barang,
                    $rel->tanggal ? $rel->tanggal->format('Y-m-d') : '',
                    $rel->debit,
                    $rel->kredit,
                    $rel->total_rp,
                ];
            }

            $filename = "CAPEX_Report_All_{$year}.xlsx";
            return \App\Services\ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Capex Report');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Helper to handle uploaded image file
     */
    private function handleUpload($file)
    {
        $uploadDir = public_path('uploads/capex');
        if (!File::exists($uploadDir)) {
            File::makeDirectory($uploadDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $filename = 'capex_' . time() . '_' . uniqid() . '.' . $file->getClientOriginalExtension();
        $file->move($uploadDir, $filename);

        return '/uploads/capex/' . $filename;
    }

    /**
     * Delete all CAPEX records (RAB & Realisasi).
     */
    public function destroyAll(Request $request)
    {
        $location = $request->get('location', 'all');

        $rabQuery = CapexRab::query();
        $realQuery = CapexRealisasi::query();

        if (in_array($location, ['kantor', 'mess'])) {
            $rabQuery->where('lokasi', $location);
            $realQuery->where('lokasi', $location);
            $deletedRab = $rabQuery->delete();
            $deletedReal = $realQuery->delete();
            $msg = "Seluruh data CAPEX lokasi " . ucfirst($location) . " ({$deletedRab} RAB, {$deletedReal} Realisasi) berhasil dihapus.";
        } else {
            $deletedRab = $rabQuery->delete();
            $deletedReal = $realQuery->delete();
            $msg = "Seluruh data CAPEX ({$deletedRab} RAB, {$deletedReal} Realisasi) berhasil dihapus.";
        }

        ActivityLog::log('Hapus', 'Capex', $msg, [
            'deleted_rab' => $deletedRab,
            'deleted_realisasi' => $deletedReal,
            'location' => $location,
        ]);

        return redirect()
            ->route('administrasi.capex.index', ['location' => $location])
            ->with('success', $msg);
    }
