<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Cost;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Cost\BiayaRekruit;
use App\Models\Cost\CapexRab;
use App\Models\Cost\CapexRealisasi;
use App\Models\Cost\Cost;
use App\Models\Cost\Vra;
use App\Traits\HandlesCsvImports;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class CostController extends Controller
{
    use HandlesCsvImports;

    public const MONTH_NAMES = [
        1  => 'Januari',   2  => 'Februari', 3  => 'Maret',
        4  => 'April',     5  => 'Mei',       6  => 'Juni',
        7  => 'Juli',      8  => 'Agustus',   9  => 'September',
        10 => 'Oktober',   11 => 'November',  12 => 'Desember',
    ];

    /**
     * Display the Cost management and monthly report page.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        // 1. Dynamic Year Selection
        $selectedYear = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $dbYears = Cost::select('tahun')->distinct()->pluck('tahun')->toArray();
        $baseYears = range(date('Y') - 3, date('Y') + 2);
        $years = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_merge($baseYears, $dbYears, [$selectedYear]))));
        sort($years);

        $selectedMonth = $request->get('month', 'all'); // 'all' or 1..12
        $selectedJenis = $request->get('jenis', 'all'); // 'all' or specific jenis_cost
        $search = trim($request->get('search', ''));

        // Optionally perform auto-aggregation sync on page load
        $this->syncAggregatedCosts($selectedYear, is_numeric($selectedMonth) ? (int)$selectedMonth : null);

        // 2. Query Costs
        $query = Cost::where('tahun', $selectedYear);

        if (is_numeric($selectedMonth) && (int)$selectedMonth >= 1 && (int)$selectedMonth <= 12) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($selectedMonth) {
                $q->where('bulan', (int)$selectedMonth)
                  ->orWhereNull('bulan');
            });
        }

        if ($selectedJenis !== 'all') {
            $query->where('jenis_cost', $selectedJenis);
        }

        if (!empty($search)) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('account_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('jenis_cost', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('GL_ACCOUNT', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        if ($selectedMonth === 'all') {
            // Ketika filter 'Semua (Tahunan)', agregasikan SUM budget dan SUM realisasi per unique account
            $allCosts = $query->select(
                DB::raw('MIN(cost_id) as cost_id'),
                'GL_ACCOUNT',
                'jenis_cost',
                'account_name',
                DB::raw('SUM(budget) as budget'),
                DB::raw('SUM(realisasi) as realisasi'),
                DB::raw('MAX(budget_tahunan) as budget_tahunan'),
                DB::raw('MAX(tahun) as tahun')
            )
            ->groupBy('jenis_cost', 'GL_ACCOUNT', 'account_name')
            ->orderBy(DB::raw('MIN(cost_id)'), 'asc')
            ->get();
        } else {
            $allCosts = $query->orderBy('cost_id', 'asc')->get();
        }

        // 3. Group by jenis_cost
        $grouped = [];
        foreach ($allCosts as $cost) {
            $key = $cost->jenis_cost ?: 'BIAYA UMUM LAINNYA';
            $grouped[$key][] = $cost;
        }

        // 4. Distinct Jenis Cost for Filter
        $jenisList = Cost::where('tahun', $selectedYear)->select('jenis_cost')->distinct()->pluck('jenis_cost')->filter()->values();

        // 5. Summary Totals
        $totalBudget        = (float) $allCosts->sum('budget');
        $totalRealisasi     = (float) $allCosts->sum('realisasi');
        $totalBudgetTahunan = (float) $allCosts->sum('budget_tahunan');
        $sisaBudget         = $totalBudgetTahunan > 0 ? ($totalBudgetTahunan - $totalRealisasi) : ($totalBudget - $totalRealisasi);
        $pctRealisasi       = $totalBudgetTahunan > 0 ? round(($totalRealisasi / $totalBudgetTahunan) * 100, 1) : ($totalBudget > 0 ? round(($totalRealisasi / $totalBudget) * 100, 1) : 0);

        $summary = compact(
            'totalBudget',
            'totalRealisasi',
            'totalBudgetTahunan',
            'sisaBudget',
            'pctRealisasi'
        );

        $monthNames = self::MONTH_NAMES;

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Cost.cost', compact(
            'years',
            'selectedYear',
            'selectedMonth',
            'selectedJenis',
            'jenisList',
            'search',
            'grouped',
            'summary',
            'monthNames'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Trigger manual sync from VRA, Capex, and Biaya Rekruit.
     */
    public function sync(Request $request)
    {
        $year = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $month = $request->get('month');
        $monthNum = (is_numeric($month) && $month >= 1 && $month <= 12) ? (int)$month : null;

        $stats = $this->syncAggregatedCosts($year, $monthNum);

        $msg = "Sinkronisasi berhasil! Data VRA ({$stats['vra']} kendaraan), Capex (Kantor & Mess), dan Rekruit ({$stats['rekruit']}) berhasil diagregasikan ke tabel COST.";

        return redirect()
            ->route('administrasi.cost.index', ['year' => $year, 'month' => $month])
            ->with('success', $msg);
    }

    /**
     * Core Aggregation & UPSERT logic for VRA, Capex, and Biaya Rekruit.
     */
    public function syncAggregatedCosts(int $year, ?int $month = null): array
    {
        $stats = ['vra' => 0, 'capex' => 2, 'rekruit' => 0];

        DB::transaction(function () use ($year, $month, &$stats) {
            // =========================================================================
            // 1. VRA -> COST
            // =========================================================================
            $vraQuery = Vra::where('tahun', $year);
            if ($month !== null) {
                $vraQuery->where('bulan', $month);
            }

            $vraVehicles = $vraQuery->select(
                'kendaraan',
                DB::raw('SUM(total_biaya_bulan) as total_biaya'),
                DB::raw('SUM(upah) as total_upah'),
                DB::raw('SUM(BBM) as total_bbm'),
                DB::raw('SUM(preventif_maintenance) as total_maint'),
                DB::raw('SUM(biaya_lainnya) as total_lain')
            )
            ->groupBy('kendaraan')
            ->get();

            // Standard accounts map
            $standardMap = [
                'Bus'      => '1. Alokasi Bus',
                'Hilux'    => '2. Alokasi Hilux',
                'Fortuner' => '3. Alokasi Fortuner',
            ];

            // Initialize standard vehicle totals to 0
            $vehicleTotals = [
                'Bus'      => 0.0,
                'Hilux'    => 0.0,
                'Fortuner' => 0.0,
            ];
            $customVehicles = [];

            foreach ($vraVehicles as $v) {
                $rawName = trim((string) $v->kendaraan);
                $cleanName = match (true) {
                    str_contains(strtolower($rawName), 'hilux') => 'Hilux',
                    str_contains(strtolower($rawName), 'bus') => 'Bus',
                    str_contains(strtolower($rawName), 'fortuner') => 'Fortuner',
                    default => $rawName,
                };

                if (array_key_exists($cleanName, $vehicleTotals)) {
                    $vehicleTotals[$cleanName] += (float) $v->total_biaya;
                } else {
                    $customVehicles[$cleanName] = ($customVehicles[$cleanName] ?? 0.0) + (float) $v->total_biaya;
                }
            }

            $stats['vra'] = count(array_filter($vehicleTotals)) + count($customVehicles);
            $syncedVraAccountNames = [];

            // Update standard VRA accounts (Bus, Hilux, Fortuner)
            foreach ($standardMap as $catKey => $accountName) {
                $totalVal = $vehicleTotals[$catKey];
                $matchingRows = Cost::where('tahun', $year)
                    ->where(function ($q) use ($accountName, $catKey) {
                        $q->where('account_name', $accountName)
                          ->orWhere('account_name', 'like', "%Alokasi%{$catKey}%");
                    })
                    ->orderBy('cost_id', 'asc')
                    ->get();

                if ($matchingRows->isNotEmpty()) {
                    $masterRow = $matchingRows->first();
                    if ($matchingRows->count() > 1) {
                        foreach ($matchingRows->slice(1) as $dup) {
                            if ((float)$masterRow->budget == 0 && (float)$dup->budget > 0) {
                                $masterRow->budget = $dup->budget;
                            }
                            if ((float)$masterRow->budget_tahunan == 0 && (float)$dup->budget_tahunan > 0) {
                                $masterRow->budget_tahunan = $dup->budget_tahunan;
                            }
                            $dup->delete();
                        }
                    }

                    $masterRow->update([
                        'account_name'   => $accountName,
                        'realisasi'      => $totalVal,
                        'jenis_cost'     => 'BIAYA PERJALANAN DINAS',
                        'budget'         => $masterRow->budget,
                        'budget_tahunan' => $masterRow->budget_tahunan,
                    ]);
                    $syncedVraAccountNames[] = $masterRow->account_name;
                } else {
                    $newCost = Cost::create([
                        'tahun'          => $year,
                        'bulan'          => null,
                        'GL_ACCOUNT'     => '135.80.00005/850.91.05000/850.91.02002/850.91.04001/850.91.05002/850.91.05003/850.91.06001/850.91.06002',
                        'jenis_cost'     => 'BIAYA PERJALANAN DINAS',
                        'account_name'   => $accountName,
                        'budget'         => 0,
                        'realisasi'      => $totalVal,
                        'budget_tahunan' => 0,
                    ]);
                    $syncedVraAccountNames[] = $newCost->account_name;
                }
            }

            // Update custom VRA accounts if any
            foreach ($customVehicles as $cName => $totalVal) {
                $matchingRows = Cost::where('tahun', $year)
                    ->where('account_name', "Alokasi {$cName}")
                    ->orderBy('cost_id', 'asc')
                    ->get();

                if ($matchingRows->isNotEmpty()) {
                    $masterRow = $matchingRows->first();
                    if ($matchingRows->count() > 1) {
                        foreach ($matchingRows->slice(1) as $dup) {
                            if ((float)$masterRow->budget == 0 && (float)$dup->budget > 0) {
                                $masterRow->budget = $dup->budget;
                            }
                            if ((float)$masterRow->budget_tahunan == 0 && (float)$dup->budget_tahunan > 0) {
                                $masterRow->budget_tahunan = $dup->budget_tahunan;
                            }
                            $dup->delete();
                        }
                    }

                    $masterRow->update([
                        'realisasi'      => $totalVal,
                        'jenis_cost'     => 'BIAYA PERJALANAN DINAS',
                        'budget'         => $masterRow->budget,
                        'budget_tahunan' => $masterRow->budget_tahunan,
                    ]);
                    $syncedVraAccountNames[] = $masterRow->account_name;
                } else {
                    $newCost = Cost::create([
                        'tahun'          => $year,
                        'bulan'          => null,
                        'GL_ACCOUNT'     => '135.80.00005/850.91.05000/850.91.02002/850.91.04001/850.91.05002/850.91.05003/850.91.06001/850.91.06002',
                        'jenis_cost'     => 'BIAYA PERJALANAN DINAS',
                        'account_name'   => "Alokasi {$cName}",
                        'budget'         => 0,
                        'realisasi'      => $totalVal,
                        'budget_tahunan' => 0,
                    ]);
                    $syncedVraAccountNames[] = $newCost->account_name;
                }
            }

            // Remove non-standard orphan Alokasi rows (e.g., Alokasi Ford Ranger..., Alokasi Mobil Test)
            $standardVraAccounts = array_values($standardMap);
            Cost::where('tahun', $year)
                ->where('account_name', 'like', 'Alokasi %')
                ->whereNotIn('account_name', array_merge($standardVraAccounts, $syncedVraAccountNames))
                ->delete();

            // =========================================================================
            // 2. capex_rab -> COST (budget_tahunan) & 3. capex_realisasi -> COST (realisasi)
            // =========================================================================
            $capexMap = [
                'kantor' => 'Capex Kantor',
                'mess'   => 'Capex Mess',
            ];

            foreach ($capexMap as $lokasi => $accName) {
                $rabTotal  = (float) CapexRab::where('tahun', $year)->where('lokasi', $lokasi)->sum('total_rp');

                $realQuery = CapexRealisasi::where('tahun', $year)->where('lokasi', $lokasi);
                if ($month !== null) {
                    $realQuery->whereMonth('tanggal', $month);
                }
                $realTotal = (float) $realQuery->sum('total_rp');

                $matchingRows = Cost::where('tahun', $year)
                    ->where(function ($q) use ($accName, $lokasi) {
                        $q->where('account_name', $accName)
                          ->orWhere('account_name', 'like', "%Capex%{$lokasi}%");
                    })
                    ->orderBy('cost_id', 'asc')
                    ->get();

                if ($matchingRows->isNotEmpty()) {
                    $masterRow = $matchingRows->first();
                    if ($matchingRows->count() > 1) {
                        foreach ($matchingRows->slice(1) as $dup) {
                            if ((float)$masterRow->budget == 0 && (float)$dup->budget > 0) {
                                $masterRow->budget = $dup->budget;
                            }
                            if ((float)$masterRow->budget_tahunan == 0 && (float)$dup->budget_tahunan > 0) {
                                $masterRow->budget_tahunan = $dup->budget_tahunan;
                            }
                            $dup->delete();
                        }
                    }

                    $finalBudgetTahunan = $rabTotal > 0 ? $rabTotal : $masterRow->budget_tahunan;

                    $masterRow->update([
                        'account_name'   => $accName,
                        'budget_tahunan' => $finalBudgetTahunan,
                        'realisasi'      => $realTotal,
                        'jenis_cost'     => 'CAPEX',
                        'budget'         => $masterRow->budget,
                    ]);
                } else {
                    Cost::create([
                        'tahun'          => $year,
                        'bulan'          => null,
                        'GL_ACCOUNT'     => '135.80.00010',
                        'jenis_cost'     => 'CAPEX',
                        'account_name'   => $accName,
                        'budget'         => 0,
                        'realisasi'      => $realTotal,
                        'budget_tahunan' => $rabTotal,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            // =========================================================================
            // 4. Biaya_Rekruit -> COST (realisasi)
            // =========================================================================
            $rekruitQuery = BiayaRekruit::query()->where(function ($q) use ($year) {
                $q->where('tahun', $year)
                  ->orWhereYear('tanggal', $year);
            });
            if ($month !== null) {
                $rekruitQuery->whereMonth('tanggal', $month);
            }
            $totalRekruit = (float) $rekruitQuery->sum('total_biaya');
            $stats['rekruit'] = $totalRekruit;

            $matchingRows = Cost::where('tahun', $year)
                ->where(function ($q) {
                    $q->where('account_name', 'REKRUT')
                      ->orWhere('account_name', 'like', '%REKRUT%');
                })
                ->orderBy('cost_id', 'asc')
                ->get();

            if ($matchingRows->isNotEmpty()) {
                $masterRow = $matchingRows->first();
                if ($matchingRows->count() > 1) {
                    foreach ($matchingRows->slice(1) as $dup) {
                        if ((float)$masterRow->budget == 0 && (float)$dup->budget > 0) {
                            $masterRow->budget = $dup->budget;
                        }
                        if ((float)$masterRow->budget_tahunan == 0 && (float)$dup->budget_tahunan > 0) {
                            $masterRow->budget_tahunan = $dup->budget_tahunan;
                        }
                        $dup->delete();
                    }
                }

                $masterRow->update([
                    'account_name'   => 'REKRUT',
                    'realisasi'      => $totalRekruit,
                    'jenis_cost'     => 'REKRUT',
                    'budget'         => $masterRow->budget,
                    'budget_tahunan' => $masterRow->budget_tahunan,
                ]);
            } else {
                Cost::create([
                    'tahun'          => $year,
                    'bulan'          => null,
                    'GL_ACCOUNT'     => '135.80.00008',
                    'jenis_cost'     => 'REKRUT',
                    'account_name'   => 'REKRUT',
                    'budget'         => 0,
                    'realisasi'      => $totalRekruit,
                    'budget_tahunan' => 0,
                ]);
            }
        });

        return $stats;
    }

    /**
     * Import CSV File into Cost Database.
     */
    public function importCsv(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'csv_file'    => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt,text|max:10240',
            'import_mode' => 'nullable|string|in:append,replace',
            'tahun'       => 'nullable|integer|min:2000|max:2099',
            'bulan'       => 'nullable',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('csv_file');
        $filePath = $file->getRealPath();
        $importMode = $request->get('import_mode', 'append');
        $defaultYear = (int) $request->get('tahun', date('Y'));

        $rawTargetMonth = $request->get('bulan');
        $targetMonth = (is_numeric($rawTargetMonth) && (int)$rawTargetMonth >= 1 && (int)$rawTargetMonth <= 12) ? (int)$rawTargetMonth : null;

        $handle = fopen($filePath, 'r');
        if (!$handle) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Gagal membuka file CSV yang diunggah.');
        }

        $delimiter = $this->detectCsvDelimiter($filePath);

        // Read header
        $rawHeaders = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter);
        if (!$rawHeaders) {
            fclose($handle);
            return back()->with('error', 'Format file CSV tidak valid atau kosong.');
        }

        // Clean & normalize headers
        $cleanHeaders = $this->cleanCsvHeaders($rawHeaders);

        // Map column indices
        $headerMap = [];
        foreach ($cleanHeaders as $idx => $col) {
            if (in_array($col, ['costid', 'id'])) $headerMap['cost_id'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['glaccount', 'gl', 'noaccount', 'kodeaccount'])) $headerMap['GL_ACCOUNT'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['jeniscost', 'kategori', 'jenispengeluaran', 'kelompok'])) $headerMap['jenis_cost'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['accountname', 'namaaccount', 'namaitem', 'uraian', 'keterangan'])) $headerMap['account_name'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['bulan', 'month', 'bln'])) $headerMap['bulan'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['tahun', 'year', 'thn'])) $headerMap['tahun'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['budget', 'anggaran', 'budgetbulan'])) $headerMap['budget'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['realisasi', 'aktual', 'actual'])) $headerMap['realisasi'] = $idx;
            if (in_array($col, ['budgettahunan', 'budgettahun', 'annualbudget', 'totalbudget'])) $headerMap['budget_tahunan'] = $idx;
        }

        // Handle Replace mode
        if ($importMode === 'replace') {
            $delQuery = Cost::where('tahun', $defaultYear);
            if ($targetMonth !== null) {
                $delQuery->where('bulan', $targetMonth);
            }
            $delQuery->delete();
        }

        $importedCount = 0;
        $updatedCount  = 0;

        DB::beginTransaction();
        try {
            while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
                // Skip empty rows
                if (empty(array_filter($row, fn($v) => trim($v) !== ''))) {
                    continue;
                }

                $getVal = function ($key, $default = null) use ($row, $headerMap) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$key]) && isset($row[$headerMap[$key]])) {
                        return trim($row[$headerMap[$key]]);
                    }
                    return $default;
                };

                $costId        = $getVal('cost_id');
                $glAccount     = $getVal('GL_ACCOUNT', null);
                $jenisCost     = $getVal('jenis_cost', 'BIAYA UMUM LAINNYA');
                $accountName   = $getVal('account_name', 'Item Biaya');
                $rawBulan      = $getVal('bulan');
                if ($rawBulan !== null && $rawBulan !== '' && is_numeric($rawBulan) && (int)$rawBulan >= 1 && (int)$rawBulan <= 12) {
                    $bulan = (int)$rawBulan;
                } else {
                    $bulan = $targetMonth;
                }

                $tahun         = (int) $getVal('tahun', $defaultYear);
                if ($tahun <= 0) $tahun = $defaultYear;

                $budget        = $this->cleanNumeric($getVal('budget', 0));
                $realisasi     = $this->cleanNumeric($getVal('realisasi', 0));
                $budgetTahunan = $this->cleanNumeric($getVal('budget_tahunan', $budget * 12));

                $data = [
                    'GL_ACCOUNT'     => $glAccount,
                    'jenis_cost'     => $jenisCost,
                    'account_name'   => $accountName,
                    'bulan'          => $bulan,
                    'tahun'          => $tahun,
                    'budget'         => $budget,
                    'realisasi'      => $realisasi,
                    'budget_tahunan' => $budgetTahunan,
                ];

                $upperAcc = strtoupper(trim($accountName));
                $isAutomated = (
                    (str_contains($upperAcc, 'ALOKASI') && (str_contains($upperAcc, 'BUS') || str_contains($upperAcc, 'HILUX') || str_contains($upperAcc, 'FORTUNER'))) ||
                    (str_contains($upperAcc, 'CAPEX') && (str_contains($upperAcc, 'KANTOR') || str_contains($upperAcc, 'MESS') || str_contains($upperAcc, 'MES'))) ||
                    ($upperAcc === 'REKRUT' || str_contains($upperAcc, 'BIAYA REKRUIT') || str_contains($upperAcc, 'BIAYA REKRUT'))
                );

                if ($isAutomated) {
                    $existing = $this->findExistingAutomatedCost($tahun, $accountName);
                    if ($existing) {
                        $existing->update([
                            'GL_ACCOUNT'     => $glAccount ?: $existing->GL_ACCOUNT,
                            'jenis_cost'     => $jenisCost ?: $existing->jenis_cost,
                            'account_name'   => $accountName ?: $existing->account_name,
                            'budget'         => $budget,
                            'budget_tahunan' => $budgetTahunan > 0 ? $budgetTahunan : ($budget * 12),
                            // Keep dynamic calculated realisasi if already non-zero, otherwise update
                            'realisasi'      => (float)$existing->realisasi > 0 ? $existing->realisasi : $realisasi,
                        ]);
                        $updatedCount++;
                    } else {
                        Cost::create($data);
                        $importedCount++;
                    }
                } elseif ($costId && is_numeric($costId)) {
                    $existing = Cost::find((int) $costId);
                    if ($existing) {
                        $existing->update($data);
                        $updatedCount++;
                    } else {
                        $data['cost_id'] = (int) $costId;
                        Cost::create($data);
                        $importedCount++;
                    }
                } else {
                    $existing = Cost::where('tahun', $tahun)
                        ->where('account_name', $accountName)
                        ->where(function ($q) use ($bulan) {
                            if ($bulan === null) $q->whereNull('bulan');
                            else $q->where('bulan', $bulan);
                        })
                        ->first();

                    if ($existing) {
                        $existing->update($data);
                        $updatedCount++;
                    } else {
                        Cost::create($data);
                        $importedCount++;
                    }
                }
            }

            DB::commit();
            fclose($handle);

            // Re-sync automatic aggregation from source tables
            $this->syncAggregatedCosts($defaultYear, $targetMonth);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            if (is_resource($handle)) {
                fclose($handle);
            }
            return back()->with('error', 'Terjadi kesalahan saat import data: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }

        $monthLabel = $targetMonth ? ' (' . (self::MONTH_NAMES[$targetMonth] ?? 'Bulan ' . $targetMonth) . ')' : '';
        $msg = "Import Data Cost{$monthLabel} berhasil! ({$importedCount} data baru ditambahkan, {$updatedCount} data diperbarui).";

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Cost',
            "Mengimport data Cost dari file " . $file->getClientOriginalName() . " ({$importedCount} baru, {$updatedCount} diperbarui)",
            ['filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(), 'imported' => $importedCount, 'updated' => $updatedCount]
        );

        $redirectMonth = $targetMonth ?? $request->get('current_month', 'all');

        return redirect()
            ->route('administrasi.cost.index', ['year' => $defaultYear, 'month' => $redirectMonth])
            ->with('success', $msg);
    }

    /**
     * Store a new Cost entry.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tahun'          => 'required|integer|min:2000|max:2099',
            'bulan'          => 'nullable|integer|min:1|max:12',
            'GL_ACCOUNT'     => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'jenis_cost'     => 'required|string|max:100',
            'account_name'   => 'required|string|max:150',
            'budget'         => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'realisasi'      => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'budget_tahunan' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
        ]);

        Cost::create($validated);

        return redirect()
            ->route('administrasi.cost.index', ['year' => $validated['tahun']])
            ->with('success', 'Data Cost berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    /**
     * Show single Cost item JSON for Edit modal.
     */
    public function show($id)
    {
        $record = Cost::findOrFail($id);
        return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => $record]);
    }

    /**
     * Update Cost item.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $record = Cost::findOrFail($id);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tahun'          => 'required|integer|min:2000|max:2099',
            'bulan'          => 'nullable|integer|min:1|max:12',
            'GL_ACCOUNT'     => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'jenis_cost'     => 'required|string|max:100',
            'account_name'   => 'required|string|max:150',
            'budget'         => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'realisasi'      => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'budget_tahunan' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
        ]);

        $record->update($validated);

        return redirect()
            ->route('administrasi.cost.index', ['year' => $record->tahun])
            ->with('success', 'Data Cost berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    /**
     * Delete Cost item.
     */
    public function destroy($id)
    {
        $record = Cost::findOrFail($id);
        $tahun = $record->tahun;
        $record->delete();

        return redirect()
            ->route('administrasi.cost.index', ['year' => $tahun])
            ->with('success', 'Data Cost berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    /**
     * Delete all Cost records (for selected month or entire year).
     */
    public function destroyAll(Request $request)
    {
        $year = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $month = $request->get('month', 'all');

        $query = Cost::where('tahun', $year);

        if (is_numeric($month) && (int)$month >= 1 && (int)$month <= 12) {
            $query->where('bulan', (int)$month);
            $deleted = $query->delete();
            $monthName = self::MONTH_NAMES[(int)$month] ?? "Bulan {$month}";
            $msg = "Seluruh data Cost pada {$monthName} {$year} ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.";
        } else {
            $deleted = $query->delete();
            $msg = "Seluruh data Cost tahun {$year} ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.";
        }

        ActivityLog::log('Hapus', 'Cost', $msg, [
            'count' => $deleted,
            'year'  => $year,
            'month' => $month,
        ]);

        return redirect()
            ->route('administrasi.cost.index', ['year' => $year, 'month' => $month])
            ->with('success', $msg);
    }

    /**
     * Export Cost data as CSV.
     */
    public function export(Request $request)
    {
        $year  = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $month = $request->get('month', 'all');

        $query = Cost::where('tahun', $year);
        if (is_numeric($month) && $month >= 1 && $month <= 12) {
            $query->where('bulan', (int)$month);
        }

        $records = $query->orderBy('jenis_cost')->orderBy('cost_id')->get();

        $headers = ['cost_id', 'GL_ACCOUNT', 'jenis_cost', 'account_name', 'bulan', 'budget', 'realisasi', 'budget_tahunan'];
        $dataRows = [];

        foreach ($records as $r) {
            $dataRows[] = [
                $r->cost_id,
                $r->GL_ACCOUNT,
                $r->jenis_cost,
                $r->account_name,
                $r->bulan,
                $r->budget,
                $r->realisasi,
                $r->budget_tahunan,
            ];
        }

        $filename = "Cost_Report_{$year}.xlsx";
        return \App\Services\ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Cost Report');
    }

    /**
     * Find existing automated cost record by account_name pattern matching.
     */
    protected function findExistingAutomatedCost(int $tahun, string $accountName): ?Cost
    {
        $upper = strtoupper(trim($accountName));

        // VRA (Bus, Hilux, Fortuner)
        if (str_contains($upper, 'ALOKASI') && (str_contains($upper, 'BUS') || str_contains($upper, 'HILUX') || str_contains($upper, 'FORTUNER'))) {
            $keyword = match (true) {
                str_contains($upper, 'BUS') => 'Bus',
                str_contains($upper, 'HILUX') => 'Hilux',
                str_contains($upper, 'FORTUNER') => 'Fortuner',
                default => '',
            };
            return Cost::where('tahun', $tahun)
                ->where(function ($q) use ($accountName, $keyword) {
                    $q->where('account_name', $accountName)
                      ->orWhere('account_name', 'like', "%Alokasi%{$keyword}%");
                })
                ->orderBy('cost_id', 'asc')
                ->first();
        }

        // Capex (Kantor, Mess)
        if (str_contains($upper, 'CAPEX') && (str_contains($upper, 'KANTOR') || str_contains($upper, 'MESS') || str_contains($upper, 'MES'))) {
            $lokasi = (str_contains($upper, 'MESS') || str_contains($upper, 'MES')) ? 'mess' : 'kantor';
            return Cost::where('tahun', $tahun)
                ->where(function ($q) use ($accountName, $lokasi) {
                    $q->where('account_name', $accountName)
                      ->orWhere('account_name', 'like', "%Capex%{$lokasi}%");
                })
                ->orderBy('cost_id', 'asc')
                ->first();
        }

        // Rekruit
        if ($upper === 'REKRUT' || str_contains($upper, 'BIAYA REKRUIT') || str_contains($upper, 'BIAYA REKRUT') || str_contains($upper, 'REKRUTMEN')) {
            return Cost::where('tahun', $tahun)
                ->where(function ($q) {
                    $q->where('account_name', 'REKRUT')
                      ->orWhere('account_name', 'like', '%REKRUT%');
                })
                ->orderBy('cost_id', 'asc')
                ->first();
        }

        return null;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Cost;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;

class VraController extends Controller
{
    use HandlesCsvImports;

    private const MONTHS = [
        1 => 'Januari',
        2 => 'Februari',
        3 => 'Maret',
        4 => 'April',
        5 => 'Mei',
        6 => 'Juni',
        7 => 'Juli',
        8 => 'Agustus',
        9 => 'September',
        10 => 'Oktober',
        11 => 'November',
        12 => 'Desember',
    ];

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        // 1. Dynamic Years & Selected Year
        $selectedYear = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $dbYears = Vra::select('tahun')->distinct()->pluck('tahun')->toArray();
        $baseYears = range(date('Y') - 3, date('Y') + 2);
        $years = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_merge($baseYears, $dbYears, [$selectedYear]))));
        sort($years);

        $selectedPeriod = $request->get('period', 'overall'); // 'overall' or '1'..'12'
        $search = trim($request->get('search', ''));
        $months = self::MONTHS;

        // 3. Query Data based on Period Context
        if ($selectedPeriod === 'overall') {
            // Overall View: Group by vehicle for annual summary
            $query = Vra::where('tahun', $selectedYear);

            if (!empty($search)) {
                $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                    $q->where('nomor_polisi', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                      ->orWhere('kendaraan', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                });
            }

            // Get grouped vehicle annual summary
            $records = $query->select(
                'nomor_polisi',
                'kendaraan',
                DB::raw('MAX(vra_id) as vra_id'),
                DB::raw('COUNT(bulan) as total_bulan_tercatat'),
                DB::raw('SUM(upah) as upah'),
                DB::raw('SUM(BBM) as BBM'),
                DB::raw('MAX(BBM_tahun) as BBM_tahun'),
                DB::raw('SUM(preventif_maintenance) as preventif_maintenance'),
                DB::raw('SUM(biaya_lainnya) as biaya_lainnya'),
                DB::raw('SUM(total_biaya_bulan) as total_biaya_bulan'),
                DB::raw('MIN(KM_awal) as KM_awal'),
                DB::raw('MAX(KM_akhir) as KM_akhir'),
                DB::raw('SUM(KM) as KM'),
                DB::raw('SUM(BBM_liter) as BBM_liter'),
                DB::raw('MAX(budget_tahun) as budget_tahun')
            )
            ->groupBy('nomor_polisi', 'kendaraan')
            ->orderBy('nomor_polisi', 'asc')
            ->paginate(15)
            ->withQueryString();

            // Calculate computed metrics per aggregated row
            $records->getCollection()->transform(function ($item) {
                $item->BBM_KM_liter = $item->BBM_liter > 0 ? ($item->KM / $item->BBM_liter) : 0;
                $item->VRA = $item->KM > 0 ? ($item->total_biaya_bulan / $item->KM) : 0;
                return $item;
            });

            // Calculate overall totals
            $allAnnualRecords = Vra::where('tahun', $selectedYear);
            if (!empty($search)) {
                $allAnnualRecords->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                    $q->where('nomor_polisi', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                      ->orWhere('kendaraan', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                });
            }

            $allGrouped = $allAnnualRecords->select(
                'nomor_polisi',
                'kendaraan',
                DB::raw('SUM(upah) as upah'),
                DB::raw('SUM(BBM) as BBM'),
                DB::raw('MAX(BBM_tahun) as BBM_tahun'),
                DB::raw('SUM(preventif_maintenance) as preventif_maintenance'),
                DB::raw('SUM(biaya_lainnya) as biaya_lainnya'),
                DB::raw('SUM(total_biaya_bulan) as total_biaya_bulan'),
                DB::raw('SUM(KM) as KM'),
                DB::raw('SUM(BBM_liter) as BBM_liter'),
                DB::raw('MAX(budget_tahun) as budget_tahun')
            )
            ->groupBy('nomor_polisi', 'kendaraan')
            ->get();

            $totals = $this->calculateTotals($allGrouped);

        } else {
            // Monthly View: Filter by specific month & year
            $monthNum = (int) $selectedPeriod;
            $query = Vra::where('tahun', $selectedYear)->where('bulan', $monthNum);

            if (!empty($search)) {
                $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                    $q->where('nomor_polisi', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                      ->orWhere('kendaraan', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                });
            }

            $records = $query->orderBy('nomor_polisi', 'asc')
                ->orderBy('vra_id', 'asc')
                ->paginate(15)
                ->withQueryString();

            // Calculate monthly totals
            $allMonthlyRecords = Vra::where('tahun', $selectedYear)
                ->where('bulan', $monthNum);

            if (!empty($search)) {
                $allMonthlyRecords->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                    $q->where('nomor_polisi', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                      ->orWhere('kendaraan', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                });
            }

            $totals = $this->calculateTotals($allMonthlyRecords->get());
        }

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Cost.vra', compact(
            'years',
            'selectedYear',
            'selectedPeriod',
            'months',
            'records',
            'totals',
            'search'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'nomor_polisi' => 'required|string|max:20',
            'kendaraan' => 'required|string|max:100',
            'tahun' => 'required|integer',
            'bulan' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:12',
            'upah' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'BBM' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'BBM_tahun' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'preventif_maintenance' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'biaya_lainnya' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'KM_awal' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'KM_akhir' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'KM' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'BBM_liter' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'budget_tahun' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
        ]);

        // Default numeric zero
        foreach ([
            'upah', 'BBM', 'BBM_tahun', 'preventif_maintenance',
            'biaya_lainnya', 'KM_awal', 'KM_akhir', 'KM', 'BBM_liter', 'budget_tahun'
        ] as $field) {
            $validated[$field] = isset($validated[$field]) && $validated[$field] !== '' ? (float) $validated[$field] : 0;
        }

        // Auto calculate Total Biaya Bulan = upah + BBM + preventif_maintenance + biaya_lainnya
        $validated['total_biaya_bulan'] = $validated['upah']
            + $validated['BBM']
            + $validated['preventif_maintenance']
            + $validated['biaya_lainnya'];

        // Auto calculate KM
        if ($validated['KM_akhir'] > $validated['KM_awal'] && $validated['KM'] == 0) {
            $validated['KM'] = $validated['KM_akhir'] - $validated['KM_awal'];
        } elseif ($validated['KM'] > 0 && $validated['KM_akhir'] == 0) {
            $validated['KM_akhir'] = $validated['KM_awal'] + $validated['KM'];
        }

        // Auto calculate BBM_KM_liter = KM / BBM_liter
        $validated['BBM_KM_liter'] = $validated['BBM_liter'] > 0 ? ($validated['KM'] / $validated['BBM_liter']) : 0;

        // Auto calculate VRA = total_biaya_bulan / KM
        $validated['VRA'] = $validated['KM'] > 0 ? ($validated['total_biaya_bulan'] / $validated['KM']) : 0;

        $vra = Vra::create($validated);

        (new CostController())->syncAggregatedCosts((int)$validated['tahun']);

        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Data VRA berhasil ditambahkan.',
                'data' => $vra
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.vra.index', [
            'year' => $validated['tahun'],
            'period' => $validated['bulan']
        ])->with('success', 'Data VRA untuk kendaraan ' . $validated['nomor_polisi'] . ' berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $vra = Vra::findOrFail($id);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'nomor_polisi' => 'required|string|max:20',
            'kendaraan' => 'required|string|max:100',
            'upah' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'BBM' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'BBM_tahun' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'preventif_maintenance' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'biaya_lainnya' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'KM_awal' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'KM_akhir' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'KM' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'BBM_liter' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'budget_tahun' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
        ]);

        // Default numeric zero
        foreach ([
            'upah', 'BBM', 'BBM_tahun', 'preventif_maintenance',
            'biaya_lainnya', 'KM_awal', 'KM_akhir', 'KM', 'BBM_liter', 'budget_tahun'
        ] as $field) {
            $validated[$field] = isset($validated[$field]) && $validated[$field] !== '' ? (float) $validated[$field] : 0;
        }

        // Auto calculate total biaya bulan
        $validated['total_biaya_bulan'] = $validated['upah']
            + $validated['BBM']
            + $validated['preventif_maintenance']
            + $validated['biaya_lainnya'];

        // Auto calculate KM
        if ($validated['KM_akhir'] > $validated['KM_awal'] && $validated['KM'] == 0) {
            $validated['KM'] = $validated['KM_akhir'] - $validated['KM_awal'];
        } elseif ($validated['KM'] > 0 && $validated['KM_akhir'] == 0) {
            $validated['KM_akhir'] = $validated['KM_awal'] + $validated['KM'];
        }

        // Auto calculate BBM_KM_liter = KM / BBM_liter
        $validated['BBM_KM_liter'] = $validated['BBM_liter'] > 0 ? ($validated['KM'] / $validated['BBM_liter']) : 0;

        // Auto calculate VRA = total_biaya_bulan / KM
        $validated['VRA'] = $validated['KM'] > 0 ? ($validated['total_biaya_bulan'] / $validated['KM']) : 0;

        $vra->update($validated);

        (new CostController())->syncAggregatedCosts((int)$vra->tahun);

        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Data VRA berhasil diperbarui.',
                'data' => $vra
            ]);
        }

        $period = $request->get('period', $vra->bulan);

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.vra.index', [
            'year' => $vra->tahun,
            'period' => $period
        ])->with('success', 'Data VRA untuk kendaraan ' . $vra->nomor_polisi . ' berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $vra = Vra::findOrFail($id);
        $year = $vra->tahun;
        $period = $request->get('period', $vra->bulan);
        $noPol = $vra->nomor_polisi;

        $vra->delete();

        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => "Data VRA {$noPol} berhasil dihapus."
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.vra.index', [
            'year' => $year,
            'period' => $period
        ])->with('success', "Data VRA kendaraan {$noPol} berhasil dihapus.");
    }

    /**

    public function export(Request $request)
    {
        $year = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $period = $request->get('period', 'overall');

        $headers = [
            'vra_id',
            'nomor_polisi',
            'kendaraan',
            'bulan',
            'upah',
            'BBM',
            'BBM_tahun',
            'preventif_maintenance',
            'biaya_lainnya',
            'total_biaya_bulan',
            'KM_awal',
            'KM_akhir',
            'KM',
            'BBM_liter',
            'BBM_KM_liter',
            'VRA',
            'budget_tahun'
        ];

        $query = Vra::where('tahun', $year);
        if ($period !== 'overall') {
            $query->where('bulan', (int) $period);
        }

        $records = $query->orderBy('bulan', 'asc')->orderBy('nomor_polisi', 'asc')->get();
        $dataRows = [];

        foreach ($records as $row) {
            $dataRows[] = [
                $row->vra_id,
                $row->nomor_polisi,
                $row->kendaraan,
                $row->bulan,
                $row->upah,
                $row->BBM,
                $row->BBM_tahun,
                $row->preventif_maintenance,
                $row->biaya_lainnya,
                $row->total_biaya_bulan,
                $row->KM_awal,
                $row->KM_akhir,
                $row->KM,
                $row->BBM_liter,
                $row->BBM_KM_liter,
                $row->VRA,
                $row->budget_tahun
            ];
        }

        $filename = "VRA_Report_{$year}_" . ($period === 'overall' ? 'Overall' : "Bulan_{$period}") . ".xlsx";
        return \App\Services\ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Report VRA');
    }

    /**
     * Import CSV File into VRA Database
     */
    public function importCsv(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'csv_file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt,text|max:10240',
            'import_mode' => 'nullable|string|in:append,replace',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('csv_file');
        $filePath = $file->getRealPath();
        $importMode = $request->get('import_mode', 'append');

        // Optional replace existing data
        if ($importMode === 'replace') {
            Vra::truncate();
        }

        // Open file
        $handle = fopen($filePath, 'r');
        if (!$handle) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Gagal membuka file CSV yang diunggah.');
        }

        $delimiter = $this->detectCsvDelimiter($filePath);
        $rawHeaders = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter);
        if (!$rawHeaders) {
            fclose($handle);
            return back()->with('error', 'Format file CSV tidak valid atau file kosong.');
        }

        $cleanHeaders = $this->cleanCsvHeaders($rawHeaders);

        // Normalize header mapping
        $headerMap = [];
        foreach ($cleanHeaders as $index => $clean) {
            if (in_array($clean, ['vraid', 'id', 'idvra'])) {
                $headerMap['vra_id'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['nomorpolisi', 'nopolisi', 'nopol', 'plat', 'platnomor'])) {
                $headerMap['nomor_polisi'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['kendaraan', 'namakendaraan', 'jeniskendaraan', 'unit', 'mobil', 'tipekendaraan'])) {
                $headerMap['kendaraan'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['bulan', 'month', 'bln', 'periode'])) {
                $headerMap['bulan'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['tahun', 'year', 'thn'])) {
                $headerMap['tahun'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['upah', 'upahbulan', 'biayaupah', 'gaji'])) {
                $headerMap['upah'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['bbmtahun', 'bbmpertahun', 'bahanbakartahun'])) {
                $headerMap['BBM_tahun'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['bbm', 'bbmbulan', 'bahanbakar', 'biayabbm'])) {
                $headerMap['BBM'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['preventifmaintenance', 'prevmaint', 'preventivemaintenance', 'maintenance', 'perawatan'])) {
                $headerMap['preventif_maintenance'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['biayalainnya', 'biayalain', 'lainnya'])) {
                $headerMap['biaya_lainnya'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['totalbiayabulan', 'totalbiaya', 'total'])) {
                $headerMap['total_biaya_bulan'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['kmawal', 'odometerawal', 'kilometerawal'])) {
                $headerMap['KM_awal'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['kmakhir', 'odometerakhir', 'kilometerakhir'])) {
                $headerMap['KM_akhir'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['km', 'kmbulan', 'totalkm', 'jarak'])) {
                $headerMap['KM'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['bbmliter', 'literbbm', 'liter'])) {
                $headerMap['BBM_liter'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['bbmkmliter', 'kmliter', 'kml', 'rasiobbm'])) {
                $headerMap['BBM_KM_liter'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['vra', 'biayaperkm', 'costperkm'])) {
                $headerMap['VRA'] = $index;
            } elseif (in_array($clean, ['budgettahun', 'budgetkmtahun', 'budgetkm', 'budget'])) {
                $headerMap['budget_tahun'] = $index;
            }
        }

        $fallbackYear = (int) $request->get('year', 2026);
        $fallbackMonth = $request->get('period') === 'overall' ? 5 : (int)$request->get('period', 5);

        $insertedCount = 0;
        $updatedCount = 0;

        while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
            if (empty(array_filter($row))) {
                continue;
            }

            $noPol = isset($headerMap['nomor_polisi']) && isset($row[$headerMap['nomor_polisi']]) ? trim($row[$headerMap['nomor_polisi']]) : '';
            $kendaraan = isset($headerMap['kendaraan']) && isset($row[$headerMap['kendaraan']]) ? trim($row[$headerMap['kendaraan']]) : '';

            if (empty($noPol) && empty($kendaraan)) {
                continue;
            }

            $tahun = isset($headerMap['tahun']) && !empty($row[$headerMap['tahun']]) ? (int)$row[$headerMap['tahun']] : $fallbackYear;
            $bulan = isset($headerMap['bulan']) && !empty($row[$headerMap['bulan']]) ? (int)$row[$headerMap['bulan']] : $fallbackMonth;

            // Month text fallback (Jan -> 1, Mei -> 5, etc.)
            if ($bulan === 0 && isset($headerMap['bulan']) && !empty($row[$headerMap['bulan']])) {
                $mText = strtolower(trim($row[$headerMap['bulan']]));
                $monthTextMap = [
                    'jan' => 1, 'januari' => 1, 'feb' => 2, 'februari' => 2, 'mar' => 3, 'maret' => 3,
                    'apr' => 4, 'april' => 4, 'mei' => 5, 'may' => 5, 'jun' => 6, 'juni' => 6,
                    'jul' => 7, 'juli' => 7, 'aug' => 8, 'agustus' => 8, 'agu' => 8, 'sep' => 9, 'september' => 9,
                    'okt' => 10, 'oktober' => 10, 'oct' => 10, 'nov' => 11, 'november' => 11, 'des' => 12, 'desember' => 12, 'dec' => 12
                ];
                $bulan = $monthTextMap[$mText] ?? 1;
            }

            $upah = isset($headerMap['upah']) ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['upah']], 0) : 0;
            $bbm = isset($headerMap['BBM']) ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['BBM']], 0) : 0;
            $bbmTahun = isset($headerMap['BBM_tahun']) ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['BBM_tahun']], $bbm * 12) : ($bbm * 12);
            $maint = isset($headerMap['preventif_maintenance']) ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['preventif_maintenance']], 0) : 0;
            $lainnya = isset($headerMap['biaya_lainnya']) ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['biaya_lainnya']], 0) : 0;

            $totalBiayaBulan = isset($headerMap['total_biaya_bulan']) && $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['total_biaya_bulan']], 0) > 0
                ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['total_biaya_bulan']], 0)
                : ($upah + $bbm + $maint + $lainnya);

            $kmAwal = isset($headerMap['KM_awal']) ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['KM_awal']], 0) : 0;
            $kmAkhir = isset($headerMap['KM_akhir']) ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['KM_akhir']], 0) : 0;
            $km = isset($headerMap['KM']) && $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['KM']], 0) > 0
                ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['KM']], 0)
                : ($kmAkhir > $kmAwal ? ($kmAkhir - $kmAwal) : 0);

            if ($kmAkhir == 0 && $kmAwal > 0 && $km > 0) {
                $kmAkhir = $kmAwal + $km;
            }

            $bbmLiter = isset($headerMap['BBM_liter']) ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['BBM_liter']], 0) : 0;

            $bbmKmLiter = isset($headerMap['BBM_KM_liter']) && $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['BBM_KM_liter']], 0) > 0
                ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['BBM_KM_liter']], 0)
                : ($bbmLiter > 0 ? ($km / $bbmLiter) : 0);

            $vraVal = isset($headerMap['VRA']) && $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['VRA']], 0) > 0
                ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['VRA']], 0)
                : ($km > 0 ? ($totalBiayaBulan / $km) : 0);

            $budgetTahun = isset($headerMap['budget_tahun']) ? $this->cleanNumeric($row[$headerMap['budget_tahun']], 0) : 0;

            // Check existing by vra_id if present, or by (nomor_polisi, tahun, bulan)
            $existing = null;
            if (isset($headerMap['vra_id']) && !empty($row[$headerMap['vra_id']])) {
                $id = (int)$row[$headerMap['vra_id']];
                $existing = Vra::find($id);
            }

            if (!$existing) {
                $existing = Vra::where('nomor_polisi', $noPol)
                    ->where('tahun', $tahun)
                    ->where('bulan', $bulan)
                    ->first();
            }

            $dataArray = [
                'nomor_polisi' => $noPol,
                'kendaraan' => $kendaraan ?: ($existing ? $existing->kendaraan : 'Kendaraan Operasional'),
                'tahun' => $tahun,
                'bulan' => $bulan,
                'upah' => $upah,
                'BBM' => $bbm,
                'BBM_tahun' => $bbmTahun,
                'preventif_maintenance' => $maint,
                'biaya_lainnya' => $lainnya,
                'total_biaya_bulan' => $totalBiayaBulan,
                'KM_awal' => $kmAwal,
                'KM_akhir' => $kmAkhir,
                'KM' => $km,
                'BBM_liter' => $bbmLiter,
                'BBM_KM_liter' => $bbmKmLiter,
                'VRA' => $vraVal,
                'budget_tahun' => $budgetTahun,
            ];

            if ($existing) {
                $existing->update($dataArray);
                $updatedCount++;
            } else {
                Vra::create($dataArray);
                $insertedCount++;
            }
        }

        fclose($handle);

        $msg = "Import CSV berhasil: {$insertedCount} data baru ditambahkan";
        if ($updatedCount > 0) {
            $msg .= ", {$updatedCount} data diperbarui";
        }
        $msg .= ".";

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'VRA',
            "Mengimport data VRA dari file " . $file->getClientOriginalName() . " ({$insertedCount} baru, {$updatedCount} diperbarui)",
            ['filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(), 'inserted' => $insertedCount, 'updated' => $updatedCount]
        );

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.vra.index', [
            'year' => $fallbackYear,
            'period' => $request->get('period', 'overall')
        ])->with('success', $msg);
    }

    /**
     * Delete all VRA records.
     */
    public function destroyAll(Request $request)
    {
        $year = $request->get('year');
        $period = $request->get('period', 'overall');

        $query = Vra::query();

        if ($year && is_numeric($year)) {
            $query->where('tahun', (int)$year);
        }

        if ($period !== 'overall' && is_numeric($period) && (int)$period >= 1 && (int)$period <= 12) {
            $query->where('bulan', (int)$period);
            $deleted = $query->delete();
            $monthName = self::MONTHS[(int)$period] ?? "Bulan {$period}";
            $msg = "Seluruh data VRA pada {$monthName} {$year} ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.";
        } else {
            $deleted = $query->delete();
            $msg = $year ? "Seluruh data VRA tahun {$year} ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus." : "Seluruh data VRA ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.";
        }

        ActivityLog::log('Hapus', 'VRA', $msg, [
            'count'  => $deleted,
            'year'   => $year,
            'period' => $period,
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.vra.index', [
            'year' => $year ?: 2026,
            'period' => $period
        ])->with('success', $msg);
    }

    /**
     * Helper to compute aggregate totals for VRA records.
     */
    protected function calculateTotals($rows): array
    {
        $totalKM = $rows->sum('KM');
        $totalBiaya = $rows->sum('total_biaya_bulan');
        $totalBBM_liter = $rows->sum('BBM_liter');

        return [
            'count'        => $rows->count(),
            'upah'         => $rows->sum('upah'),
            'bbm'          => $rows->sum('BBM'),
            'bbm_tahun'    => $rows->sum('BBM_tahun'),
            'maintenance'  => $rows->sum('preventif_maintenance'),
            'lainnya'      => $rows->sum('biaya_lainnya'),
            'total_biaya'  => $totalBiaya,
            'km'           => $totalKM,
            'bbm_liter'    => $totalBBM_liter,
            'bbm_km_liter' => $totalBBM_liter > 0 ? ($totalKM / $totalBBM_liter) : 0,
            'vra'          => $totalKM > 0 ? ($totalBiaya / $totalKM) : 0,
            'budget_tahun' => $rows->sum('budget_tahun'),
        ];
    }
