<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\Program\ProgramReguler;
use App\Models\Program\ProgramNonReguler;
use App\Models\Program\TrainingRecord;
use App\Models\Monitoring\Asisten;
use App\Models\Monitoring\AsistenProgramMonitoring;
use App\Services\SpreadsheetReader;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class DashboardController extends Controller
{
    public const MONTH_3_LETTERS = [
        1 => 'JAN', 2 => 'FEB', 3 => 'MAR', 4 => 'APR',
        5 => 'MEI', 6 => 'JUN', 7 => 'JUL', 8 => 'AGU',
        9 => 'SEP', 10 => 'OKT', 11 => 'NOV', 12 => 'DES',
    ];

    public function parseMonthNumber($value): ?int
    {
        if ($value === null || $value === '' || $value === 'all') return null;
        if (is_numeric($value)) {
            $num = (int) $value;
            return ($num >= 1 && $num <= 12) ? $num : null;
        }

        $upper = strtoupper(substr(trim((string) $value), 0, 3));
        $map = [
            'JAN' => 1, 'FEB' => 2, 'MAR' => 3, 'APR' => 4,
            'MEI' => 5, 'MAY' => 5, 'JUN' => 6, 'JUL' => 7,
            'AGU' => 8, 'AGS' => 8, 'AUG' => 8, 'SEP' => 9,
            'OKT' => 10, 'OCT' => 10, 'NOV' => 11, 'DES' => 12, 'DEC' => 12,
        ];
        return $map[$upper] ?? null;
    }

    public function extractYearFromField($val): ?int
    {
        if (empty($val)) return null;
        if ($val instanceof \DateTimeInterface) return (int) $val->format('Y');
        if (is_numeric($val) && (int)$val >= 2000 && (int)$val <= 2100) return (int) $val;
        if (is_array($val)) {
            foreach ($val as $item) {
                $y = $this->extractYearFromField($item);
                if ($y) return $y;
            }
            return null;
        }
        if (is_string($val)) {
            $trimmed = trim($val);
            if (str_starts_with($trimmed, '[') && str_ends_with($trimmed, ']')) {
                $decoded = json_decode($trimmed, true);
                if (is_array($decoded)) {
                    return $this->extractYearFromField($decoded);
                }
            }
            if (preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $trimmed, $m)) {
                return (int) $m[1];
            }
            $time = strtotime($trimmed);
            if ($time !== false && $time > 0) {
                return (int) date('Y', $time);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function resolveProgramRegulerYear($p): int
    {
        if ($p->Mulai_program && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->Mulai_program))) return $y;
        if (!empty($p->tahun) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tahun))) return $y;
        if (!empty($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan))) return $y;
        if ($p->Selesai_program && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->Selesai_program))) return $y;
        if ($p->created_at && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->created_at))) return $y;
        return 2026;
    }

    public function resolveProgramNonRegulerYear($p): int
    {
        if (!empty($p->tahun) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tahun))) return $y;
        if ($p->start_date && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->start_date))) return $y;
        if (!empty($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan))) return $y;
        if ($p->end_date && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->end_date))) return $y;
        if ($p->created_at && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->created_at))) return $y;
        return 2026;
    }

    protected function filterRegulerByYear($programs, int $year)
    {
        return $programs->filter(function($p) use ($year) {
            return $this->resolveProgramRegulerYear($p) === $year;
        });
    }

    protected function filterNonRegulerByYear($programs, int $year)
    {
        return $programs->filter(function($p) use ($year) {
            return $this->resolveProgramNonRegulerYear($p) === $year;
        });
    }

    protected function filterRecordsByYearAndCumulativeMonth($records, int $year, ?int $selectedMonthNum)
    {
        return $records->filter(function($r) use ($year, $selectedMonthNum) {
            // 1. Year filter
            $rYear = null;
            if (!empty($r->tahun)) {
                $rYear = (int) $r->tahun;
            } elseif (!empty($r->training_date)) {
                $rYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($r->training_date));
            } elseif (method_exists($r, 'activityDates')) {
                $dates = $r->activityDates();
                foreach ($dates as $d) {
                    if ($d) {
                        $rYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($d));
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } elseif (!empty($r->created_at)) {
                $rYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($r->created_at));
            } else {
                $rYear = 2026;
            }

            if ($rYear !== $year) {
                return false;
            }

            // 2. Month cumulative filter
            if ($selectedMonthNum !== null) {
                $mNum = null;
                if ($r->bulan) {
                    $mNum = $this->parseMonthNumber($r->bulan);
                }
                if (!$mNum && $r->training_date) {
                    $mNum = (int) date('n', strtotime($r->training_date));
                }
                if (!$mNum && method_exists($r, 'activityDates')) {
                    $dates = $r->activityDates();
                    foreach ($dates as $d) {
                        if ($d) {
                            $mNum = (int) date('n', strtotime($d));
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if ($mNum !== null && $mNum > $selectedMonthNum) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            return true;
        });
    }

    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $trYears = TrainingRecord::whereNotNull('tahun')->pluck('tahun')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->filter()->all();
        $trDateYears = TrainingRecord::whereNotNull('training_date')->get()->map(fn($r) => (int) date('Y', strtotime($r->training_date)))->filter()->all();
        $regYears = ProgramReguler::all()->map(fn($p) => $this->resolveProgramRegulerYear($p))->filter()->all();
        $nonRegYears = ProgramNonReguler::all()->map(fn($p) => $this->resolveProgramNonRegulerYear($p))->filter()->all();

        $years = collect([2024, 2025, 2026, 2027])
            ->merge($trYears)
            ->merge($trDateYears)
            ->merge($regYears)
            ->merge($nonRegYears)
            ->filter(fn($y) => $y >= 2000 && $y <= 2100)
            ->unique()
            ->sort()
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $yearDefault = in_array(2026, $years, true) ? 2026 : ($years[count($years)-1] ?? (int)date('Y'));
        $year = (int) $request->input('year', $yearDefault);
        $rawMonth = $request->input('month', 'all');
        $selectedMonthNum = $this->parseMonthNumber($rawMonth);
        $selectedMonthCode = $selectedMonthNum ? self::MONTH_3_LETTERS[$selectedMonthNum] : 'all';
        $monthList = self::MONTH_3_LETTERS;

        // 1. REKAP TRAINING REPORT (Reguler, Softskill, Technical)
        $rekapTraining = $this->computeRekapTrainingReport($year, $selectedMonthNum);

        // 2. MONITORING TRAINEE UNDER 2 YEARS
        $traineeUnder2Years = $this->computeTraineeUnder2Years($year);

        // 3. MONITORING KARIR LULUSAN FRLC
        $karirLulusan = $this->computeKarirLulusan($year);

        // 4. STAFF FRESH GRADUATE (Asisten Trainee)
        $staffFreshGraduate = $this->computeStaffFreshGraduate($year, $selectedMonthNum);

        // 5. PROGRAM SOFTSKILL BY REGION
        $softskillRegional = $this->computeSoftskillRegional($year, $selectedMonthNum);

        // 6. PROGRAM NON-REGULER TEKNIKAL BY CATEGORY & REGION
        $teknikalBreakdown = $this->computeTeknikalBreakdown($year, $selectedMonthNum);

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Dashboard.dashboard', compact(
            'year',
            'years',
            'rawMonth',
            'selectedMonthNum',
            'selectedMonthCode',
            'monthList',
            'rekapTraining',
            'traineeUnder2Years',
            'karirLulusan',
            'staffFreshGraduate',
            'softskillRegional',
            'teknikalBreakdown'
        ));
    }

    protected function computeRekapTrainingReport(int $year, ?int $selectedMonthNum = null): array
    {
        $regulerPrograms = $this->filterRegulerByYear(ProgramReguler::all(), $year);
        $nonRegulerPrograms = $this->filterNonRegulerByYear(ProgramNonReguler::all(), $year);
        $records = $this->filterRecordsByYearAndCumulativeMonth(TrainingRecord::all(), $year, $selectedMonthNum);

        $regPlanBatch = (int) $regulerPrograms->count();
        $regPlanPart = (int) $regulerPrograms->sum('target_peserta');
        $regRecords = $records->where('program_type', 'reguler');
        $regRealPart = (int) $regRecords->pluck('participant_identifier')->filter()->unique()->count() ?: (int) $regRecords->count();
        $regRealBatch = (int) $regRecords->pluck('notes')->filter()->unique()->count() ?: ($regRealPart > 0 ? $regPlanBatch : 0);
        $regPctBatch = $regPlanBatch > 0 ? round(($regRealBatch / $regPlanBatch) * 100) : 0;
        $regPctPart = $regPlanPart > 0 ? round(($regRealPart / $regPlanPart) * 100) : 0;

        $softPrograms = $nonRegulerPrograms->filter(fn($p) => $p->isSoftSkill());
        $softPlanBatch = (int) $softPrograms->sum(fn($p) => (int)($p->TARGET_BATCH ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0));
        $softPlanPart = (int) $softPrograms->sum(fn($p) => (int)($p->TARGET_PESERTA ?? $p->target_total ?? 0));
        $softRecords = $records->where('program_type', 'non_reguler')->filter(function($r) use ($softPrograms) {
            return $softPrograms->contains('id_nonreguler', $r->program_id);
        });
        $softRealPart = (int) $softRecords->count();
        $softRealBatch = (int) $softPrograms->sum(function($p) use ($softRecords) {
            $explicitBatch = (int) ($p->realisasi_batch ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0);
            if ($explicitBatch > 0) return $explicitBatch;
            $hasRecords = $softRecords->contains('program_id', $p->id_nonreguler);
            return $hasRecords ? 1 : 0;
        });
        $softPctBatch = $softPlanBatch > 0 ? round(($softRealBatch / $softPlanBatch) * 100) : 0;
        $softPctPart = $softPlanPart > 0 ? round(($softRealPart / $softPlanPart) * 100) : 0;

        $tekPrograms = $nonRegulerPrograms->filter(fn($p) => !$p->isSoftSkill());
        $tekPlanBatch = (int) $tekPrograms->sum(fn($p) => (int)($p->TARGET_BATCH ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0));
        $tekPlanPart = (int) $tekPrograms->sum(fn($p) => (int)($p->TARGET_PESERTA ?? $p->target_total ?? 0));
        $tekRecords = $records->where('program_type', 'non_reguler')->filter(function($r) use ($tekPrograms) {
            return $tekPrograms->contains('id_nonreguler', $r->program_id);
        });
        $tekRealPart = (int) $tekRecords->count();
        $tekRealBatch = (int) $tekPrograms->sum(function($p) use ($tekRecords) {
            $explicitBatch = (int) ($p->realisasi_batch ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0);
            if ($explicitBatch > 0) return $explicitBatch;
            $hasRecords = $tekRecords->contains('program_id', $p->id_nonreguler);
            return $hasRecords ? 1 : 0;
        });
        $tekPctBatch = $tekPlanBatch > 0 ? round(($tekRealBatch / $tekPlanBatch) * 100) : 0;
        $tekPctPart = $tekPlanPart > 0 ? round(($tekRealPart / $tekPlanPart) * 100) : 0;

        return [
            'rows' => [
                'reguler' => [
                    'name' => 'REGULER',
                    'plan_batch' => $regPlanBatch, 'plan_participant' => $regPlanPart,
                    'realisasi_batch' => $regRealBatch, 'realisasi_participant' => $regRealPart,
                    'pct_batch' => $regPctBatch, 'pct_participant' => $regPctPart,
                ],
                'softskill' => [
                    'name' => 'SOFTSKILL',
                    'plan_batch' => $softPlanBatch, 'plan_participant' => $softPlanPart,
                    'realisasi_batch' => $softRealBatch, 'realisasi_participant' => $softRealPart,
                    'pct_batch' => $softPctBatch, 'pct_participant' => $softPctPart,
                ],
                'technical' => [
                    'name' => 'TECHNICAL/REFRESHMENT',
                    'plan_batch' => $tekPlanBatch, 'plan_participant' => $tekPlanPart,
                    'realisasi_batch' => $tekRealBatch, 'realisasi_participant' => $tekRealPart,
                    'pct_batch' => $tekPctBatch, 'pct_participant' => $tekPctPart,
                ],
            ],
            'chart_batch' => [
                'categories' => ['REGULER', 'SOFTSKILL', 'TECHNICAL/REFRESHMENT'],
                'plan' => [$regPlanBatch, $softPlanBatch, $tekPlanBatch],
                'realisasi' => [$regRealBatch, $softRealBatch, $tekRealBatch],
                'pct' => [$regPctBatch, $softPctBatch, $tekPctBatch],
            ],
            'chart_participant' => [
                'categories' => ['REGULER', 'SOFTSKILL', 'TECHNICAL/REFRESHMENT'],
                'plan' => [$regPlanPart, $softPlanPart, $tekPlanPart],
                'realisasi' => [$regRealPart, $softRealPart, $tekRealPart],
                'pct' => [$regPctPart, $softPctPart, $tekPctPart],
            ],
        ];
    }

    protected function computeTraineeUnder2Years(int $currentYear): array
    {
        $minYear = $currentYear - 2;
        $batchPrograms = AsistenProgramMonitoring::where(function($q) use ($minYear) {
            $q->where('tahun_training', '>=', $minYear)
              ->orWhere('tahun_lulus', '>=', $minYear)
              ->orWhere('tahun_rekrut', '>=', $minYear);
        })->get();

        $programKeywords = [
            'FAT' => ['FIELD ASSISTANT', 'FAT'],
            'MAT' => ['MILL ASSISTANT', 'MAT'],
            'AAT' => ['ADMIN ASSISTANT', 'ADMINISTRATION ASSISTANT', 'AAT'],
            'TAT' => ['TRACTION ASSISTANT', 'TAT'],
        ];

        $allAsisten = Asisten::all();
        $rows = [];
        $totTrainee = 0; $totCulled = 0; $totPassed = 0; $totResign = 0; $totExisting = 0;

        foreach ($programKeywords as $prog => $keywords) {
            $filtered = $batchPrograms->filter(function($b) use ($keywords) {
                $name = strtoupper((string)$b->nama_program);
                $cat = strtoupper((string)$b->kategori_program);
                foreach ($keywords as $kw) {
                    if (str_contains($name, $kw) || str_contains($cat, $kw)) return true;
                }
                return false;
            });

            $trainee = (int) $filtered->sum('jumlah_trainee');
            $culled = (int) $filtered->sum('jumlah_culled');
            $passed = max(0, $trainee - $culled);

            $asistenRecent = $allAsisten->filter(function($a) use ($keywords, $minYear) {
                $pName = strtoupper((string)$a->program);
                $matchesProg = false;
                foreach ($keywords as $kw) {
                    if (str_contains($pName, $kw)) {
                        $matchesProg = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!$matchesProg) return false;

                preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $pName, $matches);
                if (!empty($matches[1])) {
                    return (int)$matches[1] >= $minYear;
                }
                return true;
            });

            $resign = $asistenRecent->filter(fn($a) => in_array(strtoupper(trim((string)($a->status_karyawan ?: $a->keterangan ?: ''))), ['RESIGN', 'PHK', 'TERMINATE']))->count();
            $existing = max(0, $passed - $resign);

            $pctCulled = $trainee > 0 ? round(($culled / $trainee) * 100) : 0;
            $pctPassed = $trainee > 0 ? round(($passed / $trainee) * 100) : 0;
            $pctResign = $passed > 0 ? round(($resign / $passed) * 100) : 0;
            $pctExisting = $passed > 0 ? round(($existing / $passed) * 100) : 0;

            $rows[$prog] = [
                'program' => $prog,
                'trainee' => $trainee,
                'culled' => $culled,
                'passed' => $passed,
                'resign' => $resign,
                'existing' => $existing,
                'pct_culled' => $pctCulled,
                'pct_passed' => $pctPassed,
                'pct_resign' => $pctResign,
                'pct_existing' => $pctExisting,
            ];

            $totTrainee += $trainee;
            $totCulled += $culled;
            $totPassed += $passed;
            $totResign += $resign;
            $totExisting += $existing;
        }

        $totPctCulled = $totTrainee > 0 ? round(($totCulled / $totTrainee) * 100) : 0;
        $totPctPassed = $totTrainee > 0 ? round(($totPassed / $totTrainee) * 100) : 0;
        $totPctResign = $totPassed > 0 ? round(($totResign / $totPassed) * 100) : 0;
        $totPctExisting = $totPassed > 0 ? round(($totExisting / $totPassed) * 100) : 0;

        return [
            'rows' => $rows,
            'total' => [
                'program' => 'Total',
                'trainee' => $totTrainee,
                'culled' => $totCulled,
                'passed' => $totPassed,
                'resign' => $totResign,
                'existing' => $totExisting,
                'pct_culled' => $totPctCulled,
                'pct_passed' => $totPctPassed,
                'pct_resign' => $totPctResign,
                'pct_existing' => $totPctExisting,
            ],
            'chart' => [
                'categories' => array_keys($programKeywords),
                'culled' => array_column($rows, 'pct_culled'),
                'passed' => array_column($rows, 'pct_passed'),
                'resign' => array_column($rows, 'pct_resign'),
                'existing' => array_column($rows, 'pct_existing'),
            ]
        ];
    }

    protected function computeKarirLulusan(int $year): array
    {
        $allAsisten = Asisten::whereNotNull('program')->get();
        $minYear = $year - 2;
        $allAsisten = $allAsisten->filter(function($a) use ($year, $minYear) {
            $pName = strtoupper((string)$a->program);
            preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $pName, $matches);
            if (!empty($matches[1])) {
                return (int)$matches[1] >= $minYear && (int)$matches[1] <= $year;
            }
            if (!empty($a->tahun_lulus) || !empty($a->tahun_training) || !empty($a->tahun_rekrut)) {
                $yL = (int)$a->tahun_lulus;
                $yT = (int)$a->tahun_training;
                $yR = (int)$a->tahun_rekrut;
                return ($yL >= $minYear && $yL <= $year) || ($yT >= $minYear && $yT <= $year) || ($yR >= $minYear && $yR <= $year);
            }
            return true;
        });

        $programKeywords = [
            'FAT' => ['FIELD ASSISTANT', 'FAT'],
            'MAT' => ['MILL ASSISTANT', 'MAT'],
            'AAT' => ['ADMIN ASSISTANT', 'ADMINISTRATION ASSISTANT', 'AAT'],
            'TAT' => ['TRACTION ASSISTANT', 'TAT'],
            'DMT' => ['DOWNSTREAM', 'DMT'],
        ];

        $rows = [];
        $totPc = 0; $totGm = 0; $totMk = 0; $totAskep = 0; $totAsst = 0; $totAll = 0;

        foreach ($programKeywords as $prog => $keywords) {
            $progAsisten = $allAsisten->filter(function($a) use ($keywords) {
                $pName = strtoupper((string)$a->program);
                foreach ($keywords as $kw) {
                    if (str_contains($pName, $kw)) return true;
                }
                return false;
            });

            $pc = 0; $gm = 0; $mk = 0; $askep = 0; $asst = 0;

            foreach ($progAsisten as $a) {
                $lvl = strtoupper(trim((string)($a->level_jabatan ?: '')));
                if ($lvl === '') {
                    $lvl = strtoupper(trim((string)($a->jabatan_terakhir ?: $a->jabatan_awal ?: '')));
                }
                if (str_contains($lvl, 'PC') || str_contains($lvl, 'CONTROLLER')) $pc++;
                elseif (str_contains($lvl, 'GM') || str_contains($lvl, 'GENERAL MANAGER')) $gm++;
                elseif (str_contains($lvl, 'MK') || str_contains($lvl, 'MM') || str_contains($lvl, 'MANAGER') || str_contains($lvl, 'KASIE')) $mk++;
                elseif (str_contains($lvl, 'ASKEP') || str_contains($lvl, 'KTU')) $askep++;
                else $asst++;
            }

            $total = $pc + $gm + $mk + $askep + $asst;

            $rows[$prog] = [
                'program' => $prog,
                'pc' => $pc, 'gm' => $gm, 'mk_mm' => $mk, 'askep_ktu' => $askep, 'asst' => $asst,
                'total' => $total,
                'pct_pc' => $total > 0 ? round(($pc / $total) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'pct_gm' => $total > 0 ? round(($gm / $total) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'pct_mk_mm' => $total > 0 ? round(($mk / $total) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'pct_askep_ktu' => $total > 0 ? round(($askep / $total) * 100, 1) : 0,
                'pct_asst' => $total > 0 ? round(($asst / $total) * 100, 1) : 0,
            ];

            $totPc += $pc; $totGm += $gm; $totMk += $mk; $totAskep += $askep; $totAsst += $asst; $totAll += $total;
        }

        $totalRow = [
            'program' => 'TOTAL',
            'pc' => $totPc, 'gm' => $totGm, 'mk_mm' => $totMk, 'askep_ktu' => $totAskep, 'asst' => $totAsst,
            'total' => $totAll,
            'pct_pc' => $totAll > 0 ? round(($totPc / $totAll) * 100, 2) : 0,
            'pct_gm' => $totAll > 0 ? round(($totGm / $totAll) * 100, 2) : 0,
            'pct_mk_mm' => $totAll > 0 ? round(($totMk / $totAll) * 100, 2) : 0,
            'pct_askep_ktu' => $totAll > 0 ? round(($totAskep / $totAll) * 100, 2) : 0,
            'pct_asst' => $totAll > 0 ? round(($totAsst / $totAll) * 100, 2) : 0,
        ];

        return ['rows' => $rows, 'total' => $totalRow];
    }

    protected function computeStaffFreshGraduate(int $year, ?int $selectedMonthNum = null): array
    {
        $reguler = $this->filterRegulerByYear(ProgramReguler::all(), $year);
        $records = $this->filterRecordsByYearAndCumulativeMonth(TrainingRecord::where('program_type', 'reguler')->get(), $year, $selectedMonthNum);

        $programs = ['FAT', 'MAT', 'DMT', 'TAT', 'AAT'];
        $rows = [];
        $totPlanB = 0; $totPlanP = 0; $totRealB = 0; $totRealP = 0;

        foreach ($programs as $prog) {
            $matchingMaster = $reguler->filter(fn($p) => str_starts_with(strtoupper($p->Training_Program), $prog));
            $planBatch = (int) $matchingMaster->count();
            $planPart = (int) $matchingMaster->sum('target_peserta');

            $matchingRecs = $records->filter(fn($r) => str_contains(strtoupper($r->notes), $prog));
            $realPart = (int) $matchingRecs->pluck('participant_identifier')->filter()->unique()->count() ?: (int) $matchingRecs->count();
            $realBatch = (int) $matchingRecs->pluck('notes')->filter()->unique()->count() ?: ($realPart > 0 ? max(1, $planBatch) : 0);

            $pctBatch = $planBatch > 0 ? round(($realBatch / $planBatch) * 100) : 0;
            $pctPart = $planPart > 0 ? round(($realPart / $planPart) * 100) : 0;

            $rows[$prog] = [
                'name' => $prog,
                'plan_batch' => $planBatch,
                'plan_participant' => $planPart,
                'realisasi_batch' => $realBatch,
                'realisasi_participant' => $realPart,
                'pct_batch' => $pctBatch,
                'pct_participant' => $pctPart,
            ];

            $totPlanB += $planBatch; $totPlanP += $planPart; $totRealB += $realBatch; $totRealP += $realPart;
        }

        $totPctB = $totPlanB > 0 ? round(($totRealB / $totPlanB) * 100) : 0;
        $totPctP = $totPlanP > 0 ? round(($totRealP / $totPlanP) * 100) : 0;

        return [
            'total' => [
                'name' => 'Asisten Trainee',
                'plan_batch' => $totPlanB, 'plan_participant' => $totPlanP,
                'realisasi_batch' => $totRealB, 'realisasi_participant' => $totRealP,
                'pct_batch' => $totPctB, 'pct_participant' => $totPctP,
            ],
            'rows' => $rows,
            'chart' => [
                'categories' => $programs,
                'plan' => array_column($rows, 'plan_participant'),
                'realisasi' => array_column($rows, 'realisasi_participant'),
                'pct' => array_column($rows, 'pct_participant'),
            ]
        ];
    }

    protected function computeSoftskillRegional(int $year, ?int $selectedMonthNum = null): array
    {
        $nonReg = $this->filterNonRegulerByYear(ProgramNonReguler::all(), $year)->filter(fn($p) => $p->isSoftSkill());
        $records = $this->filterRecordsByYearAndCumulativeMonth(TrainingRecord::where('program_type', 'non_reguler')->get(), $year, $selectedMonthNum);

        $regions = ['Riau', 'Kalbar', 'Kubar'];
        $rows = [];
        $totPlanB = 0; $totPlanP = 0; $totRealB = 0; $totRealP = 0;

        foreach ($regions as $reg) {
            $regKey = ($reg === 'Kubar') ? 'kaltim' : strtolower($reg);
            $matchingProgs = $nonReg->filter(fn($p) => str_contains(strtolower((string)$p->region), $regKey));

            $planBatch = (int) $matchingProgs->sum(fn($p) => (int)($p->TARGET_BATCH ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0));
            $planPart = (int) $matchingProgs->sum(fn($p) => (int)($p->TARGET_PESERTA ?? $p->target_total ?? 0));

            $matchingRecs = $records->filter(function($r) use ($matchingProgs, $regKey) {
                return $matchingProgs->contains('id_nonreguler', $r->program_id) || str_contains(strtolower((string)$r->region), $regKey);
            });
            $realPart = (int) $matchingRecs->count();
            $realBatch = (int) $matchingProgs->sum(function($p) use ($matchingRecs) {
                $explicitBatch = (int) ($p->realisasi_batch ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0);
                if ($explicitBatch > 0) return $explicitBatch;
                $hasRecords = $matchingRecs->contains('program_id', $p->id_nonreguler);
                return $hasRecords ? 1 : 0;
            });

            $pctB = $planBatch > 0 ? round(($realBatch / $planBatch) * 100) : 0;
            $pctP = $planPart > 0 ? round(($realPart / $planPart) * 100) : 0;

            $rows[$reg] = [
                'region' => $reg,
                'plan_batch' => $planBatch, 'plan_participant' => $planPart,
                'realisasi_batch' => $realBatch, 'realisasi_participant' => $realPart,
                'pct_batch' => $pctB, 'pct_participant' => $pctP,
            ];

            $totPlanB += $planBatch; $totPlanP += $planPart; $totRealB += $realBatch; $totRealP += $realPart;
        }

        $totPctB = $totPlanB > 0 ? round(($totRealB / $totPlanB) * 100) : 0;
        $totPctP = $totPlanP > 0 ? round(($totRealP / $totPlanP) * 100) : 0;

        return [
            'total' => [
                'region' => 'Softskill',
                'plan_batch' => $totPlanB, 'plan_participant' => $totPlanP,
                'realisasi_batch' => $totRealB, 'realisasi_participant' => $totRealP,
                'pct_batch' => $totPctB, 'pct_participant' => $totPctP,
            ],
            'rows' => $rows,
            'chart' => [
                'categories' => $regions,
                'plan_batch' => array_column($rows, 'plan_batch'),
                'realisasi_batch' => array_column($rows, 'realisasi_batch'),
                'pct_batch' => array_column($rows, 'pct_batch'),
                'plan_participant' => array_column($rows, 'plan_participant'),
                'realisasi_participant' => array_column($rows, 'realisasi_participant'),
                'pct_participant' => array_column($rows, 'pct_participant'),
            ]
        ];
    }

    protected function computeTeknikalBreakdown(int $year, ?int $selectedMonthNum = null): array
    {
        $nonReg = $this->filterNonRegulerByYear(ProgramNonReguler::all(), $year)->filter(fn($p) => !$p->isSoftSkill());
        $records = $this->filterRecordsByYearAndCumulativeMonth(TrainingRecord::where('program_type', 'non_reguler')->get(), $year, $selectedMonthNum);

        $categories = ['ESTATE', 'MILL', 'TRACTION', 'DOWNSTREAM', 'ADMINISTRASI'];
        $groups = [];
        $chartPartPlan = []; $chartPartReal = []; $chartPartPct = [];
        $chartBatchPlan = []; $chartBatchReal = []; $chartBatchPct = [];

        foreach ($categories as $cat) {
            $catKey = strtolower($cat);
            $catProgs = $nonReg->filter(function($p) use ($catKey) {
                $haystack = strtolower(($p->kategori_pelatihan ?? '') . ' ' . ($p->sub_kategori ?? '') . ' ' . ($p->jenis_pelatihan ?? ''));
                if ($catKey === 'estate') {
                    return str_contains($haystack, 'estate') || str_contains($haystack, 'tanaman') || str_contains($haystack, 'agronomi') || str_contains($haystack, 'kebun')
                        || (!str_contains($haystack, 'mill') && !str_contains($haystack, 'pabrik') && !str_contains($haystack, 'traction') && !str_contains($haystack, 'traksi') && !str_contains($haystack, 'downstream') && !str_contains($haystack, 'administrasi') && !str_contains($haystack, 'admin'));
                }
                if ($catKey === 'mill') {
                    return str_contains($haystack, 'mill') || str_contains($haystack, 'pabrik') || str_contains($haystack, 'processing');
                }
                if ($catKey === 'traction') {
                    return str_contains($haystack, 'traction') || str_contains($haystack, 'traksi') || str_contains($haystack, 'bengkel') || str_contains($haystack, 'workshop');
                }
                if ($catKey === 'downstream') {
                    return str_contains($haystack, 'downstream') || str_contains($haystack, 'refinery') || str_contains($haystack, 'biodiesel');
                }
                if ($catKey === 'administrasi') {
                    return str_contains($haystack, 'administrasi') || str_contains($haystack, 'admin') || str_contains($haystack, 'finance') || str_contains($haystack, 'accounting') || str_contains($haystack, 'hrd') || str_contains($haystack, 'ktu');
                }
                return false;
            });

            $planB = (int) $catProgs->sum(fn($p) => (int)($p->TARGET_BATCH ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0));
            $planP = (int) $catProgs->sum(fn($p) => (int)($p->TARGET_PESERTA ?? $p->target_total ?? 0));

            $catRecs = $records->filter(function($r) use ($catProgs, $catKey) {
                if ($r->program_id) {
                    return $catProgs->contains('id_nonreguler', $r->program_id);
                }
                $notes = strtolower((string)$r->notes);
                if ($catKey === 'estate') return str_contains($notes, 'estate') || str_contains($notes, 'tanaman') || str_contains($notes, 'agronomi');
                if ($catKey === 'mill') return str_contains($notes, 'mill') || str_contains($notes, 'pabrik');
                if ($catKey === 'traction') return str_contains($notes, 'traction') || str_contains($notes, 'traksi') || str_contains($notes, 'bengkel');
                if ($catKey === 'downstream') return str_contains($notes, 'downstream');
                if ($catKey === 'administrasi') return str_contains($notes, 'administrasi') || str_contains($notes, 'admin');
                return false;
            });
            $realP = (int) $catRecs->count();
            $realB = (int) $catProgs->sum(function($p) use ($catRecs) {
                $explicitBatch = (int) ($p->realisasi_batch ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0);
                if ($explicitBatch > 0) return $explicitBatch;
                $hasRecords = $catRecs->contains('program_id', $p->id_nonreguler);
                return $hasRecords ? 1 : 0;
            });

            $pctB = $planB > 0 ? round(($realB / $planB) * 100) : 0;
            $pctP = $planP > 0 ? round(($realP / $planP) * 100) : 0;

            $items = [];
            if ($cat !== 'DOWNSTREAM') {
                foreach (['Riau', 'Kalbar', 'Kubar'] as $reg) {
                    $regKey = ($reg === 'Kubar') ? 'kaltim' : strtolower($reg);
                    $regProgs = $catProgs->filter(fn($p) => str_contains(strtolower((string)$p->region), $regKey));
                    $rPlanB = (int) $regProgs->sum(fn($p) => (int)($p->TARGET_BATCH ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0));
                    $rPlanP = (int) $regProgs->sum(fn($p) => (int)($p->TARGET_PESERTA ?? $p->target_total ?? 0));

                    $rRecs = $catRecs->filter(fn($r) => str_contains(strtolower((string)$r->region), $regKey));
                    $rRealP = (int) $rRecs->count();
                    $rRealB = (int) $regProgs->sum(function($p) use ($rRecs) {
                        $explicitBatch = (int) ($p->realisasi_batch ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0);
                        if ($explicitBatch > 0) return $explicitBatch;
                        $hasRecords = $rRecs->contains('program_id', $p->id_nonreguler);
                        return $hasRecords ? 1 : 0;
                    });

                    $items[] = [
                        'name' => "{$cat} - {$reg}",
                        'plan_batch' => $rPlanB, 'plan_participant' => $rPlanP,
                        'realisasi_batch' => $rRealB, 'realisasi_participant' => $rRealP,
                        'pct_batch' => $rPlanB > 0 ? round(($rRealB / $rPlanB) * 100) : 0,
                        'pct_participant' => $rPlanP > 0 ? round(($rRealP / $rPlanP) * 100) : 0,
                    ];
                }
            }

            $groups[$cat] = [
                'total' => [
                    'name' => $cat,
                    'plan_batch' => $planB, 'plan_participant' => $planP,
                    'realisasi_batch' => $realB, 'realisasi_participant' => $realP,
                    'pct_batch' => $pctB, 'pct_participant' => $pctP,
                ],
                'items' => $items,
            ];

            $chartPartPlan[] = $planP;
            $chartPartReal[] = $realP;
            $chartPartPct[] = $pctP;
            $chartBatchPlan[] = $planB;
            $chartBatchReal[] = $realB;
            $chartBatchPct[] = $pctB;
        }

        return [
            'groups' => $groups,
            'chart_participant' => [
                'categories' => $categories,
                'plan' => $chartPartPlan,
                'realisasi' => $chartPartReal,
                'pct' => $chartPartPct,
            ],
            'chart_batch' => [
                'categories' => $categories,
                'plan' => $chartBatchPlan,
                'realisasi' => $chartBatchReal,
                'pct' => $chartBatchPct,
            ]
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Inventaris;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Inventaris\Barang;
use App\Models\Inventaris\Pembelian;
use App\Models\Inventaris\StockOpname;

class InventarisController extends Controller

    /* =========================================================================
     * PRIVATE HELPERS (DRY OPTIMIZATION)
     * ========================================================================= */
    private function applyJenisLokasiFilter($query, ?string $jenisLokasiFilter, ?string $relation = null)
    {
        if ($jenisLokasiFilter && in_array($jenisLokasiFilter, ['Kantor', 'Gudang'], true)) {
            if ($relation) {
                $query->whereHas($relation, function ($q) use ($jenisLokasiFilter) {
                    $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $jenisLokasiFilter)->orWhere('lokasi', $jenisLokasiFilter);
                });
            } else {
                $query->where(function ($q) use ($jenisLokasiFilter) {
                    $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $jenisLokasiFilter)->orWhere('lokasi', $jenisLokasiFilter);
                });
            }
        }
        return $query;
    }

    private function parseCsvFile(Request $request): array
    {
        $request->validate([
            'file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('file');
        $handle = fopen($file->getRealPath(), 'r');
        if (!$handle) {
            return [];
        }

        $rawHeaderLine = fgets($handle);
        $rawHeaderLine = str_replace("\xEF\xBB\xBF", '', $rawHeaderLine);
        rewind($handle);

        $delimiter = (strpos($rawHeaderLine, ';') !== false) ? ';' : ',';

        $rawHeader = fgetcsv($handle, 1000, $delimiter);
        $headerMap = [];
        if ($rawHeader) {
            foreach ($rawHeader as $idx => $colName) {
                $cleanName = strtolower(trim(str_replace(["\xEF\xBB\xBF", ' ', '_', '-'], '', $colName)));
                $headerMap[$cleanName] = $idx;
            }
        }

        $rows = [];
        while (($data = fgetcsv($handle, 1000, $delimiter)) !== false) {
            if (!empty($data) && count($data) >= 1) {
                $rows[] = $data;
            }
        }
        fclose($handle);

        return [
            'headerMap' => $headerMap,
            'rows' => $rows,
        ];
    }

    private function parseDateString(?string $tanggalRaw): string
    {
        if (empty($tanggalRaw)) {
            return date('Y-m-d');
        }

        if (preg_match('/^\d{4}$/', $tanggalRaw)) {
            return $tanggalRaw . '-01-01';
        }

        try {
            return Carbon::parse($tanggalRaw)->format('Y-m-d');
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return date('Y-m-d');
        }
    }

    private function findOrCreateBarang(?string $idBarang, ?string $namaAsset, ?string $jenisLokasiRow = null, string $defaultLokasi = 'auto'): Barang
    {
        $barang = null;
        if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
            $barang = Barang::find((int) $idBarang);
        }

        if (!$barang && !empty($namaAsset)) {
            if (is_numeric($namaAsset)) {
                $barang = Barang::find((int) $namaAsset);
            }
            if (!$barang) {
                $barang = Barang::where('nama_asset', $namaAsset)->first();
            }
        }

        if (!$barang) {
            $finalLokasi = $jenisLokasiRow ?: ($defaultLokasi === 'auto' ? 'Kantor' : $defaultLokasi);
            $finalNama = !empty($namaAsset) ? $namaAsset : (!empty($idBarang) ? "Asset #{$idBarang}" : "Asset Baru");
            $attr = [
                'nama_asset' => $finalNama,
                'satuan' => 'Unit',
                'jenis_lokasi' => $finalLokasi,
                'lokasi' => $finalLokasi,
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ];
            if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
                $attr['id'] = (int) $idBarang;
                DB::table('barang')->insert($attr);
                $barang = Barang::find((int) $idBarang);
            } else {
                $barang = Barang::create($attr);
            }
        }

        return $barang;
    }

    /* =========================================================================
     * 1. BARANG TAB (GUDANG & KANTOR UNIFIED)
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function barangIndex(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->query('search');
        $jenisLokasiFilter = $request->query('jenis_lokasi');

        $query = Barang::query();
        $this->applyJenisLokasiFilter($query, $jenisLokasiFilter);

        if ($search) {
            $query->where('nama_asset', 'like', "%{$search}%");
        }

        $barangList = $query->orderBy('nama_asset', 'asc')->paginate(15)->withQueryString();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.inventaris_barang', [
            'barangList' => $barangList,
            'search' => $search,
            'jenisLokasiFilter' => $jenisLokasiFilter,
            'activeTab' => 'barang',
        ]);
    }

    public function barangStore(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'nama_asset' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'satuan' => 'required|string|max:50',
            'jenis_lokasi' => 'required|in:Kantor,Gudang',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $validated['lokasi'] = $validated['jenis_lokasi'];

        Barang::create($validated);

        return redirect()->back()->with('success', 'Aset barang berhasil ditambahkan!');
    }

    public function barangUpdate(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $barang = Barang::findOrFail($id);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'nama_asset' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'satuan' => 'required|string|max:50',
            'jenis_lokasi' => 'required|in:Kantor,Gudang',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $validated['lokasi'] = $validated['jenis_lokasi'];

        $barang->update($validated);

        return redirect()->back()->with('success', 'Data aset barang berhasil diperbarui!');
    }

    public function barangDestroy($id)
    {
        $barang = Barang::findOrFail($id);
        $barang->delete();

        return redirect()->back()->with('success', 'Data aset barang berhasil dihapus!');
    }

    public function barangTemplate()

        return ExcelExporter::download('Template_Import_Barang.xlsx', $headers, $sampleRows, 'Template Barang');
    }

    public function barangImport(Request $request)
    {
        $defaultLokasi = $request->input('jenis_lokasi_default', 'auto');
        $csvData = $this->parseCsvFile($request);
        if (empty($csvData)) {
            return redirect()->back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Gagal membaca file import.']);
        }

        $headerMap = $csvData['headerMap'];
        $hasHeader = isset($headerMap['idbarang']) || isset($headerMap['id']) || isset($headerMap['namaasset']) || isset($headerMap['namabarang']) || isset($headerMap['nama']) || isset($headerMap['barang']);
        $rows = $csvData['rows'];

        $imported = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $data) {
            $idBarang = null;
            $namaAsset = null;
            $satuan = 'Unit';
            $jenisLokasi = null;
            $keterangan = null;

            if ($hasHeader) {
                if (isset($headerMap['idbarang']) && isset($data[$headerMap['idbarang']])) {
                    $idBarang = trim($data[$headerMap['idbarang']]);
                } elseif (isset($headerMap['id']) && isset($data[$headerMap['id']])) {
                    $idBarang = trim($data[$headerMap['id']]);
                }

                foreach (['namaasset', 'namabarang', 'nama', 'barang'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $namaAsset = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (isset($headerMap['satuan']) && isset($data[$headerMap['satuan']])) {
                    $satuan = trim($data[$headerMap['satuan']]);
                }

                $rawLokasi = isset($headerMap['jenislokasi']) && isset($data[$headerMap['jenislokasi']])
                    ? trim($data[$headerMap['jenislokasi']])
                    : (isset($headerMap['lokasi']) && isset($data[$headerMap['lokasi']]) ? trim($data[$headerMap['lokasi']]) : null);
                if ($rawLokasi && in_array(ucfirst(strtolower($rawLokasi)), ['Kantor', 'Gudang'], true)) {
                    $jenisLokasi = ucfirst(strtolower($rawLokasi));
                }

                if (isset($headerMap['keterangan']) && isset($data[$headerMap['keterangan']])) {
                    $keterangan = trim($data[$headerMap['keterangan']]);
                }
            } else {
                $col0 = trim($data[0] ?? '');
                if (is_numeric($col0) && isset($data[1])) {
                    $idBarang = $col0;
                    $namaAsset = trim($data[1]);
                    $satuan = isset($data[2]) && !empty(trim($data[2])) ? trim($data[2]) : 'Unit';
                    $keterangan = isset($data[3]) ? trim($data[3]) : null;
                } else {
                    $namaAsset = $col0;
                    $satuan = isset($data[1]) && !empty(trim($data[1])) ? trim($data[1]) : 'Unit';
                    if (isset($data[2]) && in_array(ucfirst(strtolower(trim($data[2]))), ['Kantor', 'Gudang'], true)) {
                        $jenisLokasi = ucfirst(strtolower(trim($data[2])));
                        $keterangan = isset($data[3]) ? trim($data[3]) : null;
                    } else {
                        $keterangan = isset($data[2]) ? trim($data[2]) : null;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (($namaAsset && in_array(strtolower($namaAsset), ['nama_asset', 'nama asset', 'nama barang', 'nama_barang', 'id_barang', 'id'], true)) ||
                ($idBarang && !is_numeric($idBarang) && in_array(strtolower($idBarang), ['id_barang', 'id', 'id_pembelian'], true))) {
                continue;
            }

            if (empty($namaAsset) && empty($idBarang)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (!$jenisLokasi) {
                $jenisLokasi = in_array($defaultLokasi, ['Kantor', 'Gudang'], true) ? $defaultLokasi : 'Kantor';
            }

            $barang = null;
            if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
                $barang = Barang::find((int) $idBarang);
            }
            if (!$barang && !empty($namaAsset)) {
                $barang = Barang::where('nama_asset', $namaAsset)->first();
            }

            if ($barang) {
                $barang->update([
                    'nama_asset' => !empty($namaAsset) ? $namaAsset : $barang->nama_asset,
                    'satuan' => !empty($satuan) ? $satuan : $barang->satuan,
                    'jenis_lokasi' => $jenisLokasi ?: $barang->jenis_lokasi,
                    'lokasi' => $jenisLokasi ?: $barang->lokasi,
                    'keterangan' => $keterangan !== null ? $keterangan : $barang->keterangan,
                ]);
            } else {
                $attributes = [
                    'nama_asset' => !empty($namaAsset) ? $namaAsset : "Asset #{$idBarang}",
                    'satuan' => !empty($satuan) ? $satuan : 'Unit',
                    'jenis_lokasi' => $jenisLokasi,
                    'lokasi' => $jenisLokasi,
                    'keterangan' => $keterangan,
                    'created_at' => now(),
                    'updated_at' => now(),
                ];
                if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
                    $attributes['id'] = (int) $idBarang;
                    DB::table('barang')->insert($attributes);
                } else {
                    Barang::create($attributes);
                }
            }

            $imported++;
        }

        $fileName = $request->file('file')?->getClientOriginalName() ?? 'file.csv';
        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Inventaris Barang',
            "Mengimport {$imported} data barang inventaris dari file " . $fileName,
            ['filename' => $fileName, 'count' => $imported]
        );

        return redirect()->back()->with('success', "Berhasil mengimpor {$imported} data barang!");
    }

    /* =========================================================================
     * 2. PEMBELIAN TAB (GUDANG & KANTOR UNIFIED)
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function pembelianIndex(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->query('search');
        $selectedYear = $request->query('year');
        $jenisLokasiFilter = $request->query('jenis_lokasi');
        $lokasiSpesifikFilter = $request->query('lokasi_spesifik');

        if (!$selectedYear) {
            $selectedYear = 'all';
        }


        $pembelianYearQuery = Pembelian::query();
        $this->applyJenisLokasiFilter($pembelianYearQuery, $jenisLokasiFilter, 'barang');
        $pembelianYears = $pembelianYearQuery
            ->selectRaw('YEAR(tanggal_pembelian) as yr')
            ->whereNotNull('tanggal_pembelian')
            ->pluck('yr')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->toArray();

        $soYearQuery = StockOpname::query();
        $this->applyJenisLokasiFilter($soYearQuery, $jenisLokasiFilter, 'barang');
        $soYears = $soYearQuery
            ->selectRaw('YEAR(tanggal_stock_opname) as yr')
            ->whereNotNull('tanggal_stock_opname')
            ->pluck('yr')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->toArray();

        $currentYear = (int) date('Y');
        $defaultYears = [2017, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, $currentYear];
        $allYears = array_values(array_unique(array_merge($defaultYears, $pembelianYears, $soYears)));
        sort($allYears);

        $query = Pembelian::with('barang');
        $this->applyJenisLokasiFilter($query, $jenisLokasiFilter, 'barang');

        if ($selectedYear !== 'all' && $selectedYear !== 'Semua Tahun' && $selectedYear !== 'all_years') {
            $query->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', $selectedYear);
        }

        if ($lokasiSpesifikFilter) {
            $query->where('lokasi_spesifik', $lokasiSpesifikFilter);
        }

        if ($search) {
            $query->whereHas('barang', function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama_asset', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $pembelianList = $query->orderByDesc('tanggal_pembelian')->paginate(15)->withQueryString();

        $kpiQuery = Pembelian::query();
        $this->applyJenisLokasiFilter($kpiQuery, $jenisLokasiFilter, 'barang');

        if ($selectedYear !== 'all' && $selectedYear !== 'Semua Tahun' && $selectedYear !== 'all_years') {
            $kpiQuery->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', $selectedYear);
        }

        $totalJenisAset = (clone $kpiQuery)->distinct('barang_id')->count('barang_id');
        $totalBarangDibeli = (clone $kpiQuery)->sum('jumlah');

        $allBarang = Barang::orderBy('nama_asset', 'asc')->get();

        $availableRooms = StockOpname::whereNotNull('lokasi_spesifik')
            ->where('lokasi_spesifik', '!=', '')
            ->distinct()
            ->pluck('lokasi_spesifik')
            ->sort()
            ->values()
            ->toArray();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.inventaris_pembelian', [
            'pembelianList' => $pembelianList,
            'allBarang' => $allBarang,
            'availableRooms' => $availableRooms,
            'years' => $allYears,
            'selectedYear' => $selectedYear,
            'search' => $search,
            'jenisLokasiFilter' => $jenisLokasiFilter,
            'lokasiSpesifikFilter' => $lokasiSpesifikFilter,
            'totalJenisAset' => $totalJenisAset,
            'totalBarangDibeli' => $totalBarangDibeli,
            'activeTab' => 'pembelian',
        ]);
    }

    public function pembelianStore(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'barang_id' => 'required|exists:barang,id',
            'tanggal_pembelian' => 'required|date',
            'jumlah' => 'required|integer|min:1',
            'lokasi_spesifik' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        Pembelian::create($validated);

        $year = Carbon::parse($validated['tanggal_pembelian'])->year;

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.pembelian', ['year' => $year])
            ->with('success', 'Data pembelian aset berhasil disimpan!');
    }

    public function pembelianUpdate(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $pembelian = Pembelian::findOrFail($id);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'barang_id' => 'required|exists:barang,id',
            'tanggal_pembelian' => 'required|date',
            'jumlah' => 'required|integer|min:1',
            'lokasi_spesifik' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $pembelian->update($validated);

        $year = Carbon::parse($validated['tanggal_pembelian'])->year;

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.pembelian', ['year' => $year])
            ->with('success', 'Data pembelian berhasil diperbarui!');
    }

    public function pembelianDestroy($id)
    {
        $pembelian = Pembelian::findOrFail($id);
        $pembelian->delete();

        return redirect()->back()->with('success', 'Data pembelian berhasil dihapus!');
    }

    public function pembelianTemplate()
    {
        $headers = ['nama_asset', 'tanggal_pembelian', 'jumlah', 'jenis_lokasi', 'lokasi_spesifik', 'keterangan'];
        $sampleRows = [
            ['Kursi Kerja Ergonomis', date('Y-m-d'), '5', 'Kantor', 'Planter', 'Pengadaan staf'],
            ['Semen Padang 50kg', date('Y-m-d'), '10', 'Gudang', '', 'Stok material gudang'],
        ];

        return ExcelExporter::download('Template_Import_Pembelian.xlsx', $headers, $sampleRows, 'Template Pembelian');
    }

    public function pembelianImport(Request $request)
    {
        $defaultLokasi = $request->input('jenis_lokasi_default', 'auto');
        $csvData = $this->parseCsvFile($request);
        if (empty($csvData)) {
            return redirect()->back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Gagal membaca file import.']);
        }

        $headerMap = $csvData['headerMap'];
        $hasHeader = isset($headerMap['idpembelian']) || isset($headerMap['idbarang']) || isset($headerMap['namaasset']) || isset($headerMap['nama']) || isset($headerMap['barang']) || isset($headerMap['tanggalpembelian']) || isset($headerMap['tanggal']) || isset($headerMap['tahun']);
        $rows = $csvData['rows'];

        $imported = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $data) {
            $idBarang = null;
            $namaAsset = null;
            $tanggalRaw = null;
            $jumlahRaw = null;
            $jenisLokasiRow = null;
            $lokasiSpesifik = null;
            $keterangan = null;

            if ($hasHeader) {
                if (isset($headerMap['idbarang']) && isset($data[$headerMap['idbarang']])) $idBarang = trim($data[$headerMap['idbarang']]);

                foreach (['namaasset', 'namabarang', 'nama', 'barang'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $namaAsset = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['tanggalpembelian', 'tanggal', 'tahunpembelian', 'tahun'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $tanggalRaw = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['jumlah', 'qty', 'jumlahpembelian'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $jumlahRaw = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['jenislokasi', 'lokasi'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $rawLokasi = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        if (in_array(ucfirst(strtolower($rawLokasi)), ['Kantor', 'Gudang'], true)) {
                            $jenisLokasiRow = ucfirst(strtolower($rawLokasi));
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['lokasispesifik', 'ruangan'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $lokasiSpesifik = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (isset($headerMap['keterangan']) && isset($data[$headerMap['keterangan']])) {
                    $keterangan = trim($data[$headerMap['keterangan']]);
                }
            } else {
                if (isset($data[0])) $namaAsset = trim($data[0]);
                if (isset($data[1])) $tanggalRaw = trim($data[1]);
                if (isset($data[2])) $jumlahRaw = trim($data[2]);
                if (isset($data[3])) {
                    if (in_array(ucfirst(strtolower(trim($data[3]))), ['Kantor', 'Gudang'], true)) {
                        $jenisLokasiRow = ucfirst(strtolower(trim($data[3])));
                        if (isset($data[4])) $lokasiSpesifik = trim($data[4]);
                        if (isset($data[5])) $keterangan = trim($data[5]);
                    } else {
                        $lokasiSpesifik = trim($data[3]);
                        if (isset($data[4])) $keterangan = trim($data[4]);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (($namaAsset && in_array(strtolower($namaAsset), ['nama_asset', 'nama asset', 'nama barang', 'id_barang', 'id_pembelian'], true)) ||
                ($idBarang && !is_numeric($idBarang) && in_array(strtolower($idBarang), ['id_barang', 'id_pembelian', 'id'], true))) {
                continue;
            }

            if (empty($idBarang) && empty($namaAsset)) {
                continue;
            }

            $barang = $this->findOrCreateBarang($idBarang, $namaAsset, $jenisLokasiRow, $defaultLokasi);
            $tanggal = $this->parseDateString($tanggalRaw);
            $jumlah = max(1, (int) $jumlahRaw);

            $pembelianAttr = [
                'barang_id' => $barang->id,
                'tanggal_pembelian' => $tanggal,
                'jumlah' => $jumlah,
                'lokasi_spesifik' => $lokasiSpesifik,
                'keterangan' => $keterangan,
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ];

            if (!empty($idPembelian) && is_numeric($idPembelian)) {
                $pembelian = Pembelian::find((int) $idPembelian);
                if ($pembelian) {
                    $pembelian->update($pembelianAttr);
                } else {
                    $pembelianAttr['id'] = (int) $idPembelian;
                    DB::table('pembelian')->insert($pembelianAttr);
                }
            } else {
                Pembelian::create($pembelianAttr);
            }

            $imported++;
        }

        $fileName = $request->file('file')?->getClientOriginalName() ?? 'file.csv';
        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Inventaris Pembelian',
            "Mengimport {$imported} data pembelian inventaris dari file " . $fileName,
            ['filename' => $fileName, 'count' => $imported]
        );

        return redirect()->back()->with('success', "Berhasil mengimpor {$imported} data pembelian!");
    }

    /* =========================================================================
     * 3. STOCK OPNAME SESSIONS LIST & DETAIL
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function stockOpnameIndex(Request $request)
    {
        $jenisLokasiFilter = $request->query('jenis_lokasi');

        $query = StockOpname::query();
        $this->applyJenisLokasiFilter($query, $jenisLokasiFilter, 'barang');

        $sessions = $query->select(
            'tanggal_stock_opname',
            DB::raw('MAX(status) as status'),
            DB::raw('MAX(catatan_sesi) as catatan_sesi'),
            DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT barang_id) as total_aset_diperiksa'),
            DB::raw('SUM(jumlah_rusak) as total_masalah')
        )
        ->groupBy('tanggal_stock_opname')
        ->orderByDesc('tanggal_stock_opname')
        ->get();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.inventaris_stock_opname', [
            'sessions' => $sessions,
            'jenisLokasiFilter' => $jenisLokasiFilter,
            'activeTab' => 'stock_opname',
        ]);
    }

    public function stockOpnameSessionStore(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tanggal_stock_opname' => 'required|date',
            'status' => 'required|in:Selesai,Draf',
            'catatan_sesi' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $existing = StockOpname::where('tanggal_stock_opname', $validated['tanggal_stock_opname'])->first();

        if ($existing) {
            return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $validated['tanggal_stock_opname']])
                ->with('info', 'Sesi Stock Opname untuk tanggal tersebut sudah ada.');
        }

        $firstBarang = Barang::first();
        if ($firstBarang) {
            StockOpname::create([
                'barang_id' => $firstBarang->id,
                'tanggal_stock_opname' => $validated['tanggal_stock_opname'],
                'status' => $validated['status'],
                'catatan_sesi' => $validated['catatan_sesi'],
                'jumlah_baik' => 0,
                'jumlah_rusak' => 0,
                'grand_total' => 0,
                'keterangan' => 'Inisialisasi Stock Opname',
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $validated['tanggal_stock_opname']])
            ->with('success', 'Sesi Stock Opname berhasil dibuat!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameSessionUpdate(Request $request, $date)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'status' => 'required|in:Selesai,Draf',
            'catatan_sesi' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        StockOpname::where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)
        ->update([
            'status' => $validated['status'],
            'catatan_sesi' => $validated['catatan_sesi'],
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $date])
            ->with('success', 'Informasi sesi Stock Opname berhasil diperbarui!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameSessionDestroy($date)
    {
        StockOpname::where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)->delete();

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.stock-opname')
            ->with('success', 'Sesi Stock Opname tanggal ' . Carbon::parse($date)->translatedFormat('d F Y') . ' berhasil dihapus!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameDetail(Request $request, $date)
    {
        $search = $request->query('search');
        $jenisLokasiFilter = $request->query('jenis_lokasi');
        $lokasiSpesifikFilter = $request->query('lokasi_spesifik');

        $query = StockOpname::with('barang')
            ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date);

        $this->applyJenisLokasiFilter($query, $jenisLokasiFilter, 'barang');

        if ($lokasiSpesifikFilter) {
            $query->where('lokasi_spesifik', $lokasiSpesifikFilter);
        }

        if ($search) {
            $query->whereHas('barang', function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama_asset', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $items = $query->get();

        $sessionMeta = StockOpname::where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)->first();

        $allBarang = Barang::orderBy('nama_asset', 'asc')->get();

        $availableRooms = StockOpname::whereNotNull('lokasi_spesifik')
            ->where('lokasi_spesifik', '!=', '')
            ->distinct()
            ->pluck('lokasi_spesifik')
            ->sort()
            ->values()
            ->toArray();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.inventaris_stock_opname_detail', [
            'date' => $date,
            'formattedDate' => Carbon::parse($date)->translatedFormat('d F Y'),
            'sessionMeta' => $sessionMeta,
            'items' => $items,
            'allBarang' => $allBarang,
            'availableRooms' => $availableRooms,
            'search' => $search,
            'jenisLokasiFilter' => $jenisLokasiFilter,
            'lokasiSpesifikFilter' => $lokasiSpesifikFilter,
            'activeTab' => 'stock_opname',
        ]);
    }

    public function stockOpnameItemStore(Request $request, $date)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'barang_id' => 'required|exists:barang,id',
            'lokasi_spesifik' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'jumlah_baik' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_rusak' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
            'foto_kerusakan' => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,webp|max:5120',
        ]);

        $fotoPath = null;
        if ($request->hasFile('foto_kerusakan')) {
            $fotoPath = $request->file('foto_kerusakan')->store('inventaris', 'public');
        }

        $sessionMeta = StockOpname::where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)->first();
        $status = $sessionMeta ? $sessionMeta->status : 'Selesai';
        $catatan = $sessionMeta ? $sessionMeta->catatan_sesi : null;

        $baik = (int) ($validated['jumlah_baik'] ?? 0);
        $rusak = (int) ($validated['jumlah_rusak'] ?? 0);

        StockOpname::create([
            'barang_id' => $validated['barang_id'],
            'tanggal_stock_opname' => $date,
            'status' => $status,
            'catatan_sesi' => $catatan,
            'lokasi_spesifik' => $validated['lokasi_spesifik'] ?? null,
            'jumlah_baik' => $baik,
            'jumlah_rusak' => $rusak,
            'grand_total' => $baik + $rusak,
            'keterangan' => $validated['keterangan'] ?? null,
            'foto_kerusakan' => $fotoPath,
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $date])
            ->with('success', 'Data aset berhasil ditambahkan ke Stock Opname!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameItemUpdate(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $item = StockOpname::findOrFail($id);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'barang_id' => 'required|exists:barang,id',
            'lokasi_spesifik' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'jumlah_baik' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_rusak' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
            'foto_kerusakan' => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,webp|max:5120',
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto_kerusakan')) {
            if ($item->foto_kerusakan && Storage::disk('public')->exists($item->foto_kerusakan)) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($item->foto_kerusakan);
            }
            $item->foto_kerusakan = $request->file('foto_kerusakan')->store('inventaris', 'public');
        }

        $baik = (int) ($validated['jumlah_baik'] ?? 0);
        $rusak = (int) ($validated['jumlah_rusak'] ?? 0);

        $item->barang_id = $validated['barang_id'];
        $item->lokasi_spesifik = $validated['lokasi_spesifik'] ?? null;
        $item->jumlah_baik = $baik;
        $item->jumlah_rusak = $rusak;
        $item->grand_total = $baik + $rusak;
        $item->keterangan = $validated['keterangan'] ?? null;
        $item->save();

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $item->tanggal_stock_opname->format('Y-m-d')])
            ->with('success', 'Data kondisi barang berhasil diperbarui!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameItemDestroy($id)
    {
        $item = StockOpname::findOrFail($id);
        $date = $item->tanggal_stock_opname->format('Y-m-d');

        if ($item->foto_kerusakan && Storage::disk('public')->exists($item->foto_kerusakan)) {
            Storage::disk('public')->delete($item->foto_kerusakan);
        }

        $item->delete();

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $date])
            ->with('success', 'Data barang berhasil dihapus dari Stock Opname!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameExport($date)
    {
        $items = StockOpname::with('barang')
            ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)
            ->get();

        $headers = ['ID', 'Nama Asset', 'Satuan', 'Jenis Lokasi', 'Lokasi Spesifik', 'Baik', 'Rusak', 'Grand Total', 'Keterangan'];
        $dataRows = [];

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $dataRows[] = [
                $item->id,
                $item->barang?->nama_asset,
                $item->barang?->satuan,
                $item->barang?->jenis_lokasi,
                $item->lokasi_spesifik ?: '-',
                $item->jumlah_baik,
                $item->jumlah_rusak,
                $item->grand_total,
                $item->keterangan ?: '-',
            ];
        }

        $filename = "Stock_Opname_{$date}.xlsx";
        return ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Stock Opname');
    }

    public function stockOpnameTemplate()
    {
        $headers = ['nama_asset', 'tanggal_stock_opname', 'jenis_lokasi', 'lokasi_spesifik', 'jumlah_baik', 'jumlah_rusak', 'keterangan'];
        $sampleRows = [
            ['Kursi Kerja Ergonomis', date('Y-m-d'), 'Kantor', 'Planter', '45', '5', 'Kondisi baik & 5 rusak roda'],
            ['Semen Padang 50kg', date('Y-m-d'), 'Gudang', '', '100', '0', 'Stok utuh'],
        ];

        return ExcelExporter::download('Template_Import_Stock_Opname.xlsx', $headers, $sampleRows, 'Template Stock Opname');
    }

    public function stockOpnameImport(Request $request)
    {
        $defaultLokasi = $request->input('jenis_lokasi_default', 'auto');
        $csvData = $this->parseCsvFile($request);
        if (empty($csvData)) {
            return redirect()->back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Gagal membaca file import.']);
        }

        $headerMap = $csvData['headerMap'];
        $hasHeader = isset($headerMap['idstockopname']) || isset($headerMap['idbarang']) || isset($headerMap['namaasset']) || isset($headerMap['namabarang']) || isset($headerMap['nama']) || isset($headerMap['barang']) || isset($headerMap['tanggalstockopname']) || isset($headerMap['tanggal']);
        $rows = $csvData['rows'];

        $imported = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $data) {
            $idStockOpname = null;
            $idBarang = null;
            $namaAsset = null;
            $tanggalRaw = null;
            $jenisLokasiRow = null;
            $lokasiSpesifik = null;
            $jumlahBaik = 0;
            $jumlahRusak = 0;
            $keterangan = null;

            if ($hasHeader) {
                if (isset($headerMap['idstockopname']) && isset($data[$headerMap['idstockopname']])) {
                    $idStockOpname = trim($data[$headerMap['idstockopname']]);
                }
                if (isset($headerMap['idbarang']) && isset($data[$headerMap['idbarang']])) {
                    $idBarang = trim($data[$headerMap['idbarang']]);
                }

                foreach (['namaasset', 'namabarang', 'nama', 'barang'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $namaAsset = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['tanggalstockopname', 'tanggal', 'tgl'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $tanggalRaw = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['jenislokasi', 'lokasi'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $rawLokasi = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        if (in_array(ucfirst(strtolower($rawLokasi)), ['Kantor', 'Gudang'], true)) {
                            $jenisLokasiRow = ucfirst(strtolower($rawLokasi));
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['lokasispesifik', 'ruangan'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $lokasiSpesifik = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['jumlahbaik', 'baik'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $jumlahBaik = (int) trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['jumlahrusak', 'rusak'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $jumlahRusak = (int) trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (isset($headerMap['keterangan']) && isset($data[$headerMap['keterangan']])) {
                    $keterangan = trim($data[$headerMap['keterangan']]);
                }
            } else {
                if (count($data) >= 4 && is_numeric(trim($data[0])) && is_numeric(trim($data[1]))) {
                    $idStockOpname = trim($data[0]);
                    $idBarang = trim($data[1]);
                    $tanggalRaw = trim($data[2]);
                    $jumlahBaik = (int) trim($data[3] ?? 0);
                    $jumlahRusak = (int) trim($data[4] ?? 0);
                    $keterangan = isset($data[6]) ? trim($data[6]) : (isset($data[5]) && !is_numeric(trim($data[5])) ? trim($data[5]) : null);
                } else {
                    if (isset($data[0])) $namaAsset = trim($data[0]);
                    if (isset($data[1])) $tanggalRaw = trim($data[1]);
                    if (isset($data[2])) $lokasiSpesifik = trim($data[2]);
                    if (isset($data[3])) $jumlahBaik = (int) trim($data[3]);
                    if (isset($data[4])) $jumlahRusak = (int) trim($data[4]);
                    if (isset($data[5])) $keterangan = trim($data[5]);
                }
            }

            if (($namaAsset && in_array(strtolower($namaAsset), ['nama_asset', 'nama asset', 'nama barang', 'id_barang', 'id_stock_opname'], true)) ||
                ($idBarang && !is_numeric($idBarang) && in_array(strtolower($idBarang), ['id_barang', 'id_stock_opname', 'id'], true))) {
                continue;
            }

            if (empty($idBarang) && empty($namaAsset)) {
                continue;
            }

            $barang = $this->findOrCreateBarang($idBarang, $namaAsset, $jenisLokasiRow, $defaultLokasi);
            $tanggal = $this->parseDateString($tanggalRaw);

            $baik = max(0, $jumlahBaik);
            $rusak = max(0, $jumlahRusak);

            $soAttr = [
                'barang_id' => $barang->id,
                'tanggal_stock_opname' => $tanggal,
                'status' => 'Selesai',
                'catatan_sesi' => 'Hasil Import File Stock Opname',
                'lokasi_spesifik' => $lokasiSpesifik,
                'jumlah_baik' => $baik,
                'jumlah_rusak' => $rusak,
                'grand_total' => $baik + $rusak,
                'keterangan' => $keterangan,
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ];

            if (!empty($idStockOpname) && is_numeric($idStockOpname)) {
                $so = StockOpname::find((int) $idStockOpname);
                if ($so) {
                    $so->update($soAttr);
                } else {
                    $soAttr['id'] = (int) $idStockOpname;
                    DB::table('stock_opname')->insert($soAttr);
                }
            } else {
                StockOpname::create($soAttr);
            }

            $imported++;
        }

        $fileName = $request->file('file')?->getClientOriginalName() ?? 'file.csv';
        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Inventaris Stock Opname',
            "Mengimport {$imported} data stock opname inventaris dari file " . $fileName,
            ['filename' => $fileName, 'count' => $imported]
        );

        return redirect()->back()->with('success', "Berhasil mengimpor {$imported} data stock opname!");
    }

    /* =========================================================================
     * BULK DELETE (DESTROY ALL) METHODS
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function barangDestroyAll(Request $request)
    {
        $jenisLokasi = $request->get('jenis_lokasi');
        $msg = '';

        DB::transaction(function () use ($jenisLokasi, &$msg) {
            if ($jenisLokasi && in_array($jenisLokasi, ['Gudang', 'Kantor'], true)) {
                $barangIds = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $jenisLokasi)
                    ->orWhere('lokasi', $jenisLokasi)
                    ->pluck('id');

                StockOpname::whereIn('barang_id', $barangIds)->delete();
                Pembelian::whereIn('barang_id', $barangIds)->delete();
                $deleted = Barang::whereIn('id', $barangIds)->delete();
                $msg = "Seluruh data Barang inventaris lokasi {$jenisLokasi} ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.";
            } else {
                StockOpname::query()->delete();
                Pembelian::query()->delete();
                $deleted = Barang::query()->delete();
                $msg = "Seluruh data Barang inventaris ({$deleted} data) beserta riwayatnya berhasil dihapus.";
            }

            ActivityLog::log(
                'Hapus',
                'Inventaris Barang',
                $msg,
                ['jenis_lokasi' => $jenisLokasi, 'count' => $deleted]
            );
        });

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.barang', array_filter(['jenis_lokasi' => $jenisLokasi]))
            ->with('success', $msg);
    }

    public function pembelianDestroyAll(Request $request)
    {
        $jenisLokasi = $request->get('jenis_lokasi');

        if ($jenisLokasi && in_array($jenisLokasi, ['Gudang', 'Kantor'], true)) {
            $barangIds = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $jenisLokasi)
                ->orWhere('lokasi', $jenisLokasi)
                ->pluck('id');
            $deleted = Pembelian::whereIn('barang_id', $barangIds)->delete();
            $msg = "Seluruh data Pembelian inventaris lokasi {$jenisLokasi} ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.";
        } else {
            $deleted = Pembelian::query()->delete();
            $msg = "Seluruh data Pembelian inventaris ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.";
        }

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Hapus',
            'Inventaris Pembelian',
            $msg,
            ['jenis_lokasi' => $jenisLokasi, 'count' => $deleted]
        );

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.pembelian', array_filter(['jenis_lokasi' => $jenisLokasi]))
            ->with('success', $msg);
    }

    public function stockOpnameDestroyAll(Request $request)
    {
        $jenisLokasi = $request->get('jenis_lokasi');

        if ($jenisLokasi && in_array($jenisLokasi, ['Gudang', 'Kantor'], true)) {

                ->orWhere('lokasi', $jenisLokasi)
                ->pluck('id');
            $deleted = StockOpname::whereIn('barang_id', $barangIds)->delete();

            ->with('success', $msg);
    }
