<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Inventaris;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Inventaris\Barang;
use App\Models\Inventaris\Pembelian;
use App\Models\Inventaris\StockOpname;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class InventarisDashboardController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $selectedYear = (int) $request->query('year', date('Y'));

        // Fetch all available years from Pembelian & StockOpname
        $pembelianYears = Pembelian::selectRaw('YEAR(tanggal_pembelian) as yr')->whereNotNull('tanggal_pembelian')->pluck('yr')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->toArray();
        $soYears = StockOpname::selectRaw('YEAR(tanggal_stock_opname) as yr')->whereNotNull('tanggal_stock_opname')->pluck('yr')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->toArray();
        $defaultYears = [2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, (int)date('Y')];
        $allYears = array_values(array_unique(array_merge($defaultYears, $pembelianYears, $soYears)));
        sort($allYears);

        // 1. KPI CARD METRICS
        $totalJenisBarang = Barang::count();
        $totalBarangGudang = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', 'Gudang')->orWhere('lokasi', 'Gudang')->count();
        $totalBarangKantor = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', 'Kantor')->orWhere('lokasi', 'Kantor')->count();

        $allBarang = Barang::all();
        $totalAsetUnit = 0;
        $totalKondisiBaik = 0;
        $totalKondisiRusak = 0;

        $gudangBaik = 0; $gudangRusak = 0;
        $kantorBaik = 0; $kantorRusak = 0;

        $damagedItems = [];

        foreach ($allBarang as $barang) {
            $latestSO = StockOpname::where('barang_id', $barang->id)
                ->whereYear('tanggal_stock_opname', '<=', $selectedYear)
                ->orderByDesc('tanggal_stock_opname')
                ->first();

            $totalPembelian = Pembelian::where('barang_id', $barang->id)
                ->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', '<=', $selectedYear)
                ->sum('jumlah');

            $stok = $latestSO ? $latestSO->grand_total : $totalPembelian;
            $baik = $latestSO ? $latestSO->jumlah_baik : $stok;
            $rusak = $latestSO ? $latestSO->jumlah_rusak : 0;

            $totalAsetUnit += $stok;
            $totalKondisiBaik += $baik;
            $totalKondisiRusak += $rusak;

            $isGudang = in_array(ucfirst(strtolower($barang->jenis_lokasi ?: $barang->lokasi)), ['Gudang']);
            if ($isGudang) {
                $gudangBaik += $baik;
                $gudangRusak += $rusak;
            } else {
                $kantorBaik += $baik;
                $kantorRusak += $rusak;
            }

            if ($rusak > 0) {
                $damagedItems[] = [
                    'nama_asset' => $barang->nama_asset,
                    'satuan' => $barang->satuan,
                    'jenis_lokasi' => $barang->jenis_lokasi ?: 'Kantor',
                    'lokasi_spesifik' => $latestSO ? $latestSO->lokasi_spesifik : '-',
                    'jumlah_rusak' => $rusak,
                    'jumlah_baik' => $baik,
                    'grand_total' => $stok,
                    'keterangan' => $latestSO ? $latestSO->keterangan : '-',
                ];
            }
        }

        // Sort damaged items by jumlah_rusak DESC (Top 10)
        usort($damagedItems, fn($a, $b) => $b['jumlah_rusak'] <=> $a['jumlah_rusak']);
        $topDamagedItems = array_slice($damagedItems, 0, 10);

        $healthRatio = $totalAsetUnit > 0 ? round(($totalKondisiBaik / $totalAsetUnit) * 100, 1) : 0;
        $damageRatio = $totalAsetUnit > 0 ? round(($totalKondisiRusak / $totalAsetUnit) * 100, 1) : 0;

        $totalPembelianYtd = Pembelian::whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', $selectedYear)->sum('jumlah');

        // 2. CHART 1 DATA: Condition by Location (Gudang vs Kantor)
        $chartLocationCondition = [
            'categories' => ['Gudang', 'Kantor'],
            'baik' => [$gudangBaik, $kantorBaik],
            'rusak' => [$gudangRusak, $kantorRusak],
        ];

        // 3. CHART 2 DATA: Room Breakdown (Kantor Rooms)
        $kantorBarang = Barang::where(function($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', 'Kantor')->orWhere('lokasi', 'Kantor');
        })->get();

        $roomMap = [];
        foreach ($kantorBarang as $b) {
            $latestSO = StockOpname::where('barang_id', $b->id)
                ->whereYear('tanggal_stock_opname', '<=', $selectedYear)
                ->orderByDesc('tanggal_stock_opname')
                ->first();

            $totalPembelian = Pembelian::where('barang_id', $b->id)
                ->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', '<=', $selectedYear)
                ->sum('jumlah');

            $stok = $latestSO ? $latestSO->grand_total : $totalPembelian;
            $baik = $latestSO ? $latestSO->jumlah_baik : $stok;
            $rusak = $latestSO ? $latestSO->jumlah_rusak : 0;

            $roomName = ($latestSO && !empty(trim($latestSO->lokasi_spesifik)))
                ? trim($latestSO->lokasi_spesifik)
                : (($b->lokasi && !in_array($b->lokasi, ['Kantor', 'Gudang'])) ? $b->lokasi : 'Kantor (Umum)');

            if (!isset($roomMap[$roomName])) {
                $roomMap[$roomName] = (object) [
                    'lokasi_spesifik' => $roomName,
                    'total_baik' => 0,
                    'total_rusak' => 0,
                    'total_aset' => 0,
                ];
            }

            $roomMap[$roomName]->total_baik += $baik;
            $roomMap[$roomName]->total_rusak += $rusak;
            $roomMap[$roomName]->total_aset += $stok;
        }

        $roomSummaryList = array_values($roomMap);
        usort($roomSummaryList, fn($a, $b) => $b->total_aset <=> $a->total_aset);
        $roomSummary = collect($roomSummaryList);

        $chartRoom = [
            'rooms' => $roomSummary->pluck('lokasi_spesifik')->toArray(),
            'baik' => $roomSummary->pluck('total_baik')->map(fn($v) => (int)$v)->toArray(),
            'rusak' => $roomSummary->pluck('total_rusak')->map(fn($v) => (int)$v)->toArray(),
        ];

        // 4. CHART 3 DATA: Purchase Trend per Year
        $purchaseTrendData = [];
        foreach ($allYears as $yr) {
            $qty = Pembelian::whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', $yr)->sum('jumlah');
            $purchaseTrendData[] = (int) $qty;
        }

        $chartPurchaseTrend = [
            'years' => $allYears,
            'quantities' => $purchaseTrendData,
        ];

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.dashboard', [
            'selectedYear' => $selectedYear,
            'years' => $allYears,
            'totalJenisBarang' => $totalJenisBarang,
            'totalBarangGudang' => $totalBarangGudang,
            'totalBarangKantor' => $totalBarangKantor,
            'totalAsetUnit' => $totalAsetUnit,
            'totalKondisiBaik' => $totalKondisiBaik,
            'totalKondisiRusak' => $totalKondisiRusak,
            'healthRatio' => $healthRatio,
            'damageRatio' => $damageRatio,
            'totalPembelianYtd' => $totalPembelianYtd,
            'chartLocationCondition' => $chartLocationCondition,
            'chartRoom' => $chartRoom,
            'chartPurchaseTrend' => $chartPurchaseTrend,
            'topDamagedItems' => $topDamagedItems,
            'roomSummary' => $roomSummary,
            'activeTab' => 'dashboard',
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Inventaris;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Inventaris\Barang;
use App\Models\Inventaris\Pembelian;
use App\Models\Inventaris\StockOpname;
use App\Services\ExcelExporter;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

class InventarisGudangController extends Controller
{
    protected string $lokasi = 'Gudang';

    /* =========================================================================
     * 1. BARANG TAB
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function barangIndex(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->query('search');
        $jenisLokasiFilter = $request->query('jenis_lokasi');

        $query = Barang::where(function($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        });

        if ($jenisLokasiFilter && in_array($jenisLokasiFilter, ['Kantor', 'Gudang'])) {
            $query->where('jenis_lokasi', $jenisLokasiFilter);
        }

        if ($search) {
            $query->where('nama_asset', 'like', "%{$search}%");
        }

        $barangList = $query->orderBy('nama_asset', 'asc')->paginate(10)->withQueryString();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.gudang_barang', [
            'barangList' => $barangList,
            'search' => $search,
            'jenisLokasiFilter' => $jenisLokasiFilter,
            'activeTab' => 'barang',
        ]);
    }

    public function barangStore(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'nama_asset' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'satuan' => 'required|string|max:50',
            'jenis_lokasi' => 'required|in:Kantor,Gudang',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $validated['lokasi'] = $validated['jenis_lokasi'];

        Barang::create($validated);

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.barang')
            ->with('success', 'Aset barang berhasil ditambahkan!');
    }

    public function barangUpdate(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $barang = Barang::findOrFail($id);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'nama_asset' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'satuan' => 'required|string|max:50',
            'jenis_lokasi' => 'required|in:Kantor,Gudang',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $validated['lokasi'] = $validated['jenis_lokasi'];

        $barang->update($validated);

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.barang')
            ->with('success', 'Data aset barang berhasil diperbarui!');
    }

    public function barangDestroy($id)
    {
        $barang = Barang::findOrFail($id);
        $barang->delete();

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.barang')
            ->with('success', 'Data aset barang berhasil dihapus!');
    }

    private function parseCsvFile(Request $request): array
    {
        $request->validate([
            'file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('file');
        $handle = fopen($file->getRealPath(), 'r');
        if (!$handle) {
            return [];
        }

        $rawHeaderLine = fgets($handle);
        $rawHeaderLine = str_replace("\xEF\xBB\xBF", '', $rawHeaderLine);
        rewind($handle);

        $delimiter = (strpos($rawHeaderLine, ';') !== false) ? ';' : ',';

        $rawHeader = fgetcsv($handle, 1000, $delimiter);
        $headerMap = [];
        if ($rawHeader) {
            foreach ($rawHeader as $idx => $colName) {
                $cleanName = strtolower(trim(str_replace(["\xEF\xBB\xBF", ' ', '_', '-'], '', $colName)));
                $headerMap[$cleanName] = $idx;
            }
        }

        $rows = [];
        while (($data = fgetcsv($handle, 1000, $delimiter)) !== false) {
            if (!empty($data) && count($data) >= 1) {
                $rows[] = $data;
            }
        }
        fclose($handle);

        return [
            'headerMap' => $headerMap,
            'rows' => $rows,
        ];
    }

    private function parseDateString(?string $tanggalRaw): string
    {
        if (empty($tanggalRaw)) {
            return date('Y-m-d');
        }

        if (preg_match('/^\d{4}$/', $tanggalRaw)) {
            return $tanggalRaw . '-01-01';
        }

        try {
            return Carbon::parse($tanggalRaw)->format('Y-m-d');
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return date('Y-m-d');
        }
    }

    private function findOrCreateBarang(?string $idBarang, ?string $namaAsset): Barang
    {
        $barang = null;
        if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
            $barang = Barang::find((int) $idBarang);
        }

        if (!$barang && !empty($namaAsset)) {
            if (is_numeric($namaAsset)) {
                $barang = Barang::find((int) $namaAsset);
            }
            if (!$barang) {
                $barang = Barang::where(function($q) {
                    $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
                })->where('nama_asset', $namaAsset)->first();
            }
        }

        if (!$barang) {
            $finalNama = !empty($namaAsset) ? $namaAsset : (!empty($idBarang) ? "Asset #{$idBarang}" : "Asset Baru");
            $attributes = [
                'nama_asset' => $finalNama,
                'satuan' => 'Unit',
                'jenis_lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
                'lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
            ];
            if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
                $attributes['id'] = (int) $idBarang;
                DB::table('barang')->insert($attributes);
                $barang = Barang::find((int) $idBarang);
            } else {
                $barang = Barang::create($attributes);
            }
        }

        return $barang;
    }

    public function barangImport(Request $request)
    {
        $csvData = $this->parseCsvFile($request);
        if (empty($csvData)) {
            return redirect()->back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Gagal membaca file import.']);
        }

        $headerMap = $csvData['headerMap'];
        $hasHeader = isset($headerMap['idbarang']) || isset($headerMap['id']) || isset($headerMap['namaasset']) || isset($headerMap['namabarang']) || isset($headerMap['nama']) || isset($headerMap['barang']);
        $rows = $csvData['rows'];

        $imported = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $data) {
            $idBarang = null;
            $namaAsset = null;
            $satuan = 'Unit';
            $keterangan = null;

            if ($hasHeader) {
                if (isset($headerMap['idbarang']) && isset($data[$headerMap['idbarang']])) {
                    $idBarang = trim($data[$headerMap['idbarang']]);
                } elseif (isset($headerMap['id']) && isset($data[$headerMap['id']])) {
                    $idBarang = trim($data[$headerMap['id']]);
                }

                foreach (['namaasset', 'namabarang', 'nama', 'barang'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $namaAsset = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (isset($headerMap['satuan']) && isset($data[$headerMap['satuan']])) {
                    $satuan = trim($data[$headerMap['satuan']]);
                }

                if (isset($headerMap['keterangan']) && isset($data[$headerMap['keterangan']])) {
                    $keterangan = trim($data[$headerMap['keterangan']]);
                }
            } else {
                $col0 = trim($data[0] ?? '');
                if (is_numeric($col0) && isset($data[1])) {
                    $idBarang = $col0;
                    $namaAsset = trim($data[1]);
                    $satuan = isset($data[2]) && !empty(trim($data[2])) ? trim($data[2]) : 'Unit';
                    $keterangan = isset($data[3]) ? trim($data[3]) : null;
                } else {
                    $namaAsset = $col0;
                    $satuan = isset($data[1]) && !empty(trim($data[1])) ? trim($data[1]) : 'Unit';
                    $keterangan = isset($data[2]) ? trim($data[2]) : null;
                }
            }

            if (($namaAsset && in_array(strtolower($namaAsset), ['nama_asset', 'nama asset', 'nama barang', 'nama_barang', 'id_barang', 'id'], true)) ||
                ($idBarang && !is_numeric($idBarang) && in_array(strtolower($idBarang), ['id_barang', 'id', 'id_pembelian'], true))) {
                continue;
            }

            if (empty($namaAsset) && empty($idBarang)) {
                continue;
            }

            $barang = null;
            if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
                $barang = Barang::find((int) $idBarang);
            }
            if (!$barang && !empty($namaAsset)) {
                $barang = Barang::where(function($q) {
                    $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
                })->where('nama_asset', $namaAsset)->first();
            }

            if ($barang) {
                $barang->update([
                    'nama_asset' => !empty($namaAsset) ? $namaAsset : $barang->nama_asset,
                    'satuan' => !empty($satuan) ? $satuan : $barang->satuan,
                    'jenis_lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
                    'lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
                    'keterangan' => $keterangan !== null ? $keterangan : $barang->keterangan,
                ]);
            } else {
                $attributes = [
                    'nama_asset' => !empty($namaAsset) ? $namaAsset : "Asset #{$idBarang}",
                    'satuan' => !empty($satuan) ? $satuan : 'Unit',
                    'jenis_lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
                    'lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
                    'keterangan' => $keterangan,
                ];
                if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
                    $attributes['id'] = (int) $idBarang;
                }
                Barang::create($attributes);
            }

            $imported++;
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.barang')
            ->with('success', "Berhasil mengimpor {$imported} data barang untuk Gudang!");
    }

    /* =========================================================================
     * 2. PEMBELIAN TAB
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function pembelianIndex(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->query('search');
        $selectedYear = $request->query('year');
        $lokasiSpesifikFilter = $request->query('lokasi_spesifik');

        $pembelianYears = Pembelian::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->selectRaw('YEAR(tanggal_pembelian) as yr')
        ->whereNotNull('tanggal_pembelian')
        ->pluck('yr')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->toArray();

        $soYears = StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->selectRaw('YEAR(tanggal_stock_opname) as yr')
        ->whereNotNull('tanggal_stock_opname')
        ->pluck('yr')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->toArray();

        $currentYear = (int) date('Y');
        $defaultYears = [2017, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, $currentYear];
        $allYears = array_values(array_unique(array_merge($defaultYears, $pembelianYears, $soYears)));
        sort($allYears);

        if (!$selectedYear) {
            $selectedYear = 'all';
        }

        $query = Pembelian::with('barang')
            ->whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
                $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
            });

        if ($selectedYear !== 'all' && $selectedYear !== 'Semua Tahun' && $selectedYear !== 'all_years') {
            $query->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', $selectedYear);
        }

        if ($lokasiSpesifikFilter) {
            $query->where('lokasi_spesifik', $lokasiSpesifikFilter);
        }

        if ($search) {
            $query->whereHas('barang', function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama_asset', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $pembelianList = $query->orderByDesc('tanggal_pembelian')->paginate(10)->withQueryString();

        $kpiQuery = Pembelian::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        });

        if ($selectedYear !== 'all' && $selectedYear !== 'Semua Tahun' && $selectedYear !== 'all_years') {
            $kpiQuery->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', $selectedYear);
        }

        $totalJenisAset = (clone $kpiQuery)->distinct('barang_id')->count('barang_id');
        $totalBarangDibeli = (clone $kpiQuery)->sum('jumlah');

        $allBarang = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orderBy('nama_asset', 'asc')->get();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.gudang_pembelian', [
            'pembelianList' => $pembelianList,
            'allBarang' => $allBarang,
            'years' => $allYears,
            'selectedYear' => $selectedYear,
            'search' => $search,
            'lokasiSpesifikFilter' => $lokasiSpesifikFilter,
            'totalJenisAset' => $totalJenisAset,
            'totalBarangDibeli' => $totalBarangDibeli,
            'activeTab' => 'pembelian',
        ]);
    }

    public function pembelianStore(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'barang_id' => 'required|exists:barang,id',
            'tanggal_pembelian' => 'required|date',
            'jumlah' => 'required|integer|min:1',
            'lokasi_spesifik' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        Pembelian::create($validated);

        $year = Carbon::parse($validated['tanggal_pembelian'])->year;

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.pembelian', ['year' => $year])
            ->with('success', 'Data pembelian aset berhasil disimpan!');
    }

    public function pembelianUpdate(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $pembelian = Pembelian::findOrFail($id);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'barang_id' => 'required|exists:barang,id',
            'tanggal_pembelian' => 'required|date',
            'jumlah' => 'required|integer|min:1',
            'lokasi_spesifik' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $pembelian->update($validated);

        $year = Carbon::parse($validated['tanggal_pembelian'])->year;

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.pembelian', ['year' => $year])
            ->with('success', 'Data pembelian berhasil diperbarui!');
    }

    public function pembelianImport(Request $request)
    {
        $csvData = $this->parseCsvFile($request);
        if (empty($csvData)) {
            return redirect()->back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Gagal membaca file import.']);
        }

        $headerMap = $csvData['headerMap'];
        $hasHeader = isset($headerMap['idpembelian']) || isset($headerMap['idbarang']) || isset($headerMap['namaasset']) || isset($headerMap['namabarang']) || isset($headerMap['nama']) || isset($headerMap['barang']) || isset($headerMap['tanggalpembelian']) || isset($headerMap['tanggal']) || isset($headerMap['tahunpembelian']) || isset($headerMap['tahun']);
        $rows = $csvData['rows'];

        $imported = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $data) {
            $idPembelian = null;
            $idBarang = null;
            $namaAsset = null;
            $tanggalRaw = null;
            $jumlahRaw = null;
            $lokasiSpesifik = null;
            $keterangan = null;

            if ($hasHeader) {
                if (isset($headerMap['idpembelian']) && isset($data[$headerMap['idpembelian']])) {
                    $idPembelian = trim($data[$headerMap['idpembelian']]);
                }
                if (isset($headerMap['idbarang']) && isset($data[$headerMap['idbarang']])) {
                    $idBarang = trim($data[$headerMap['idbarang']]);
                }

                foreach (['namaasset', 'namabarang', 'nama', 'barang'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $namaAsset = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['tanggalpembelian', 'tanggal', 'tahunpembelian', 'tahun'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $tanggalRaw = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['jumlah', 'qty', 'jumlahpembelian'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $jumlahRaw = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['lokasispesifik', 'ruangan'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $lokasiSpesifik = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (isset($headerMap['keterangan']) && isset($data[$headerMap['keterangan']])) {
                    $keterangan = trim($data[$headerMap['keterangan']]);
                }
            } else {
                if (count($data) >= 4 && is_numeric(trim($data[0])) && is_numeric(trim($data[1]))) {
                    $idPembelian = trim($data[0]);
                    $idBarang = trim($data[1]);
                    $tanggalRaw = trim($data[2]);
                    $jumlahRaw = trim($data[3]);
                    $keterangan = isset($data[4]) ? trim($data[4]) : null;
                } else {
                    if (isset($data[0])) $namaAsset = trim($data[0]);
                    if (isset($data[1])) $tanggalRaw = trim($data[1]);
                    if (isset($data[2])) $jumlahRaw = trim($data[2]);
                    if (isset($data[3])) $lokasiSpesifik = trim($data[3]);
                    if (isset($data[4])) $keterangan = trim($data[4]);
                }
            }

            if (($namaAsset && in_array(strtolower($namaAsset), ['nama_asset', 'nama asset', 'nama barang', 'id_barang', 'id_pembelian'], true)) ||
                ($idBarang && !is_numeric($idBarang) && in_array(strtolower($idBarang), ['id_barang', 'id_pembelian', 'id'], true))) {
                continue;
            }

            if (empty($idBarang) && empty($namaAsset)) {
                continue;
            }

            $barang = $this->findOrCreateBarang($idBarang, $namaAsset);
            $tanggal = $this->parseDateString($tanggalRaw);
            $jumlah = max(1, (int) $jumlahRaw);

            $pembelianAttr = [
                'barang_id' => $barang->id,
                'tanggal_pembelian' => $tanggal,
                'jumlah' => $jumlah,
                'lokasi_spesifik' => $lokasiSpesifik,
                'keterangan' => $keterangan,
            ];

            if (!empty($idPembelian) && is_numeric($idPembelian)) {
                $pembelian = Pembelian::find((int) $idPembelian);
                if ($pembelian) {
                    $pembelian->update($pembelianAttr);
                } else {
                    $pembelianAttr['id'] = (int) $idPembelian;
                    Pembelian::create($pembelianAttr);
                }
            } else {
                Pembelian::create($pembelianAttr);
            }

            $imported++;
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.pembelian')
            ->with('success', "Berhasil mengimpor {$imported} data pembelian untuk Gudang!");
    }

    /* =========================================================================
     * 3. STOCK OPNAME SESSIONS LIST
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function stockOpnameIndex()
    {
        $sessions = StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->select(
            'tanggal_stock_opname',
            DB::raw('MAX(status) as status'),
            DB::raw('MAX(catatan_sesi) as catatan_sesi'),
            DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT barang_id) as total_aset_diperiksa'),
            DB::raw('SUM(jumlah_rusak) as total_masalah')
        )
        ->groupBy('tanggal_stock_opname')
        ->orderByDesc('tanggal_stock_opname')
        ->get();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.gudang_stock_opname', [
            'sessions' => $sessions,
            'activeTab' => 'stock_opname',
        ]);
    }

    public function stockOpnameSessionStore(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tanggal_stock_opname' => 'required|date',
            'status' => 'required|in:Selesai,Draf',
            'catatan_sesi' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $existing = StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $validated['tanggal_stock_opname'])->first();

        if ($existing) {
            return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $validated['tanggal_stock_opname']])
                ->with('info', 'Sesi Stock Opname untuk tanggal tersebut sudah ada.');
        }

        $firstBarang = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi)->first();
        if ($firstBarang) {
            StockOpname::create([
                'barang_id' => $firstBarang->id,
                'tanggal_stock_opname' => $validated['tanggal_stock_opname'],
                'status' => $validated['status'],
                'catatan_sesi' => $validated['catatan_sesi'],
                'jumlah_baik' => 0,
                'jumlah_rusak' => 0,
                'grand_total' => 0,
                'keterangan' => 'Inisialisasi Stock Opname',
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $validated['tanggal_stock_opname']])
            ->with('success', 'Sesi Stock Opname berhasil dibuat!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameSessionUpdate(Request $request, $date)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'status' => 'required|in:Selesai,Draf',
            'catatan_sesi' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)
        ->update([
            'status' => $validated['status'],
            'catatan_sesi' => $validated['catatan_sesi'],
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $date])
            ->with('success', 'Informasi sesi Stock Opname berhasil diperbarui!');
    }

            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })

    }

            });

        $sessionMeta = StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);

        $allBarang = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orderBy('nama_asset', 'asc')->get();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.gudang_stock_opname_detail', [

            'sessionMeta' => $sessionMeta,
            'items' => $items,
            'allBarang' => $allBarang,
            'search' => $search,
            'lokasiSpesifikFilter' => $lokasiSpesifikFilter,
            'activeTab' => 'stock_opname',
        ]);
    }

    public function stockOpnameItemStore(Request $request, $date)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'barang_id' => 'required|exists:barang,id',
            'lokasi_spesifik' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'jumlah_baik' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_rusak' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
            'foto_kerusakan' => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,webp|max:5120',
        ]);

        $fotoPath = null;
        if ($request->hasFile('foto_kerusakan')) {
            $fotoPath = $request->file('foto_kerusakan')->store('inventaris', 'public');
        }

        $sessionMeta = StockOpname::where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)->first();
        $status = $sessionMeta ? $sessionMeta->status : 'Selesai';
        $catatan = $sessionMeta ? $sessionMeta->catatan_sesi : null;

        $baik = (int) ($validated['jumlah_baik'] ?? 0);
        $rusak = (int) ($validated['jumlah_rusak'] ?? 0);

        StockOpname::create([
            'barang_id' => $validated['barang_id'],
            'tanggal_stock_opname' => $date,
            'status' => $status,
            'catatan_sesi' => $catatan,
            'lokasi_spesifik' => $validated['lokasi_spesifik'] ?? null,
            'jumlah_baik' => $baik,
            'jumlah_rusak' => $rusak,
            'grand_total' => $baik + $rusak,
            'keterangan' => $validated['keterangan'] ?? null,
            'foto_kerusakan' => $fotoPath,
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $date])
            ->with('success', 'Data aset berhasil ditambahkan ke Stock Opname!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameItemUpdate(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $item = StockOpname::findOrFail($id);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'barang_id' => 'required|exists:barang,id',
            'lokasi_spesifik' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'jumlah_baik' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_rusak' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
            'foto_kerusakan' => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,webp|max:5120',
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto_kerusakan')) {
            if ($item->foto_kerusakan && Storage::disk('public')->exists($item->foto_kerusakan)) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($item->foto_kerusakan);
            }
            $item->foto_kerusakan = $request->file('foto_kerusakan')->store('inventaris', 'public');
        }

        $baik = (int) ($validated['jumlah_baik'] ?? 0);
        $rusak = (int) ($validated['jumlah_rusak'] ?? 0);

        $item->barang_id = $validated['barang_id'];
        $item->lokasi_spesifik = $validated['lokasi_spesifik'] ?? null;
        $item->jumlah_baik = $baik;
        $item->jumlah_rusak = $rusak;
        $item->grand_total = $baik + $rusak;
        $item->keterangan = $validated['keterangan'] ?? null;
        $item->save();

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $item->tanggal_stock_opname->format('Y-m-d')])
            ->with('success', 'Data kondisi barang berhasil diperbarui!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameItemDestroy($id)
    {
        $item = StockOpname::findOrFail($id);
        $date = $item->tanggal_stock_opname->format('Y-m-d');

        if ($item->foto_kerusakan && Storage::disk('public')->exists($item->foto_kerusakan)) {
            Storage::disk('public')->delete($item->foto_kerusakan);
        }

        $item->delete();

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.gudang.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $date])
            ->with('success', 'Data barang berhasil dihapus dari Stock Opname!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameExport($date)
    {
        $items = StockOpname::with('barang')
            ->whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
                $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
            })
            ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)
            ->get();

        $headers = ['ID', 'Nama Asset', 'Satuan', 'Jenis Lokasi', 'Lokasi Spesifik', 'Baik', 'Rusak', 'Grand Total', 'Keterangan'];
        $dataRows = [];

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $dataRows[] = [
                $item->id,
                $item->barang?->nama_asset,
                $item->barang?->satuan,
                $item->barang?->jenis_lokasi,
                $item->lokasi_spesifik ?: '-',
                $item->jumlah_baik,
                $item->jumlah_rusak,
                $item->grand_total,
                $item->keterangan ?: '-',
            ];
        }

        $filename = "Stock_Opname_Gudang_{$date}.xlsx";
        return ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Stock Opname Gudang');
    }

    {

        DB::transaction(function () use (&$msg) {
            $barangIds = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)
                ->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi)
                ->pluck('id');

            StockOpname::whereIn('barang_id', $barangIds)->delete();

    }

    public function barangIndex(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->query('search');
        $jenisLokasiFilter = $request->query('jenis_lokasi');

        $query = Barang::where(function($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        });

            $query->where('jenis_lokasi', $jenisLokasiFilter);

        }

        $barangList = $query->orderBy('nama_asset', 'asc')->paginate(10)->withQueryString();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.kantor_barang', [
            'barangList' => $barangList,
            'search' => $search,
            'jenisLokasiFilter' => $jenisLokasiFilter,
            'activeTab' => 'barang',
        ]);
    }

    private function parseCsvFile(Request $request): array
    {
        $request->validate([
            'file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('file');
        $handle = fopen($file->getRealPath(), 'r');
        if (!$handle) {
            return [];
        }

        $rawHeaderLine = fgets($handle);
        $rawHeaderLine = str_replace("\xEF\xBB\xBF", '', $rawHeaderLine);
        rewind($handle);

        $delimiter = (strpos($rawHeaderLine, ';') !== false) ? ';' : ',';

        $rawHeader = fgetcsv($handle, 1000, $delimiter);
        $headerMap = [];
        if ($rawHeader) {
            foreach ($rawHeader as $idx => $colName) {
                $cleanName = strtolower(trim(str_replace(["\xEF\xBB\xBF", ' ', '_', '-'], '', $colName)));
                $headerMap[$cleanName] = $idx;
            }
        }

        $rows = [];
        while (($data = fgetcsv($handle, 1000, $delimiter)) !== false) {
            if (!empty($data) && count($data) >= 1) {
                $rows[] = $data;
            }
        }
        fclose($handle);

        return [
            'headerMap' => $headerMap,
            'rows' => $rows,
        ];
    }

    private function parseDateString(?string $tanggalRaw): string
    {
        if (empty($tanggalRaw)) {
            return date('Y-m-d');
        }

        if (preg_match('/^\d{4}$/', $tanggalRaw)) {
            return $tanggalRaw . '-01-01';
        }

        try {
            return Carbon::parse($tanggalRaw)->format('Y-m-d');
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return date('Y-m-d');
        }
    }

    private function findOrCreateBarang(?string $idBarang, ?string $namaAsset): Barang
    {
        $barang = null;
        if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
            $barang = Barang::find((int) $idBarang);
        }

        if (!$barang && !empty($namaAsset)) {
            if (is_numeric($namaAsset)) {
                $barang = Barang::find((int) $namaAsset);
            }
            if (!$barang) {
                $barang = Barang::where(function($q) {
                    $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
                })->where('nama_asset', $namaAsset)->first();
            }
        }

        if (!$barang) {
            $finalNama = !empty($namaAsset) ? $namaAsset : (!empty($idBarang) ? "Asset #{$idBarang}" : "Asset Baru");
            $attributes = [
                'nama_asset' => $finalNama,
                'satuan' => 'Unit',
                'jenis_lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
                'lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
            ];
            if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
                $attributes['id'] = (int) $idBarang;
                DB::table('barang')->insert($attributes);
                $barang = Barang::find((int) $idBarang);
            } else {
                $barang = Barang::create($attributes);
            }
        }

        return $barang;
    }

    public function barangImport(Request $request)
    {
        $csvData = $this->parseCsvFile($request);
        if (empty($csvData)) {
            return redirect()->back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Gagal membaca file import.']);
        }

        $headerMap = $csvData['headerMap'];
        $hasHeader = isset($headerMap['idbarang']) || isset($headerMap['id']) || isset($headerMap['namaasset']) || isset($headerMap['namabarang']) || isset($headerMap['nama']) || isset($headerMap['barang']);
        $rows = $csvData['rows'];

        $imported = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $data) {
            $idBarang = null;
            $namaAsset = null;
            $satuan = 'Unit';
            $keterangan = null;

            if ($hasHeader) {
                if (isset($headerMap['idbarang']) && isset($data[$headerMap['idbarang']])) {
                    $idBarang = trim($data[$headerMap['idbarang']]);
                } elseif (isset($headerMap['id']) && isset($data[$headerMap['id']])) {
                    $idBarang = trim($data[$headerMap['id']]);
                }

                foreach (['namaasset', 'namabarang', 'nama', 'barang'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $namaAsset = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (isset($headerMap['satuan']) && isset($data[$headerMap['satuan']])) {
                    $satuan = trim($data[$headerMap['satuan']]);
                }

                if (isset($headerMap['keterangan']) && isset($data[$headerMap['keterangan']])) {
                    $keterangan = trim($data[$headerMap['keterangan']]);
                }
            } else {
                $col0 = trim($data[0] ?? '');
                if (is_numeric($col0) && isset($data[1])) {
                    $idBarang = $col0;
                    $namaAsset = trim($data[1]);
                    $satuan = isset($data[2]) && !empty(trim($data[2])) ? trim($data[2]) : 'Unit';
                    $keterangan = isset($data[3]) ? trim($data[3]) : null;
                } else {
                    $namaAsset = $col0;
                    $satuan = isset($data[1]) && !empty(trim($data[1])) ? trim($data[1]) : 'Unit';
                    $keterangan = isset($data[2]) ? trim($data[2]) : null;
                }
            }

            if (($namaAsset && in_array(strtolower($namaAsset), ['nama_asset', 'nama asset', 'nama barang', 'nama_barang', 'id_barang', 'id'], true)) ||
                ($idBarang && !is_numeric($idBarang) && in_array(strtolower($idBarang), ['id_barang', 'id', 'id_pembelian'], true))) {
                continue;
            }

            if (empty($namaAsset) && empty($idBarang)) {
                continue;
            }

            $barang = null;
            if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
                $barang = Barang::find((int) $idBarang);
            }
            if (!$barang && !empty($namaAsset)) {
                $barang = Barang::where(function($q) {
                    $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
                })->where('nama_asset', $namaAsset)->first();
            }

            if ($barang) {
                $barang->update([
                    'nama_asset' => !empty($namaAsset) ? $namaAsset : $barang->nama_asset,
                    'satuan' => !empty($satuan) ? $satuan : $barang->satuan,
                    'jenis_lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
                    'lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
                    'keterangan' => $keterangan !== null ? $keterangan : $barang->keterangan,
                ]);
            } else {
                $attributes = [
                    'nama_asset' => !empty($namaAsset) ? $namaAsset : "Asset #{$idBarang}",
                    'satuan' => !empty($satuan) ? $satuan : 'Unit',
                    'jenis_lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
                    'lokasi' => $this->lokasi,
                    'keterangan' => $keterangan,
                ];
                if (!empty($idBarang) && is_numeric($idBarang)) {
                    $attributes['id'] = (int) $idBarang;
                }
                Barang::create($attributes);
            }

            $imported++;
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.barang')
            ->with('success', "Berhasil mengimpor {$imported} data barang untuk Kantor!");
    }

    public function pembelianIndex(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->query('search');
        $selectedYear = $request->query('year');
        $lokasiSpesifikFilter = $request->query('lokasi_spesifik');

        $pembelianYears = Pembelian::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->selectRaw('YEAR(tanggal_pembelian) as yr')
        ->whereNotNull('tanggal_pembelian')
        ->pluck('yr')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->toArray();

        $soYears = StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->selectRaw('YEAR(tanggal_stock_opname) as yr')
        ->whereNotNull('tanggal_stock_opname')
        ->pluck('yr')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->toArray();

        $currentYear = (int) date('Y');
        $defaultYears = [2017, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, $currentYear];
        $allYears = array_values(array_unique(array_merge($defaultYears, $pembelianYears, $soYears)));
        sort($allYears);

        if (!$selectedYear) {
            $selectedYear = 'all';
        }

        $query = Pembelian::with('barang')
            ->whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
                $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
            });

        if ($selectedYear !== 'all' && $selectedYear !== 'Semua Tahun' && $selectedYear !== 'all_years') {
            $query->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', $selectedYear);
        }

        if ($lokasiSpesifikFilter) {
            $query->where('lokasi_spesifik', $lokasiSpesifikFilter);
        }

        if ($search) {
            $query->whereHas('barang', function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama_asset', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $pembelianList = $query->orderByDesc('tanggal_pembelian')->paginate(10)->withQueryString();

        $kpiQuery = Pembelian::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        });

        if ($selectedYear !== 'all' && $selectedYear !== 'Semua Tahun' && $selectedYear !== 'all_years') {
            $kpiQuery->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', $selectedYear);
        }

        $totalJenisAset = (clone $kpiQuery)->distinct('barang_id')->count('barang_id');
        $totalBarangDibeli = (clone $kpiQuery)->sum('jumlah');

        $allBarang = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orderBy('nama_asset', 'asc')->get();

        $availableRooms = StockOpname::whereNotNull('lokasi_spesifik')
            ->where('lokasi_spesifik', '!=', '')
            ->distinct()
            ->pluck('lokasi_spesifik')
            ->sort()
            ->values()
            ->toArray();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.kantor_pembelian', [
            'pembelianList' => $pembelianList,
            'allBarang' => $allBarang,
            'availableRooms' => $availableRooms,
            'years' => $allYears,
            'selectedYear' => $selectedYear,
            'search' => $search,
            'lokasiSpesifikFilter' => $lokasiSpesifikFilter,
            'totalJenisAset' => $totalJenisAset,
            'totalBarangDibeli' => $totalBarangDibeli,
            'activeTab' => 'pembelian',
        ]);
    }

    public function pembelianImport(Request $request)
    {
        $csvData = $this->parseCsvFile($request);
        if (empty($csvData)) {
            return redirect()->back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Gagal membaca file import.']);
        }

        $headerMap = $csvData['headerMap'];
        $hasHeader = isset($headerMap['idpembelian']) || isset($headerMap['idbarang']) || isset($headerMap['namaasset']) || isset($headerMap['namabarang']) || isset($headerMap['nama']) || isset($headerMap['barang']) || isset($headerMap['tanggalpembelian']) || isset($headerMap['tanggal']) || isset($headerMap['tahunpembelian']) || isset($headerMap['tahun']);
        $rows = $csvData['rows'];

        $imported = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $data) {
            $idPembelian = null;
            $idBarang = null;
            $namaAsset = null;
            $tanggalRaw = null;
            $jumlahRaw = null;
            $lokasiSpesifik = null;
            $keterangan = null;

            if ($hasHeader) {
                if (isset($headerMap['idpembelian']) && isset($data[$headerMap['idpembelian']])) {
                    $idPembelian = trim($data[$headerMap['idpembelian']]);
                }
                if (isset($headerMap['idbarang']) && isset($data[$headerMap['idbarang']])) {
                    $idBarang = trim($data[$headerMap['idbarang']]);
                }

                foreach (['namaasset', 'namabarang', 'nama', 'barang'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $namaAsset = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['tanggalpembelian', 'tanggal', 'tahunpembelian', 'tahun'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $tanggalRaw = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['jumlah', 'qty', 'jumlahpembelian'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $jumlahRaw = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                foreach (['lokasispesifik', 'ruangan'] as $k) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$k]) && isset($data[$headerMap[$k]])) {
                        $lokasiSpesifik = trim($data[$headerMap[$k]]);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (isset($headerMap['keterangan']) && isset($data[$headerMap['keterangan']])) {
                    $keterangan = trim($data[$headerMap['keterangan']]);
                }
            } else {
                if (count($data) >= 4 && is_numeric(trim($data[0])) && is_numeric(trim($data[1]))) {
                    $idPembelian = trim($data[0]);
                    $idBarang = trim($data[1]);
                    $tanggalRaw = trim($data[2]);
                    $jumlahRaw = trim($data[3]);
                    $keterangan = isset($data[4]) ? trim($data[4]) : null;
                } else {
                    if (isset($data[0])) $namaAsset = trim($data[0]);
                    if (isset($data[1])) $tanggalRaw = trim($data[1]);
                    if (isset($data[2])) $jumlahRaw = trim($data[2]);
                    if (isset($data[3])) $lokasiSpesifik = trim($data[3]);
                    if (isset($data[4])) $keterangan = trim($data[4]);
                }
            }

            if (($namaAsset && in_array(strtolower($namaAsset), ['nama_asset', 'nama asset', 'nama barang', 'id_barang', 'id_pembelian'], true)) ||
                ($idBarang && !is_numeric($idBarang) && in_array(strtolower($idBarang), ['id_barang', 'id_pembelian', 'id'], true))) {
                continue;
            }

            if (empty($idBarang) && empty($namaAsset)) {
                continue;
            }

            $barang = $this->findOrCreateBarang($idBarang, $namaAsset);
            $tanggal = $this->parseDateString($tanggalRaw);
            $jumlah = max(1, (int) $jumlahRaw);

            $pembelianAttr = [
                'barang_id' => $barang->id,
                'tanggal_pembelian' => $tanggal,
                'jumlah' => $jumlah,
                'lokasi_spesifik' => $lokasiSpesifik,
                'keterangan' => $keterangan,
            ];

            if (!empty($idPembelian) && is_numeric($idPembelian)) {
                $pembelian = Pembelian::find((int) $idPembelian);
                if ($pembelian) {
                    $pembelian->update($pembelianAttr);
                } else {
                    $pembelianAttr['id'] = (int) $idPembelian;
                    Pembelian::create($pembelianAttr);
                }
            } else {
                Pembelian::create($pembelianAttr);
            }

            $imported++;
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.pembelian')
            ->with('success', "Berhasil mengimpor {$imported} data pembelian untuk Kantor!");
    }

     * 3. STOCK OPNAME SESSIONS LIST
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function stockOpnameIndex()
    {
        $sessions = StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->select(
            'tanggal_stock_opname',
            DB::raw('MAX(status) as status'),
            DB::raw('MAX(catatan_sesi) as catatan_sesi'),
            DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT barang_id) as total_aset_diperiksa'),
            DB::raw('SUM(jumlah_rusak) as total_masalah')
        )
        ->groupBy('tanggal_stock_opname')
        ->orderByDesc('tanggal_stock_opname')
        ->get();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.kantor_stock_opname', [
            'sessions' => $sessions,
            'activeTab' => 'stock_opname',
        ]);
    }

    public function stockOpnameSessionStore(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tanggal_stock_opname' => 'required|date',
            'status' => 'required|in:Selesai,Draf',
            'catatan_sesi' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $existing = StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $validated['tanggal_stock_opname'])->first();

        if ($existing) {
            return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $validated['tanggal_stock_opname']])
                ->with('info', 'Sesi Stock Opname untuk tanggal tersebut sudah ada.');
        }

        $firstBarang = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi)->first();
        if ($firstBarang) {
            StockOpname::create([
                'barang_id' => $firstBarang->id,
                'tanggal_stock_opname' => $validated['tanggal_stock_opname'],
                'status' => $validated['status'],
                'catatan_sesi' => $validated['catatan_sesi'],
                'jumlah_baik' => 0,
                'jumlah_rusak' => 0,
                'grand_total' => 0,
                'keterangan' => 'Inisialisasi Stock Opname',
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $validated['tanggal_stock_opname']])
            ->with('success', 'Sesi Stock Opname berhasil dibuat!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameSessionUpdate(Request $request, $date)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'status' => 'required|in:Selesai,Draf',
            'catatan_sesi' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)
        ->update([
            'status' => $validated['status'],
            'catatan_sesi' => $validated['catatan_sesi'],
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $date])
            ->with('success', 'Informasi sesi Stock Opname berhasil diperbarui!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameSessionDestroy($date)
    {
        StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)
        ->delete();

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.stock-opname')
            ->with('success', 'Sesi Stock Opname tanggal ' . Carbon::parse($date)->translatedFormat('d F Y') . ' berhasil dihapus!');
    }

    /* =========================================================================
     * 4. STOCK OPNAME DETAIL VIEW
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function stockOpnameDetail(Request $request, $date)
    {
        $search = $request->query('search');
        $lokasiSpesifikFilter = $request->query('lokasi_spesifik');

        $query = StockOpname::with('barang')
            ->whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
                $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
            })
            ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date);

        if ($lokasiSpesifikFilter) {
            $query->where('lokasi_spesifik', $lokasiSpesifikFilter);
        }

        if ($search) {
            $query->whereHas('barang', function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama_asset', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $items = $query->get();

        $sessionMeta = StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)
        ->first();

        $allBarang = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orderBy('nama_asset', 'asc')->get();

        $availableRooms = StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->whereNotNull('lokasi_spesifik')
        ->where('lokasi_spesifik', '!=', '')
        ->distinct()
        ->pluck('lokasi_spesifik')
        ->sort()
        ->values()
        ->toArray();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.kantor_stock_opname_detail', [
            'date' => $date,
            'formattedDate' => Carbon::parse($date)->translatedFormat('d F Y'),
            'sessionMeta' => $sessionMeta,
            'items' => $items,
            'allBarang' => $allBarang,
            'availableRooms' => $availableRooms,
            'search' => $search,
            'lokasiSpesifikFilter' => $lokasiSpesifikFilter,
            'activeTab' => 'stock_opname',
        ]);
    }

    public function stockOpnameItemStore(Request $request, $date)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'barang_id' => 'required|exists:barang,id',
            'lokasi_spesifik' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'jumlah_baik' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_rusak' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
            'foto_kerusakan' => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,webp|max:5120',
        ]);

        $fotoPath = null;
        if ($request->hasFile('foto_kerusakan')) {
            $fotoPath = $request->file('foto_kerusakan')->store('inventaris', 'public');
        }

        $sessionMeta = StockOpname::where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)->first();
        $status = $sessionMeta ? $sessionMeta->status : 'Selesai';
        $catatan = $sessionMeta ? $sessionMeta->catatan_sesi : null;

        $baik = (int) ($validated['jumlah_baik'] ?? 0);
        $rusak = (int) ($validated['jumlah_rusak'] ?? 0);

        StockOpname::create([
            'barang_id' => $validated['barang_id'],
            'tanggal_stock_opname' => $date,
            'status' => $status,
            'catatan_sesi' => $catatan,
            'lokasi_spesifik' => $validated['lokasi_spesifik'] ?? null,
            'jumlah_baik' => $baik,
            'jumlah_rusak' => $rusak,
            'grand_total' => $baik + $rusak,
            'keterangan' => $validated['keterangan'] ?? null,
            'foto_kerusakan' => $fotoPath,
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $date])
            ->with('success', 'Data aset berhasil ditambahkan ke Stock Opname Kantor!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameItemUpdate(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $item = StockOpname::findOrFail($id);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'barang_id' => 'required|exists:barang,id',
            'lokasi_spesifik' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'jumlah_baik' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'jumlah_rusak' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
            'foto_kerusakan' => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,webp|max:5120',
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto_kerusakan')) {
            if ($item->foto_kerusakan && Storage::disk('public')->exists($item->foto_kerusakan)) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($item->foto_kerusakan);
            }
            $item->foto_kerusakan = $request->file('foto_kerusakan')->store('inventaris', 'public');
        }

        $baik = (int) ($validated['jumlah_baik'] ?? 0);
        $rusak = (int) ($validated['jumlah_rusak'] ?? 0);

        $item->barang_id = $validated['barang_id'];
        $item->lokasi_spesifik = $validated['lokasi_spesifik'] ?? null;
        $item->jumlah_baik = $baik;
        $item->jumlah_rusak = $rusak;
        $item->grand_total = $baik + $rusak;
        $item->keterangan = $validated['keterangan'] ?? null;
        $item->save();

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $item->tanggal_stock_opname->format('Y-m-d')])
            ->with('success', 'Data kondisi barang berhasil diperbarui!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameItemDestroy($id)
    {
        $item = StockOpname::findOrFail($id);
        $date = $item->tanggal_stock_opname->format('Y-m-d');

        if ($item->foto_kerusakan && Storage::disk('public')->exists($item->foto_kerusakan)) {
            Storage::disk('public')->delete($item->foto_kerusakan);
        }

        $item->delete();

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.stock-opname.detail', ['date' => $date])
            ->with('success', 'Data barang berhasil dihapus dari Stock Opname!');
    }

    public function stockOpnameExport($date)
    {
        $items = StockOpname::with('barang')
            ->whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
                $q->where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
            })
            ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)
            ->get();

        $headers = ['ID', 'Nama Asset', 'Satuan', 'Jenis Lokasi', 'Lokasi Spesifik', 'Baik', 'Rusak', 'Grand Total', 'Keterangan'];
        $dataRows = [];

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $dataRows[] = [
                $item->id,
                $item->barang?->nama_asset,
                $item->barang?->satuan,
                $item->barang?->jenis_lokasi,
                $item->lokasi_spesifik ?: '-',
                $item->jumlah_baik,
                $item->jumlah_rusak,
                $item->grand_total,
                $item->keterangan ?: '-',
            ];
        }

        $filename = "Stock_Opname_Kantor_{$date}.xlsx";
        return ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Stock Opname Kantor');
    }

            ['2', '27', 'Kursi Merah', date('Y-m-d'), 'Ruang Meeting', '20', '2', '2 unit butuh perbaikan'],
        ];

        return ExcelExporter::download('Template_Import_Stock_Opname_Kantor.xlsx', $headers, $sampleRows, 'Template Stock Opname Kantor');
    }

    public function barangDestroyAll()
    {
        $msg = '';
        DB::transaction(function () use (&$msg) {
            $barangIds = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)
                ->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi)
                ->pluck('id');

            StockOpname::whereIn('barang_id', $barangIds)->delete();
            Pembelian::whereIn('barang_id', $barangIds)->delete();
            $deleted = Barang::whereIn('id', $barangIds)->delete();
            $msg = "Seluruh data Barang inventaris Kantor ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.";
        });

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.barang')->with('success', $msg);
    }

    public function pembelianDestroyAll()
    {
        $barangIds = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)
            ->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi)
            ->pluck('id');
        $deleted = Pembelian::whereIn('barang_id', $barangIds)->delete();

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.pembelian')
            ->with('success', "Seluruh data Pembelian inventaris Kantor ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.");
    }

    public function stockOpnameDestroyAll()
    {
        $barangIds = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $this->lokasi)
            ->orWhere('lokasi', $this->lokasi)
            ->pluck('id');
        $deleted = StockOpname::whereIn('barang_id', $barangIds)->delete();

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.inventaris.kantor.stock-opname')
            ->with('success', "Seluruh data Stock Opname inventaris Kantor ({$deleted} data) berhasil dihapus.");
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Inventaris;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Inventaris\Barang;
use App\Models\Inventaris\Pembelian;

use App\Services\ExcelExporter;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class InventarisMessController extends Controller
{
    protected string $lokasi = 'Mess';

    /* =========================================================================
     * 1. BARANG TAB (READ-ONLY)
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function barangIndex(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->query('search');

        $query = Barang::where('lokasi', $this->lokasi);

        if ($search) {
            $query->where('nama_asset', 'like', "%{$search}%");
        }

        $barangList = $query->orderBy('nama_asset', 'asc')->paginate(10)->withQueryString();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.mess_barang', [
            'barangList' => $barangList,
            'search' => $search,
            'activeTab' => 'barang',
        ]);
    }

    /* =========================================================================
     * 2. PEMBELIAN TAB (READ-ONLY)
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function pembelianIndex(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->query('search');
        $selectedYear = $request->query('year');

        // Extract available years from database
        $availableYears = Pembelian::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->selectRaw('YEAR(tanggal_pembelian) as year')
        ->distinct()
        ->orderByDesc('year')
        ->pluck('year')
        ->toArray();

        $currentYear = (int) date('Y');
        $defaultYears = [$currentYear - 1, $currentYear, $currentYear + 1];
        $allYears = array_values(array_unique(array_merge($defaultYears, $availableYears)));
        sort($allYears);

        if (!$selectedYear) {
            $selectedYear = in_array($currentYear, $allYears) ? $currentYear : (end($allYears) ?: $currentYear);
        }

        $query = Pembelian::with('barang')
            ->whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
                $q->where('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
            });

        if ($selectedYear !== 'all' && $selectedYear !== 'Semua Tahun' && $selectedYear !== 'all_years') {
            $query->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', $selectedYear);
        }

        if ($search) {
            $query->whereHas('barang', function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama_asset', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $pembelianList = $query->orderByDesc('tanggal_pembelian')->paginate(10)->withQueryString();

        // Calculate KPIs
        $kpiQuery = Pembelian::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        });

        if ($selectedYear !== 'all' && $selectedYear !== 'Semua Tahun' && $selectedYear !== 'all_years') {
            $kpiQuery->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', $selectedYear);
        }

        $totalJenisAset = (clone $kpiQuery)->distinct('barang_id')->count('barang_id');
        $totalBarangDibeli = (clone $kpiQuery)->sum('jumlah');

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.mess_pembelian', [
            'pembelianList' => $pembelianList,
            'years' => $allYears,
            'selectedYear' => $selectedYear,
            'search' => $search,
            'totalJenisAset' => $totalJenisAset,
            'totalBarangDibeli' => $totalBarangDibeli,
            'activeTab' => 'pembelian',
        ]);
    }

    /* =========================================================================
     * 3. STOCK OPNAME SESSIONS LIST (READ-ONLY)
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function stockOpnameIndex()

        $sessions = StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {

            DB::raw('SUM(jumlah_rusak_ringan + jumlah_rusak_berat + jumlah_hilang) as total_masalah')
        )
        ->groupBy('tanggal_stock_opname')
        ->orderByDesc('tanggal_stock_opname')
        ->get();

            'sessions' => $sessions,
            'activeTab' => 'stock_opname',
        ]);
    }

    /* =========================================================================
     * 4. STOCK OPNAME DETAIL VIEW (READ-ONLY)
     * ========================================================================= */
    public function stockOpnameDetail(Request $request, $date)
    {
        $search = $request->query('search');

        $query = StockOpname::with('barang')
            ->whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
                $q->where('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
            })
            ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date);

        if ($search) {
            $query->whereHas('barang', function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama_asset', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $items = $query->get();

        $sessionMeta = StockOpname::whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
            $q->where('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
        })
        ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)
        ->first();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.mess_stock_opname_detail', [
            'date' => $date,
            'formattedDate' => Carbon::parse($date)->translatedFormat('d F Y'),
            'sessionMeta' => $sessionMeta,
            'items' => $items,
            'search' => $search,
            'activeTab' => 'stock_opname',
        ]);
    }

    public function stockOpnameExport($date)
    {
        $items = StockOpname::with('barang')
            ->whereHas('barang', function ($q) {
                $q->where('lokasi', $this->lokasi);
            })
            ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $date)
            ->get();

        $headers = ['No', 'Nama Asset', 'Satuan', 'Baik', 'Rusak Ringan', 'Rusak Berat', 'Hilang', 'Grand Total', 'Keterangan'];
        $dataRows = [];

        $no = 1;
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $dataRows[] = [
                $no++,
                $item->barang->nama_asset ?? '-',
                $item->barang->satuan ?? 'Unit',
                $item->jumlah_baik,
                $item->jumlah_rusak_ringan,
                $item->jumlah_rusak_berat,
                $item->jumlah_hilang,
                $item->grand_total,
                $item->keterangan ?? '-',
            ];
        }

        $filename = "Stock_Opname_Mess_{$date}.xlsx";
        return ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Stock Opname Mess');
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Inventaris;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Inventaris\Barang;
use App\Models\Inventaris\Pembelian;
use App\Models\Inventaris\StockOpname;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class InventarisSummaryController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $selectedYear = (int) $request->query('year', date('Y'));
        $years = [2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026];

        $locations = ['Gudang', 'Kantor'];
        $summaryData = [];

        foreach ($locations as $lokasi) {
            $barangList = Barang::where('jenis_lokasi', $lokasi)
                ->orWhere('lokasi', $lokasi)
                ->orderBy('nama_asset', 'asc')
                ->get();

            $items = [];
            foreach ($barangList as $barang) {
                // Get latest Stock Opname up to or within selected year
                $latestSO = StockOpname::where('barang_id', $barang->id)
                    ->whereYear('tanggal_stock_opname', '<=', $selectedYear)
                    ->orderByDesc('tanggal_stock_opname')
                    ->first();

                // Total purchased up to this year
                $totalPembelian = Pembelian::where('barang_id', $barang->id)
                    ->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', '<=', $selectedYear)
                    ->sum('jumlah');

                $stok = $latestSO ? $latestSO->grand_total : $totalPembelian;
                $baik = $latestSO ? $latestSO->jumlah_baik : $stok;
                $rusak = $latestSO ? $latestSO->jumlah_rusak : 0;
                $keterangan = $latestSO ? $latestSO->keterangan : ($barang->keterangan ?: '-');

                // Room breakdown for Kantor items
                $roomBreakdown = [];
                if ($lokasi === 'Kantor') {
                    $latestDate = StockOpname::where('barang_id', $barang->id)
                        ->whereYear('tanggal_stock_opname', '<=', $selectedYear)
                        ->max('tanggal_stock_opname');

                    if ($latestDate) {
                        $roomRecords = StockOpname::where('barang_id', $barang->id)
                            ->where('tanggal_stock_opname', $latestDate)
                            ->whereNotNull('lokasi_spesifik')
                            ->get();

                        foreach ($roomRecords as $rec) {
                            $roomBreakdown[] = [
                                'lokasi_spesifik' => $rec->lokasi_spesifik,
                                'jumlah_baik' => $rec->jumlah_baik,
                                'jumlah_rusak' => $rec->jumlah_rusak,
                                'grand_total' => $rec->grand_total,
                            ];
                        }
                    }
                }

                $items[] = [
                    'id' => $barang->id,
                    'nama_asset' => $barang->nama_asset,
                    'satuan' => $barang->satuan,
                    'jenis_lokasi' => $barang->jenis_lokasi ?: $lokasi,
                    'stok' => $stok,
                    'baik' => $baik,
                    'rusak' => $rusak,
                    'keterangan' => $keterangan ?: '-',
                    'room_breakdown' => $roomBreakdown,
                ];
            }

            $summaryData[$lokasi] = $items;
        }

        // Room summary aggregation for Kantor
        $kantorBarangSummary = Barang::where(function($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_lokasi', 'Kantor')->orWhere('lokasi', 'Kantor');
        })->get();

        $summaryRoomMap = [];
        foreach ($kantorBarangSummary as $b) {
            $latestSO = StockOpname::where('barang_id', $b->id)
                ->whereYear('tanggal_stock_opname', '<=', $selectedYear)
                ->orderByDesc('tanggal_stock_opname')
                ->first();

            $totalPembelian = Pembelian::where('barang_id', $b->id)
                ->whereYear('tanggal_pembelian', '<=', $selectedYear)
                ->sum('jumlah');

            $stok = $latestSO ? $latestSO->grand_total : $totalPembelian;
            $baik = $latestSO ? $latestSO->jumlah_baik : $stok;
            $rusak = $latestSO ? $latestSO->jumlah_rusak : 0;

            $roomName = ($latestSO && !empty(trim($latestSO->lokasi_spesifik)))
                ? trim($latestSO->lokasi_spesifik)
                : (($b->lokasi && !in_array($b->lokasi, ['Kantor', 'Gudang'])) ? $b->lokasi : 'Kantor (Umum)');

            if (!isset($summaryRoomMap[$roomName])) {
                $summaryRoomMap[$roomName] = (object) [
                    'lokasi_spesifik' => $roomName,
                    'total_jenis_barang' => 0,
                    'total_baik' => 0,
                    'total_rusak' => 0,
                    'total_aset' => 0,
                ];
            }

            $summaryRoomMap[$roomName]->total_jenis_barang += 1;
            $summaryRoomMap[$roomName]->total_baik += $baik;
            $summaryRoomMap[$roomName]->total_rusak += $rusak;
            $summaryRoomMap[$roomName]->total_aset += $stok;
        }

        $summaryRoomList = array_values($summaryRoomMap);
        usort($summaryRoomList, fn($a, $b) => strcmp($a->lokasi_spesifik, $b->lokasi_spesifik));
        $kantorRoomSummary = collect($summaryRoomList);

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Inventaris.summary', [
            'summaryData' => $summaryData,
            'kantorRoomSummary' => $kantorRoomSummary,
            'years' => $years,
            'selectedYear' => (int) $selectedYear,
            'activeTab' => 'summary',
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Monitoring;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
