    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // IMPORT APIS
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    public function importEmployees(Request $request)
    {
        $mode = $request->input('mode', 'replace'); // 'replace' or 'append'
        $rows = [];

        if ($request->hasFile('file')) {
            try {
                $file = $request->file('file');
                $rawRows = SpreadsheetReader::read($file->getRealPath(), $file->getClientOriginalExtension());
                if (!empty($rawRows)) {
                    $header = array_shift($rawRows);
                    foreach ($rawRows as $data) {
                        $row = [];
                        foreach ($header as $i => $col) {
                            $row[trim((string)$col)] = isset($data[$i]) ? trim((string)$data[$i]) : null;
                        }
                        if (!empty($row['NAMA']) || !empty($row['NIK']) || !empty($row['ID_MONITORING'])) {
                            $rows[] = $row;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Gagal membaca file: ' . $e->getMessage()], 422);
            }
        } elseif ($request->filled('rows') && is_array($request->input('rows'))) {
            $rows = $request->input('rows');
        } else {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'File CSV atau data rows tidak ditemukan.',
            ], 422);
        }

        if (empty($rows)) {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Tidak ada baris data valid untuk diimport.',
            ], 422);
        }

        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0;');
        if ($mode === 'replace') {
            DB::table('monitoring_employees')->truncate();
            $seqId = 1;
        } else {
            $maxId = (int) DB::table('monitoring_employees')->max('id_monitoring');
            $seqId = $maxId + 1;
        }
        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1;');

        $batch = [];
        $insertedCount = 0;

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $nama = $row['NAMA'] ?? $row['nama'] ?? '';
            if (empty($nama) && empty($row['NIK'] ?? $row['nik'] ?? '')) {
                continue;
            }

            $payload = $this->normalizeEmployeePayload($row);
            $payload['id_monitoring'] = $seqId++;
            $payload['created_at'] = now();
            $payload['updated_at'] = now();

            $batch[] = $payload;

            if (count($batch) >= 100) {
                DB::table('monitoring_employees')->insert($batch);
                $insertedCount += count($batch);
                $batch = [];
            }
        }

        if (!empty($batch)) {
            DB::table('monitoring_employees')->insert($batch);
            $insertedCount += count($batch);
        }

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Monitoring Alumni',
            "Mengimport {$insertedCount} data karyawan alumni",
            ['count' => $insertedCount, 'mode' => $mode]
        );

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'message' => "Berhasil mengimport {$insertedCount} data karyawan.",
            'total' => DB::table('monitoring_employees')->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function importAngkatan(Request $request)
    {
        $mode = $request->input('mode', 'replace');
        $rows = [];

        if ($request->hasFile('file')) {
            try {
                $file = $request->file('file');
                $rawRows = SpreadsheetReader::read($file->getRealPath(), $file->getClientOriginalExtension());
                if (!empty($rawRows)) {
                    $header = array_shift($rawRows);
                    foreach ($rawRows as $data) {
                        $row = [];
                        foreach ($header as $i => $col) {
                            $row[trim((string)$col)] = isset($data[$i]) ? trim((string)$data[$i]) : null;
                        }
                        if (!empty($row['angkatan']) || !empty($row['Angkatan'])) {
                            $rows[] = $row;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Gagal membaca file: ' . $e->getMessage()], 422);
            }
        } elseif ($request->filled('rows') && is_array($request->input('rows'))) {
            $rows = $request->input('rows');
        } else {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'File CSV atau data rows tidak ditemukan.',
            ], 422);
        }

        if (empty($rows)) {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Tidak ada baris data valid untuk diimport.',
            ], 422);
        }

        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0;');
        if ($mode === 'replace') {
            DB::table('monitoring_angkatan')->truncate();
            $seqId = 1;
        } else {
            $maxId = (int) DB::table('monitoring_angkatan')->max('id_angkatan');
            $seqId = $maxId + 1;
        }
        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1;');

        $batch = [];
        $insertedCount = 0;

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $angkatan = $row['angkatan'] ?? $row['Angkatan'] ?? '';
            if (empty($angkatan)) continue;

            $batch[] = [
                'id_angkatan' => $seqId++,
                'angkatan' => $angkatan,
                'jumlah_awal' => (int) ($row['Jumlah Awal'] ?? $row['jumlah_awal'] ?? 0),
                'lulus' => (int) ($row['lulus'] ?? $row['Lulus'] ?? 0),
                'resign_in_class' => (int) ($row['Resign_In_Class'] ?? $row['resign_in_class'] ?? 0),
                'resign_ojt' => (int) ($row['Resign_OJT'] ?? $row['resign_ojt'] ?? 0),
                'tidak_lulus' => (int) ($row['tidak_lulus'] ?? $row['tidak_lulus_calculated'] ?? 0),
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ];

            if (count($batch) >= 50) {
                DB::table('monitoring_angkatan')->insert($batch);
                $insertedCount += count($batch);
                $batch = [];
            }
        }

        if (!empty($batch)) {
            DB::table('monitoring_angkatan')->insert($batch);
            $insertedCount += count($batch);
        }

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Monitoring Alumni',
            "Mengimport {$insertedCount} data angkatan",
            ['count' => $insertedCount, 'mode' => $mode]
        );

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'message' => "Berhasil mengimport {$insertedCount} data angkatan.",
            'total' => DB::table('monitoring_angkatan')->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function importCulled(Request $request)
    {
        $mode = $request->input('mode', 'replace');
        $rows = [];

        if ($request->hasFile('file')) {
            try {
                $file = $request->file('file');
                $rawRows = SpreadsheetReader::read($file->getRealPath(), $file->getClientOriginalExtension());
                if (!empty($rawRows)) {
                    $header = array_shift($rawRows);
                    foreach ($rawRows as $data) {
                        $row = [];
                        foreach ($header as $i => $col) {
                            $row[trim((string)$col)] = isset($data[$i]) ? trim((string)$data[$i]) : null;
                        }
                        if (!empty($row['NAMA']) || !empty($row['nama']) || !empty($row['Nama']) || !empty($row['Nama Lengkap'])) {
                            $rows[] = $row;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Gagal membaca file: ' . $e->getMessage()], 422);
            }
        } elseif ($request->filled('rows') && is_array($request->input('rows'))) {
            $rows = $request->input('rows');
        } else {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'File CSV atau data rows tidak ditemukan.',
            ], 422);
        }

        if (empty($rows)) {
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Tidak ada baris data valid untuk diimport.',
            ], 422);
        }

        $angkatanMap = DB::table('monitoring_angkatan')->pluck('id_angkatan', 'angkatan')->mapWithKeys(function($id, $name) {
            return [strtolower(trim((string)$name)) => $id];
        })->toArray();

        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0;');
        if ($mode === 'replace') {
            DB::table('monitoring_culled')->truncate();
            $seqId = 1;
        } else {
            $maxId = (int) DB::table('monitoring_culled')->max('id_culled');
            $seqId = $maxId + 1;
        }
        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1;');

        $batch = [];
        $insertedCount = 0;

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $nama = $row['NAMA'] ?? $row['nama'] ?? $row['Nama'] ?? $row['Nama Lengkap'] ?? '';
            if (empty($nama)) continue;

            $idAngkatan = null;
            $angkatanName = $row['ANGKATAN'] ?? $row['angkatan'] ?? $row['Angkatan'] ?? $row['id_angkatan'] ?? $row['ID_ANGKATAN'] ?? null;
            if ($angkatanName) {
                if (is_numeric($angkatanName) && in_array((int)$angkatanName, $angkatanMap, true)) {
                    $idAngkatan = (int)$angkatanName;
                } else {
                    $cleanName = strtolower(trim((string)$angkatanName));
                    if (isset($angkatanMap[$cleanName])) {
                        $idAngkatan = $angkatanMap[$cleanName];
                    }
                }
            }

            $status = $row['KATEGORI_STATUS'] ?? $row['kategori_status'] ?? $row['Kategori Status'] ?? $row['STATUS'] ?? $row['status'] ?? 'Culled';
            $jenisCulled = $row['JENIS_CULLED'] ?? $row['jenis_culled'] ?? $row['Jenis_culled'] ?? $row['Jenis Culled'] ?? null;
            $alasan = $row['ALASAN'] ?? $row['alasan'] ?? $row['Alasan'] ?? $row['Alasan Detail'] ?? null;

            $batch[] = [
                'id_culled' => $seqId++,
                'id_angkatan' => $idAngkatan,
                'nama' => $nama,
                'alasan' => $alasan,
                'kategori_status' => $status,
                'jenis_culled' => $jenisCulled,
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ];

            if (count($batch) >= 100) {
                DB::table('monitoring_culled')->insert($batch);
                $insertedCount += count($batch);
                $batch = [];
            }
        }

        if (!empty($batch)) {
            DB::table('monitoring_culled')->insert($batch);
            $insertedCount += count($batch);
        }

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Monitoring Alumni',
            "Mengimport {$insertedCount} data peserta culled",
            ['count' => $insertedCount, 'mode' => $mode]
        );

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',

            'total' => DB::table('monitoring_culled')->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function resetData()
    {
        if (class_exists(MonitoringSeeder::class)) {
            $seeder = new MonitoringSeeder();
            $seeder->run();
        } elseif (class_exists(RootMonitoringSeeder::class)) {
            $seeder = new RootMonitoringSeeder();
            $seeder->run();
        }

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'message' => 'Database Monitoring berhasil di-reset ke data awal master CSV',
        ]);
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Monitoring;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Monitoring\MonitoringTalent;
use App\Models\AppSetting;
use App\Services\ExcelExporter;
use App\Services\SpreadsheetReader;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class MonitoringTalentController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display a listing of talent monitoring records.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $kategori = trim((string) $request->input('kategori', 'all'));
        $status = trim((string) $request->input('status', 'all'));
        $region = trim((string) $request->input('region', 'all'));
        $talentTo = trim((string) $request->input('talent_to', 'all'));
        $search = trim((string) $request->input('search', ''));

        $query = MonitoringTalent::query()
            ->category($kategori)
            ->region($region)
            ->status($status);

        if ($talentTo !== 'all' && $talentTo !== '') {
            $query->where('talent_to', $talentTo);
        }

        if ($search !== '') {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('employee_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('employee_id', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('posisi_asal', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('talent_to', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('unit', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('mentor_lapangan', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('mentor_frlc', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('keterangan', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('lokasi_penugasan_baru', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        // Summary KPI Metrics
        $allTalents = MonitoringTalent::all();
        $totalAll = $allTalents->count();

        $countSudah = $allTalents->filter(fn($t) => str_contains(strtolower($t->status ?? ''), 'sudah penugasan'))->count();
        $countAkan = $allTalents->filter(fn($t) => str_contains(strtolower($t->status ?? ''), 'akan penugasan'))->count();
        $countBelum = $allTalents->filter(fn($t) => str_contains(strtolower($t->status ?? ''), 'belum penugasan'))->count();
        $countConfirm = $allTalents->filter(fn($t) => str_contains(strtolower($t->status ?? ''), 'confirm'))->count();

        // Manual Progress Materi Setting
        $progressMateri = (float) AppSetting::get('talent_program_progress_materi', 83);

        // Dynamic Category counts
        $categories = MonitoringTalent::distinct()->pluck('kategori')->filter()->values();
        $categoryCounts = [];
        foreach ($categories as $cat) {
            $categoryCounts[$cat] = $allTalents->where('kategori', $cat)->count();
        }

        // Filter Dropdown Lists
        $statuses = MonitoringTalent::distinct()->pluck('status')->filter()->values();
        $regions = \App\Services\RegionHelper::getCanonicalRegions(MonitoringTalent::distinct()->pluck('region'));
        $talentToList = MonitoringTalent::distinct()->pluck('talent_to')->filter()->values();

        $perPage = (int) $request->input('per_page', 25);
        $talents = $query->orderBy('no', 'asc')->paginate($perPage)->withQueryString();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Monitoring.monitoring_talent', compact(
            'talents',
            'kategori',
            'status',
            'region',
            'talentTo',
            'search',
            'totalAll',
            'countSudah',
            'countAkan',
            'countBelum',
            'countConfirm',
            'progressMateri',
            'categoryCounts',
            'categories',
            'statuses',
            'regions',
            'talentToList'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Update manual Progress Materi for Talent Program.
     */
    public function updateProgressMateri(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'progress_materi' => 'required|numeric|min:0|max:100',
        ]);

        AppSetting::set('talent_program_progress_materi', $request->input('progress_materi'));

        return redirect()->back()->with('success', 'Progres Materi Talent Program berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    /**
     * Shared validation rules for store and update.
     */
    protected function validationRules(): array
    {
        return [
            'employee_id' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'employee_name' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'posisi_asal' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'talent_to' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'unit' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'region' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'mentor_lapangan' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'mentor_frlc' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'status' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
            'periode_penugasan_lama' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'alasan' => 'nullable|string',
            'periode_penugasan_baru' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'lokasi_penugasan_baru' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'catatan_tambahan' => 'nullable|string',
            'kategori' => 'required|string|max:255',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created talent record.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $data = $request->validate($this->validationRules());

        if (empty($data['no'])) {
            $data['no'] = ((int) MonitoringTalent::max('no')) + 1;
        }

        MonitoringTalent::create($data);

        return back()->with('success', 'Data peserta talent berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    /**
     * Update an existing talent record.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $talent = MonitoringTalent::findOrFail($id);
        $data = $request->validate($this->validationRules());

        $talent->update($data);

        return back()->with('success', 'Data peserta talent berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    /**
     * Delete a single talent record.
     */
    public function destroy($id)
    {
        $talent = MonitoringTalent::findOrFail($id);
        $talent->delete();

        return back()->with('success', 'Data peserta talent berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    /**
     * Delete all talent records.
     */
    public function destroyAll()
    {
        $count = MonitoringTalent::count();
        MonitoringTalent::truncate();

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Hapus',
            'Monitoring Talent',
            "Menghapus semua data monitoring talent ({$count} data)",
            ['count' => $count]
        );

        return back()->with('success', "Seluruh data monitoring talent ({$count} data) berhasil dihapus.");
    }

    /**
     * Import talent data from CSV/Excel via SpreadsheetReader.
     */
    public function import(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'file' => 'required|file|max:20480',
        ]);

        try {
            $file = $request->file('file');
            $rows = SpreadsheetReader::read($file->getRealPath(), $file->getClientOriginalExtension());
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Gagal membaca file: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }

        if (empty($rows)) {
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'File tidak memiliki baris data valid.']);
        }

        $rawHeaders = array_shift($rows);
        $headerMap = [];

        foreach ($rawHeaders as $idx => $h) {
            $clean = SpreadsheetReader::cleanString($h);
            if (in_array($clean, ['no', 'id', 'nomor'])) $headerMap['no'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['employee id', 'nik', 'id karyawan', 'nip', 'badge'])) $headerMap['employee_id'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['employee name', 'nama', 'nama karyawan', 'nama peserta', 'name'])) $headerMap['employee_name'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['posisi asal', 'posisi', 'jabatan', 'jabatan asal'])) $headerMap['posisi_asal'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['talent to', 'posisi tujuan', 'target posisi', 'to'])) $headerMap['talent_to'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['unit', 'kebun/pabrik', 'lokasi', 'work location', 'estate'])) $headerMap['unit'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['region', 'wilayah'])) $headerMap['region'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['mentor lapangan', 'mentor lap', 'mentor lap.'])) $headerMap['mentor_lapangan'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['mentor frlc', 'mentor fr', 'mentor'])) $headerMap['mentor_frlc'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['status', 'status penugasan'])) $headerMap['status'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['keterangan', 'ket', 'notes', 'note'])) $headerMap['keterangan'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['periode penugasan lama', 'periode lama', 'periode asal'])) $headerMap['periode_penugasan_lama'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['alasan', 'alasan penugasan'])) $headerMap['alasan'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['periode penugasan baru', 'periode baru', 'periode tujuan'])) $headerMap['periode_penugasan_baru'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['lokasi penugasan baru', 'lokasi baru', 'lokasi tugas baru', 'penugasan baru'])) $headerMap['lokasi_penugasan_baru'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['catatan tambahan', 'catatan', 'keterangan tambahan'])) $headerMap['catatan_tambahan'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($clean, ['kategori', 'category', 'kategori talent'])) $headerMap['kategori'] = $idx;
        }

        $imported = 0;
        $insertBatch = [];

        DB::beginTransaction();
        try {
            foreach ($rows as $row) {
                if (empty(array_filter($row, fn($v) => trim((string)$v) !== ''))) continue;

                $getVal = function($key, $fallbackIndex = null) use ($row, $headerMap) {
                    if (isset($headerMap[$key]) && isset($row[$headerMap[$key]])) {
                        return trim((string) $row[$headerMap[$key]]);
                    }
                    if ($fallbackIndex !== null && isset($row[$fallbackIndex])) {
                        return trim((string) $row[$fallbackIndex]);
                    }
                    return '';
                };

                $empName = $getVal('employee_name', 2);
                if (empty($empName)) continue;

                $noVal = $getVal('no', 0);
                $no = (!empty($noVal) && is_numeric($noVal)) ? (int) $noVal : ($imported + 1);
                $empId = $getVal('employee_id', 1) ?: null;
                $posisiAsal = $getVal('posisi_asal', 3) ?: null;
                $talentTo = $getVal('talent_to', 4) ?: null;
                $unit = $getVal('unit', 5) ?: null;
                $region = $getVal('region', 6) ?: null;
                $mentorLap = $getVal('mentor_lapangan', 7) ?: null;
                $mentorFrlc = $getVal('mentor_frlc', 8) ?: null;
                $status = $getVal('status', 9) ?: null;
                $keterangan = $getVal('keterangan', 10) ?: null;
                $periodeLama = $getVal('periode_penugasan_lama', 11) ?: null;
                $alasan = $getVal('alasan', 12) ?: null;
                $periodeBaru = $getVal('periode_penugasan_baru', 13) ?: null;
                $lokasiBaru = $getVal('lokasi_penugasan_baru', 14) ?: null;

                $kategori = $getVal('kategori', count($row) - 1);
                if (empty($kategori) || !str_starts_with(strtoupper($kategori), 'TALENT')) {
                    $kategori = 'TALENT ESTATE TAHUN 2026';
                }

                if (strcasecmp((string)$talentTo, 'PC') === 0) {
                    if (str_contains(strtoupper($kategori), 'MILL') || str_contains($posisiAsal ?? '', 'Mill')) {
                        $talentTo = 'PC (Production Controller)';
                    } else {
                        $talentTo = 'PC (Plantation Controller)';
                    }
                }

                $catatanVal = $getVal('catatan_tambahan', 15);
                if ($catatanVal !== '' && $catatanVal !== '-') {
                    $catatan = $catatanVal;
                } else {
                    $notes = [];
                    for ($i = 15; $i < count($row) - 1; $i++) {
                        $val = trim((string)($row[$i] ?? ''));
                        if (!empty($val) && $val !== '-') {
                            $notes[] = $val;
                        }
                    }
                    $catatan = !empty($notes) ? implode(' | ', $notes) : null;
                }

                $insertBatch[] = [
                    'no' => $no,
                    'employee_id' => $empId,
                    'employee_name' => $empName,
                    'posisi_asal' => $posisiAsal,
                    'talent_to' => $talentTo,
                    'unit' => $unit,
                    'region' => $region,
                    'mentor_lapangan' => $mentorLap,
                    'mentor_frlc' => $mentorFrlc,
                    'status' => $status,
                    'keterangan' => $keterangan,
                    'periode_penugasan_lama' => $periodeLama,
                    'alasan' => $alasan,
                    'periode_penugasan_baru' => $periodeBaru,
                    'lokasi_penugasan_baru' => $lokasiBaru,
                    'catatan_tambahan' => $catatan,
                    'kategori' => $kategori,
                    'created_at' => now(),
                    'updated_at' => now(),
                ];

                $imported++;

                if (count($insertBatch) >= 100) {
                    MonitoringTalent::insert($insertBatch);
                    $insertBatch = [];
                }
            }

            if (!empty($insertBatch)) {
                MonitoringTalent::insert($insertBatch);
            }

            DB::commit();

            ActivityLog::log(
                'Import',
                'Monitoring Talent',
                "Mengimport {$imported} data peserta talent dari file " . $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                ['filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(), 'count' => $imported]
            );

            return back()->with('success', "{$imported} data peserta talent berhasil diimpor.");
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Gagal mengimpor file: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Export talent data to CSV.
     */
    public function export(Request $request)
    {
        $kategori = trim((string) $request->input('kategori', 'all'));
        $status = trim((string) $request->input('status', 'all'));
        $region = trim((string) $request->input('region', 'all'));
        $search = trim((string) $request->input('search', ''));

        $query = MonitoringTalent::query();

        if ($kategori !== 'all' && $kategori !== '') {
            $query->where('kategori', $kategori);
        }
        if ($status !== 'all' && $status !== '') {
            $query->where('status', 'like', "%{$status}%");
        }
        if ($region !== 'all' && $region !== '') {
            $query->where('region', $region);
        }
        if ($search !== '') {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('employee_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('employee_id', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('posisi_asal', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('unit', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $records = $query->orderBy('no', 'asc')->get();
        $headers = [
            'No',
            'Employee ID',
            'Employee Name',
            'Posisi Asal',
            'Talent To',
            'Unit',
            'Region',
            'Mentor Lapangan',

            'Status',

            'Periode Penugasan Lama',
            'Alasan',
            'Periode Penugasan Baru',
            'Lokasi Penugasan Baru',
            'Catatan Tambahan',
            'Kategori',
        ];

        $dataRows = [];
        foreach ($records as $r) {
            $dataRows[] = [
                $r->no,
                $r->employee_id,
                $r->employee_name,
                $r->posisi_asal,
                $r->talent_to,
                $r->unit,
                $r->region,
                $r->mentor_lapangan,
                $r->mentor_frlc,
                $r->status,
                $r->keterangan,
                $r->periode_penugasan_lama,
                $r->alasan,
                $r->periode_penugasan_baru,
                $r->lokasi_penugasan_baru,
                $r->catatan_tambahan,
                $r->kategori,
            ];
        }

        $filename = 'Monitoring_Talent_' . date('Ymd_His') . '.xlsx';
        return ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Monitoring Talent');
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Monitoring;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\Monitoring\ResignedStaff;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\IOFactory;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class ResignedStaffController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        // ==== 1. Filter Data ====
        $query = ResignedStaff::query();

        if ($request->has('region') && $request->region != 'All Region' && $request->region != '') {
            $query->where('region', $request->region);
        }

        $availableYears = ResignedStaff::selectRaw('YEAR(resign_date) as year')
                            ->whereNotNull('resign_date')
                            ->distinct()
                            ->pluck('year')
                            ->sort()
                            ->values()
                            ->toArray();
        if (empty($availableYears)) {
            $availableYears = [2025, 2026];
        }

        $selectedYears = $request->input('years', $availableYears);
        if (!is_array($selectedYears)) {
            $selectedYears = [$selectedYears];
        }

        if ($request->has('years')) {
            $query->whereIn(DB::raw('YEAR(resign_date)'), $selectedYears);
        }

        // Clone query for Data Karyawan (Table)
        $tableQuery = clone $query;
        if ($request->has('search') && $request->search != '') {
            $search = $request->search;
            $tableQuery->where(function($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('employee_id', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('kebun', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }
        $perPage = $request->input('per_page', 10);
        $resignedStaffs = $tableQuery->orderBy('resign_date', 'desc')->paginate($perPage)->withQueryString();

        // ==== 2. Dashboard Aggregations (Top Cards) ====
        $stats = (clone $query)->select(
            DB::raw('YEAR(resign_date) as year'),
            DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total'),
            DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(jenis_resign) = 'voluntary' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_vt"),
            DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(jenis_resign) = 'involuntary' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_it"),
            DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(alumni) = 'alumni' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_alumni"),
            DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(alumni) = 'non alumni' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_non_alumni")
        )->groupBy(DB::raw('YEAR(resign_date)'))
         ->get()
         ->keyBy('year');

        $statTotal = (object)[
            'total' => 0, 'total_vt' => 0, 'total_it' => 0, 'total_alumni' => 0, 'total_non_alumni' => 0
        ];

        foreach ($selectedYears as $year) {
            if ($stats->has($year)) {
                $s = $stats->get($year);
                $statTotal->total += $s->total;
                $statTotal->total_vt += $s->total_vt;
                $statTotal->total_it += $s->total_it;
                $statTotal->total_alumni += $s->total_alumni;
                $statTotal->total_non_alumni += $s->total_non_alumni;
            }
        }

        // Safe percentage function
        $calcPct = function($part, $total) {
            return $total > 0 ? round(($part / $total) * 100, 1) : 0;
        };

        // ==== 3. Chart: Cluster Penyebab Resign ====
        $clusterSelect = ['cluster_resign'];
        foreach ($selectedYears as $year) {
            $clusterSelect[] = DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(resign_date) = {$year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_{$year}");
        }
        $clusterStats = (clone $query)->select($clusterSelect)
         ->whereNotNull('cluster_resign')
         ->groupBy('cluster_resign')
         ->orderBy(DB::raw('COUNT(*)'), 'desc')
         ->limit(10)
         ->get();

        // ==== 4. Chart: Resign by Jabatan ====
        $jabatanSelect = ['jabatan'];
        foreach ($selectedYears as $year) {
            $jabatanSelect[] = DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(resign_date) = {$year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_{$year}");
        }
        $jabatanStats = (clone $query)->select($jabatanSelect)
         ->whereNotNull('jabatan')
         ->groupBy('jabatan')
         ->orderBy(DB::raw('COUNT(*)'), 'asc')
         ->limit(10)
         ->get();

        // ==== 5. Table: Top 10 Kebun ====
        $getTopKebun = function($year) use ($query) {
            return (clone $query)->select(
                'kebun',
                DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(jenis_resign) = 'involuntary' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as it"),
                DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(jenis_resign) = 'voluntary' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as vt"),
                DB::raw("COUNT(*) as total")
            )->whereYear('resign_date', $year)
             ->whereNotNull('kebun')
             ->groupBy('kebun')
             ->orderBy('total', 'desc')
             ->limit(10)
             ->get();
        };

        $topKebunTables = [];
        foreach ($selectedYears as $year) {
            $topKebunTables[$year] = $getTopKebun($year);
        }

        // ==== 6. Trend Turnover ====
        $trendStats = (clone $query)->select(
            DB::raw("DATE_FORMAT(resign_date, '%Y-%m') as month_year"),
            DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(jenis_resign) = 'involuntary' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as it"),
            DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(jenis_resign) = 'voluntary' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as vt"),
            DB::raw("COUNT(*) as total")
        )->groupBy('month_year')
         ->orderBy('month_year', 'asc')
         ->get();

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Monitoring.staf_resign', compact(
            'resignedStaffs', 'availableYears', 'selectedYears',
            'stats', 'statTotal', 'calcPct',
            'clusterStats', 'jabatanStats', 'topKebunTables', 'trendStats'
        ));
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'employee_id' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'nama' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'jabatan' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'kebun' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'region' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'jenis_resign' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'cluster_resign' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'alumni' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'join_date' => 'nullable|date',
            'resign_date' => 'nullable|date',
            'deskripsi_resign' => 'nullable|string',
            'keterangan' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        ResignedStaff::create($request->all());

        return redirect()->route('administrasi.staf-resign.index')->with('success', 'Data karyawan resign berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    public function update(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $staff = ResignedStaff::findOrFail($id);
        $staff->update($request->all());
        return redirect()->route('administrasi.staf-resign.index')->with('success', 'Data karyawan resign berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy($id)
    {
        $staff = ResignedStaff::findOrFail($id);
        $staff->delete();
        return redirect()->route('administrasi.staf-resign.index')->with('success', 'Data karyawan resign berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    public function downloadTemplate()
    {
        $headers = [
            'Content-type' => 'text/csv',
            'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename=template_import_staf_resign.csv',
            'Pragma' => 'no-cache',
            'Cache-Control' => 'must-revalidate, post-check=0, pre-check=0',
            'Expires' => '0',
        ];

        $columns = ['employee_id', 'nama', 'jabatan', 'kebun', 'region', 'join_date', 'resign_date', 'jenis_resign', 'cluster_resign', 'alumni', 'deskripsi_resign', 'keterangan'];

        $callback = function() use ($columns) {
            $file = fopen('php://output', 'w');
            fputcsv($file, $columns);
            fputcsv($file, ['123', 'Test Staff', 'Asisten', 'MRE', 'Kubar', '2022-01-15', '2025-06-10', 'VT', 'Pindah Perusahaan', 'ALUMNI', 'Penjelasan singkat', 'Catatan opsional']);
            fclose($file);
        };

        return response()->stream($callback, 200, $headers);
    }
    public function previewImport(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'file' => 'required|file'
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('file');
        $extension = $file->getClientOriginalExtension();

        if (!in_array($extension, ['csv', 'txt', 'xls', 'xlsx'])) {
            return redirect()->route('administrasi.staf-resign.index')->with('error', 'Format file tidak didukung! Pastikan file berformat Excel (.xlsx/.xls) atau CSV.');
        }

        $filename = 'import_resign_'.time().'.'.$extension;
        $file->move(storage_path('app/temp'), $filename);
        $fullPath = storage_path('app/temp/' . $filename);

        $spreadsheet = IOFactory::load($fullPath);
        $worksheet = $spreadsheet->getActiveSheet();
        $rows = $worksheet->toArray();
        $rawHeader = array_shift($rows);

        $aliasMap = [
            'id' => 'employee_id', 'id_karyawan' => 'employee_id', 'nik' => 'employee_id',
            'nama_karyawan' => 'nama', 'name' => 'nama',
            'tgl_join' => 'join_date', 'tanggal_join' => 'join_date', 'join' => 'join_date',
            'tgl_resign' => 'resign_date', 'tanggal_resign' => 'resign_date', 'resign' => 'resign_date',
            'desc_resign' => 'deskripsi_resign', 'alasan_resign' => 'deskripsi_resign', 'alasan' => 'deskripsi_resign',
            'jenis' => 'jenis_resign', 'tipe_resign' => 'jenis_resign',
            'cluster' => 'cluster_resign', 'kategori_resign' => 'cluster_resign'
        ];

        $header = array_map(function($col) use ($aliasMap) {
            $col = strtolower(trim(str_replace([' ', '-'], '_', $col)));
            return $aliasMap[$col] ?? $col;
        }, $rawHeader);

        $previewData = [];
        $validRowsCount = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            if (count($header) == count($row)) {
                $rowData = array_combine($header, $row);
                if (!empty(array_filter($rowData))) {
                    if ($validRowsCount < 3) {
                        $previewData[] = $rowData;
                    }
                    $validRowsCount++;
                }
            }
        }

        return redirect()->back()->with([
            'preview_data' => $previewData,
            'temp_file' => 'temp/' . $filename,
            'total_rows' => $validRowsCount
        ]);
    }

    public function processImport(Request $request)
    {
        $tempFile = $request->input('temp_file');
        if (!$tempFile) {
            return redirect()->back()->with('error', 'File import tidak ditemukan atau kadaluarsa.');
        }

        $fullPath = storage_path('app/' . $tempFile);
        if (!file_exists($fullPath)) {
            return redirect()->back()->with('error', 'File import tidak ditemukan atau kadaluarsa.');
        }

        $spreadsheet = IOFactory::load($fullPath);
        $worksheet = $spreadsheet->getActiveSheet();
        $rows = $worksheet->toArray();
        $rawHeader = array_shift($rows);

        $aliasMap = [
            'id' => 'employee_id', 'id_karyawan' => 'employee_id', 'nik' => 'employee_id',
            'nama_karyawan' => 'nama', 'name' => 'nama',
            'tgl_join' => 'join_date', 'tanggal_join' => 'join_date', 'join' => 'join_date',
            'tgl_resign' => 'resign_date', 'tanggal_resign' => 'resign_date', 'resign' => 'resign_date',
            'desc_resign' => 'deskripsi_resign', 'alasan_resign' => 'deskripsi_resign', 'alasan' => 'deskripsi_resign',
            'jenis' => 'jenis_resign', 'tipe_resign' => 'jenis_resign',
            'cluster' => 'cluster_resign', 'kategori_resign' => 'cluster_resign'
        ];

        $header = array_map(function($col) use ($aliasMap) {
            $col = strtolower(trim(str_replace([' ', '-'], '_', $col)));
            return $aliasMap[$col] ?? $col;
        }, $rawHeader);

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            if (count($header) == count($row)) {
                $rowData = array_combine($header, $row);

                if (empty(array_filter($rowData))) {
                    continue;
                }

                $joinDate = $this->parseDate($rowData['join_date'] ?? null);
                $resignDate = $this->parseDate($rowData['resign_date'] ?? null);

                ResignedStaff::create([
                    'employee_id' => $rowData['employee_id'] ?? null,
                    'nama' => $rowData['nama'] ?? null,
                    'jabatan' => $rowData['jabatan'] ?? null,
                    'kebun' => $rowData['kebun'] ?? null,
                    'region' => $rowData['region'] ?? null,
                    'join_date' => $joinDate,
                    'resign_date' => $resignDate,
                    'jenis_resign' => $rowData['jenis_resign'] ?? null,
                    'cluster_resign' => $rowData['cluster_resign'] ?? null,
                    'alumni' => $rowData['alumni'] ?? null,
                    'deskripsi_resign' => $rowData['deskripsi_resign'] ?? null,
                    'keterangan' => $rowData['keterangan'] ?? null,
                ]);
            }
        }

        if (file_exists($fullPath)) {
            unlink($fullPath);
        }
        return redirect()->route('administrasi.staf-resign.index')->with('success', 'Data berhasil di-import!');
    }

    private function parseDate($dateValue) {
        if (!$dateValue) return null;
        try {
            if (is_numeric($dateValue)) {
                return \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\Date::excelToDateTimeObject($dateValue)->format('Y-m-d');
            }
            if (strpos($dateValue, '/') !== false) {
                // assume d/m/Y
                return Carbon::createFromFormat('d/m/Y', $dateValue)->format('Y-m-d');
            }
            return Carbon::parse($dateValue)->format('Y-m-d');
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Program;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Program\ProgramNonReguler;
use App\Models\Program\ProgramReguler;
use App\Models\Program\TrainingRecord;
use App\Services\SpreadsheetReader;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class DashboardMonitoringTahunanController extends Controller
{
    public const MONTH_3_LETTERS = [
        1 => 'JAN', 2 => 'FEB', 3 => 'MAR', 4 => 'APR',
        5 => 'MEI', 6 => 'JUN', 7 => 'JUL', 8 => 'AGU',
        9 => 'SEP', 10 => 'OKT', 11 => 'NOV', 12 => 'DES',
    ];

    public const MONTH_NAMES = [
        1 => 'Januari', 2 => 'Februari', 3 => 'Maret', 4 => 'April',
        5 => 'Mei', 6 => 'Juni', 7 => 'Juli', 8 => 'Agustus',
        9 => 'September', 10 => 'Oktober', 11 => 'November', 12 => 'Desember',
    ];

    public function extractYearFromField($val): ?int
    {
        if (empty($val)) return null;
        if ($val instanceof \DateTimeInterface) return (int) $val->format('Y');
        if (is_numeric($val) && (int)$val >= 2000 && (int)$val <= 2100) return (int) $val;
        if (is_array($val)) {
            foreach ($val as $item) {
                $y = $this->extractYearFromField($item);
                if ($y) return $y;
            }
            return null;
        }
        if (is_string($val)) {
            $trimmed = trim($val);
            if (str_starts_with($trimmed, '[') && str_ends_with($trimmed, ']')) {
                $decoded = json_decode($trimmed, true);
                if (is_array($decoded)) {
                    return $this->extractYearFromField($decoded);
                }
            }
            if (preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $trimmed, $m)) {
                return (int) $m[1];
            }
            $time = strtotime($trimmed);
            if ($time !== false && $time > 0) {
                return (int) date('Y', $time);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function resolveProgramRegulerYear($p): int
    {
        if ($p->Mulai_program && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->Mulai_program))) return $y;
        if (!empty($p->tahun) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tahun))) return $y;
        if (!empty($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan))) return $y;
        if ($p->Selesai_program && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->Selesai_program))) return $y;
        if ($p->created_at && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->created_at))) return $y;
        return 2026;
    }

    public function resolveProgramNonRegulerYear($p): int
    {
        if (!empty($p->tahun) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tahun))) return $y;
        if ($p->start_date && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->start_date))) return $y;
        if (!empty($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan))) return $y;
        if ($p->end_date && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->end_date))) return $y;
        if ($p->created_at && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->created_at))) return $y;
        return 2026;
    }

    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $trYears = TrainingRecord::whereNotNull('tahun')->pluck('tahun')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->filter()->all();
        $trDateYears = TrainingRecord::whereNotNull('training_date')->get()->map(fn($r) => (int) date('Y', strtotime($r->training_date)))->filter()->all();
        $regYears = ProgramReguler::all()->map(fn($p) => $this->resolveProgramRegulerYear($p))->filter()->all();
        $nonRegYears = ProgramNonReguler::all()->map(fn($p) => $this->resolveProgramNonRegulerYear($p))->filter()->all();

        $years = collect([2024, 2025, 2026, 2027])
            ->merge($trYears)
            ->merge($trDateYears)
            ->merge($regYears)
            ->merge($nonRegYears)
            ->filter(fn($y) => $y >= 2000 && $y <= 2100)
            ->unique()
            ->sort()
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $yearDefault = in_array(2026, $years, true) ? 2026 : ($years[count($years)-1] ?? (int)date('Y'));
        $year = (int) $request->input('year', $yearDefault);

        $tab = $request->input('tab', 'non_reguler'); // 'reguler' or 'non_reguler'
        $category = $request->input('category', 'all'); // 'all', 'staf', 'mandor', 'managerial', 'technical'
        $selectedProgramName = $request->input('program', 'all');
        $rawMonth = $request->input('month', 'all'); // 'all' or 1..12 or 'JAN'..'DES'
        $selectedRegion = trim((string) $request->input('region', 'all'));

        $selectedMonthNum = $this->parseMonthNumber($rawMonth); // null if 'all'
        $selectedMonthCode = $selectedMonthNum ? self::MONTH_3_LETTERS[$selectedMonthNum] : 'all';

        $cleanStr = fn($str) => SpreadsheetReader::cleanString($str);

        // Fetch List of Available Regions (Standardized)
        $regRegions = ProgramReguler::pluck('Region');
        $nonRegRegions = ProgramNonReguler::pluck('region');
        $trRegions = TrainingRecord::pluck('region');
        $rawRegions = $regRegions->merge($nonRegRegions)->merge($trRegions);
        $regions = \App\Services\RegionHelper::getCanonicalRegions($rawRegions);

        // 1. Fetch Master Programs Filtered By Year
        $regulerAll = ProgramReguler::all()->filter(fn($p) => $this->resolveProgramRegulerYear($p) === $year);
        $nonRegulerAll = ProgramNonReguler::all()->filter(fn($p) => $this->resolveProgramNonRegulerYear($p) === $year);

        // Dynamic Counts for Category Cards (Gambar 2)
        $regulerTotalCount = $regulerAll->count();
        $regulerStafCount = $regulerAll->filter(fn($p) => str_contains($cleanStr($p->jenis_program_reguler), 'staf'))->count();
        $regulerMandorCount = $regulerAll->filter(fn($p) => str_contains($cleanStr($p->jenis_program_reguler), 'mandor'))->count();

        $nonRegulerTotalCount = $nonRegulerAll->count();
        $nonRegulerManagerialCount = $nonRegulerAll->filter(fn($p) => str_contains($cleanStr($p->kategori_pelatihan), 'managerial') || str_contains($cleanStr($p->sub_kategori), 'soft'))->count();
        $nonRegulerTechnicalCount = $nonRegulerAll->filter(fn($p) => str_contains($cleanStr($p->kategori_pelatihan), 'technical') && !str_contains($cleanStr($p->sub_kategori), 'soft'))->count();

        $nonRegulerSubCategories = ProgramNonReguler::pluck('sub_kategori')
            ->filter()
            ->map(fn($c) => trim((string)$c))
            ->unique()
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $subCategoryCounts = [];
        foreach ($nonRegulerSubCategories as $subCat) {
            $search = $cleanStr($subCat);
            $subCategoryCounts[$subCat] = $nonRegulerAll->filter(function($p) use ($search, $cleanStr) {
                return str_contains($cleanStr($p->sub_kategori), $search)
                    || str_contains($cleanStr($p->kategori_pelatihan), $search);
            })->count();
        }

        // 2. Fetch Records from TrainingRecord
        $trainingRecords = TrainingRecord::where('status', 'valid')->get();

        // 3. Build Distinct Programs List for Current Tab & Category
        $currentBatches = collect();
        if ($tab === 'reguler') {
            $filteredReg = $regulerAll;
            if ($category === 'staf') {
                $filteredReg = $filteredReg->filter(fn($p) => str_contains($cleanStr($p->jenis_program_reguler), 'staf'));
            } elseif ($category === 'mandor') {
                $filteredReg = $filteredReg->filter(fn($p) => str_contains($cleanStr($p->jenis_program_reguler), 'mandor'));
            }
            $currentBatches = $filteredReg->map(fn($item) => [
                'type' => 'reguler',
                'id' => $item->getKey(),
                'name' => trim((string) $item->Training_Program),
                'clean_name' => trim((string) preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $item->Training_Program)),
                'batch' => 1,
                'target' => (int) $item->target_peserta,
                'region' => trim((string) $item->Region),
                'location' => $item->Lokasi_training ?: '-',
                'start' => $item->Mulai_program,
                'end' => $item->Selesai_program,
                'sub_category' => $item->jenis_program_reguler ?: 'Reguler',
                'model' => $item,
            ]);
        } else {
            $filteredNon = $nonRegulerAll;
            if ($category === 'managerial' || strcasecmp($category, 'softskill') === 0) {
                $filteredNon = $filteredNon->filter(fn($p) => str_contains($cleanStr($p->kategori_pelatihan), 'managerial') || str_contains($cleanStr($p->sub_kategori), 'soft'));
            } elseif ($category === 'technical') {
                $filteredNon = $filteredNon->filter(fn($p) => str_contains($cleanStr($p->kategori_pelatihan), 'technical') && !str_contains($cleanStr($p->sub_kategori), 'soft'));
            } elseif ($category !== 'all' && $category !== '') {
                $searchCat = $cleanStr($category);
                $filteredNon = $filteredNon->filter(function($p) use ($searchCat, $cleanStr) {
                    return str_contains($cleanStr($p->sub_kategori), $searchCat)
                        || str_contains($cleanStr($p->kategori_pelatihan), $searchCat)
                        || str_contains($cleanStr($p->jenis_pelatihan), $searchCat);
                });
            }
            $currentBatches = $filteredNon->map(fn($item) => [
                'type' => 'non_reguler',
                'id' => $item->getKey(),
                'name' => trim((string) $item->jenis_pelatihan),
                'clean_name' => trim((string) preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $item->jenis_pelatihan)),
                'batch' => (int) ($item->TARGET_BATCH ?? $item->total_batch ?? 0),
                'target' => (int) ($item->TARGET_PESERTA ?? $item->target_total ?? 0),
                'region' => trim((string) $item->region),
                'location' => $item->lokasi_training ?: '-',
                'start' => $item->start_date,
                'end' => $item->end_date,
                'sub_category' => $item->sub_kategori ?: 'Technical',
                'model' => $item,
            ]);
        }

        // Filter currentBatches by Region keyword if selected
        if ($selectedRegion !== 'all' && $selectedRegion !== '') {
            $currentBatches = $currentBatches->filter(function($b) use ($selectedRegion) {
                return \App\Services\RegionHelper::matches($b['region'] ?? '', $selectedRegion);
            });
        }

        // Group by distinct Program Name
        $programGroups = $currentBatches->groupBy('name')->map(function ($items, $name) use ($trainingRecords, $tab, $year, $selectedMonthNum, $selectedRegion) {
            $first = $items->first();
            $related = $items->map(function ($batch) use ($trainingRecords, $tab, $year, $selectedMonthNum, $selectedRegion) {
                // Find actual records matching id or program name, filtered cumulatively (Jan s/d selected month)
                $matchedRecords = $trainingRecords->filter(function($r) use ($batch, $tab, $year, $selectedMonthNum, $selectedRegion) {
                    if ($r->program_type !== $tab) return false;

                    // Match Region keyword if specified
                    if ($selectedRegion !== 'all' && $selectedRegion !== '') {
                        $rReg = (string) ($r->region ?: '');
                        $bReg = (string) ($batch['region'] ?? '');
                        $rMatches = \App\Services\RegionHelper::matches($rReg, $selectedRegion);
                        $bMatches = \App\Services\RegionHelper::matches($bReg, $selectedRegion);

                        if ($rReg !== '' && !$rMatches && $bReg !== '' && !$bMatches) {
                            return false;
                        }
                        if ($rReg !== '' && !$rMatches && $bReg === '') {
                            return false;
                        }
                    }

                    // Match program
                    $matchesProgram = false;
                    if ($r->program_id && (int) $r->program_id === (int) $batch['id']) {
                        $matchesProgram = true;
                    } elseif ($tab === 'reguler') {
                        $notes = strtolower(trim((string) $r->notes));
                        $bName = strtolower(trim((string) $batch['clean_name']));
                        if ($bName !== '' && (str_contains($notes, $bName) || str_contains($bName, $notes))) {
                            $matchesProgram = true;
                        } elseif (str_contains(strtolower($batch['name']), 'carry over')) {
                            $bPrefix = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s+\d{4}.*$/', '', $bName));
                            $nPrefix = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s+\d{4}.*$/', '', $notes));
                            if ($bPrefix !== '' && $bPrefix === $nPrefix) {
                                $matchesProgram = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (!$matchesProgram) return false;

                    // Match Year
                    $rYear = null;
                    if (!empty($r->tahun)) {
                        $rYear = (int) $r->tahun;
                    } elseif (!empty($r->training_date)) {
                        $rYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($r->training_date));
                    } elseif (method_exists($r, 'activityDates')) {
                        $dates = $r->activityDates();
                        foreach ($dates as $d) {
                            if ($d) {
                                $rYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($d));
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    } elseif (!empty($r->created_at)) {
                        $rYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($r->created_at));
                    } else {
                        $rYear = 2026;
                    }

                    if ($rYear !== $year) {
                        return false;
                    }

                    // Match Month (Cumulative: Jan s/d selectedMonthNum)
                    if ($selectedMonthNum !== null) {
                        $mNum = null;
                        if ($r->bulan) {
                            $mNum = $this->parseMonthNumber($r->bulan);
                        }
                        if (!$mNum && $r->training_date) {
                            $mNum = (int) date('n', strtotime($r->training_date));
                        }
                        if (!$mNum) {
                            $dates = $r->activityDates();
                            foreach ($dates as $d) {
                                if ($d) {
                                    $mNum = (int) date('n', strtotime($d));
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        // Must be <= selectedMonthNum (Januari s/d Bulan Terpilih)
                        if ($mNum !== null) {
                            return $mNum <= $selectedMonthNum;
                        }

                        return true;
                    }

                    return true;
                });

                // For Reguler programs: distinct participants by identifier/name
                if ($tab === 'reguler') {
                    $uniqueRecords = $matchedRecords->unique(function($r) {
                        return strtolower(trim($r->participant_identifier ?: $r->participant_name ?: $r->id));
                    });
                    $actualParticipants = $uniqueRecords->count();
                } else {
                    $actualParticipants = $matchedRecords->count();
                }

                if ($tab === 'reguler') {
                    $realizedBatch = $actualParticipants > 0 ? 1 : 0;
                } else {
                    $explicitBatch = (int) ($batch['model']->realisasi_batch ?? $batch['model']->total_batch ?? 0);
                    $realizedBatch = $explicitBatch > 0 ? $explicitBatch : ($actualParticipants > 0 ? 1 : 0);
                }

                $periodStr = '- - -';
                if ($batch['start']) {
                    $periodStr = Carbon::parse($batch['start'])->format('d M Y');
                    if ($batch['end']) {
                        $periodStr .= ' – ' . Carbon::parse($batch['end'])->format('d M Y');
                    }
                }

                return array_merge($batch, [
                    'actual_participants' => $actualParticipants,
                    'realized_batch' => $realizedBatch,
                    'period' => $periodStr,
                ]);
            });

            $targetBatch = $items->sum('batch');
            $targetParticipants = $items->sum('target');
            $realizedBatch = $related->sum('realized_batch');
            $realizedParticipants = $related->sum('actual_participants');

            $isUnbudget = ($targetParticipants === 0 && $realizedParticipants > 0);
            $participantPercent = $targetParticipants > 0
                ? round(($realizedParticipants / $targetParticipants) * 100)
                : ($isUnbudget ? 100 : 0);
            $batchPercent = $targetBatch > 0
                ? round(($realizedBatch / $targetBatch) * 100)
                : ($realizedBatch > 0 ? 100 : 0);

            return [
                'name' => $name,
                'type' => $first['type'],
                'target_batch' => $targetBatch,
                'realized_batch' => $realizedBatch,
                'batch_percent' => $batchPercent,
                'target_participants' => $targetParticipants,
                'realized_participants' => $realizedParticipants,
                'participant_percent' => $participantPercent,
                'is_unbudget' => $isUnbudget,
                'batches' => $related->values(),
            ];
        })->values();

        // Sort Programs nicely
        if ($tab === 'reguler') {
            $order = ['FAT', 'MAT', 'TAT', 'DMT', 'AAT', 'PMT', 'PKT'];
            $programGroups = $programGroups->sort(function($a, $b) use ($order) {
                $prefixA = strtoupper(explode(' ', $a['name'])[0] ?? '');
                $prefixB = strtoupper(explode(' ', $b['name'])[0] ?? '');
                $idxA = array_search($prefixA, $order);
                $idxB = array_search($prefixB, $order);
                if ($idxA !== false && $idxB !== false) return $idxA - $idxB;
                if ($idxA !== false) return -1;
                if ($idxB !== false) return 1;
                return strcmp($a['name'], $b['name']);
            })->values();
        } else {
            $programGroups = $programGroups->sortBy('name')->values();
        }

        // List of all program names for the Button Filter
        $allProgramButtons = $programGroups->pluck('name')->values()->all();

        // If a specific program is selected, filter to that program; otherwise show all
        $activePrograms = $programGroups;
        $isSingleProgram = false;
        $singleProgramData = null;

        if ($selectedProgramName !== 'all' && $selectedProgramName !== '') {
            $found = $programGroups->first(fn($p) => strcasecmp($p['name'], $selectedProgramName) === 0);
            if ($found) {
                $activePrograms = collect([$found]);
                $isSingleProgram = true;
                $singleProgramData = $found;
            }
        }

        // 4. Calculate Aggregate Metrics for KPI Cards
        $totalTargetBatch = $activePrograms->sum('target_batch');
        $totalRealizedBatch = $activePrograms->sum('realized_batch');
        $batchPct = $totalTargetBatch > 0 ? round(($totalRealizedBatch / $totalTargetBatch) * 100) : ($totalRealizedBatch > 0 ? 100 : 0);

        $totalTargetPeserta = $activePrograms->sum('target_participants');
        $totalRealizedPeserta = $activePrograms->sum('realized_participants');
        $pesertaPct = $totalTargetPeserta > 0 ? round(($totalRealizedPeserta / $totalTargetPeserta) * 100) : ($totalRealizedPeserta > 0 ? 100 : 0);

        $kpi = [
            'target_batch' => $totalTargetBatch,
            'realized_batch' => $totalRealizedBatch,
            'batch_percentage' => $batchPct,
            'target_peserta' => $totalTargetPeserta,
            'realized_peserta' => $totalRealizedPeserta,
            'peserta_percentage' => $pesertaPct,
        ];

        // 5. Build Chart Data (Horizontal Bars: Target vs Realisasi Peserta)
        $chartLabels = [];
        $chartTargets = [];
        $chartRealizations = [];
        $chartPercentages = [];

        foreach ($activePrograms as $prog) {
            $chartLabels[] = $prog['name'];
            $chartTargets[] = $prog['target_participants'];
            $chartRealizations[] = $prog['realized_participants'];
            $chartPercentages[] = $prog['participant_percent'];
        }

        $chartData = [
            'labels' => $chartLabels,
            'targets' => $chartTargets,
            'realizations' => $chartRealizations,
            'percentages' => $chartPercentages,
        ];

        // Related Batches
        $relatedBatches = $activePrograms->flatMap(fn($p) => $p['batches'])->values();

        // Dynamic Title for Header Banner
        $monthLabel = $selectedMonthNum ? ' (JAN - ' . strtoupper(self::MONTH_3_LETTERS[$selectedMonthNum]) . ')' : '';
        $headerTitle = 'DASHBOARD PROGRESS PROGRAM ' . strtoupper($tab === 'reguler' ? 'REGULER' : 'NON REGULER') . $monthLabel . ' ' . $year;
        if ($isSingleProgram) {
            $headerTitle = 'DASHBOARD PROGRESS ' . strtoupper($singleProgramData['name']) . $monthLabel . ' ' . $year;
        } elseif ($category !== 'all') {
            $catLabel = match($category) {
                'staf' => 'REGULER - STAF',
                'mandor' => 'REGULER - MANDOR',
                'managerial' => 'MANAGERIAL & LEADERSHIP',
                'technical' => 'TECHNICAL',
                default => strtoupper($category)
            };
            $headerTitle = 'DASHBOARD PROGRESS PROGRAM ' . $catLabel . $monthLabel . ' ' . $year;
        }

        $monthList = self::MONTH_3_LETTERS;

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Dashboard.dashboard_monitoring_tahunan', compact(
            'years',
            'year',
            'tab',
            'category',
            'selectedProgramName',
            'selectedMonthNum',
            'selectedMonthCode',
            'monthList',
            'regions',
            'selectedRegion',
            'headerTitle',
            'regulerTotalCount',
            'regulerStafCount',
            'regulerMandorCount',
            'nonRegulerTotalCount',
            'nonRegulerManagerialCount',
            'nonRegulerTechnicalCount',
            'nonRegulerSubCategories',
            'subCategoryCounts',
            'allProgramButtons',
            'programGroups',
            'activePrograms',
            'kpi',
            'chartData',
            'isSingleProgram',
            'singleProgramData',
            'relatedBatches'
        ));
    }

    public function parseMonthNumber($value): ?int
    {
        if ($value === null || $value === '' || $value === 'all') return null;
        if (is_numeric($value)) {
            $num = (int) $value;
            return ($num >= 1 && $num <= 12) ? $num : null;
        }

        $upper = strtoupper(substr(trim((string) $value), 0, 3));
        $map = [
            'JAN' => 1, 'FEB' => 2, 'MAR' => 3, 'APR' => 4,
            'MEI' => 5, 'MAY' => 5, 'JUN' => 6, 'JUL' => 7,
            'AGU' => 8, 'AGS' => 8, 'AUG' => 8, 'SEP' => 9,
            'OKT' => 10, 'OCT' => 10, 'NOV' => 11, 'DES' => 12, 'DEC' => 12,
        ];
        return $map[$upper] ?? null;
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Program;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\Program\TrainingRecord;
use App\Models\Program\ProgramReguler;
use App\Models\Program\ProgramNonReguler;
use App\Models\Monitoring\MonitoringEmployee;
