class DashboardRealisasiController extends Controller
{
    public const MONTH_3_LETTERS = [
        1 => 'JAN', 2 => 'FEB', 3 => 'MAR', 4 => 'APR',
        5 => 'MEI', 6 => 'JUN', 7 => 'JUL', 8 => 'AGU',
        9 => 'SEP', 10 => 'OKT', 11 => 'NOV', 12 => 'DES',
    ];

    public function parseMonthNumber($value): ?int
    {
        if ($value === null || $value === '' || $value === 'all') return null;
        if (is_numeric($value)) {
            $num = (int) $value;
            return ($num >= 1 && $num <= 12) ? $num : null;
        }

        $upper = strtoupper(substr(trim((string) $value), 0, 3));
        $map = [
            'JAN' => 1, 'FEB' => 2, 'MAR' => 3, 'APR' => 4,
            'MEI' => 5, 'MAY' => 5, 'JUN' => 6, 'JUL' => 7,
            'AGU' => 8, 'AGS' => 8, 'AUG' => 8, 'SEP' => 9,
            'OKT' => 10, 'OCT' => 10, 'NOV' => 11, 'DES' => 12, 'DEC' => 12,
        ];
        return $map[$upper] ?? null;
    }

    public function extractYearFromField($val): ?int
    {
        if (empty($val)) return null;
        if ($val instanceof \DateTimeInterface) return (int) $val->format('Y');
        if (is_numeric($val) && (int)$val >= 2000 && (int)$val <= 2100) return (int) $val;
        if (is_array($val)) {
            foreach ($val as $item) {
                $y = $this->extractYearFromField($item);
                if ($y) return $y;
            }
            return null;
        }
        if (is_string($val)) {
            $trimmed = trim($val);
            if (str_starts_with($trimmed, '[') && str_ends_with($trimmed, ']')) {
                $decoded = json_decode($trimmed, true);
                if (is_array($decoded)) {
                    return $this->extractYearFromField($decoded);
                }
            }
            if (preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $trimmed, $m)) {
                return (int) $m[1];
            }
            $time = strtotime($trimmed);
            if ($time !== false && $time > 0) {
                return (int) date('Y', $time);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function resolveProgramRegulerYear($p): int
    {
        if ($p->Mulai_program && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->Mulai_program))) return $y;
        if (!empty($p->Training_Program) && preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $p->Training_Program, $m)) return (int) $m[1];
        if (!empty($p->tahun) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tahun))) return $y;
        if (!empty($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan))) return $y;
        if ($p->Selesai_program && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->Selesai_program))) return $y;
        if ($p->created_at && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->created_at))) return $y;
        return 2026;
    }

    public function resolveProgramNonRegulerYear($p): int
    {
        if ($p->start_date && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->start_date))) return $y;
        if (!empty($p->tahun) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tahun))) return $y;
        if (!empty($p->jenis_pelatihan) && preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $p->jenis_pelatihan, $m)) return (int) $m[1];
        if (!empty($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->tanggal_pelaksanaan))) return $y;
        if ($p->end_date && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->end_date))) return $y;
        if ($p->created_at && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($p->created_at))) return $y;
        return 2026;
    }

    protected function filterRegulerByYear($programs, int $year)
    {
        return $programs->filter(function($p) use ($year) {
            $mulaiYear = $p->Mulai_program ? $this->extractYearFromField($p->Mulai_program) : null;
            $selesaiYear = $p->Selesai_program ? $this->extractYearFromField($p->Selesai_program) : null;
            $titleYear = (!empty($p->Training_Program) && preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $p->Training_Program, $m)) ? (int) $m[1] : null;

            if ($year === 2026) {
                // Include programs from 2025 carry-over, 2026, and 2027 planned (like TAT I 2027, MAT I 2027)
                if ($p->Mulai_program) {
                    $mY = (int) date('Y', strtotime($p->Mulai_program));
                    if ($mY === 2026 || $mY === 2025) return true;
                }
                if ($titleYear === 2026 || $titleYear === 2025) return true;
                if (!empty($p->Training_Program) && (str_contains($p->Training_Program, 'TAT I 2027') || str_contains($p->Training_Program, 'MAT I 2027'))) {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            if ($titleYear === $year) return true;

            if ($mulaiYear && $selesaiYear) {
                if ($mulaiYear <= $year && $selesaiYear >= $year) {
                    return true;
                }
            } elseif ($mulaiYear) {
                if ($mulaiYear === $year) return true;
            } elseif ($selesaiYear) {
                if ($selesaiYear === $year) return true;
            }

            return $this->resolveProgramRegulerYear($p) === $year;
        });
    }

    protected function filterNonRegulerByYear($programs, int $year)
    {
        return $programs->filter(function($p) use ($year) {
            return $this->resolveProgramNonRegulerYear($p) === $year;
        });
    }

    protected function filterRecordsByYearAndCumulativeMonth($records, int $year, ?int $selectedMonthNum)
    {
        return $records->filter(function($r) use ($year, $selectedMonthNum) {
            // 1. Year filter
            $rYear = null;
            if (!empty($r->tahun)) {
                $rYear = (int) $r->tahun;
            } elseif (!empty($r->training_date)) {
                $rYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($r->training_date));
            } elseif (method_exists($r, 'activityDates')) {
                $dates = $r->activityDates();
                foreach ($dates as $d) {
                    if ($d) {
                        $rYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($d));
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } elseif (!empty($r->created_at)) {
                $rYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($r->created_at));
            } else {
                $rYear = 2026;
            }

            if ($rYear !== $year) {
                // Allow carry-over training records (from previous year) for reguler programs
                if (!($r->program_type === 'reguler' && $rYear === $year - 1)) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            // 2. Month cumulative filter
            if ($selectedMonthNum !== null) {
                $mNum = null;
                if ($r->bulan) {
                    $mNum = $this->parseMonthNumber($r->bulan);
                }
                if (!$mNum && $r->training_date) {
                    $mNum = (int) date('n', strtotime($r->training_date));
                }
                if (!$mNum && method_exists($r, 'activityDates')) {
                    $dates = $r->activityDates();
                    foreach ($dates as $d) {
                        if ($d) {
                            $mNum = (int) date('n', strtotime($d));
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if ($mNum !== null && $mNum > $selectedMonthNum) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            return true;
        });
    }

    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $trYears = TrainingRecord::whereNotNull('tahun')->pluck('tahun')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->filter()->all();
        $trDateYears = TrainingRecord::whereNotNull('training_date')->get()->map(fn($r) => (int) date('Y', strtotime($r->training_date)))->filter()->all();
        $regYears = ProgramReguler::all()->map(fn($p) => $this->resolveProgramRegulerYear($p))->filter()->all();
        $nonRegYears = ProgramNonReguler::all()->map(fn($p) => $this->resolveProgramNonRegulerYear($p))->filter()->all();

        $years = collect([2024, 2025, 2026, 2027])
            ->merge($trYears)
            ->merge($trDateYears)
            ->merge($regYears)
            ->merge($nonRegYears)
            ->filter(fn($y) => $y >= 2000 && $y <= 2100)
            ->unique()
            ->sort()
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $yearDefault = in_array(2026, $years, true) ? 2026 : ($years[count($years)-1] ?? (int)date('Y'));
        $year = (int) $request->input('year', $yearDefault);

        $rawMonth = $request->input('month', 'all');
        $selectedMonthNum = $this->parseMonthNumber($rawMonth);
        $selectedMonthCode = ($selectedMonthNum && isset(self::MONTH_3_LETTERS[$selectedMonthNum]))
            ? self::MONTH_3_LETTERS[$selectedMonthNum]
            : 'all';
        $monthList = self::MONTH_3_LETTERS;

        $rawRegion = trim((string) $request->input('region', 'all'));
        $region = ($rawRegion === '' || $rawRegion === 'Semua Region') ? 'all' : $rawRegion;
        $programType = trim((string) $request->input('program_type', 'all'));
        $selectedProgram = trim((string) $request->input('program', 'all'));
        $category = trim((string) $request->input('category', 'all'));
        $unit = trim((string) $request->input('unit', 'all'));
        $level = trim((string) $request->input('level', 'all'));

        // Collect distinct available regions from databases
        $regulerRegions = ProgramReguler::distinct()->pluck('Region')->filter()->map(fn($r) => trim((string)$r));
        $nonRegulerRegions = ProgramNonReguler::distinct()->pluck('region')->filter()->map(fn($r) => trim((string)$r));
        $recordRegions = TrainingRecord::distinct()->pluck('region')->filter()->map(fn($r) => trim((string)$r));

        $allRegions = $regulerRegions->merge($nonRegulerRegions)->merge($recordRegions)
            ->map(function($r) {
                if (strcasecmp($r, 'riau') === 0) return 'Riau';
                if (strcasecmp($r, 'kalbar') === 0) return 'Kalbar';
                if (strcasecmp($r, 'kaltim') === 0 || strcasecmp($r, 'kaltim fr') === 0) return 'Kaltim FR';
                if (strcasecmp($r, 'corporate') === 0) return 'Corporate';
                return $r;
            })
            ->unique()
            ->values()
            ->all();

        // Program Options & Category Options for Dropdown Filter
        $regulerProgramOptions = ProgramReguler::pluck('Training_Program')
            ->toBase()
            ->map(function($p) {
                return trim((string) preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $p));
            })->filter()->unique()->values();

        $nonRegulerProgramOptions = ProgramNonReguler::pluck('jenis_pelatihan')
            ->toBase()
            ->map(function($p) {
                return trim((string) preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $p));
            })->filter()->unique()->values();

        $nonRegulerCategoryOptions = ProgramNonReguler::pluck('kategori_pelatihan')
            ->concat(ProgramNonReguler::pluck('sub_kategori'))
            ->filter()
            ->map(fn($c) => trim((string)$c))
            ->unique()
            ->values()
            ->all();

        if ($programType === 'reguler') {
            $availablePrograms = $regulerProgramOptions;
        } elseif ($programType === 'non_reguler') {
            $availablePrograms = $nonRegulerProgramOptions;
        } else {
            $availablePrograms = $regulerProgramOptions->concat($nonRegulerProgramOptions)->unique()->values();
        }

        // Base Queries with Filters
        $trainingRecordQuery = TrainingRecord::query();
        if ($region !== 'all') {
            $searchRegion = $region;
            if (strcasecmp($region, 'Kaltim FR') === 0) {
                $trainingRecordQuery->where(function($q) {
                    $q->where('region', 'LIKE', '%kaltim%')
                      ->orWhere('region', 'LIKE', '%Kaltim FR%');
                });
            } else {
                $trainingRecordQuery->where('region', 'LIKE', '%' . $searchRegion . '%');
            }
        }
        if ($level !== 'all' && $level !== '') {
            $trainingRecordQuery->where('level', 'LIKE', '%' . $level . '%');
        }

        // 1. Progress MT Per Program Tables (Separated into Staf & Mandor)
        $cleanStr = fn($str) => SpreadsheetReader::cleanString($str);

        $normalizeName = function(?string $name): string {
            if (!$name) return '';
            $clean = strtolower(trim($name));
            $clean = preg_replace('/[.\-_,]/', ' ', $clean);
            $clean = preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $clean);
            $clean = str_replace('deofinka', 'df', $clean);
            return trim($clean);
        };

        $normalizeAngkatan = function(string $name): string {
            $str = strtoupper(trim(preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $name)));
            $str = str_replace(
                ['FIELD ASSISTANT', 'ESTATE CADET TRAINEE', 'ESTATE CADET', 'MILL ASSISTANT', 'ADMIN ASSISTANT', 'PROCESSING', 'PABRIK'],
                ['FAT', 'ECT', 'ECT', 'MAT', 'AAT', 'PMT', 'PMT'],
                $str
            );
            $str = preg_replace('/[^A-Z0-9]/', ' ', $str);
            $parts = array_values(array_filter(explode(' ', $str)));
            return implode('-', $parts);
        };

        $allEmployees = MonitoringEmployee::all();
        $allCulled = MonitoringCulled::all();
        $allAngkatans = MonitoringAngkatan::all();
        $allTrainingRecords = (clone $trainingRecordQuery)->where(function($q) {
            $q->where('program_type', 'reguler')
              ->orWhere('notes', 'LIKE', 'FAT%')
              ->orWhere('notes', 'LIKE', 'MAT%')
              ->orWhere('notes', 'LIKE', 'TAT%')
              ->orWhere('notes', 'LIKE', 'AAT%')
              ->orWhere('notes', 'LIKE', 'DMT%')
              ->orWhere('notes', 'LIKE', 'ECT%')
              ->orWhere('notes', 'LIKE', 'PMT%')
              ->orWhere('notes', 'LIKE', 'PKT%');
        })->get();
        $allTrainingRecords = $this->filterRecordsByYearAndCumulativeMonth($allTrainingRecords, $year, $selectedMonthNum);

        $regulerProgramsQuery = ProgramReguler::query();
        if ($region !== 'all') {
            if (strcasecmp($region, 'Kaltim FR') === 0) {
                $regulerProgramsQuery->where(function($q) {
                    $q->where('Region', 'LIKE', '%kaltim%')
                      ->orWhere('Region', 'LIKE', '%Kaltim FR%');
                });
            } else {
                $regulerProgramsQuery->where('Region', 'LIKE', '%' . $region . '%');
            }
        }
        $regulerPrograms = $regulerProgramsQuery->get();
        $regulerPrograms = $this->filterRegulerByYear($regulerPrograms, $year);

        if ($programType === 'non_reguler') {
            $regulerPrograms = collect();
        } else {
            if ($category === 'staf') {
                $regulerPrograms = $regulerPrograms->filter(function($p) use ($cleanStr) {
                    $pName = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $p->Training_Program));
                    $isMandor = str_contains($cleanStr($p->jenis_program_reguler), 'mandor') || str_starts_with(strtoupper($pName), 'PMT') || str_starts_with(strtoupper($pName), 'PKT');
                    return !$isMandor;
                });
            } elseif ($category === 'mandor') {
                $regulerPrograms = $regulerPrograms->filter(function($p) use ($cleanStr) {
                    $pName = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $p->Training_Program));
                    $isMandor = str_contains($cleanStr($p->jenis_program_reguler), 'mandor') || str_starts_with(strtoupper($pName), 'PMT') || str_starts_with(strtoupper($pName), 'PKT');
                    return $isMandor;
                });
            }

            if ($selectedProgram !== 'all' && $selectedProgram !== '') {
                $regulerPrograms = $regulerPrograms->filter(function($p) use ($selectedProgram, $cleanStr) {
                    $pName = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $p->Training_Program));
                    return strcasecmp($pName, $selectedProgram) === 0 || str_contains($cleanStr($pName), $cleanStr($selectedProgram));
                });
            }
        }

        $mtStafTable = [];
        $stafRencana = 0;
        $stafKelas = 0;
        $stafResign = 0;
        $stafLulus = 0;

        $mtMandorTable = [];
        $mandorRencana = 0;
        $mandorKelas = 0;
        $mandorResign = 0;
        $mandorLulus = 0;

        foreach ($regulerPrograms as $p) {
            $pName = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $p->Training_Program));
            $normPName = $normalizeAngkatan($pName);

            // Matching helper strictly for this program batch
            $isMatch = function(string $rawCandidate) use ($normPName, $normalizeAngkatan) {
                if (trim($rawCandidate) === '') return false;
                $candidate = $normalizeAngkatan($rawCandidate);
                if ($candidate === $normPName) return true;

                // Special case for AAT II 2025 (Carry Over) which has records labeled AAT II 2026
                if (str_starts_with($normPName, 'AAT-II') && str_starts_with($candidate, 'AAT-II')) {
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            };

            // 1. Matched Training Records (Unique participant names)
            $trNames = $allTrainingRecords->filter(fn($r) => $isMatch((string)$r->notes))
                ->pluck('participant_name')
                ->map($normalizeName)
                ->filter()
                ->unique();

            // 2. Matched Employees (Unique participant names)
            $empNames = $allEmployees->filter(fn($e) => $isMatch((string)$e->angkatan_fr_academy))
                ->pluck('nama')
                ->map($normalizeName)
                ->filter()
                ->unique();

            // 3. Matched Culled (Unique names)
            $culledNames = $allCulled->filter(function($c) use ($allAngkatans, $isMatch) {
                $ang = $allAngkatans->firstWhere('id_angkatan', $c->id_angkatan);
                return $ang && $isMatch((string) $ang->angkatan);
            })->pluck('nama')->map($normalizeName)->filter()->unique();

            // 4. Combined in-class participants (Unique across TR, Employees, Culled)
            $allInClass = $trNames->concat($empNames)->concat($culledNames)->unique()->values();
            $kelas = $allInClass->count();

            // 5. Resigned participants (Deduplicated)
            $matchingEmps = $allEmployees->filter(fn($e) => $isMatch((string)$e->angkatan_fr_academy));
            $resignedEmpNames = $matchingEmps->filter(function($e) {
                $stat = strtoupper(trim($e->status ?: $e->kategori ?: ''));
                return in_array($stat, ['RESIGN', 'TERMINATE']) || !empty($e->date_terminate) || !empty($e->alasan_resign);
            })->pluck('nama')->map($normalizeName)->filter()->unique();

            $allResigned = $resignedEmpNames->concat($culledNames)->unique()->values();
            $resign = $allResigned->count();

            $rencana = (int) ($p->TARGET_PESERTA ?? $p->target_peserta ?? 0);
            $lulus = max(0, $kelas - $resign);

            $isMandor = str_contains($cleanStr($p->jenis_program_reguler), 'mandor') || str_starts_with(strtoupper($pName), 'PMT') || str_starts_with(strtoupper($pName), 'PKT');

            $rowItem = [
                'name' => $pName,
                'region' => $p->Region ?: 'Nasional',
                'rencana' => $rencana,
                'kelas' => $kelas,
                'resign' => $resign,
                'lulus' => $lulus,
            ];

            if ($isMandor) {
                $mandorRencana += $rencana;
                $mandorKelas += $kelas;
                $mandorResign += $resign;
                $mandorLulus += $lulus;
                $mtMandorTable[] = $rowItem;
            } else {
                $stafRencana += $rencana;
                $stafKelas += $kelas;
                $stafResign += $resign;
                $stafLulus += $lulus;
                $mtStafTable[] = $rowItem;
            }
        }

        $mtStafSummary = [
            'peserta' => $stafKelas,
            'rencana' => $stafRencana,
            'resign' => $stafResign,
            'lulus' => $stafLulus,
        ];

        $mtMandorSummary = [
            'peserta' => $mandorKelas,
            'rencana' => $mandorRencana,
            'resign' => $mandorResign,
            'lulus' => $mandorLulus,
        ];

        // Combined MT summary for backwards compatibility
        $mtProgramTable = array_merge($mtStafTable, $mtMandorTable);
        $mtSummary = [
            'peserta' => $stafKelas + $mandorKelas,
            'rencana' => $stafRencana + $mandorRencana,
            'resign' => $stafResign + $mandorResign,
            'lulus' => $stafLulus + $mandorLulus,
        ];

        // 1. Progres Reguler Staff (Management Trainee) KPI Card - Excludes Mandor
        // Kalkulasi persentase = (jumlah peserta di kelas / target rencana) * 100
        $now = Carbon::now();
        $regulerStaffPrograms = $regulerPrograms->filter(function($p) use ($cleanStr) {
            $pName = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $p->Training_Program));
            $isMandor = str_contains($cleanStr($p->jenis_program_reguler), 'mandor') || str_starts_with(strtoupper($pName), 'PMT') || str_starts_with(strtoupper($pName), 'PKT');
            return !$isMandor;
        });

        $regulerBerjalan = $regulerStaffPrograms->filter(function($p) use ($now) {
            if (!$p->Mulai_program) return true;
            return $p->Mulai_program <= $now && ($p->Selesai_program >= $now || !$p->Selesai_program);
        })->count();

        $regulerSelesai = $regulerStaffPrograms->filter(function($p) use ($now) {
            if (!$p->Selesai_program) return false;
            return $p->Selesai_program < $now;
        })->count();

        $regulerPercentage = $stafRencana > 0 ? round(($stafKelas / $stafRencana) * 100) : 0;

        $regulerMt = [
            'percentage' => $regulerPercentage,
            'target' => 100,
            'jumlah_peserta' => $stafKelas,
            'target_peserta' => $stafRencana,
            'program_berjalan' => $regulerBerjalan,
            'program_selesai' => $regulerSelesai,
        ];

        // 2. Progres Talent Program (Dari Database Monitoring Talent)
        $talentQuery = MonitoringTalent::query();
        if ($region !== 'all') {
            $searchReg = str_replace([' FR', ' fr'], '', $region);
            $talentQuery->where('region', 'LIKE', "%{$searchReg}%");
        }

        $totalTalent = $talentQuery->count();
        $sudahPenugasan = (clone $talentQuery)->where(function($sub) {
            $sub->where('status', 'LIKE', '%sudah penugasan%')
                ->orWhere('status', 'LIKE', '%confirm%');
        })->count();
        $akanPenugasan = (clone $talentQuery)->where('status', 'LIKE', '%akan penugasan%')->count();
        $belumPenugasan = (clone $talentQuery)->where('status', 'LIKE', '%belum penugasan%')->count();

        $talentPercentage = (float) AppSetting::get('talent_program_progress_materi', 83);

        $talentToBreakdown = (clone $talentQuery)->select('talent_to', DB::raw('count(*) as total'))
            ->whereNotNull('talent_to')
            ->where('talent_to', '!=', '')
            ->groupBy('talent_to')
            ->orderByDesc('total')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn($item) => [
                'role' => $item->talent_to,
                'count' => (int) $item->total,
            ])
            ->all();

        $talentProgram = [
            'percentage' => $talentPercentage,
            'target' => 100,
            'jumlah_talent' => $totalTalent,
            'sudah_penugasan' => $sudahPenugasan,
            'akan_penugasan' => $akanPenugasan,
            'belum_penugasan' => $belumPenugasan,
            'breakdown' => $talentToBreakdown,
        ];

        // 3 & 4. Soft Skill & Teknikal
        $nonRegulerProgramsQuery = ProgramNonReguler::query();
        if ($region !== 'all') {
            if (strcasecmp($region, 'Kaltim FR') === 0) {
                $nonRegulerProgramsQuery->where(function($q) {
                    $q->where('region', 'LIKE', '%kaltim%')
                      ->orWhere('region', 'LIKE', '%Kaltim FR%');
                });
            } else {
                $nonRegulerProgramsQuery->where('region', 'LIKE', '%' . $region . '%');
            }
        }
        $regulerPrefixes = ['FAT', 'MAT', 'TAT', 'AAT', 'DMT', 'ECT', 'PMT', 'PKT'];
        $nonRegulerPrograms = $nonRegulerProgramsQuery->get();
        $nonRegulerPrograms = $this->filterNonRegulerByYear($nonRegulerPrograms, $year)->filter(function($p) use ($regulerPrefixes) {
            $name = strtoupper(trim($p->jenis_pelatihan));
            foreach ($regulerPrefixes as $prefix) {
                if (str_starts_with($name, $prefix)) return false;
            }
            return true;
        });

        $trNonReg = (clone $trainingRecordQuery)->where('program_type', 'non_reguler')->get();
        $trNonReg = $this->filterRecordsByYearAndCumulativeMonth($trNonReg, $year, $selectedMonthNum)->filter(function($r) use ($regulerPrefixes) {
            $notes = strtoupper(trim((string)$r->notes));
            foreach ($regulerPrefixes as $prefix) {
                if (str_starts_with($notes, $prefix)) return false;
            }
            return true;
        });

        if ($programType === 'reguler') {
            $nonRegulerPrograms = collect();
        } else {
            if ($category === 'managerial' || strcasecmp($category, 'Managerial and Leadership') === 0 || strcasecmp($category, 'Softskill') === 0) {
                $nonRegulerPrograms = $nonRegulerPrograms->filter(fn($p) => $p->isSoftSkill() || str_contains($cleanStr($p->kategori_pelatihan), 'managerial') || str_contains($cleanStr($p->sub_kategori), 'soft'));
            } elseif ($category === 'technical' || strcasecmp($category, 'Technical') === 0) {
                $nonRegulerPrograms = $nonRegulerPrograms->filter(fn($p) => !$p->isSoftSkill() || str_contains($cleanStr($p->kategori_pelatihan), 'technical'));
            } elseif ($category !== 'all' && $category !== '') {
                $searchCat = $cleanStr($category);
                $nonRegulerPrograms = $nonRegulerPrograms->filter(function($p) use ($searchCat, $cleanStr) {
                    return str_contains($cleanStr($p->sub_kategori), $searchCat)
                        || str_contains($cleanStr($p->kategori_pelatihan), $searchCat)
                        || str_contains($cleanStr($p->jenis_pelatihan), $searchCat);
                });
            }

            if ($selectedProgram !== 'all' && $selectedProgram !== '') {
                $nonRegulerPrograms = $nonRegulerPrograms->filter(function($p) use ($selectedProgram, $cleanStr) {
                    $pName = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $p->jenis_pelatihan));
                    return strcasecmp($pName, $selectedProgram) === 0 || str_contains($cleanStr($pName), $cleanStr($selectedProgram));
                });
            }
        }

        $softPrograms = [];
        $tekPrograms = [];

        foreach ($nonRegulerPrograms as $p) {
            if ($p->isSoftSkill()) {
                $softPrograms[] = $p;
            } else {
                $tekPrograms[] = $p;
            }
        }

        $calcMetrics = function($progList) use ($trNonReg, $year) {
            $targPeserta = 0;
            $targBatch = 0;
            $realPeserta = 0;
            $realBatch = 0;

            foreach ($progList as $p) {
                $pId = $p->getKey();
                $targPeserta += (int) ($p->TARGET_PESERTA ?? $p->target_total ?? 0);
                $targBatch += (int) ($p->TARGET_BATCH ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0);
                // Count all training records regardless of year
                $pRecords = $trNonReg->where('program_id', $pId);

                $count = $pRecords->count();
                $realPeserta += $count;
                $explicitBatch = (int) ($p->realisasi_batch ?? $p->total_batch ?? 0);
                if ($explicitBatch > 0) {
                    $realBatch += $explicitBatch;
                } elseif ($count > 0) {
                    $realBatch += 1;
                }
            }

            $pct = $targPeserta > 0 ? round(($realPeserta / $targPeserta) * 100) : 0;

            return [
                'percentage' => $pct,
                'target' => 100,
                'peserta_realisasi' => $realPeserta,
                'peserta_target' => $targPeserta,
                'batch_realisasi' => $realBatch,
                'batch_target' => $targBatch,
                'total_program' => count($progList),
            ];
        };

        $softSkill = $calcMetrics($softPrograms);
        $teknikal = $calcMetrics($tekPrograms);

        // 6. Monthly Chart Data (Jan - Des) - Real-time Per Bulan from TrainingRecord
        $months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Agu', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des'];
        $monthMap = ['JAN' => 1, 'FEB' => 2, 'MAR' => 3, 'APR' => 4, 'MEI' => 5, 'MAY' => 5, 'JUN' => 6, 'JUL' => 7, 'AGU' => 8, 'AGS' => 8, 'AUG' => 8, 'SEP' => 9, 'OKT' => 10, 'OCT' => 10, 'NOV' => 11, 'DES' => 12, 'DEC' => 12];

        $allYearRecords = $this->filterRecordsByYearAndCumulativeMonth((clone $trainingRecordQuery)->get(), $year, null);

        $monthlyPesertaMap = array_fill(1, 12, 0);
        $monthlyProgramSets = array_fill(1, 12, []);

        foreach ($allYearRecords as $r) {
            $mCode = strtoupper(substr(trim((string) $r->bulan), 0, 3));
            $mNum = $monthMap[$mCode] ?? null;
            if (!$mNum && $r->training_date) {
                $mNum = (int) date('n', strtotime($r->training_date));
            }
            if ($mNum && isset($monthlyPesertaMap[$mNum])) {
                $monthlyPesertaMap[$mNum]++;
                $monthlyProgramSets[$mNum][$r->program_type . ':' . $r->program_id] = true;
            }
        }

        $monthlyPeserta = [];
        $monthlyProgram = [];
        for ($m = 1; $m <= 12; $m++) {
            $monthlyPeserta[] = $monthlyPesertaMap[$m];
            $monthlyProgram[] = count($monthlyProgramSets[$m]);
        }

        $monthlyData = [
            'labels' => $months,
            'peserta' => $monthlyPeserta,
            'program' => $monthlyProgram,
            'total_peserta_ytd' => array_sum($monthlyPeserta),
            'total_program_ytd' => array_sum($monthlyProgram),
        ];

        // 7. Evaluasi Pelatihan
        $evaluasi = [
            'average_score' => 4.43,
            'max_score' => 5.00,
            'ratings' => [
                ['stars' => '5. Sangat Baik', 'percent' => 58, 'color' => 'bg-[#1b4332]'],
                ['stars' => '4. Baik', 'percent' => 32, 'color' => 'bg-[#2d5a27]'],
                ['stars' => '3. Cukup', 'percent' => 7, 'color' => 'bg-amber-500'],
                ['stars' => '2. Kurang', 'percent' => 2, 'color' => 'bg-orange-500'],
                ['stars' => '1. Sangat Kurang', 'percent' => 1, 'color' => 'bg-rose-500'],
            ],
            'footer' => [
                'rata_rata' => '4.43 / 5.00',
                'responden' => '3.248 org',
                'pelatihan' => '129 prg',
                'respon_rate' => '92%',
            ]
        ];

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Dashboard.dashboard_realisasi', compact(
            'regulerMt',
            'talentProgram',
            'softSkill',
            'teknikal',
            'mtProgramTable',
            'mtSummary',
            'mtStafTable',
            'mtStafSummary',
            'mtMandorTable',
            'mtMandorSummary',
            'monthlyData',
            'evaluasi',
            'years',
            'year',
            'monthList',
            'selectedMonthCode',
            'selectedMonthNum',
            'region',
            'allRegions',
            'programType',
            'selectedProgram',
            'category',
            'availablePrograms',
            'regulerProgramOptions',
            'nonRegulerProgramOptions',
            'nonRegulerCategoryOptions',
            'unit',
            'level'
        ));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Program;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Program\ProgramNonReguler;
use App\Models\Program\ProgramReguler;
use App\Models\Program\RealisasiVsBatch;
use App\Models\Program\TrainingRecord;
use App\Services\SpreadsheetReader;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class ProgramBatchController extends Controller
{
    public function programIndex(Request $request)
    {
        $yearInput = $request->input('year');
        $year = ($yearInput !== null && $yearInput !== '' && $yearInput !== 'all') ? (int) $yearInput : null;
        $type = $request->input('type', 'all');
        $search = strtolower(trim((string) $request->input('search')));
        $region = strtolower(trim((string) $request->input('region')));
        $groups = $this->programGroups($year, $type, $region)->filter(function ($group) use ($search) {
            if ($search !== '' && !str_contains(strtolower($group['search_text']), $search)) return false;
            return true;
        })->values();
        $regions = $this->programGroups(null, 'all')->pluck('region')->filter()->unique()->sort()->values();
        $availableYears = $this->allProgramYears();
        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Program.program', compact('groups', 'year', 'type', 'search', 'region', 'regions', 'availableYears'));
    }

    public function programShow(Request $request, string $type, string $name)
    {
        $yearInput = $request->input('year');
        $year = ($yearInput !== null && $yearInput !== '' && $yearInput !== 'all') ? (int) $yearInput : null;
        $group = $this->programGroups($year, $type, trim((string) $request->input('region', '')))->first(fn ($item) => $item['name'] === $name);
        abort_unless($group, 404);
        $availableYears = $this->allProgramYears();
        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Program.program_detail', ['group' => $group, 'year' => $year, 'availableYears' => $availableYears]);
    }

    public function index()
    {
        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Program.program_batch');
    }

    public function data()
    {
        $records = TrainingRecord::where('status', 'valid')->get()->groupBy(fn ($record) => $record->program_type . ':' . $record->program_id);

        $nonReguler = ProgramNonReguler::query()->latest('start_date')->get()->map(fn ($item) => $this->normalizeNonReguler($item, $records->get('non_reguler:' . $item->id_nonreguler, collect())));
        $reguler = ProgramReguler::query()->latest('Mulai_program')->get()->map(fn ($item) => $this->normalizeReguler($item, $records->get('reguler:' . $item->Program_reguler_id, collect())));

        return response()->json($nonReguler->concat($reguler)->values());
    }

    private function programGroups(?int $year, string $type, string $region = '')
    {
        $cleanStr = fn($str) => strtolower(trim(preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/', '', (string) $str)));
        $isSoft = function($item) use ($cleanStr) {
            $kat = $cleanStr(($item->kategori_pelatihan ?? '') . ' ' . ($item->sub_kategori ?? '') . ' ' . ($item->jenis_pelatihan ?? ''));
            return str_contains($kat, 'managerial') || str_contains($kat, 'leadership') || str_contains($kat, 'soft');
        };

        $batches = collect();

        // 1. Non Reguler Programs
        if ($type !== 'reguler') {
            $nonRegQuery = ProgramNonReguler::all();
            if (in_array($type, ['non_reguler_soft_skill', 'soft_skill'], true)) {
                $nonRegQuery = $nonRegQuery->filter($isSoft);
            } elseif (in_array($type, ['non_reguler_teknikal', 'teknikal'], true)) {
                $nonRegQuery = $nonRegQuery->reject($isSoft);
            }

            $batches = $batches->concat($nonRegQuery->map(function ($item) use ($isSoft) {
                $soft = $isSoft($item);
                return [
                    'type' => 'non_reguler',
                    'sub_type' => $soft ? 'soft_skill' : 'teknikal',
                    'type_label' => $soft ? 'Non Reguler - Soft Skill' : 'Non Reguler - Teknikal',
                    'id' => $item->getKey(),
                    'name' => trim((string) $item->jenis_pelatihan),
                    'batch' => (int) ($item->TARGET_BATCH ?? $item->total_batch ?? 0),
                    'target' => (int) ($item->TARGET_PESERTA ?? $item->target_total ?? 0),
                    'region' => trim((string) $item->region),
                    'location' => $item->lokasi_training,
                    'start' => $item->start_date,
                    'end' => $item->end_date,
                    'model' => $item
                ];
            }));
        }

        // 2. Reguler Programs
        if (in_array($type, ['all', 'reguler'], true)) {
            $batches = $batches->concat(ProgramReguler::all()->map(fn ($item) => [
                'type' => 'reguler',
                'sub_type' => 'reguler',
                'type_label' => 'Reguler',
                'id' => $item->getKey(),
                'name' => trim((string) $item->Training_Program),
                'batch' => 1,
                'target' => $item->target_peserta,
                'region' => trim((string) $item->Region),
                'location' => $item->Lokasi_training,
                'start' => $item->Mulai_program,
                'end' => $item->Selesai_program,
                'model' => $item
            ]));
        }

        if ($region !== '') $batches = $batches->filter(fn ($batch) => $this->normalizeRegion($batch['region']) === $this->normalizeRegion($region));
        $batches = $batches->filter(fn ($batch) => $this->batchInYear($batch, $year));
        $records = TrainingRecord::where('status', 'valid')->get()->groupBy(fn ($record) => $record->program_type . ':' . $record->program_id);

        return $batches->groupBy(fn ($batch) => $batch['type'] . ':' . $batch['name'])->map(function ($items) use ($records, $year) {
            $first = $items->first();
            $related = $items->map(function ($batch) use ($records, $year) {
                $key = $batch['type'] . ':' . $batch['id'];
                $actualRecords = $records->get($key, collect())->filter(fn ($record) => $this->recordInYear($record, $year));
                $actualParticipants = $actualRecords->count();
                if ($batch['type'] === 'reguler') {
                    $realizedBatch = $actualRecords->isNotEmpty() ? 1 : 0;
                } else {
                    $explicitBatch = (int) ($batch['model']->realisasi_batch ?? $batch['model']->total_batch ?? 0);
                    $realizedBatch = $explicitBatch > 0 ? $explicitBatch : ($actualRecords->isNotEmpty() ? 1 : 0);
                }
                return $batch + ['actual_participants' => $actualParticipants, 'realized_batch' => $realizedBatch, 'period' => $this->period($batch)];
            });
            $targetBatch = $items->sum('batch');
            $targetParticipants = $items->sum('target');
            $realizedBatch = $related->sum('realized_batch');
            $realizedParticipants = $related->sum('actual_participants');
            $regions = $items->pluck('region')->filter()->map(fn ($value) => trim((string) $value))->unique()->values()->all();
            $searchText = $items->flatMap(fn ($item) => [$item['name'], $item['region'], $item['location'], $item['model']->Batch ?? null])->filter()->implode(' ');
            return [
                'key' => $first['type'] . '|' . $first['name'],
                'type' => $first['type'],
                'sub_type' => $first['sub_type'] ?? 'reguler',
                'type_label' => $first['type_label'] ?? ($first['type'] === 'reguler' ? 'Reguler' : 'Non Reguler'),
                'name' => $first['name'],
                'region' => $regions[0] ?? '',
                'regions' => $regions,
                'search_text' => $searchText,
                'total_batch' => $targetBatch,
                'target_participants' => $targetParticipants,
                'realized_batch' => $realizedBatch,
                'realized_participants' => $realizedParticipants,
                'batch_percent' => $this->percent($realizedBatch, $targetBatch),
                'participant_percent' => $this->percent($realizedParticipants, $targetParticipants),
                'batches' => $related->values()
            ];
        })->values();
    }

    private function extractYearFromField($val): ?int
    {
        if (empty($val)) return null;
        if ($val instanceof \DateTimeInterface) return (int) $val->format('Y');
        if (is_numeric($val) && (int)$val >= 2000 && (int)$val <= 2100) return (int) $val;
        if (is_array($val)) {
            foreach ($val as $item) {
                if ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($item)) return $y;
            }
            return null;
        }
        if (is_string($val)) {
            $trimmed = trim($val);
            if (str_starts_with($trimmed, '[') && str_ends_with($trimmed, ']')) {
                if ($decoded = json_decode($trimmed, true)) {
                    if ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($decoded)) return $y;
                }
            }
            if (preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $trimmed, $m)) return (int) $m[1];
            if (($time = strtotime($trimmed)) !== false && $time > 0) return (int) date('Y', $time);
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function getBatchYear(array $batch): ?int
    {
        $model = $batch['model'] ?? null;
        if ($batch['type'] === 'reguler') {
            if (!empty($batch['start'])) return (int) date('Y', strtotime($batch['start']));
            if ($model && !empty($model->tahun)) return (int) $model->tahun;
            if ($model && !empty($model->tanggal_pelaksanaan) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($model->tanggal_pelaksanaan))) return $y;
            if (!empty($batch['end'])) return (int) date('Y', strtotime($batch['end']));
        } else {
            if ($model && !empty($model->tahun)) return (int) $model->tahun;
            if (!empty($batch['start'])) return (int) date('Y', strtotime($batch['start']));
            if ($model && !empty($model->tanggal_pelaksanaan) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($model->tanggal_pelaksanaan))) return $y;
            if (!empty($batch['end'])) return (int) date('Y', strtotime($batch['end']));
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function batchInYear(array $batch, ?int $year): bool
    {
        if ($year === null) return true;
        $bYear = $this->getBatchYear($batch);
        if ($bYear !== null) return $bYear === $year;
        return collect([$batch['start'], $batch['end']])->contains(fn ($date) => $date && (int) date('Y', strtotime($date)) === $year);
    }

    private function recordInYear(TrainingRecord $record, ?int $year): bool
    {
        if ($year === null) return true;
        return collect($record->activityDates())->contains(fn ($date) => $date && (int) date('Y', strtotime($date)) === $year);
    }

    private function batchMonths(array $batch): array
    {
        return collect([$batch['start'], $batch['end']])->filter()->map(fn ($date) => (int) date('n', strtotime($date)))->unique()->values()->all();
    }

    private function period(array $batch): string
    {
        return ($batch['start'] ? date('d M Y', strtotime($batch['start'])) : '-') . ' - ' . ($batch['end'] ? date('d M Y', strtotime($batch['end'])) : '-');
    }

    public function allProgramYears(): array
    {
        $regYears = ProgramReguler::all()->map(function ($item) {
            if ($item->Mulai_program) return (int) $item->Mulai_program->format('Y');
            if ($item->tahun) return (int) $item->tahun;
            if (!empty($item->tanggal_pelaksanaan) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($item->tanggal_pelaksanaan))) return $y;
            if ($item->Selesai_program) return (int) $item->Selesai_program->format('Y');
            return null;
        });

        $nonRegYears = ProgramNonReguler::all()->map(function ($item) {
            if ($item->tahun) return (int) $item->tahun;
            if ($item->start_date) return (int) $item->start_date->format('Y');
            if (!empty($item->tanggal_pelaksanaan) && ($y = $this->extractYearFromField($item->tanggal_pelaksanaan))) return $y;
            if ($item->end_date) return (int) $item->end_date->format('Y');
            return null;
        });

        return collect($regYears->all())
            ->merge($nonRegYears->all())
            ->merge([(int) date('Y')])
            ->filter()
            ->map(fn ($v) => (int) $v)
            ->unique()
            ->sortDesc()
            ->values()
            ->all();
    }

    private function percent(int $value, int $total): float
    {
        return $total > 0 ? round($value / $total * 100, 2) : 0;
    }

    private function normalizeRegion($value): string
    {
        return strtolower(trim(str_replace(' fr', '', (string) $value)));
    }

    public function store(Request $request, string $type)
    {
        abort_unless(in_array($type, ['reguler', 'non_reguler'], true), 404);
        $model = $type === 'reguler' ? new ProgramReguler() : new ProgramNonReguler();
        $model->newQuery()->create($this->preparePayload($request->all(), $type));
        return response()->json(['message' => 'Data berhasil disimpan.'], 201);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, string $type, int $id)
    {
        abort_unless(in_array($type, ['reguler', 'non_reguler'], true), 404);
        $model = $type === 'reguler' ? new ProgramReguler() : new ProgramNonReguler();
        $model->newQuery()->findOrFail($id)->update($this->preparePayload($request->all(), $type));
        return response()->json(['message' => 'Data berhasil diperbarui.']);
    }

    public function destroy(string $type, int $id)
    {
        abort_unless(in_array($type, ['reguler', 'non_reguler'], true), 404);
        $model = $type === 'reguler' ? new ProgramReguler() : new ProgramNonReguler();
        $model->newQuery()->findOrFail($id)->delete();
        return response()->json(['message' => 'Data berhasil dihapus.']);
    }

    public function destroyAll(Request $request)
    {
        $type = $request->input('type'); // 'reguler', 'non_reguler', or null/all
        if ($type === 'reguler') {
            ProgramReguler::truncate();
            ActivityLog::log('Hapus', 'Program Batch', "Menghapus seluruh data Program Reguler");
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Seluruh data Program Reguler berhasil dihapus.']);
        } elseif ($type === 'non_reguler') {
            ProgramNonReguler::truncate();
            ActivityLog::log('Hapus', 'Program Batch', "Menghapus seluruh data Program Non Reguler");
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Seluruh data Program Non Reguler berhasil dihapus.']);
        } else {
            ProgramReguler::truncate();
            ProgramNonReguler::truncate();
            ActivityLog::log('Hapus', 'Program Batch', "Menghapus seluruh data Program Batch (Reguler & Non Reguler)");
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Seluruh data Program Batch (Reguler & Non Reguler) berhasil dihapus.']);
        }
    }

    public function import(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate(['file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt,xlsx|max:20480']);
        $file = $request->file('file');
        $rows = SpreadsheetReader::read($file->getRealPath(), $file->getClientOriginalExtension());
        if (count($rows) < 2) {
            if ($request->wantsJson() || $request->ajax() || $request->isJson()) {
                return response()->json(['message' => 'File tidak memiliki data.'], 422);
            }
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'File tidak memiliki data.']);
        }

        $rawHeaders = array_shift($rows);
        $cleanHeader = fn ($str) => SpreadsheetReader::cleanString($str);
        $normalizedHeaders = array_map($cleanHeader, $rawHeaders);

        // Detect if non-reguler or reguler
        $isNonReg = false;
        $isReg = false;

        foreach ($normalizedHeaders as $h) {
            $clean = str_replace(['_', ' ', '-'], '', $h);
            if (in_array($clean, ['jenispelatihan', 'idnonreguler', 'pesertaast', 'pesertanonstaf', 'typetraining', 'tdtotal'])) {
                $isNonReg = true;
            }
            if (in_array($clean, ['trainingprogram', 'namaprogramreguler', 'programregulerid', 'freshgraduate', 'promosimandor', 'jenisprogramreguler', 'jumlahbulantraining', 'totaltrainingdays', 'uangsaku'])) {
                $isReg = true;
            }
        }

        $table = null;
        if ($isReg) $table = 'reg';
        elseif ($isNonReg) $table = 'non';
        else {
            // Fallback check
            if (in_array('jenis_pelatihan', $rawHeaders, true)) $table = 'non';
            elseif (in_array('Training_Program', $rawHeaders, true) || in_array('Nama_Program_reguler', $rawHeaders, true)) $table = 'reg';
        }

        if (!$table) {
            if ($request->wantsJson() || $request->ajax() || $request->isJson()) {
                return response()->json(['message' => 'Header tidak dikenali. Gunakan template batch non-reguler atau reguler.'], 422);
            }
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Header tidak dikenali. Gunakan template batch non-reguler atau reguler.']);
        }

        $imported = 0;
        $seenRegIds = [];
        $seenNonRegIds = [];
        DB::transaction(function () use ($rows, $normalizedHeaders, $table, &$imported, &$seenRegIds, &$seenNonRegIds) {
            foreach ($rows as $row) {
                if (empty(array_filter($row, fn ($val) => trim((string) $val) !== ''))) continue;
                $item = [];
                foreach ($normalizedHeaders as $idx => $h) {
                    $clean = str_replace(['_', ' ', '-'], '', $h);
                    $item[$clean] = trim((string) ($row[$idx] ?? ''));
                }
                $stored = $this->storeRowMapped($item, $table, $seenRegIds, $seenNonRegIds);
                if ($stored) $imported++;
            }
        });

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Program Batch',
            "Mengimport {$imported} data program batch dari file " . $file->getClientOriginalName(),
            ['filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(), 'count' => $imported]
        );

        $message = "{$imported} data program batch berhasil diimpor.";
        if ($request->wantsJson() || $request->ajax() || $request->isJson()) {
            return response()->json(['message' => $message, 'count' => $imported], 200);
        }

        return back()->with('success', $message);
    }

    private function storeRowMapped(array $item, string $table, array &$seenRegIds = [], array &$seenNonRegIds = []): bool
    {
        if ($table === 'reg') {
            $trainingProgram = $item['trainingprogram'] ?? $item['namaprogramreguler'] ?? $item['namaprogram'] ?? $item['pelatihan'] ?? $item['namapelatihan'] ?? '';
            if ($trainingProgram === '') return false;

            $record = [
                'Kategori_Program' => !empty($item['kategoriprogram']) ? $item['kategoriprogram'] : (!empty($item['kategori']) ? $item['kategori'] : 'REGULER'),
                'Training_Program' => $trainingProgram,
                'Batch' => $item['batch'] ?? $item['angkatan'] ?? null,
                'Lokasi_training' => $item['lokasitraining'] ?? $item['lokasi'] ?? null,
                'Mulai_program' => $this->dateValue($item['mulaiprogram'] ?? $item['startdate'] ?? $item['tglmulai'] ?? null),
                'Selesai_program' => $this->dateValue($item['selesaiprogram'] ?? $item['enddate'] ?? $item['tglselesai'] ?? null),
                'jumlah_bulan_training' => is_numeric($item['jumlahbulantraining'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['jumlahbulantraining'] : (is_numeric($item['durasi'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['durasi'] : 0),
                'jumlah_hari' => is_numeric($item['jumlahhari'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['jumlahhari'] : 0,
                'Total_training_days' => is_numeric($item['totaltrainingdays'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['totaltrainingdays'] : (is_numeric($item['totalhari'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['totalhari'] : 0),
                'Promosi_mandor' => is_numeric($item['promosimandor'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['promosimandor'] : 0,
                'Fresh_Graduate' => is_numeric($item['freshgraduate'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['freshgraduate'] : 0,
                'target_peserta' => is_numeric($item['targetpeserta'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['targetpeserta'] : (is_numeric($item['totalorang'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['totalorang'] : 0),
                'Uang_saku' => is_numeric($item['uangsaku'] ?? null) ? (float) $item['uangsaku'] : 0,
                'jenis_program_reguler' => $item['jenisprogramreguler'] ?? $item['subkategori'] ?? null,
                'Region' => $item['region'] ?? $item['wilayah'] ?? null,
                'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => $this->jsonValue($item['tanggalpelaksanaan'] ?? null),
                'tahun' => is_numeric($item['tahun'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['tahun'] : null,
            ];

            // Normalize nulls/empty strings
            $record = array_map(fn ($v) => is_array($v) ? $v : ($v === '' || strtolower(trim((string) $v)) === 'null' ? null : $v), $record);

            $id = $item['programregulerid'] ?? $item['programid'] ?? $item['id'] ?? null;
            if (is_numeric($id) && (int) $id > 0) {
                $intId = (int) $id;
                if (!in_array($intId, $seenRegIds, true)) {
                    $seenRegIds[] = $intId;
                    $record['Program_reguler_id'] = $intId;
                    ProgramReguler::query()->updateOrCreate(['Program_reguler_id' => $intId], $record);
                } else {
                    ProgramReguler::query()->create($record);
                }
            } else {
                ProgramReguler::query()->create($record);
            }
            return true;
        } else {
            $jenisPelatihan = $item['jenispelatihan'] ?? $item['namapelatihan'] ?? $item['pelatihan'] ?? $item['trainingprogram'] ?? '';
            if ($jenisPelatihan === '') return false;

            $record = [
                'kategori_pelatihan' => $item['kategoripelatihan'] ?? $item['kategoriprogram'] ?? $item['kategori'] ?? null,
                'jenis_pelatihan' => $jenisPelatihan,
                'region' => $item['region'] ?? $item['wilayah'] ?? null,
                'trainer' => $item['trainer'] ?? $item['instruktur'] ?? null,
                'type_training' => $item['typetraining'] ?? $item['metode'] ?? null,
                'total_jam' => is_numeric($item['totaljam'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['totaljam'] : 0,
                'total_hari' => is_numeric($item['totalhari'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['totalhari'] : 0,
                'peserta_non_staf' => is_numeric($item['pesertanonstaf'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['pesertanonstaf'] : 0,
                'peserta_ast' => is_numeric($item['pesertaast'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['pesertaast'] : 0,
                'peserta_askep' => is_numeric($item['pesertaaskep'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['pesertaaskep'] : 0,
                'peserta_mgr' => is_numeric($item['pesertamgr'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['pesertamgr'] : 0,
                'peserta_gm' => is_numeric($item['pesertagm'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['pesertagm'] : 0,
                'peserta_head' => is_numeric($item['pesertahead'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['pesertahead'] : 0,
                'target_staf' => is_numeric($item['targetstaf'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['targetstaf'] : 0,
                'target_non_staf' => is_numeric($item['targetnonstaf'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['targetnonstaf'] : 0,
                'target_total' => is_numeric($item['targettotal'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['targettotal'] : 0,
                'training_staf' => is_numeric($item['trainingstaf'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['trainingstaf'] : 0,
                'training_non_staf' => is_numeric($item['trainingnonstaf'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['trainingnonstaf'] : 0,
                'training_total' => is_numeric($item['trainingtotal'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['trainingtotal'] : 0,
                'td_staf' => is_numeric($item['tdstaf'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['tdstaf'] : 0,
                'td_non_staf' => is_numeric($item['tdnonstaf'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['tdnonstaf'] : 0,
                'td_total' => is_numeric($item['tdtotal'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['tdtotal'] : 0,
                'start_date' => $this->dateValue($item['startdate'] ?? $item['mulaiprogram'] ?? $item['tglmulai'] ?? null),
                'end_date' => $this->dateValue($item['enddate'] ?? $item['selesaiprogram'] ?? $item['tglselesai'] ?? null),
                'realisasi_batch' => is_numeric($item['realisasibatch'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['realisasibatch'] : (is_numeric($item['batch'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['batch'] : (is_numeric($item['totalbatch'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['totalbatch'] : 0)),
                'lokasi_training' => $item['lokasitraining'] ?? $item['lokasi'] ?? null,
                'deskripsi' => $item['deskripsi'] ?? $item['keterangan'] ?? null,
                'sub_kategori' => $item['subkategori'] ?? null,
                'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => $this->jsonValue($item['tanggalpelaksanaan'] ?? null),
                'TARGET_BATCH' => is_numeric($item['targetbatch'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['targetbatch'] : 0,
                'TARGET_PESERTA' => is_numeric($item['targetpeserta'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['targetpeserta'] : 0,
                'tahun' => is_numeric($item['tahun'] ?? null) ? (int) $item['tahun'] : null,
            ];

            // Normalize nulls/empty strings
            $record = array_map(fn ($v) => is_array($v) ? $v : ($v === '' || strtolower(trim((string) $v)) === 'null' ? null : $v), $record);

            $id = $item['idnonreguler'] ?? $item['programid'] ?? $item['id'] ?? null;
            if (is_numeric($id) && (int) $id > 0) {
                $intId = (int) $id;
                if (!in_array($intId, $seenNonRegIds, true)) {
                    $seenNonRegIds[] = $intId;
                    $record['id_nonreguler'] = $intId;
                    ProgramNonReguler::query()->updateOrCreate(['id_nonreguler' => $intId], $record);
                } else {
                    ProgramNonReguler::query()->create($record);
                }
            } else {
                ProgramNonReguler::query()->create($record);
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    private function preparePayload(array $payload, string $type): array
    {
        if ($type === 'reguler') {
            if (array_key_exists('Nama_Program_reguler', $payload) && !empty($payload['Nama_Program_reguler'])) {
                $payload['Training_Program'] = $payload['Nama_Program_reguler'];
            }
            if (array_key_exists('Total_orang', $payload)) {
                $payload['target_peserta'] = $payload['Total_orang'];
            }
        } else {
            if (array_key_exists('total_batch', $payload) && !array_key_exists('realisasi_batch', $payload)) {
                $payload['realisasi_batch'] = $payload['total_batch'];
            }
        }

        $dateFields = $type === 'reguler' ? ['Mulai_program', 'Selesai_program'] : ['start_date', 'end_date'];
        foreach ($dateFields as $field) $payload[$field] = $this->dateValue($payload[$field] ?? null);
        if (array_key_exists('tanggal_pelaksanaan', $payload)) $payload['tanggal_pelaksanaan'] = $this->jsonValue($payload['tanggal_pelaksanaan']);

        $numericFields = $type === 'reguler'
            ? ['jumlah_bulan_training', 'jumlah_hari', 'Total_training_days', 'Promosi_mandor', 'Fresh_Graduate', 'target_peserta', 'tahun']
            : ['total_jam', 'total_hari', 'peserta_non_staf', 'peserta_ast', 'peserta_askep', 'peserta_mgr', 'peserta_gm', 'peserta_head', 'target_staf', 'target_non_staf', 'target_total', 'training_staf', 'training_non_staf', 'training_total', 'td_staf', 'td_non_staf', 'td_total', 'realisasi_batch', 'total_batch', 'TARGET_BATCH', 'TARGET_PESERTA', 'tahun'];
        foreach ($numericFields as $field) if (array_key_exists($field, $payload)) $payload[$field] = is_numeric($payload[$field]) ? (int) $payload[$field] : null;
        if ($type === 'reguler' && array_key_exists('Uang_saku', $payload)) $payload['Uang_saku'] = is_numeric($payload['Uang_saku']) ? (float) $payload['Uang_saku'] : 0;

        $allowedColumns = $type === 'reguler'
            ? ['Kategori_Program', 'Training_Program', 'Batch', 'Lokasi_training', 'Mulai_program', 'Selesai_program', 'jumlah_bulan_training', 'jumlah_hari', 'Total_training_days', 'Promosi_mandor', 'Fresh_Graduate', 'target_peserta', 'Uang_saku', 'jenis_program_reguler', 'Region', 'tanggal_pelaksanaan', 'tahun']
            : ['kategori_pelatihan', 'jenis_pelatihan', 'region', 'trainer', 'type_training', 'total_jam', 'total_hari', 'peserta_non_staf', 'peserta_ast', 'peserta_askep', 'peserta_mgr', 'peserta_gm', 'peserta_head', 'target_staf', 'target_non_staf', 'target_total', 'training_staf', 'training_non_staf', 'training_total', 'td_staf', 'td_non_staf', 'td_total', 'start_date', 'end_date', 'realisasi_batch', 'total_batch', 'lokasi_training', 'deskripsi', 'sub_kategori', 'tanggal_pelaksanaan', 'TARGET_BATCH', 'TARGET_PESERTA', 'tahun'];

        return array_filter($payload, fn ($value, $key) => in_array($key, $allowedColumns, true), ARRAY_FILTER_USE_BOTH);
    }

    private function normalizeNonReguler(ProgramNonReguler $item, $actualRecords = null): array
    {
        $actualRecords = $actualRecords ?? collect();
        $orig = $item->toArray();

        // 1. Hitung berdasarkan Jabatan (Position)
        $orig['peserta_ast'] = $actualRecords->filter(fn($r) => str_contains(strtolower($r->position), 'asisten') && !str_contains(strtolower($r->position), 'kepala'))->count();
        $orig['peserta_askep'] = $actualRecords->filter(fn($r) => str_contains(strtolower($r->position), 'askep') || (str_contains(strtolower($r->position), 'asisten') && str_contains(strtolower($r->position), 'kepala')))->count();
        $orig['peserta_mgr'] = $actualRecords->filter(fn($r) => str_contains(strtolower($r->position), 'manager') && !str_contains(strtolower($r->position), 'general'))->count();
        $orig['peserta_gm'] = $actualRecords->filter(fn($r) => str_contains(strtolower($r->position), 'general manager') || str_contains(strtolower($r->position), 'gm'))->count();
        $orig['peserta_head'] = $actualRecords->filter(fn($r) => str_contains(strtolower($r->position), 'head'))->count();

        // 2. Hitung berdasarkan Golongan (Staf vs Non-Staf)
        $orig['training_staf'] = $actualRecords->filter(fn($r) => strtolower(trim($r->gol)) === 'staf')->count();
        $orig['training_non_staf'] = $actualRecords->filter(fn($r) => strtolower(trim($r->gol)) !== 'staf')->count();
        $orig['training_total'] = $actualRecords->count();

        // 3. Hitung Training Days (TD)
        $totalDays = (int) $item->total_hari;
        $orig['td_staf'] = $orig['training_staf'] * $totalDays;
        $orig['td_non_staf'] = $orig['training_non_staf'] * $totalDays;
        $orig['td_total'] = $orig['training_total'] * $totalDays;

        $batchCount = (int) ($item->TARGET_BATCH ?? $item->total_batch ?? 0);
        $participants = (int) ($item->TARGET_PESERTA ?? $item->target_total ?? 0);
        $year = $item->tahun ?: ($item->start_date ? (int)$item->start_date->format('Y') : ($item->end_date ? (int)$item->end_date->format('Y') : null));
        return [
            'id' => 'non-reg-' . $item->id_nonreguler,
            'title' => $item->jenis_pelatihan,
            'start' => $item->start_date,
            'end' => $item->end_date,
            'tahun' => $year,
            'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => $item->tanggal_pelaksanaan ?: array_values(array_filter([$item->start_date?->format('Y-m-d'), $item->end_date?->format('Y-m-d')])),
            'type' => 'Non-Reguler',
            'location' => $item->lokasi_training,
            'region' => $item->region,
            'subCategory' => $item->sub_kategori ?: '-',
            'batchCount' => $batchCount,
            'participants' => $participants,
            'trainer' => $item->trainer,
            'originalData' => $orig
        ];
    }

    private function normalizeReguler(ProgramReguler $item, $actualRecords = null): array
    {
        $actualRecords = $actualRecords ?? collect();
        $orig = $item->toArray();

        // 1. Hitung berdasarkan Golongan
        $orig['training_staf'] = $actualRecords->filter(fn($r) => strtolower(trim($r->gol)) === 'staf')->count();
        $orig['training_non_staf'] = $actualRecords->filter(fn($r) => strtolower(trim($r->gol)) !== 'staf')->count();
        $orig['training_total'] = $actualRecords->count();

        // 2. Hitung Training Days (TD)
        $totalDays = (int) ($item->jumlah_hari ?? $item->Total_training_days ?? 0);
        $orig['td_staf'] = $orig['training_staf'] * $totalDays;
        $orig['td_non_staf'] = $orig['training_non_staf'] * $totalDays;
        $orig['td_total'] = $orig['training_total'] * $totalDays;

        $orig['Nama_Program_reguler'] = $item->Training_Program;
        $orig['Total_orang'] = $item->target_peserta;
        $year = $item->Mulai_program ? (int)$item->Mulai_program->format('Y') : ($item->tahun ?: ($item->Selesai_program ? (int)$item->Selesai_program->format('Y') : null));
        return [
            'id' => 'reg-' . $item->Program_reguler_id,
            'title' => $item->Training_Program,
            'start' => $item->Mulai_program,
            'end' => $item->Selesai_program,
            'tahun' => $year,
            'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => $item->tanggal_pelaksanaan ?: array_values(array_filter([$item->Mulai_program?->format('Y-m-d'), $item->Selesai_program?->format('Y-m-d')])),
            'type' => 'Reguler',
            'location' => $item->Lokasi_training,
            'region' => $item->Region,
            'subCategory' => $item->jenis_program_reguler ?: '-',
            'batchCount' => 1,
            'participants' => $item->target_peserta,
            'trainer' => 'Internal',
            'originalData' => $orig
        ];
    }

    private function dateValue($value): ?string
    {
        return SpreadsheetReader::parseDate($value);
    }

    private function jsonValue($value): ?array
    {
        if (is_array($value)) return $value;
        if ($value === null || trim((string) $value) === '' || trim((string) $value) === 'null') return null;
        $decoded = json_decode((string) $value, true);
        return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : null;
    }
}

<?php

    public function index(Request $request)

' - ' . $item->region]))->values();
