    public function import(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate(['file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt,xlsx|max:20480']);
        $rows = SpreadsheetReader::read($request->file('file')->getRealPath(), $request->file('file')->getClientOriginalExtension());
        if (count($rows) < 2) return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'File tidak memiliki data.']);
        $headers = array_map(function ($value) {
            return trim((string) $value, " \t\r\n\xEF\xBB\xBF");
        }, array_shift($rows));
        $type = in_array('id_nonreguler', $headers, true) ? 'non_reguler' : (in_array('Program_id', $headers, true) ? 'reguler' : null);
        if (!$type || !in_array('bulan', $headers, true)) return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Header Realisasi tidak dikenali.']);

        $imported = 0;
        $skipped = 0;
        DB::transaction(function () use ($rows, $headers, $type, &$imported, &$skipped) {
            foreach ($rows as $row) {
                if (!is_array($row) || count(array_filter($row, fn ($value) => trim((string) $value) !== '')) === 0) continue;
                $values = array_pad($row, count($headers), null);
                $item = array_combine($headers, array_slice($values, 0, count($headers)));
                $idValue = $item[$type === 'non_reguler' ? 'id_nonreguler' : 'Program_id'] ?? null;
                $id = is_numeric($idValue) ? (int) $idValue : 0;
                $month = $this->monthNumber($item['bulan'] ?? null);
                if (!$id || !$month) {
                    $skipped++;
                    continue;
                }
                $yearValue = $item['tahun'] ?? date('Y');
                $year = is_numeric($yearValue) ? (int) $yearValue : (int) date('Y');
                RealisasiVsBatch::updateOrCreate(
                    ['program_type' => $type, 'program_id' => $id, 'tahun' => $year, 'bulan' => $month],
                    ['legacy_realized_batch' => $this->number($item['REALISASI_BATCH'] ?? null), 'legacy_realized_participants' => $this->number($item['REALISASI_PESERTA'] ?? null)]
                );
                $imported++;
            }
        });

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Realisasi Vs Target',
            "Mengimport {$imported} data realisasi vs target dari file " . $request->file('file')->getClientOriginalName(),
            ['filename' => $request->file('file')->getClientOriginalName(), 'count' => $imported, 'skipped' => $skipped]
        );

        return back()->with('success', "{$imported} data realisasi berhasil disimpan" . ($skipped ? ". {$skipped} baris dilewati karena ID atau bulan tidak valid" : '') . '. Nilai akan digantikan otomatis saat Training Record tersedia.');
    }

    public function export(Request $request)
    {
        $year = (int) $request->input('year', date('Y'));
        $rawMonth = $request->input('month');
        $month = $this->monthNumber($rawMonth) ?? (int) date('n');
        $type = $request->input('type', 'all');
        $region = trim((string) $request->input('region', ''));
        $rows = $this->buildRows($year, $month, $type, $region);

        $headers = ['Realisasi ID', 'Batch ID', 'Tipe', 'Region', 'Bulan', 'Planned Batch', 'Realisasi Batch', '% Batch', 'Planned Peserta', 'Realisasi Peserta', '% Peserta'];
        $dataRows = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $dataRows[] = [
                $row->realisasi_id,
                $row->batch_id,
                $row->program_type,
                $row->region,
                self::MONTH_3_LETTERS[$month],
                $row->planned_batch,
                $row->realized_batch,
                $row->batch_percent,
                $row->planned_participants,
                $row->realized_participants,
                $row->participant_percent
            ];
        }

        $filename = 'realisasi_vs_batch_' . $year . '_' . self::MONTH_3_LETTERS[$month] . '.xlsx';
        return ExcelExporter::download($filename, $headers, $dataRows, 'Realisasi Vs Batch');
    }

    private function buildRows(int $year, int $month, string $type, string $region = '')
    {
        $programs = collect();
        if ($type !== 'reguler') $programs = $programs->concat(ProgramNonReguler::all()->map(fn ($program) => $this->programData($program, 'non_reguler', $year, $month)));
        if ($type !== 'non_reguler') $programs = $programs->concat(ProgramReguler::all()->map(fn ($program) => $this->programData($program, 'reguler', $year, $month)));
        $programs = $programs->filter(fn ($program) => $program !== null);
        if ($region !== '') $programs = $programs->filter(fn ($program) => strtolower(trim((string) $program['region'])) === strtolower($region));
        $trainingRecords = TrainingRecord::where('status', 'valid')->get();

        return $programs->map(function ($program) use ($year, $month, $trainingRecords) {
            $matchingRecords = $trainingRecords
                ->filter(fn (TrainingRecord $record) => $this->recordMatchesActivity($record, $program))
                ->filter(function (TrainingRecord $record) use ($program, $year, $month) {
                    if ($program['program_type'] === 'non_reguler' && !$this->recordMatchesRegion($record, $program['region'])) {
                        return false;
                    }

                    // Check if TrainingRecord has explicit bulan (3 letters) or tahun
                    if ($record->bulan || $record->tahun) {
                        if ($record->tahun && (int) $record->tahun !== $year) {
                            $isCarryOver = str_contains(strtolower($program['program_name'] ?? ''), 'carry over');
                            if (!($isCarryOver && ((int) $record->tahun === $year - 1 || (int) $record->tahun === $year))) {
                                return false;
                            }
                        }
                        if ($record->bulan) {
                            $recMonth = $this->monthNumber($record->bulan);
                            return $recMonth !== null && $recMonth <= $month;
                        }
                    }

                    return collect($record->activityDates())->contains(fn ($date) =>
                        $date && (int) date('Y', strtotime($date)) === $year && (int) date('n', strtotime($date)) <= $month
                    );
                });

            $realizedParticipants = $matchingRecords->count();
            if ($program['program_type'] === 'reguler') {
                $realizedBatch = $realizedParticipants > 0 ? 1 : 0;
            } else {
                $explicitBatch = (int) ($program['realisasi_batch'] ?? $program['total_batch'] ?? 0);
                $realizedBatch = $explicitBatch > 0 ? $explicitBatch : ($realizedParticipants > 0 ? 1 : 0);
            }

            $row = (object) array_merge($program, ['realisasi_id' => null, 'realized_batch' => $realizedBatch, 'realized_participants' => $realizedParticipants]);
            $row->batch_percent = $this->percent($row->realized_batch, $row->planned_batch);
            $row->participant_percent = $this->percent($row->realized_participants, $row->planned_participants);
            return $row;
        })->values();
    }

    public function updateBatch(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'program_type' => 'required|in:non_reguler',
            'program_id' => 'required|integer',
            'realisasi_batch' => 'required|integer|min:0',
        ]);

        $id = $request->input('program_id');
        $val = (int) $request->input('realisasi_batch');

        $program = ProgramNonReguler::findOrFail($id);
        $program->update(['realisasi_batch' => $val]);
        ActivityLog::log('Edit', 'Realisasi Vs Target', "Mengubah realisasi batch program non-reguler '{$program->jenis_pelatihan}' menjadi {$val}");

        return response()->json(['message' => 'Realisasi batch berhasil diperbarui.', 'realisasi_batch' => $val]);
    }

    private function programData($program, string $type, int $year, int $month): ?array
    {
        $programYear = null;
        if ($type === 'reguler') {
            if ($program->Mulai_program) {
                $programYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($program->Mulai_program));
            } elseif ($program->tahun) {
                $programYear = (int) $program->tahun;
            } elseif ($program->Selesai_program) {
                $programYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($program->Selesai_program));
            }
        } else {
            if ($program->tahun) {
                $programYear = (int) $program->tahun;
            } elseif ($program->start_date) {
                $programYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($program->start_date));
            } elseif ($program->end_date) {
                $programYear = (int) date('Y', strtotime($program->end_date));
            }
        }

        if ($programYear !== null && $programYear !== $year) {
            return null;
        }

        $dates = $program->tanggal_pelaksanaan ?: [];
        if (!$dates) $dates = $type === 'reguler' ? [$program->Mulai_program, $program->Selesai_program] : [$program->start_date, $program->end_date];

        $hasMonthDates = collect($dates)->filter()->isNotEmpty();
        if ($hasMonthDates) {
            $inMonth = collect($dates)->contains(fn ($date) => $date && (int) date('n', strtotime($date)) <= $month);
            if (!$inMonth && $type === 'reguler') {
                return null;
            }
        }

        return [
            'program_type' => $type,
            'program_id' => $program->getKey(),
            'batch_id' => $program->getKey(),
            'program_name' => $type === 'reguler' ? $program->Training_Program : $program->jenis_pelatihan,
            'region' => $type === 'reguler' ? $program->Region : $program->region,
            'planned_batch' => $type === 'reguler' ? 1 : (int) ($program->TARGET_BATCH ?? $program->realisasi_batch ?? $program->total_batch ?? 0),
            'realisasi_batch' => $type === 'reguler' ? (int) ($program->Batch ?? 1) : (int) ($program->realisasi_batch ?? $program->total_batch ?? 0),
            'planned_participants' => $type === 'reguler' ? (int) $program->target_peserta : (int) ($program->TARGET_PESERTA ?? $program->target_total ?? 0)
        ];
    }

    public function availableYears(): array
    {
        $regYears = ProgramReguler::all()->map(function ($item) {
            if ($item->Mulai_program) return (int) $item->Mulai_program->format('Y');
            if ($item->tahun) return (int) $item->tahun;
            if ($item->Selesai_program) return (int) $item->Selesai_program->format('Y');
            return null;
        });

        $nonRegYears = ProgramNonReguler::all()->map(function ($item) {
            if ($item->tahun) return (int) $item->tahun;
            if ($item->start_date) return (int) $item->start_date->format('Y');
            if ($item->end_date) return (int) $item->end_date->format('Y');
            return null;
        });

        $rvbYears = RealisasiVsBatch::pluck('tahun')->map(fn ($v) => (int) $v);
        $trYears = TrainingRecord::pluck('tahun')->filter()->map(fn ($v) => (int) $v);

        return collect($regYears->all())
            ->merge($nonRegYears->all())
            ->merge($rvbYears->all())
            ->merge($trYears->all())
            ->merge([(int) date('Y')])
            ->filter()->map(fn ($v) => (int) $v)->unique()->sortDesc()->values()->all();
    }

    private function recordMatchesActivity(TrainingRecord $record, array $program): bool
    {
        if ($record->program_type === $program['program_type'] && (int) $record->program_id === (int) $program['program_id']) {
            return true;
        }

        $recordName = strtolower(trim((string) $record->activityName()));
        $programName = strtolower(trim((string) ($program['program_name'] ?? '')));
        if ($recordName === '' || $programName === '') return false;

        if ($recordName === $programName
            || str_starts_with($recordName, $programName)
            || str_starts_with($programName, $recordName)) {
            return true;
        }

        $cleanRecord = preg_replace('/[^\w\s]/u', ' ', $recordName);
        $cleanProgram = preg_replace('/[^\w\s]/u', ' ', $programName);

        $recordWords = array_values(array_filter(explode(' ', $cleanRecord)));
        $programWords = array_values(array_filter(explode(' ', $cleanProgram)));

        if (empty($recordWords) || empty($programWords)) return false;

        // If program is 1 word (e.g. "Supervisory", "Damkarhutlabun")
        if (count($programWords) === 1) {
            return in_array($programWords[0], $recordWords, true) || str_contains($cleanRecord, $programWords[0]);
        }

        // If program is 2 or more words
        if (count($recordWords) >= 2) {
            if ($recordWords[0] === $programWords[0] && $recordWords[1] === $programWords[1]) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        $firstTwoProgramWords = implode(' ', array_slice($programWords, 0, 2));
        if (str_contains($cleanRecord, $firstTwoProgramWords)) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function recordMatchesRegion(TrainingRecord $record, ?string $programRegion): bool
    {
        $programRegion = strtolower(trim((string) $programRegion));
        if ($programRegion === '') return true;

        return $this->normalizeRegion($record->region) === $this->normalizeRegion($programRegion);
    }

    private function normalizeRegion($value): string
    {
        return strtolower(trim(str_replace(' fr', '', (string) $value)));
    }

    private function percent(int $value, int $total): float { return $total > 0 ? round($value / $total * 100, 2) : 0; }
    private function number($value): int { return is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 0; }
    public function monthNumber($value): ?int
    {
        if ($value === null || $value === '') return null;
        if (is_numeric($value)) return max(1, min(12, (int) $value));

        $upper = strtoupper(substr(trim((string) $value), 0, 3));
        $aliasMap = [
            'JAN' => 1, 'FEB' => 2, 'MAR' => 3, 'APR' => 4,
            'MEI' => 5, 'MAY' => 5,
            'JUN' => 6, 'JUL' => 7,
            'AGU' => 8, 'AGS' => 8, 'AUG' => 8,
            'SEP' => 9,
            'OKT' => 10, 'OCT' => 10,
            'NOV' => 11, 'DES' => 12, 'DEC' => 12,
        ];
        if (isset($aliasMap[$upper])) {
            return $aliasMap[$upper];
        }

        $lower = strtolower(trim((string) $value));
        foreach (self::MONTHS as $number => $name) {
            if ($lower === strtolower($name) || $lower === strtolower(substr($name, 0, 3))) {
                return $number;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Program;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Program\ProgramNonReguler;
use App\Models\Program\ProgramReguler;
use App\Models\Program\TrainingRecord;
use App\Services\SpreadsheetReader;
use App\Services\ExcelExporter;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class TrainingRecordController extends Controller
{
    private static ?\Illuminate\Support\Collection $cachedActivities = null;

    private const MONTHS = [1 => 'Jan', 2 => 'Feb', 3 => 'Mar', 4 => 'Apr', 5 => 'Mei', 6 => 'Jun', 7 => 'Jul', 8 => 'Agu', 9 => 'Sep', 10 => 'Okt', 11 => 'Nov', 12 => 'Des'];

    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $rawYear = $request->input('year', 'all');
        $year = ($rawYear === 'all' || $rawYear === '' || $rawYear === '0') ? 'all' : (int) $rawYear;
        $month = (int) $request->input('month', 0);
        $type = $request->input('type', 'all');
        $category = trim((string) $request->input('category', 'all'));

        if (!in_array($type, ['all', 'reguler', 'non_reguler', 'non_reguler_soft_skill', 'non_reguler_teknikal', 'soft_skill', 'teknikal'], true)) {
            $type = 'all';
        }

        $activities = $this->activities();
        $filteredRecords = $this->filteredRecords($request);

        $trYears = TrainingRecord::whereNotNull('tahun')->pluck('tahun')->map(fn($y) => (int)$y)->filter()->all();
        $regYears = ProgramReguler::whereNotNull('Mulai_program')->get()->map(fn($p) => (int) optional($p->Mulai_program)->year)->filter()->all();
        $nonRegYears = ProgramNonReguler::whereNotNull('start_date')->get()->map(fn($p) => (int) optional($p->start_date)->year)->filter()->all();

        $years = collect([2024, 2025, 2026, 2027])
            ->merge($trYears)
            ->merge($regYears)
            ->merge($nonRegYears)
            ->filter(fn($y) => $y >= 2000 && $y <= 2100)
            ->unique()
            ->sort()
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $nonRegulerSubCategories = ProgramNonReguler::distinct()->pluck('sub_kategori')
            ->filter()
            ->map(fn($c) => trim((string)$c))
            ->unique()
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $perPage = 15;
        $currentPage = LengthAwarePaginator::resolveCurrentPage();
        $records = new LengthAwarePaginator(
            $filteredRecords->values()->forPage($currentPage, $perPage),
            $filteredRecords->count(),
            $perPage,
            $currentPage,
            ['path' => $request->url(), 'query' => $request->query()]
        );
        $months = self::MONTHS;

        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Program.training_record', compact('records', 'activities', 'year', 'rawYear', 'month', 'type', 'category', 'years', 'months', 'nonRegulerSubCategories'));
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $data = $this->validated($request);
        $this->ensureActivity($data['program_type'], $data['program_id']);
        $this->ensureUnique($data['program_type'], $data['program_id'], $data['participant_identifier']);
        TrainingRecord::create($data + ['status' => 'valid']);
        return back()->with('success', 'Training Record berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    public function show(TrainingRecord $trainingRecord)
    {
        return view('Administrasi.Pages.Program.training_record_detail', ['record' => $trainingRecord, 'activity' => $trainingRecord->activity()]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, TrainingRecord $trainingRecord)
    {
        $data = $this->validated($request, $trainingRecord);
        $this->ensureActivity($data['program_type'], $data['program_id']);
        $this->ensureUnique($data['program_type'], $data['program_id'], $data['participant_identifier'], null, null, null, $trainingRecord->id);
        $trainingRecord->update($data);
        return back()->with('success', 'Training Record berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy(TrainingRecord $trainingRecord)
    {
        $trainingRecord->delete();
        return back()->with('success', 'Training Record berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    public function destroyAll()
    {
        $count = TrainingRecord::count();
        TrainingRecord::truncate();

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Hapus',
            'Training Record',
            "Menghapus seluruh data Training Record ({$count} data)",
            ['count' => $count]
        );

        return back()->with('success', "Seluruh data Training Record ({$count} data) berhasil dihapus.");
    }

    public function import(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate(['file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt,xlsx|max:20480']);
        $file = $request->file('file');
        $rows = SpreadsheetReader::read($file->getRealPath(), $file->getClientOriginalExtension());
        if (count($rows) < 2) return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'File tidak memiliki data.']);

        $rawHeaders = array_shift($rows);
        $cleanStr = fn($str) => SpreadsheetReader::cleanString($str);

        // Map raw headers to standardized keys
        $headerMap = [];
        foreach ($rawHeaders as $idx => $h) {
            $cleaned = $cleanStr($h);
            if (in_array($cleaned, ['nik', 'nip', 'id peserta', 'no id', 'badge'])) $headerMap['nik'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['nama', 'nama peserta', 'peserta', 'employee name'])) $headerMap['nama'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['department', 'departemen', 'dept', 'divisi'])) $headerMap['department'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['nama pelatihan', 'training program', 'judul training', 'program', 'nama program', 'jenis pelatihan', 'pelatihan'])) $headerMap['nama pelatihan'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['region', 'wilayah', 'reg'])) $headerMap['region'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['nama pt', 'pt', 'company', 'perusahaan', 'estate'])) $headerMap['nama pt'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['lokasi kerja', 'lokasi', 'kebun/pabrik', 'unit', 'work location'])) $headerMap['lokasi kerja'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['group', 'group unit'])) $headerMap['group'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['jenis kelamin', 'jk', 'gender'])) $headerMap['jenis kelamin'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['gol', 'golongan'])) $headerMap['gol'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['jabatan', 'position', 'posisi'])) $headerMap['jabatan'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['instruktur', 'trainer', 'instructor'])) $headerMap['instruktur'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['internal/eksternal', 'internal_eksternal', 'internal eksternal'])) $headerMap['internal/eksternal'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['level'])) $headerMap['level'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['periode', 'period'])) $headerMap['periode'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['tanggal', 'tgl', 'date'])) $headerMap['tanggal'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['bulan', 'bln', 'month'])) $headerMap['bulan'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['tahun', 'thn', 'year'])) $headerMap['tahun'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['jml hari', 'jumlah hari', 'jml_hari', 'total hari', 'total_hari', 'hari'])) $headerMap['jml hari'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['jam pelatihan', 'jam_pelatihan', 'total jam', 'total_jam', 'jam', 'jam/peserta'])) $headerMap['jam pelatihan'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['keterangan', 'notes', 'note'])) $headerMap['keterangan'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['program_type', 'tipe program'])) $headerMap['program_type'] = $idx;
            elseif (in_array($cleaned, ['program_id', 'id_nonreguler', 'program reguler id'])) $headerMap['program_id'] = $idx;
            else $headerMap[$cleaned] = $idx;
        }

        if (!isset($headerMap['nama pelatihan']) || (!isset($headerMap['nik']) && !isset($headerMap['nama']))) {
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Header file tidak lengkap. Kolom wajib: NIK/Nama dan Nama Pelatihan.']);
        }

        // Clear cache so newly added programs are included
        self::$cachedActivities = null;
        $activities = $this->activities();

        $count = 0; $skipped = 0;
        $insertBatch = [];
        $now = now();

        DB::transaction(function () use ($rows, $headerMap, &$activities, &$count, &$skipped, &$insertBatch, $now) {
            foreach ($rows as $row) {
                if (empty(array_filter($row, fn ($val) => trim((string) $val) !== ''))) continue;

                $item = [];
                foreach ($headerMap as $key => $idx) {
                    $item[$key] = trim((string) ($row[$idx] ?? ''));
                }

                $nama = $item['nama'] ?? '';
                $nik = $item['nik'] ?? '';
                $namaPelatihan = $item['nama pelatihan'] ?? '';

                if ($nama === '' && $nik === '' && empty($item['jabatan']) && empty($item['nama pt'])) continue;

                $activity = $this->findActivityCached($activities, $item);
                if (!$activity) {
                    $skipped++;
                    continue;
                }

                $data = $this->importData($item, $activity);
                $data['status'] = 'valid';
                $data['created_at'] = $now;
                $data['updated_at'] = $now;
                $insertBatch[] = $data;
                $count++;

                // Insert in chunks of 500
                if (count($insertBatch) >= 500) {
                    TrainingRecord::insert($insertBatch);
                    $insertBatch = [];
                }
            }

            if (!empty($insertBatch)) {
                TrainingRecord::insert($insertBatch);
                $insertBatch = [];
            }
        });

        ActivityLog::log(
            'Import',
            'Training Record',
            "Mengimport {$count} data Training Record dari file " . $file->getClientOriginalName(),
            ['filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(), 'count' => $count, 'skipped' => $skipped]
        );

        $message = "{$count} data Training Record berhasil diimpor.";
        if ($skipped > 0) {
            $message .= " ({$skipped} data dilewati karena aktivitas program tidak ditemukan).";
        }
        return back()->with('success', $message);
    }

    public function export(Request $request): StreamedResponse
    {
        $records = $this->filteredRecords($request);
        $headers = ['No', 'NIK', 'Nama', 'Jenis Kelamin', 'Nama PT', 'Department', 'lokasi Kerja', 'Group', 'REGION', 'GOL', 'Jabatan', 'Tgl', 'Bln', 'Thn', 'Jml Hari', 'Jam Pelatihan', 'Nama Pelatihan', 'Instruktur', 'Tempat Pelatihan', 'Reg / Non Reg', 'Keterangan', 'Internal/Eksternal', 'Level', 'Periode'];

        $dataRows = [];
        foreach ($records as $index => $record) {
            $act = $record->activity();
            $dataRows[] = [
                $index + 1,
                $record->displayNik(),
                $record->participant_name,
                $record->gender,
                $record->company,
                $record->department,
                $record->work_location,
                $record->group_name,
                $record->region,
                $record->gol,
                $record->position,
                $record->tanggal,
                $record->bulan,
                $record->tahun,
                $record->jml_hari ?: ($act?->jumlah_hari ?? $act?->total_hari),
                $record->total_jam ?: $record->activityHoursPerParticipant(),
                $record->activityName(),
                $record->instructor ?: $record->activityTrainer(),
                $record->program_type === 'reguler' ? $act?->Lokasi_training : $act?->lokasi_training,
                $record->program_type === 'reguler' ? 'Reguler' : 'Non Reguler',
                $record->notes,
                $record->internal_external,
                $record->level,
                $record->periode,
            ];
        }

        return ExcelExporter::download('training_records.xlsx', $headers, $dataRows, 'Training Record');
    }

    public function template(): StreamedResponse
    {
        $headers = ['NIK', 'Nama', 'Jenis Kelamin', 'Nama PT', 'Department', 'lokasi Kerja', 'Group', 'REGION', 'GOL', 'Jabatan', 'Tgl', 'Bln', 'Thn', 'Jml Hari', 'Jam Pelatihan', 'Nama Pelatihan', 'Instruktur', 'Keterangan', 'Internal/Eksternal', 'Level', 'Periode', 'program_type', 'program_id'];
        $exampleRow = ['12345678', 'Contoh Peserta', 'L', 'PT FR', 'Agronomy', 'Estate A', 'Group 1', 'Kalbar', 'IV', 'Asisten', '15', 'JAN', 2026, '2', '16', 'Training Leadership', 'Internal', 'Contoh Catatan', 'Internal', 'Staff', '2026-1', 'reguler', 1];

        return ExcelExporter::download('training_record_template.xlsx', $headers, [$exampleRow], 'Template TR');
    }

    private function validated(Request $request, ?TrainingRecord $record = null): array
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'program_type' => 'required|in:reguler,non_reguler',
            'program_id' => 'required|integer',
            'participant_identifier' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'participant_name' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'gender' => 'nullable|string|max:50', 'company' => 'nullable|string|max:255', 'department' => 'nullable|string|max:255', 'work_location' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'group_name' => 'nullable|string|max:100', 'region' => 'nullable|string|max:100', 'gol' => 'nullable|string|max:100', 'position' => 'nullable|string|max:255', 'instructor' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'internal_external' => 'nullable|string|max:50', 'level' => 'nullable|string|max:100', 'periode' => 'nullable|string|max:100', 'notes' => 'nullable|string',
            'tanggal' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'bulan' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'tahun' => 'nullable|integer|min:2000|max:2100',
            'jml_hari' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'total_jam' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
        ]);

        if (!empty($validated['bulan'])) {
            $validated['bulan'] = strtoupper(substr(trim($validated['bulan']), 0, 3));
        }

        return $validated;
    }

    private function ensureActivity(string $type, int $id): void
    {
        if (!$this->activities()->has($type . ':' . $id)) abort(422, 'Training activity tidak ditemukan.');
    }

    private function ensureUnique(string $type, int $id, ?string $identifier, ?string $tanggal = null, ?string $bulan = null, ?int $tahun = null, ?int $ignore = null): void
    {
        if (empty($identifier)) return;
        $query = TrainingRecord::where('program_type', $type)->where('program_id', $id)->where('participant_identifier', $identifier);
        if ($tanggal) $query->where('tanggal', $tanggal);
        if ($bulan) $query->where('bulan', $bulan);
        if ($tahun) $query->where('tahun', $tahun);
        if ($ignore) $query->whereKey('!=', $ignore);
        if ($query->exists()) abort(422, 'Peserta dengan NIK ini sudah terdaftar pada jadwal training activity ini.');
    }

    private function activities()
    {
        if (self::$cachedActivities !== null) {
            return self::$cachedActivities;
        }

        $cleanStr = fn($str) => strtolower(trim(preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/', '', (string) $str)));

        $reguler = ProgramReguler::all()->mapWithKeys(fn ($item) => [
            'reguler:' . $item->getKey() => [
                'type' => 'reguler',
                'sub_type' => 'reguler',
                'type_label' => 'Reguler',
                'id' => $item->getKey(),
                'name' => $this->activityLabel($item, 'reguler'),
                'model' => $item
            ]
        ]);

        $nonReguler = ProgramNonReguler::all()->mapWithKeys(function ($item) use ($cleanStr) {
            $kat = $cleanStr(($item->kategori_pelatihan ?? '') . ' ' . ($item->sub_kategori ?? '') . ' ' . ($item->jenis_pelatihan ?? ''));
            $isSoft = str_contains($kat, 'managerial') || str_contains($kat, 'leadership') || str_contains($kat, 'soft');
            return [
                'non_reguler:' . $item->getKey() => [
                    'type' => 'non_reguler',
                    'sub_type' => $isSoft ? 'soft_skill' : 'teknikal',
                    'type_label' => $isSoft ? 'Non Reguler - Soft Skill' : 'Non Reguler - Teknikal',
                    'id' => $item->getKey(),
                    'name' => $item->jenis_pelatihan,
                    'model' => $item
                ]
            ];
        });

        return self::$cachedActivities = $reguler->union($nonReguler);
    }

    private function filteredRecords(Request $request)
    {
        $clone = $request->duplicate();
        $activities = $this->activities();
        $cleanStr = fn($str) => SpreadsheetReader::cleanString($str);

        return TrainingRecord::latest()->get()->filter(function ($record) use ($clone, $activities, $cleanStr) {
            $type = $clone->input('type', 'all');
            $category = trim((string) $clone->input('category', 'all'));
            $rawYear = $clone->input('year', 'all');
            $year = ($rawYear === 'all' || $rawYear === '' || $rawYear === '0') ? null : (int) $rawYear;
            $month = (int) $clone->input('month', 0);

            $activity = $activities->get($record->program_type . ':' . $record->program_id);
            if (!$activity) return false;

            // 1. Filter Type
            if ($type === 'reguler' && $record->program_type !== 'reguler') return false;
            if ($type === 'non_reguler' && $record->program_type !== 'non_reguler') return false;
            if (in_array($type, ['non_reguler_soft_skill', 'soft_skill'], true)) {
                if ($record->program_type !== 'non_reguler' || ($activity['sub_type'] ?? '') !== 'soft_skill') return false;
            }
            if (in_array($type, ['non_reguler_teknikal', 'teknikal'], true)) {
                if ($record->program_type !== 'non_reguler' || ($activity['sub_type'] ?? '') !== 'teknikal') return false;
            }

            // 2. Filter Category (Detail Kategori)
            if ($category !== 'all' && $category !== '') {
                $pModel = $activity['model'] ?? null;
                if ($record->program_type === 'reguler') {
                    $pName = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/', '', $activity['name'] ?? ''));
                    $isMandor = ($pModel && str_contains($cleanStr($pModel->jenis_program_reguler ?? ''), 'mandor'))
                        || str_starts_with(strtoupper($pName), 'PMT')
                        || str_starts_with(strtoupper($pName), 'PKT');

                    if ($category === 'staf' && $isMandor) return false;
                    if ($category === 'mandor' && !$isMandor) return false;
                } else {
                    // Non Reguler
                    $kat = $cleanStr(($pModel->kategori_pelatihan ?? '') . ' ' . ($pModel->sub_kategori ?? '') . ' ' . ($activity['name'] ?? ''));
                    if ($category === 'managerial' || strcasecmp($category, 'softskill') === 0) {
                        if (!str_contains($kat, 'managerial') && !str_contains($kat, 'soft')) return false;
                    } elseif ($category === 'technical') {
                        if (!str_contains($kat, 'technical') || str_contains($kat, 'soft')) return false;
                    } else {
                        $searchCat = $cleanStr($category);
                        if (!str_contains($kat, $searchCat)) return false;
                    }
                }
            }

            // 3. Filter Year
            if ($year !== null) {
                if ($record->tahun || $record->bulan) {
                    if ($record->tahun && (int) $record->tahun !== $year) return false;
                } else {
                    if (!collect($record->activityDates())->contains(fn ($date) => $date && (int) date('Y', strtotime($date)) === $year)) return false;
                }
            }

            // 4. Filter Month
            if ($month > 0) {
                if ($record->bulan) {
                    $monthShort = strtoupper(self::MONTHS[$month] ?? '');
                    if ($record->bulan !== $monthShort) return false;
                } else {
                    if (!collect($record->activityDates())->contains(fn ($date) => $date && (int) date('n', strtotime($date)) === $month)) return false;
                }
            }

            // 5. Search keyword
            $search = strtolower(trim((string) $clone->input('search')));
            if ($search !== '' && !str_contains(strtolower(implode(' ', [$record->participant_identifier, $record->participant_name, $record->company, $record->department, $record->work_location, $record->group_name, $record->region, $record->position, $record->bulan, $record->tahun, $record->jml_hari, $record->total_jam, $record->activityName()])), $search)) return false;
            foreach (['company', 'work_location', 'group_name', 'region', 'position', 'internal_external', 'level'] as $field) if ($clone->filled($field) && strtolower((string) $record->{$field}) !== strtolower((string) $clone->input($field))) return false;

            return true;
        });
    }

    private function activityDates($activity, string $type): array
    {
        return $activity->tanggal_pelaksanaan ?: ($type === 'reguler' ? array_filter([$activity->Mulai_program, $activity->Selesai_program]) : array_filter([$activity->start_date, $activity->end_date]));
    }

    private function findActivity(array $item): ?array
    {
        return $this->findActivityCached($this->activities(), $item);
    }

    private function findActivityCached(\Illuminate\Support\Collection &$activities, array $item): ?array
    {
        $type = str_replace('-', '_', strtolower(trim((string) ($item['program_type'] ?? ''))));
        $type = $type === 'nonreguler' ? 'non_reguler' : $type;
        $id = $item['program_id'] ?? ($type === 'reguler' ? ($item['program_id'] ?? null) : ($item['id_nonreguler'] ?? null));
        $rowRegion = $this->inferRowRegion($item);

        // 1. If explicit ID was provided, check with or without explicit type
        if ($id) {
            $keysToTry = [];
            if ($type) $keysToTry[] = $type . ':' . (int) $id;
            $keysToTry[] = 'non_reguler:' . (int) $id;
            $keysToTry[] = 'reguler:' . (int) $id;

            foreach ($keysToTry as $k) {
                if (isset($activities[$k])) {
                    $matchedAct = $activities[$k];
                    $actRegion = $this->normalizeRegion($matchedAct['model']->Region ?? $matchedAct['model']->region ?? '');
                    if ($rowRegion === '' || $actRegion === '' || $actRegion === $rowRegion) {
                        return $matchedAct;
                    }

                    // Region mismatch on provided ID! Look for sister program in the correct region
                    $targetProgName = trim($matchedAct['name']);
                    $actType = $matchedAct['type'];
                    $sister = $activities->first(function($act) use ($actType, $targetProgName, $rowRegion) {
                        if ($act['type'] !== $actType) return false;
                        $actReg = $this->normalizeRegion($act['model']->Region ?? $act['model']->region ?? '');
                        if ($actReg !== $rowRegion) return false;
                        return strcasecmp(trim($act['name']), $targetProgName) === 0 || $this->matchActivityNames($targetProgName, $act['name']);
                    });
                    if ($sister) return $sister;
                    return $matchedAct;
                }
            }
        }

        $rawPelatihanName = trim((string) ($item['nama pelatihan'] ?? ''));
        $name = strtolower($rawPelatihanName);
        if ($name === '') return null;

        // 2. Exact match
        $matches = $activities->filter(fn ($activity) => strtolower(trim($activity['name'])) === $name);

        // 3. Flexible match (prefix, word matching) if no exact match
        if ($matches->isEmpty()) {
            $matches = $activities->filter(function ($activity) use ($name) {
                return $this->matchActivityNames($name, $activity['name']);
            });
        }

        // 4. Filter by region if multiple matches exist or rowRegion is known
        if ($matches->count() > 1 && $rowRegion !== '') {
            $regionalMatches = $matches->filter(function ($activity) use ($rowRegion) {
                $model = $activity['model'];
                $activityRegion = $this->normalizeRegion($model->Region ?? $model->region ?? '');
                return $activityRegion === $rowRegion;
            });
            if ($regionalMatches->isNotEmpty()) $matches = $regionalMatches;
        }

        if ($matches->count() === 1) return $matches->first();

        // Fallback: alias matching or pick first match from flexible results
        if ($matches->isNotEmpty()) return $matches->first();

        $aliasMatch = $activities->first(function ($activity) use ($name, $rowRegion) {
            $model = $activity['model'];
            $aliases = [$model->Training_Program ?? null, $model->jenis_pelatihan ?? null, $model->Batch ?? null];
            $nameMatches = collect($aliases)->filter()->contains(fn ($alias) => $this->matchActivityNames($name, (string) $alias));
            if (!$nameMatches) return false;
            if ($rowRegion !== '') {
                $actReg = $this->normalizeRegion($model->Region ?? $model->region ?? '');
                if ($actReg !== '' && $actReg !== $rowRegion) return false;
            }
            return true;
        });

        if ($aliasMatch) return $aliasMatch;

        // Fallback 5: Auto-create missing unbudgeted ProgramNonReguler entry with 0 target
        $rawPelatihanName = trim((string) ($item['nama pelatihan'] ?? $item['training program'] ?? $item['program'] ?? ''));
        if ($rawPelatihanName === '') return null;

        try {
            $formattedRegion = $rowRegion ? ($rowRegion === 'riau' ? 'Riau' : ($rowRegion === 'kalbar' ? 'Kalbar' : 'Kaltim FR')) : 'Riau';
            $isSoft = str_contains(strtolower($rawPelatihanName), 'soft') || str_contains(strtolower($rawPelatihanName), 'leadership') || str_contains(strtolower($rawPelatihanName), 'managerial');

            $newNonReg = ProgramNonReguler::create([
                'jenis_pelatihan' => $rawPelatihanName,
                'kategori_pelatihan' => $isSoft ? 'Managerial and Leadership' : 'Technical',
                'sub_kategori' => $isSoft ? 'Softskill' : 'Technical',
                'region' => $formattedRegion,
                'trainer' => $item['instruktur'] ?? 'Internal',
                'lokasi_training' => $item['lokasi kerja'] ?? 'FR Academy',
                'TARGET_BATCH' => 0,
                'TARGET_PESERTA' => 0,
                'target_total' => 0,
                'total_batch' => 0,
            ]);

            $id = $newNonReg->getKey();
            $newAct = [
                'type' => 'non_reguler',
                'sub_type' => $isSoft ? 'soft_skill' : 'teknikal',
                'type_label' => $isSoft ? 'Non Reguler - Soft Skill' : 'Non Reguler - Teknikal',
                'id' => $id,
                'name' => $newNonReg->jenis_pelatihan,
                'model' => $newNonReg
            ];

            $activities->put('non_reguler:' . $id, $newAct);
            return $newAct;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private function matchActivityNames(string $inputName, string $activityName): bool
    {
        $inputName = strtolower(trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $inputName)));
        $activityName = strtolower(trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $activityName)));
        if ($inputName === '' || $activityName === '') return false;

        if ($inputName === $activityName) return true;

        // Check reguler acronyms: FAT, AAT, MAT, TAT, DMT, PMT, PKT, OAT
        $regAcronyms = ['fat', 'aat', 'mat', 'tat', 'dmt', 'pmt', 'pkt', 'oat'];
        $inWords = explode(' ', $inputName);
        $actWords = explode(' ', $activityName);
        $inFirst = $inWords[0] ?? '';
        $actFirst = $actWords[0] ?? '';

        $inIsReg = in_array($inFirst, $regAcronyms, true);
        $actIsReg = in_array($actFirst, $regAcronyms, true);

        if ($inIsReg || $actIsReg) {
            // Must have the exact same acronym
            if ($inFirst !== $actFirst) return false;
            // Check batch roman numeral (I, II, III, IV, etc.)
            $inRoman = $inWords[1] ?? '';
            $actRoman = $actWords[1] ?? '';
            if ($inRoman !== '' && $actRoman !== '' && $inRoman !== $actRoman) {
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        if (str_starts_with($inputName, $activityName) || str_starts_with($activityName, $inputName)) {
            return true;
        }

        $cleanInput = preg_replace('/[^\w\s]/u', ' ', $inputName);
        $cleanActivity = preg_replace('/[^\w\s]/u', ' ', $activityName);

        $inputWords = array_values(array_filter(explode(' ', $cleanInput)));
        $activityWords = array_values(array_filter(explode(' ', $cleanActivity)));

        if (empty($inputWords) || empty($activityWords)) return false;

        $noise = ['training', 'pelatihan', 'program', 'unbudget', 'refreshment', 'refresh', 'of', 'by', 'vendor', 'dan', '&'];
        $filteredInWords = array_values(array_diff($inputWords, $noise));
        $filteredActWords = array_values(array_diff($activityWords, $noise));

        if (!empty($filteredInWords) && !empty($filteredActWords)) {
            $intersect = array_intersect($filteredInWords, $filteredActWords);
            if (count($intersect) === count($filteredInWords) || count($intersect) === count($filteredActWords)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        // If activityName is 1 word (e.g. "Supervisory", "Damkarhutlabun")
        if (count($activityWords) === 1) {
            return in_array($activityWords[0], $inputWords, true) || str_contains($cleanInput, $activityWords[0]);
        }

        // If activityName is 2+ words
        if (count($inputWords) >= 2 && count($activityWords) >= 2) {
            if ($inputWords[0] === $activityWords[0] && $inputWords[1] === $activityWords[1]) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        $firstTwoActivityWords = implode(' ', array_slice($activityWords, 0, 2));
        if (str_contains($cleanInput, $firstTwoActivityWords)) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function activityLabel($activity, string $type): string
    {
        if ($type !== 'reguler') return trim((string) $activity->jenis_pelatihan);

        $name = trim((string) $activity->Training_Program);
        $batch = trim((string) $activity->Batch);
        if ($batch !== '' && !str_contains(strtolower($name), strtolower($batch))) $name .= ' - ' . $batch;
        return $name;
    }

    private function importData(array $item, array $activity): array
    {
        $tgl = trim((string) ($item['tgl'] ?? $item['tanggal'] ?? ''));
        $bulan = trim((string) ($item['bulan'] ?? $item['bln'] ?? $item['month'] ?? ''));
        $tahun = trim((string) ($item['tahun'] ?? $item['thn'] ?? $item['year'] ?? ''));
        $nik = trim((string) ($item['nik'] ?? ''));
        $nama = trim((string) ($item['nama'] ?? ''));

        // Check if NIK is a valid specific identifier or just a placeholder/name
        $cleanNik = strtoupper(trim($nik));
        $cleanNama = strtoupper(trim($nama));
        $isPlaceholderNik = ($nik === '' || in_array($cleanNik, ['-', '#N/A', 'PROMOSI', 'TRAINEE', '0', 'NULL', 'N/A']) || ($cleanNama !== '' && $cleanNik === $cleanNama));
        $identifier = $isPlaceholderNik ? null : $nik;

        $finalNama = $nama !== '' ? $nama : (!empty($item['jabatan']) ? $item['jabatan'] : '-');

        $inferred = $this->inferRowRegion($item);
        $finalRegion = $item['region'] ?? null;
        if (empty($finalRegion) && $inferred !== '') {
            $finalRegion = $inferred === 'riau' ? 'Riau' : ($inferred === 'kalbar' ? 'Kalbar' : 'Kaltim FR');
        }

        $tahunVal = null;
        if ($tahun !== '' && is_numeric($tahun)) {
            $yInt = (int) $tahun;
            $tahunVal = ($yInt > 2030) ? 2026 : $yInt;
        }

        return [
            'program_type' => $activity['type'],
            'program_id' => $activity['id'],
            'participant_identifier' => $identifier,
            'participant_name' => $finalNama,
            'gender' => $item['jenis kelamin'] ?? null,
            'company' => $item['nama pt'] ?? null,
            'department' => $item['department'] ?? null,
            'work_location' => $item['lokasi kerja'] ?? null,
            'group_name' => $item['group'] ?? null,
            'region' => $finalRegion,
            'gol' => $item['gol'] ?? null,
            'position' => $item['jabatan'] ?? null,
            'tanggal' => $tgl !== '' ? $tgl : null,
            'instructor' => $item['instruktur'] ?? null,
            'internal_external' => $item['internal/eksternal'] ?? null,
            'level' => $item['level'] ?? null,
            'periode' => $item['periode'] ?? null,
            'bulan' => $bulan !== '' ? strtoupper(substr($bulan, 0, 3)) : null,
            'tahun' => $tahunVal,
            'jml_hari' => $item['jml hari'] ?? null,
            'total_jam' => $item['jam pelatihan'] ?? null,
            'notes' => $item['keterangan'] ?? null,
        ];
    }

    private function inferRowRegion(array $item): string
    {
        $rawRegion = $this->normalizeRegion($item['region'] ?? '');
        if ($rawRegion === 'riau' || $rawRegion === 'kalbar' || $rawRegion === 'kaltim') {
            return $rawRegion;
        }

        $text = strtoupper(trim(($item['nama pt'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($item['lokasi kerja'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($item['group'] ?? '')));
        if (preg_match('/\b(BDL|CAK|CAK1|CAK2|CAKB|CAKM|BPPJ|BPJJ|BPEJ|BSMJ|MKBB|MKB|MKB2)\b/', $text)) return 'kaltim';
        if (preg_match('/\b(USP|FAPE|LS|LS1|LS2|SMP|SMP1|SMP2|MKS|MKS1|MKS2|MKSK|KALE|PTLJ|BKP)\b/', $text)) return 'kalbar';
        if (preg_match('/\b(SAM|SAM1|SAM2|SIR|SIR1|SIR2|SAGM|PSA|SAL|CPK|ATS|ATS1|ATS2|CLP|GSI|PISP1|PISP2|MSSP|MSSP1|MII|PTR|ANJA|ANJAS|MCM|SMM|KTBM)\b/', $text)) return 'riau';

        return $rawRegion;
    }

    private function normalizeRegion($value): string
    {
        $v = strtolower(trim(str_replace(' fr', '', (string) $value)));
        if (str_contains($v, 'riau')) return 'riau';
        if (str_contains($v, 'kalbar')) return 'kalbar';
        if (str_contains($v, 'kaltim')) return 'kaltim';
        return $v;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Imports;

use App\Models\Trainee;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\IOFactory;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;

class TraineesImport
{
    protected int $programId;
    protected array $errors = [];
    protected int $imported = 0;

    public function __construct(int $programId)
    {
        $this->programId = $programId;
    }

    /**
     * Import trainees from an uploaded Excel/CSV file.
     */
    public function import(UploadedFile $file): void
    {
        $extension = strtolower($file->getClientOriginalExtension());

        if ($extension === 'csv') {
            $this->importCsv($file->getRealPath());
        } else {
            $this->importSpreadsheet($file->getRealPath());
        }
    }

    private function importCsv(string $path): void
    {
        $handle = fopen($path, 'r');
        // Read BOM if exists
        $bom = fread($handle, 3);
        if ($bom !== "\xEF\xBB\xBF") {
            rewind($handle);
        }

        $headers = fgetcsv($handle); // skip header row
        $headers = array_map('strtolower', array_map('trim', $headers));

        $row = 2;
        while (($data = fgetcsv($handle)) !== false) {
            $mapped = array_combine($headers, $data);
            $this->processRow($mapped, $row);
            $row++;
        }
        fclose($handle);
    }

    private function importSpreadsheet(string $path): void
    {
        $spreadsheet = IOFactory::load($path);
        $sheet = $spreadsheet->getActiveSheet();
        $rows = $sheet->toArray();

        // First row is headers
        $headers = array_map('strtolower', array_map('trim', $rows[0]));
        unset($rows[0]);

        foreach ($rows as $index => $row) {
            $mapped = array_combine($headers, $row);
            $this->processRow($mapped, $index + 1);
        }
    }

    private function processRow(array $row, int $rowNum): void
    {
        $name = trim($row['nama'] ?? '');
        if (empty($name)) {
            return; // skip empty rows
        }

        // Resolve birth_date
        $birthDate = null;
        $rawDate = trim($row['tgl_lahir'] ?? '');
        if (!empty($rawDate)) {
            // Try to parse common date formats
            $timestamp = strtotime($rawDate);
            if ($timestamp !== false) {
                $birthDate = date('Y-m-d', $timestamp);
            } elseif (is_numeric($rawDate)) {
                // Excel serial date
                $birthDate = \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\Date::excelToDateTimeObject((float)$rawDate)->format('Y-m-d');
            }
        }

        $status = strtolower(trim($row['status'] ?? 'aktif'));
        if (!in_array($status, ['aktif', 'pasif', 'resign'])) {
            $status = 'aktif';
        }

        try {
            Trainee::create([
                'training_program_id' => $this->programId,
                'nik'         => trim($row['nik'] ?? '') ?: null,
                'name'        => $name,
                'birth_place' => trim($row['tempat_lahir'] ?? '') ?: null,
                'birth_date'  => $birthDate,
                'origin'      => trim($row['asal_daerah'] ?? '') ?: null,
                'university'  => trim($row['universitas'] ?? '') ?: null,
                'major'       => trim($row['jurusan'] ?? '') ?: null,
                'status'      => $status,
            ]);
            $this->imported++;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->errors[] = "Baris {$rowNum} ({$name}): " . $e->getMessage();
        }
    }

    public function getImportedCount(): int
    {
        return $this->imported;
    }

    public function getErrors(): array
    {
        return $this->errors;
    }
}

File: app/Jobs/UpdateTrainingRecordJob.php

<?php

namespace App\Jobs;

use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Bus\Dispatchable;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Models\Trainee;
use App\Models\DailyClass;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class UpdateTrainingRecordJob implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable, InteractsWithQueue, Queueable, SerializesModels;

    protected $traineeId;
    protected $dailyClassId;
    protected $attendanceDate;

    public function __construct($traineeId, $dailyClassId, $attendanceDate)
    {
        $this->traineeId = $traineeId;
        $this->dailyClassId = $dailyClassId;
        $this->attendanceDate = $attendanceDate;
    }

    public function handle()
    {
        $trainee = Trainee::find($this->traineeId);
        $dailyClass = DailyClass::find($this->dailyClassId);

        if (!$trainee || !$dailyClass) {
            return;
        }

        $dateObj = Carbon::parse($this->attendanceDate);
        $hariAbsen = $dateObj->format('d');
        $bulanAbsen = strtoupper($dateObj->translatedFormat('M')); // e.g., FEB
        $tahunAbsen = $dateObj->format('Y');

        // Kalkulasi Periode (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4)
        $monthNum = $dateObj->month;
        $periode = 'Q' . ceil($monthNum / 3);

        $parentProgramNonReg = DB::table('program_non_reguler')->where('jenis_pelatihan', $dailyClass->title)->first();
        if (!$parentProgramNonReg) return;

        $idNonReguler = $parentProgramNonReg->id_nonreguler;
        $subKategori = $parentProgramNonReg->sub_kategori;

        // Cari record yang sudah ada
        $existingRecord = DB::table('training_records')
            ->where('participant_identifier', $trainee->nik)
            ->where('program_id', $idNonReguler)
            ->where('program_type', 'non_reguler')
            ->first();

        if ($existingRecord) {
            // Update record: Tambahkan tanggal baru jika belum ada
            $tanggalArray = explode(', ', $existingRecord->tanggal);
            if (!in_array($hariAbsen, $tanggalArray)) {
                $tanggalArray[] = $hariAbsen;
                // Urutkan tanggal agar rapi
                sort($tanggalArray);
                $newTanggal = implode(', ', $tanggalArray);

                DB::table('training_records')
                    ->where('id', $existingRecord->id)
                    ->update([
                        'tanggal' => $newTanggal,
                        'updated_at' => now(),
                    ]);
            }
        } else {
            // Coba cari Golongan dari riwayat pelatihan sebelumnya
            $gol = DB::table('training_records')
                ->where('participant_identifier', $trainee->nik)
                ->whereNotNull('gol')
                ->where('gol', '!=', '-')
                ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
                ->value('gol');

            if (!$gol) {
                // Mapping sederhana tebak golongan jika tidak ada history
                $jabatan = strtolower($trainee->talent_to ?? '');
                if (str_contains($jabatan, 'askep') || str_contains($jabatan, 'asst') || str_contains($jabatan, 'manager') || str_contains($jabatan, 'staff') || str_contains($jabatan, 'ktu')) {
                    $gol = 'Staf';
                } elseif (str_contains($jabatan, 'mandor') || str_contains($jabatan, 'kerani') || str_contains($jabatan, 'pekerja')) {
                    $gol = 'Non Staf';
                } else {
                    $gol = '-';
                }
            }

            // Coba cari data dari riwayat pelatihan sebelumnya (prioritas pertama)
            $pastRecord = DB::table('training_records')
                ->where('participant_identifier', $trainee->nik)
                ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
                ->first();

            $gender = ($pastRecord && $pastRecord->gender && $pastRecord->gender !== '-') ? $pastRecord->gender : ($trainee->gender ?: '-');
            $company = ($pastRecord && $pastRecord->company && $pastRecord->company !== '-') ? $pastRecord->company : ($trainee->unit ?: '-');
            $workLoc = ($pastRecord && $pastRecord->work_location && $pastRecord->work_location !== '-') ? $pastRecord->work_location : ($trainee->unit ?: '-');
            $group = ($pastRecord && $pastRecord->group_name && $pastRecord->group_name !== '-') ? $pastRecord->group_name : ($trainee->group ?: '-');
            $region = ($pastRecord && $pastRecord->region && $pastRecord->region !== '-') ? $pastRecord->region : ($trainee->origin ?: '-');
            $level = ($pastRecord && $pastRecord->level && $pastRecord->level !== '-') ? $pastRecord->level : '-';

            // Create record baru
            DB::table('training_records')->insert([
                'program_type' => 'non_reguler',
                'program_id' => $idNonReguler,
                'participant_identifier' => $trainee->nik,
                'participant_name' => $trainee->name,
                'gender' => $gender,
                'company' => $company,
                'work_location' => $workLoc,
                'group_name' => $group,
                'region' => $region,
                'gol' => $gol,
                'position' => $trainee->talent_to ?? '-',
                'instructor' => $dailyClass->trainer_name ?: ($parentProgramNonReg->trainer ?? '-'),
                'notes' => $subKategori ?: '-',
                'internal_external' => $dailyClass->provider ?: 'Internal',
                'level' => $level,
                'periode' => $periode,
                'bulan' => $bulanAbsen,
                'tahun' => $tahunAbsen,
                'tanggal' => $hariAbsen,
                'training_date' => $this->attendanceDate,
                'status' => 'hadir',
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Request;

class ActivityLog extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    protected $fillable = [
        'user_id',
        'user_name',
        'user_role',
        'action',
        'module',
        'description',
        'ip_address',
        'user_agent',
        'properties',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'properties' => 'array',
        'created_at' => 'datetime',
        'updated_at' => 'datetime',
    ];

    public function user()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    /**
     * Helper to log an activity explicitly
     */
    public static function log(string $action, string $module, string $description, ?array $properties = null): self
    {
        $user = Auth::user();

        $roleName = '-';
        if ($user) {
            $roleName = $user->getRoleNames()->first() ?? $user->role ?? 'User';
        }

        return static::create([
            'user_id'     => $user ? $user->id : null,
            'user_name'   => $user ? $user->name : 'Sistem',
            'user_role'   => $roleName,
            'action'      => $action,
            'module'      => $module,
            'description' => $description,
            'ip_address'  => Request::ip(),
            'user_agent'  => Request::userAgent(),
            'properties'  => $properties,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models\Administrasi;

use App\Traits\LogsActivity;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class Cuti extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, LogsActivity;

    protected static $logModuleName = 'Cuti';

    protected $table = 'cuti';
    protected $primaryKey = 'cuti_id';

    protected $fillable = [
        'nik',
        'nama',
        'jabatan',
        'jenis_jabatan',
        'tmk',
        'tahun',
        'hak_cuti',
        'sisa_hak_cuti_carryover',

        'feb',
        'mar',
        'apr',
        'mei',
        'jun',
        'jul',
        'agu',
        'sep',
        'okt',
        'nov',
        'des',
        'keterangan',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'tahun' => 'integer',
        'hak_cuti' => 'integer',
        'sisa_hak_cuti_carryover' => 'integer',
        'cuti_diambil' => 'integer',
        'jan' => 'integer',
        'feb' => 'integer',
        'mar' => 'integer',
        'apr' => 'integer',
        'mei' => 'integer',
        'jun' => 'integer',
        'jul' => 'integer',
        'agu' => 'integer',
        'sep' => 'integer',
        'okt' => 'integer',
        'nov' => 'integer',
        'des' => 'integer',
        'tmk' => 'date',
    ];

    public const MONTHS = ['jan', 'feb', 'mar', 'apr', 'mei', 'jun', 'jul', 'agu', 'sep', 'okt', 'nov', 'des'];

    /**
     * Scope to order query by employee category and position hierarchy
     */
    public function scopeOrderedHierarchy($query)
    {
        $customOrderRaw = "CASE
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staf%' OR jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staff%' THEN 1
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%PBT%' THEN 2
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%KHT%' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END ASC,
        CASE
            -- 1. Staff Specific Position Hierarchy
            WHEN (jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staf%' OR jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staff%') AND jabatan LIKE '%Academy Director%' THEN 1
            WHEN (jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staf%' OR jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staff%') AND (jabatan LIKE '%Sr Manager L & D%' OR jabatan LIKE '%Sr Manager L&D%') THEN 2
            WHEN (jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staf%' OR jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staff%') AND jabatan LIKE '%Training Manager Downstream%' THEN 3
            WHEN (jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staf%' OR jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staff%') AND (jabatan LIKE '%L & D Manager%' OR jabatan LIKE '%L&D Manager%') THEN 4
            WHEN (jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staf%' OR jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staff%') AND jabatan LIKE '%Trainer%' THEN 5
            WHEN (jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staf%' OR jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staff%') AND (jabatan LIKE '%L&D Officer%' OR jabatan LIKE '%L & D Officer%') THEN 6
            WHEN (jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staf%' OR jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staff%') AND (jabatan LIKE '%Staf E-Learning%' OR jabatan LIKE '%E-Learning%') THEN 7
            WHEN (jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staf%' OR jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staff%') AND jabatan LIKE '%KTU%' THEN 8
            WHEN (jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staf%' OR jenis_jabatan LIKE '%Staff%') AND (jabatan LIKE '%Recruitment%' OR jabatan LIKE '%Rekruitmen%') THEN 9

            -- 2. Karyawan PBT Specific Position Hierarchy
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%PBT%' AND jabatan LIKE '%Driver Pool%' THEN 1
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%PBT%' AND jabatan LIKE '%Koordinator Mess%' THEN 2
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%PBT%' AND (jabatan LIKE '%Mandor Komp & Infrastruktur%' OR jabatan LIKE '%Mandor%') THEN 3

            -- 3. Karyawan KHT Specific Hierarchy
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%KHT%' AND jabatan LIKE '%Pertamanan%' THEN 1
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%KHT%' AND jabatan LIKE '%Krani Pembukuan%' THEN 2
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%KHT%' AND jabatan LIKE '%Petugas Taman%' THEN 3
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%KHT%' AND jabatan LIKE '%Krani Development%' THEN 4
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%KHT%' AND jabatan LIKE '%Training Fasilitator%' THEN 5
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%KHT%' AND jabatan LIKE '%Petugas Mess%' THEN 6
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%KHT%' AND (jabatan LIKE '%Office Boy%' OR jabatan LIKE '%Office Girl%') THEN 7
            WHEN jenis_jabatan LIKE '%KHT%' AND jabatan LIKE '%Supir%' THEN 8

            ELSE 99
        END ASC,
        nama ASC";

        return $query->orderByRaw($customOrderRaw);
    }

    /**
     * Total Penggunaan Cuti dari rincian bulanan Jan - Des
     */
    public function getTotalBulananAttribute(): int
    {
        return (int) array_sum(array_map(fn($m) => (int) $this->$m, self::MONTHS));
    }

    /**
     * Hitung Sisa Cuti:
     * Sisa Cuti = Hak Cuti + Sisa Hak Cuti Carryover - Cuti yang Diambil
     */
    public function getSisaCutiAttribute(): int
    {
        return (int) ($this->hak_cuti + $this->sisa_hak_cuti_carryover - $this->cuti_diambil);
    }

    /**
     * Periode Hak Cuti (Tahun - 1)
     */
    public function getPeriodeHakCutiAttribute(): int
    {
        return (int) ($this->tahun - 1);
    }

    /**
     * Label Periode Sisa Hak Cuti (contoh: untuk tahun 2026 -> 2023-2024)
     */
    public function getPeriodeSisaCarryoverLabelAttribute(): string
    {
        $start = $this->tahun - 3;
        $end = $this->tahun - 2;
        return "{$start}–{$end}";
    }

    /**
     * Cari histori sisa cuti dari 2 tahun sebelumnya (misal untuk 2026: sisa cuti 2023 + sisa cuti 2024)
     */
    public static function getHistoricalCarryover(string $nik, int $currentYear): int
    {
        $year1 = $currentYear - 3;
        $year2 = $currentYear - 2;

        $record1 = self::where('nik', $nik)->where('tahun', $year1)->first();
        $record2 = self::where('nik', $nik)->where('tahun', $year2)->first();

        $sisa1 = $record1 ? $record1->sisa_cuti : 0;
        $sisa2 = $record2 ? $record2->sisa_cuti : 0;

        return (int) ($sisa1 + $sisa2);
    }
}

File: app/Models/Administrasi/Mpp.php

<?php

namespace App\Models\Administrasi;

use App\Traits\LogsActivity;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class Mpp extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, LogsActivity;

    protected static $logModuleName = 'MPP';

    protected $table = 'mpp';
    protected $primaryKey = 'mpp_id';

    public const JENIS_JABATAN = ['Staff', 'PBT', 'KHT', 'KHL'];

    protected $fillable = [
        'nama_jabatan',
        'jenis_jabatan',
        'jumlah',
        'tahun',
        'bulan',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'jumlah' => 'integer',
        'tahun' => 'integer',
        'bulan' => 'integer',
    ];

    /**
     * Retrieve Matrix Data for specific year & month
     */
    public static function getMatrixData(int $year, int $month, ?string $search = null)
    {
        $query = self::where('tahun', $year)->where('bulan', $month);

        if (!empty($search)) {
            $query->where('nama_jabatan', 'like', "%{$search}%");
        }

        $records = $query->get();

        // Unique jabatan names ordered alphabetically
        $jabatanList = $records->pluck('nama_jabatan')->unique()->values();

        $matrix = [];
        $totals = [
            'Staff' => 0,
            'PBT' => 0,
            'KHT' => 0,
            'KHL' => 0,
            'total_overall' => 0,
        ];

        foreach ($jabatanList as $jabatan) {
            $row = [
                'nama_jabatan' => $jabatan,
                'Staff' => 0,
                'PBT' => 0,
                'KHT' => 0,
                'KHL' => 0,
            ];

            foreach (self::JENIS_JABATAN as $type) {
                $rec = $records->first(function ($item) use ($jabatan, $type) {
                    return $item->nama_jabatan === $jabatan && $item->jenis_jabatan === $type;
                });

                $count = $rec ? (int) $rec->jumlah : 0;
                $row[$type] = $count;
                $totals[$type] += $count;
            }

            $matrix[] = $row;
        }

        $totals['total_overall'] = $totals['Staff'] + $totals['PBT'] + $totals['KHT'] + $totals['KHL'];

        return [
            'matrix' => $matrix,
            'totals' => $totals,
        ];
    }
}

File: app/Models/Administrasi/Rekrutmen.php
================
<?php

namespace App\Models\Administrasi;

use App\Traits\LogsActivity;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class Rekrutmen extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, LogsActivity;

    protected static $logModuleName = 'Rekrutmen';

    protected $table = 'rekrutmen';

    protected $fillable = [
        'no',
        'lokasi_rekrut',
        'metode_rekrutmen',
        'program',
        'tanggal',
        'tahun',
        'jumlah_peserta_hadir',
        'jumlah_lolos_psikotest',
        'jumlah_hadir_interview_awal',
        'jumlah_lolos_interview_awal',
        'jumlah_lolos_interview_user',
        'jumlah_ikut_mcu',
        'jumlah_lolos_mcu',
        'join_fr',
        'persen_lulus',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'no' => 'integer',
        'tahun' => 'integer',
        'jumlah_peserta_hadir' => 'integer',
        'jumlah_lolos_psikotest' => 'integer',
        'jumlah_hadir_interview_awal' => 'integer',
        'jumlah_lolos_interview_awal' => 'integer',
        'jumlah_lolos_interview_user' => 'integer',
        'jumlah_ikut_mcu' => 'integer',
        'jumlah_lolos_mcu' => 'integer',
        'join_fr' => 'integer',
        'persen_lulus' => 'float',
    ];

    protected static function boot()
    {
        parent::boot();

        static::saving(function ($model) {
            $hadir = (int) $model->jumlah_peserta_hadir;
            $join = (int) $model->join_fr;
            if ($hadir > 0) {
                $model->persen_lulus = round($join / $hadir, 6);
            } else {
                $model->persen_lulus = 0;
            }

            if (empty($model->metode_rekrutmen)) {
                $model->metode_rekrutmen = 'Offline';
            }

            if (empty($model->tahun) && !empty($model->tanggal)) {
                if (preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $model->tanggal, $matches)) {
                    $model->tahun = (int) $matches[1];
                }
            }
        });
    }
}

File: app/Models/AppSetting.php
================
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class AppSetting extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    protected $table = 'app_settings';
    protected $primaryKey = 'key';
    public $incrementing = false;
    protected $keyType = 'string';

    protected $fillable = [
        'key',
        'value',
    ];

    /**
     * Get a setting value by key.
     */
    public static function get(string $key, mixed $default = null): mixed
    {
        $setting = static::find($key);
        return $setting !== null ? $setting->value : $default;
    }

    /**
     * Set a setting value by key.
     */
    public static function set(string $key, mixed $value): static
    {
        return static::updateOrCreate(
            ['key' => $key],
            ['value' => (string) $value]
        );
    }
}

File: app/Models/Concerns/HasTrainingSchedule.php

<?php

namespace App\Models\Concerns;

trait HasTrainingSchedule
{
    public function scheduleDates(): array
    {
        if (is_array($this->tanggal_pelaksanaan) && $this->tanggal_pelaksanaan) {
            return $this->tanggal_pelaksanaan;
        }

        return array_values(array_filter([
            $this->start_date?->format('Y-m-d'),
            $this->end_date?->format('Y-m-d'),
        ]));
    }
}

    protected static $logModuleName = 'Capex Realisasi';

    protected $table = 'capex_realisasi';
    protected $primaryKey = 'realisasi_id';

    protected $fillable = [
        'realisasi_id',
        'rab_id',
        'tahun',
        'lokasi',
        'kel_barang_kapital',
        'foto_barang',
        'nama_barang',
        'type',
        'tanggal',
        'debit',
        'kredit',
        'total_rp',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'tahun'    => 'integer',
        'tanggal'  => 'date',
        'debit'    => 'float',
        'kredit'   => 'float',
        'total_rp' => 'float',
    ];

    public function rab()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(CapexRab::class, 'rab_id', 'rab_id');
    }

    protected static function booted()
    {
        static::saving(function ($model) {
            $model->total_rp = (float) $model->debit - (float) $model->kredit;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models\Cost;

use App\Traits\LogsActivity;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class Cost extends Model
{
    use LogsActivity;

    protected static $logModuleName = 'Cost';
    protected $table      = 'costs';
    protected $primaryKey = 'cost_id';

    protected $fillable = [
        'cost_id',
        'GL_ACCOUNT',
        'jenis_cost',
        'account_name',
        'tahun',
        'bulan',
        'budget',
        'realisasi',
        'budget_tahunan',
        'kategori',
        'sub_kategori',
        'nama_item',
        'keterangan',
        'tanggal',
        'no_bukti',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'tahun'          => 'integer',
        'bulan'          => 'integer',
        'tanggal'        => 'date',
        'budget'         => 'decimal:2',
        'realisasi'      => 'decimal:2',
        'budget_tahunan' => 'decimal:2',
    ];

    /** Human-readable month name (Indonesian) */
    public function getBulanNamaAttribute(): string
    {
        $names = ['','Januari','Februari','Maret','April','Mei','Juni',
                  'Juli','Agustus','September','Oktober','November','Desember'];
        return $names[$this->bulan] ?? '';
    }
}

File: app/Models/Inventaris/Barang.php

<?php

namespace App\Models\Inventaris;

use App\Traits\LogsActivity;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class Barang extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, LogsActivity;

    protected static $logModuleName = 'Inventaris Barang';

    protected $table = 'barang';

    protected $fillable = [
        'id',
        'nama_asset',
        'satuan',
        'jenis_lokasi',
        'lokasi',
        'keterangan',
    ];

    /**
     * Relationship to Pembelian history.
     */
    public function pembelian()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Pembelian::class, 'barang_id');
    }

    /**
     * Relationship to Stock Opname history.
     */
    public function stockOpname()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(StockOpname::class, 'barang_id');
    }

    /**
     * Helper to get latest stock opname condition.
     */
    public function latestStockOpname()
    {
        return $this->hasOne(StockOpname::class, 'barang_id')->latestOfMany('tanggal_stock_opname');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models\Inventaris;

use App\Traits\LogsActivity;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class StockOpname extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, LogsActivity;

    protected static $logModuleName = 'Inventaris Stock Opname';

    protected $table = 'stock_opname';

    protected $fillable = [
        'id',
        'barang_id',
        'tanggal_stock_opname',
        'status',
        'catatan_sesi',
        'lokasi_spesifik',
        'jumlah_baik',
        'jumlah_rusak',
        'grand_total',
        'keterangan',
        'foto_kerusakan',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'tanggal_stock_opname' => 'date',
        'jumlah_baik' => 'integer',
        'jumlah_rusak' => 'integer',
        'grand_total' => 'integer',
    ];

    /**
     * Relationship to Barang.
     */
    public function barang()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Barang::class, 'barang_id');
    }

    /**
     * Automatically compute grand_total before saving.
     */
    protected static function booted()
    {
        static::saving(function ($model) {
            $model->grand_total = ($model->jumlah_baik ?? 0) + ($model->jumlah_rusak ?? 0);
        });
    }
}
