        // 8. Resign & Ijazah
        'status_resign',
        'tanggal_resign',
        'alasan_resign',
        'status_ijazah',
        'tanggal_pengambilan_ijazah',
        'penerima_ijazah',
        'no_tanda_terima_ijazah',
        // 9. Lainnya
        'no_bpjs_tk',
        'no_bpjs_kes',
        'npwp',
        'keterangan',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'no' => 'integer',
        'usia' => 'integer',
        'tahun_lulus' => 'integer',
        'tahun_angkatan' => 'integer',
        'ipk' => 'float',
        'nilai_psikotest' => 'float',
        'nilai_interview_hr' => 'float',
        'nilai_interview_user' => 'float',
        'nilai_akademik' => 'float',
        'nilai_praktek' => 'float',
        'nilai_sikap' => 'float',
        'nilai_akhir_training' => 'float',
        'ranking_seleksi' => 'integer',
    ];

    protected $appends = [
        'unit_kerja_display',
        'is_unit_kerja_fallback',
    ];

    /**
     * Get computed Unit Kerja (Utamakan Unit Kerja Saat Ini, fallback ke Unit Kerja Penempatan Training)
     */
    public function getUnitKerjaDisplayAttribute(): string
    {
        if (!empty(trim($this->unit_kerja_saat_ini ?? ''))) {
            return trim($this->unit_kerja_saat_ini);
        }

        if (!empty(trim($this->unit_kerja_penempatan_training ?? ''))) {
            return trim($this->unit_kerja_penempatan_training);
        }

        return '-';
    }

    /**
     * Flag whether the displayed Unit Kerja is from fallback (Penempatan Training)
     */
    public function getIsUnitKerjaFallbackAttribute(): bool
    {
        return empty(trim($this->unit_kerja_saat_ini ?? '')) && !empty(trim($this->unit_kerja_penempatan_training ?? ''));
    }

    /**
     * Normalize Keterangan to: 'Aktif', 'Resign', or 'Gagal'
     */
    public function getKeteranganAttribute($val): string
    {
        $v = strtolower(trim((string) $val));
        if (str_contains($v, 'gagal')) {
            return 'Gagal';
        }
        if (str_contains($v, 'resign') || str_contains($v, 'phk')) {
            return 'Resign';
        }
        return 'Aktif';
    }

    public function setKeteranganAttribute($val): void
    {
        $v = strtolower(trim((string) $val));
        if (str_contains($v, 'gagal')) {
            $this->attributes['keterangan'] = 'Gagal';
        } elseif (str_contains($v, 'resign') || str_contains($v, 'phk')) {
            $this->attributes['keterangan'] = 'Resign';
        } else {
            $this->attributes['keterangan'] = 'Aktif';
        }
    }
}

File: app/Models/Monitoring/MonitoringAngkatan.php

<?php

namespace App\Models\Monitoring;

use App\Traits\LogsActivity;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class MonitoringAngkatan extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, LogsActivity;

    protected static $logModuleName = 'Monitoring Angkatan';

    protected $table = 'monitoring_angkatan';
    protected $primaryKey = 'id_angkatan';

    protected $fillable = [
        'angkatan',
        'jumlah_awal',
        'lulus',
        'resign_in_class',
        'resign_ojt',
        'tidak_lulus',
    ];

    public function culleds()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(MonitoringCulled::class, 'id_angkatan', 'id_angkatan');
    }

    public function toFrontendArray(): array
    {
        $jumlahAwal = (int) $this->jumlah_awal;
        $resignInClass = (int) $this->resign_in_class;
        $resignOjt = (int) $this->resign_ojt;
        $tidakLulus = (int) $this->tidak_lulus;
        $lulus = max($jumlahAwal - $resignInClass - $resignOjt - $tidakLulus, 0);

        return [
            'id_angkatan' => $this->id_angkatan,
            'angkatan' => $this->angkatan,
            'Jumlah Awal' => $jumlahAwal,
            'lulus' => $this->lulus ?: $lulus,
            'Resign_In_Class' => $resignInClass,
            'Resign_OJT' => $resignOjt,
            'tidak_lulus' => $tidakLulus,
            'lulus_calculated' => $lulus,
            'culled_calculated' => $resignInClass + $resignOjt,
            'tidak_lulus_calculated' => $tidakLulus,
            'resign_in_class_calculated' => $resignInClass,
            'resign_ojt_calculated' => $resignOjt,
        ];
    }
}

namespace App\Models\Monitoring;

class MonitoringTalent extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, LogsActivity;

    protected static $logModuleName = 'Monitoring Talent';

    protected $table = 'monitoring_talents';

    protected $fillable = [
        'no',
        'employee_id',
        'employee_name',
        'posisi_asal',
        'talent_to',
        'unit',
        'region',
        'mentor_lapangan',
        'mentor_frlc',
        'status',
        'keterangan',
        'periode_penugasan_lama',
        'alasan',
        'periode_penugasan_baru',
        'lokasi_penugasan_baru',
        'catatan_tambahan',
        'kategori',
    ];

    /**
     * Scope filter by category.
     */
    public function scopeCategory($query, $category)
    {
        if (!empty($category) && $category !== 'all') {
            return $query->where('kategori', $category);
        }
        return $query;
    }

    /**
     * Scope filter by region keyword.
     */
    public function scopeRegion($query, $region)
    {
        return \App\Services\RegionHelper::applyQueryFilter($query, 'region', $region);
    }

    /**
     * Scope filter by status.
     */
    public function scopeStatus($query, $status)
    {
        if (!empty($status) && $status !== 'all') {
            return $query->where('status', 'like', "%{$status}%");
        }
        return $query;
    }
}

namespace App\Models\Program;

use App\Traits\LogsActivity;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class ProgramNonReguler extends Model
{
    use LogsActivity;

    protected static $logModuleName = 'Program Non-Reguler';
    protected $table = 'program_non_reguler';
    protected $primaryKey = 'id_nonreguler';
    protected $guarded = [];
    protected $casts = [
        'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => 'array',
        'start_date' => 'date:Y-m-d',
        'end_date' => 'date:Y-m-d',
    ];

    public function getTotalBatchAttribute()
    {
        return $this->attributes['realisasi_batch'] ?? $this->attributes['total_batch'] ?? 0;
    }

    public function setTotalBatchAttribute($value)
    {
        $this->attributes['realisasi_batch'] = $value;
    }

    public function trainingRecords()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TrainingRecord::class, 'program_id', 'id_nonreguler')
            ->where('program_type', 'non_reguler');
    }

    public function isSoftSkill(): bool
    {
        $kat = strtolower(trim(($this->kategori_pelatihan ?? '') . ' ' . ($this->sub_kategori ?? '') . ' ' . ($this->jenis_pelatihan ?? '')));
        return str_contains($kat, 'managerial') || str_contains($kat, 'leadership') || str_contains($kat, 'soft');
    }

    public function scopeSoftSkill($query)
    {
        return $query->where(function ($q) {
            $q->where('kategori_pelatihan', 'like', '%managerial%')
              ->orWhere('kategori_pelatihan', 'like', '%leadership%')
              ->orWhere('kategori_pelatihan', 'like', '%soft%');
        });
    }

    public function scopeTeknikal($query)
    {
        return $query->where(function ($q) {
            $q->where('kategori_pelatihan', 'not like', '%managerial%')
              ->orWhere('kategori_pelatihan', 'not like', '%leadership%')
              ->orWhere('kategori_pelatihan', 'not like', '%soft%');
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models\Program;

use App\Traits\LogsActivity;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class ProgramReguler extends Model
{
    use LogsActivity;

    protected static $logModuleName = 'Program Reguler';
    protected $table = 'program_reguler';
    protected $primaryKey = 'Program_reguler_id';
    protected $guarded = [];
    protected $casts = [
        'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => 'array',
        'Mulai_program' => 'date:Y-m-d',
        'Selesai_program' => 'date:Y-m-d',
    ];

    public function trainingRecords()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TrainingRecord::class, 'program_id', 'Program_reguler_id')
            ->where('program_type', 'reguler');
    }

    public function isMandor(): bool
    {
        $prog = strtolower(trim(($this->jenis_program_reguler ?? '') . ' ' . ($this->Training_Program ?? '')));
        return str_contains($prog, 'mandor') || str_starts_with($prog, 'pmt') || str_starts_with($prog, 'pkt');
    }

    public function scopeStaf($query)
    {
        return $query->where(function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_program_reguler', 'like', '%staf%')
              ->orWhere(function ($sub) {
                  $sub->where('jenis_program_reguler', 'not like', '%mandor%')
                      ->where('Training_Program', 'not like', 'PMT%')
                      ->where('Training_Program', 'not like', 'PKT%');
              });
        });
    }

    public function scopeMandor($query)
    {
        return $query->where(function ($q) {
            $q->where('jenis_program_reguler', 'like', '%mandor%')
              ->orWhere('Training_Program', 'like', 'PMT%')
              ->orWhere('Training_Program', 'like', 'PKT%');
        });
    }
}

File: app/Models/Program/TrainingRecord.php
================
<?php

namespace App\Models\Program;

use App\Traits\LogsActivity;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class TrainingRecord extends Model
{
    use LogsActivity;

    protected static $logModuleName = 'Training Record';

    private static array $activityCache = [];

    protected $guarded = [];
    protected $casts = ['training_date' => 'date:Y-m-d'];

    public function displayNik(): ?string
    {
        $nik = trim((string) $this->participant_identifier);
        if ($nik === '') return null;

        $upper = strtoupper($nik);
        if (str_starts_with($upper, 'NAME:') || str_starts_with($upper, 'SLOT:')) return null;
        if (in_array($upper, ['-', '#N/A', 'PROMOSI', 'TRAINEE', '0', 'NULL', 'N/A'], true)) return null;

        $name = trim((string) $this->participant_name);
        if ($name !== '' && strcasecmp($nik, $name) === 0) return null;

        return $nik;
    }

    public function reguler()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(ProgramReguler::class, 'program_id', 'Program_reguler_id');
    }

    public function nonReguler()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(ProgramNonReguler::class, 'program_id', 'id_nonreguler');
    }

    public function activity(): ?Model
    {
        $key = $this->program_type . ':' . $this->program_id;
        if (array_key_exists($key, self::$activityCache)) return self::$activityCache[$key];

        return self::$activityCache[$key] = match ($this->program_type) {
            'reguler' => $this->reguler,
            'non_reguler' => $this->nonReguler,
            default => null,
        };
    }

    public function activityDates(): array
    {
        $activity = $this->activity();
        if (!$activity) return [];

        $dates = $activity->tanggal_pelaksanaan ?: [];
        if ($dates) return array_values(array_filter($dates));

        return $this->program_type === 'reguler'
            ? array_values(array_filter([$activity->Mulai_program, $activity->Selesai_program]))
            : array_values(array_filter([$activity->start_date, $activity->end_date]));
    }

    public function activityName(): ?string
    {
        $activity = $this->activity();
        if (!$activity) return null;

        if ($this->program_type !== 'reguler') return $activity->jenis_pelatihan;

        $name = trim((string) $activity->Training_Program);
        $batch = trim((string) $activity->Batch);
        return $batch !== '' && !str_contains(strtolower($name), strtolower($batch))
            ? $name . ' - ' . $batch
            : $name;
    }

    public function activityTrainer(): ?string
    {
        $activity = $this->activity();
        if (!$activity) return null;

        return $this->program_type === 'reguler' ? ($activity->trainer ?: 'Internal') : $activity->trainer;
    }

    public function activityStartDate(): ?string
    {
        $activity = $this->activity();
        if (!$activity) return null;

        $date = $this->program_type === 'reguler' ? $activity->Mulai_program : $activity->start_date;
        return $date?->format('Y-m-d');
    }

    public function activityEndDate(): ?string
    {
        $activity = $this->activity();
        if (!$activity) return null;

        $date = $this->program_type === 'reguler' ? $activity->Selesai_program : $activity->end_date;
        return $date?->format('Y-m-d');
    }

    public function activityHoursPerParticipant(): ?float
    {
        $activity = $this->activity();
        if (!$activity) return null;

        $totalHours = $this->program_type === 'reguler' ? $activity->Total_training_days : $activity->total_jam;
        $totalParticipants = $this->program_type === 'reguler' ? $activity->target_peserta : $activity->target_total;
        if (!$totalHours || !$totalParticipants) return null;

        return round((float) $totalHours / (int) $totalParticipants, 2);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Notifications;

use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushMessage;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushChannel;

class WebPushBlastNotification extends Notification
{
    use Queueable;

    public $title;
    public $body;

    public function __construct($title, $body)
    {
        $this->title = $title;
        $this->body = $body;
    }

    public function via($notifiable)
    {
        return [WebPushChannel::class];
    }

    public function toWebPush($notifiable, $notification)
    {
        return (new WebPushMessage)
            ->title($this->title)
            ->body($this->body)
            ->icon('/logo.png')
            ->action('Buka', '/');
    }
}

File: app/Services/ExcelExporter.php
================
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Spreadsheet;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xlsx;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\Alignment;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\Fill;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\Border;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\Coordinate;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class ExcelExporter
{
    /**
     * Download styled Excel (.xlsx) file matching the standard green header design.
     * If ZipArchive is not installed on the server, automatically falls back to clean UTF-8 CSV.
     *
     * @param string $filename Output filename (e.g. "Template_Monitoring_Alumni.xlsx")
     * @param array $headers List of header column titles
     * @param array $dataRows List of data rows (each row is an array of values)
     * @param string $sheetTitle Sheet title name
     * @return StreamedResponse
     */
    public static function download(string $filename, array $headers, array $dataRows = [], string $sheetTitle = 'Sheet1'): StreamedResponse
    {
        // 1. Fallback to CSV if PHP zip extension (ZipArchive) is missing on hosting server
        if (!class_exists('\ZipArchive')) {
            $csvFilename = preg_replace('/\.[^.]+$/', '', $filename) . '.csv';
            $responseHeaders = [
                'Content-Type'        => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8',
                'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="' . $csvFilename . '"',
                'Cache-Control'       => 'max-age=0, must-revalidate',
                'Pragma'              => 'public',
            ];

            return new StreamedResponse(function () use ($headers, $dataRows) {
                if (ob_get_length()) {
                    @ob_end_clean();
                }
                $handle = fopen('php://output', 'w');
                // UTF-8 BOM so Excel opens with proper characters
                fprintf($handle, chr(0xEF) . chr(0xBB) . chr(0xBF));
                fputcsv($handle, $headers);
                foreach ($dataRows as $row) {
                    fputcsv($handle, (array)$row);
                }
                fclose($handle);
            }, 200, $responseHeaders);
        }

        $spreadsheet = new Spreadsheet();
        $sheet = $spreadsheet->getActiveSheet();
        $sheet->setTitle(substr($sheetTitle, 0, 31)); // Max sheet name length

        // Header Style (Image #1 style): Green Fill (#008000), White Bold Text, Center + Middle Align, Thin Border
        $headerStyle = [
            'font' => [
                'bold' => true,
                'color' => ['rgb' => 'FFFFFF'],
                'size' => 11,
                'name' => 'Calibri',
            ],
            'fill' => [
                'fillType' => Fill::FILL_SOLID,
                'startColor' => ['rgb' => '008000'], // Vibrant Dark Green
            ],
            'alignment' => [
                'horizontal' => Alignment::HORIZONTAL_CENTER,
                'vertical' => Alignment::VERTICAL_CENTER,
                'wrapText' => true,
            ],
            'borders' => [
                'allBorders' => [
                    'borderStyle' => Border::BORDER_THIN,
                    'color' => ['rgb' => '000000'],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        // Data Cells Style: Center + Middle Align, Thin Border
        $dataStyle = [
            'alignment' => [
                'horizontal' => Alignment::HORIZONTAL_CENTER,
                'vertical' => Alignment::VERTICAL_CENTER,
            ],
            'borders' => [
                'allBorders' => [
                    'borderStyle' => Border::BORDER_THIN,
                    'color' => ['rgb' => 'D3D3D3'],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        // Write Headers
        $colIndex = 1;
        $currencyCols = [];
        foreach ($headers as $header) {
            $colLetter = Coordinate::stringFromColumnIndex($colIndex);
            $sheet->getCell("{$colLetter}1")->setValue($header);

            $cleanH = strtolower(trim((string)$header));
            if (in_array($cleanH, ['budget', 'realisasi', 'budget_tahunan', 'total_biaya', 'biaya', 'harga', 'total_rp', 'upah', 'bbm', 'preventif_maintenance', 'biaya_lainnya', 'total_biaya_bulan', 'debit', 'kredit', 'nominal', 'amount', 'total_budget', 'total_realisasi'])
                || str_contains($cleanH, 'biaya')
                || str_contains($cleanH, 'budget')
                || str_contains($cleanH, 'realisasi')
                || str_contains($cleanH, 'harga')) {
                $currencyCols[] = $colLetter;
            }
            $colIndex++;
        }

        $highestColumn = $sheet->getHighestColumn();
        $sheet->getStyle("A1:{$highestColumn}1")->applyFromArray($headerStyle);
        $sheet->getRowDimension(1)->setRowHeight(28); // Standard comfortable row height for headers

        // Write Data Rows
        $rowIndex = 2;
        foreach ($dataRows as $row) {
            $colIndex = 1;
            foreach ((array)$row as $val) {
                $colLetter = Coordinate::stringFromColumnIndex($colIndex);
                $sheet->getCell("{$colLetter}{$rowIndex}")->setValue($val);
                $colIndex++;
            }
            $sheet->getRowDimension($rowIndex)->setRowHeight(22);
            $rowIndex++;
        }

        $lastRow = max(1, $rowIndex - 1);
        if ($lastRow > 1) {
            $sheet->getStyle("A2:{$highestColumn}{$lastRow}")->applyFromArray($dataStyle);
        }

        // Apply Currency Format ("Rp "#,##0) and Right Alignment to currency columns up to row 100 for templates
        $formatMaxRow = max(100, $lastRow);
        foreach ($currencyCols as $colLetter) {
            $sheet->getStyle("{$colLetter}2:{$colLetter}{$formatMaxRow}")
                ->getNumberFormat()
                ->setFormatCode('"Rp "#,##0');
            $sheet->getStyle("{$colLetter}2:{$colLetter}{$formatMaxRow}")
                ->getAlignment()
                ->setHorizontal(Alignment::HORIZONTAL_RIGHT);
        }

        // Auto-fit Column Widths safely
        $hasGd = extension_loaded('gd');
        $numCols = count($headers);
        for ($col = 1; $col <= $numCols; $col++) {
            $colLetter = Coordinate::stringFromColumnIndex($col);
            if ($hasGd) {
                try {
                    $sheet->getColumnDimension($colLetter)->setAutoSize(true);
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                    $sheet->getColumnDimension($colLetter)->setWidth(20);
                }
            } else {
                $sheet->getColumnDimension($colLetter)->setWidth(20);
            }
        }

        // Ensure extension is .xlsx
        if (!str_ends_with(strtolower($filename), '.xlsx')) {
            $filename = preg_replace('/\.[^.]+$/', '', $filename) . '.xlsx';
        }

        $responseHeaders = [
            'Content-Type'        => 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
            'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="' . $filename . '"',
            'Cache-Control'       => 'max-age=0, must-revalidate',
            'Pragma'              => 'public',
        ];

        return new StreamedResponse(function () use ($spreadsheet) {
            if (ob_get_length()) {
                @ob_end_clean();
            }
            $writer = new Xlsx($spreadsheet);
            $writer->save('php://output');
        }, 200, $responseHeaders);
    }
}

File: app/Services/RegionHelper.php
================
<?php

namespace App\Services;

class RegionHelper
{
    /**
     * Normalize messy region string into a clean canonical keyword/name.
     * Examples:
     * - "Kaltim - FR", "Kubar", "KALTIM" -> "Kaltim"
     * - "Kalbar", "Kalbar FR", "Kalbar - FR FR" -> "Kalbar"
     * - "Riau - FRLC", "Riau", "RIAU" -> "Riau"
     */
    public static function normalize(?string $raw): ?string
    {
        if ($raw === null) return null;
        $trimmed = trim((string) $raw);
        if ($trimmed === '' || $trimmed === '-' || strcasecmp($trimmed, 'all') === 0 || strcasecmp($trimmed, 'null') === 0) {
            return null;
        }

        $lower = strtolower($trimmed);

        if (str_contains($lower, 'kaltim') || str_contains($lower, 'kubar')) {
            return 'Kaltim';
        }
        if (str_contains($lower, 'kalbar')) {
            return 'Kalbar';
        }
        if (str_contains($lower, 'riau') || str_contains($lower, 'frlc')) {
            return 'Riau';
        }
        if (str_contains($lower, 'kalsel')) {
            return 'Kalsel';
        }
        if (str_contains($lower, 'kalteng')) {
            return 'Kalteng';
        }
        if (str_contains($lower, 'jkt') || str_contains($lower, 'jakarta')) {
            return 'Jakarta';
        }
        if (str_contains($lower, 'sumut')) {
            return 'Sumut';
        }
        if (str_contains($lower, 'head office') || $lower === 'ho') {
            return 'Head Office';
        }

        // Strip noisy suffixes like " - FR", " FR", " - FRLC"
        $cleaned = preg_replace('/\s*-\s*fr.*$/i', '', $trimmed);
        $cleaned = preg_replace('/\s+fr(\s+fr)*$/i', '', $cleaned);
        $cleaned = trim($cleaned);

        return $cleaned !== '' ? ucwords(strtolower($cleaned)) : null;
    }

    /**
     * Get a list of clean, distinct canonical region names from a collection/array of raw regions.
     */
    public static function getCanonicalRegions($rawRegions = null): array
    {
        $defaultOrder = ['Riau', 'Kalbar', 'Kaltim'];

        if ($rawRegions === null) {
            return $defaultOrder;
        }

        $normalized = collect($rawRegions)
            ->map(fn($r) => self::normalize((string)$r))
            ->filter()
            ->unique()
            ->values()
            ->all();

        return collect($defaultOrder)
            ->merge($normalized)
            ->unique()
            ->values()
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * Check if a record's region matches the selected filter keyword.
     */
    public static function matches(?string $recordRegion, ?string $filterRegion): bool
    {
        if (empty($filterRegion) || $filterRegion === 'all' || $filterRegion === '-') {
            return true;
        }
        if (empty($recordRegion) || $recordRegion === '-') {
            return false;
        }

        $rNorm = self::normalize($recordRegion);
        $fNorm = self::normalize($filterRegion);

        if ($rNorm && $fNorm && strcasecmp($rNorm, $fNorm) === 0) {
            return true;
        }

        $rLower = strtolower(trim($recordRegion));
        $fLower = strtolower(trim($filterRegion));

        if (str_contains($fLower, 'kaltim') || str_contains($fLower, 'kubar')) {
            return str_contains($rLower, 'kaltim') || str_contains($rLower, 'kubar');
        }
        if (str_contains($fLower, 'kalbar')) {
            return str_contains($rLower, 'kalbar');
        }
        if (str_contains($fLower, 'riau')) {
            return str_contains($rLower, 'riau') || str_contains($rLower, 'frlc');
        }
        if (str_contains($fLower, 'kalsel')) {
            return str_contains($rLower, 'kalsel');
        }
        if (str_contains($fLower, 'kalteng')) {
            return str_contains($rLower, 'kalteng');
        }

        return str_contains($rLower, $fLower) || str_contains($fLower, $rLower);
    }

    /**
     * Apply Eloquent query filter for region columns based on keywords.
     */
    public static function applyQueryFilter($query, string $column, ?string $filterRegion)
    {
        if (empty($filterRegion) || $filterRegion === 'all') {
            return $query;
        }

        $fLower = strtolower(trim($filterRegion));

        return $query->where(function ($q) use ($column, $fLower, $filterRegion) {
            if (str_contains($fLower, 'kaltim') || str_contains($fLower, 'kubar')) {
                $q->where($column, 'like', '%kaltim%')
                  ->orWhere($column, 'like', '%kubar%');
            } elseif (str_contains($fLower, 'kalbar')) {
                $q->where($column, 'like', '%kalbar%');
            } elseif (str_contains($fLower, 'riau')) {
                $q->where($column, 'like', '%riau%')
                  ->orWhere($column, 'like', '%frlc%');
            } elseif (str_contains($fLower, 'kalsel')) {
                $q->where($column, 'like', '%kalsel%');
            } elseif (str_contains($fLower, 'kalteng')) {
                $q->where($column, 'like', '%kalteng%');
            } elseif (str_contains($fLower, 'jkt') || str_contains($fLower, 'jakarta')) {
                $q->where($column, 'like', '%jkt%')
                  ->orWhere($column, 'like', '%jakarta%');
            } else {
                $q->where($column, 'like', "%{$filterRegion}%");
            }
        });
    }
}

================
File: app/Services/SpreadsheetReader.php
================
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use ZipArchive;

class SpreadsheetReader
{
    /**
     * Read CSV or XLSX file and return array of rows.
     */
    public static function read(string $path, string $extension = ''): array
    {
        if (empty($extension)) {
            $extension = pathinfo($path, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
        }
        $ext = strtolower($extension);
        if ($ext === 'xlsx') {
            return self::readXlsx($path);
        }

        return self::readCsv($path);
    }

    /**
     * Read CSV with automatic delimiter detection and UTF-8 BOM removal.
     */
    public static function readCsv(string $path): array
    {
        $handle = fopen($path, 'rb');
        if (!$handle) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('File CSV tidak dapat dibuka.');
        }

        $firstLine = fgets($handle);
        if ($firstLine === false) {
            fclose($handle);
            return [];
        }

        // Strip UTF-8 / UTF-16 BOM
        $firstLine = preg_replace('/^[\xEF\xBB\xBF\xFE\xFF\xFF\xFE]+/u', '', $firstLine);

        // Detect delimiter
        $delimiters = [',', ';', "\t", '|'];
        $bestDelim = ',';
        $maxCols = 0;
        foreach ($delimiters as $d) {
            $cnt = count(str_getcsv($firstLine, $d, '"', '\\'));
            if ($cnt > $maxCols) {
                $maxCols = $cnt;
                $bestDelim = $d;
            }
        }

        $rows = [];
        $firstRow = str_getcsv($firstLine, $bestDelim, '"', '\\');
        if (!empty(array_filter($firstRow, fn($v) => trim((string) $v) !== ''))) {
            $rows[] = $firstRow;
        }

        while (($data = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $bestDelim, '"', '\\')) !== false) {
            if ($data === [null] || empty(array_filter($data, fn($v) => trim((string) $v) !== ''))) {
                continue;
            }
            $rows[] = $data;
        }

        fclose($handle);
        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * Read XLSX directly via ZipArchive.
     */
    public static function readXlsx(string $path): array
    {
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($path) !== true) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('File Excel (.xlsx) tidak dapat dibaca.');
        }

        $shared = [];
        if (($xml = $zip->getFromName('xl/sharedStrings.xml')) !== false) {
            $doc = simplexml_load_string($xml);
            if ($doc && isset($doc->si)) {
                foreach ($doc->si as $item) {
                    $shared[] = (string) ($item->t ?? implode('', array_map('strval', $item->r->t ?? [])));
                }
            }
        }

        $sheetXml = $zip->getFromName('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml');
        if ($sheetXml === false) {
            for ($i = 1; $i <= 10; $i++) {
                $sheetXml = $zip->getFromName("xl/worksheets/sheet{$i}.xml");
                if ($sheetXml !== false) break;
            }
        }

        if ($sheetXml === false) {
            $zip->close();
            throw new \RuntimeException('Worksheet Excel tidak ditemukan.');
        }

        $sheet = simplexml_load_string($sheetXml);
        $rows = [];
        $headerWidth = 0;

        if ($sheet && isset($sheet->sheetData->row)) {
            foreach ($sheet->sheetData->row as $xmlRow) {
                $cells = [];
                $maxIdx = -1;
                foreach ($xmlRow->c as $cell) {
                    $ref = (string) $cell['r'];
                    preg_match('/([A-Z]+)/', $ref, $match);
                    $colLetters = $match[1] ?? 'A';
                    $column = 0;
                    foreach (str_split($colLetters) as $letter) {
                        $column = $column * 26 + ord($letter) - 64;
                    }
                    $idx = $column - 1;
                    if ($idx > $maxIdx) $maxIdx = $idx;

                    $value = (string) ($cell->v ?? '');
                    if ((string) $cell['t'] === 's') {
                        $value = $shared[(int) $value] ?? $value;
                    } elseif ((string) $cell['t'] === 'inlineStr' && isset($cell->is->t)) {
                        $value = (string) $cell->is->t;
                    }
                    $cells[$idx] = $value;
                }

                if ($maxIdx >= 0) {
                    if ($headerWidth === 0) $headerWidth = $maxIdx + 1;
                    $rowWidth = max($headerWidth, $maxIdx + 1);
                    $fullRow = [];
                    for ($c = 0; $c < $rowWidth; $c++) {
                        $fullRow[$c] = $cells[$c] ?? '';
                    }
                    if (!empty(array_filter($fullRow, fn($v) => trim((string) $v) !== ''))) {
                        $rows[] = $fullRow;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $zip->close();
        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * Parse date string or Excel numeric timestamp into Y-m-d format.
     */
    public static function parseDate($value): ?string
    {
        if ($value === null || trim((string) $value) === '') return null;
        $val = trim((string) $value);
        if (is_numeric($val) && (float) $val > 10000 && (float) $val < 70000) {
            return gmdate('Y-m-d', ((int) $val - 25569) * 86400);
        }
        $time = strtotime($val);
        return $time ? date('Y-m-d', $time) : null;
    }

    /**
     * Clean header/text string from invisible unicode characters and normalize whitespace.
     */
    public static function cleanString($str): string
    {
        return strtolower(trim(preg_replace('/[\x{200B}-\x{200D}\x{FEFF}\x{2060}\x{00A0}]/u', '', (string) $str)));
    }
}

File: app/Traits/HandlesCsvImports.php

<?php

namespace App\Traits;

trait HandlesCsvImports
{
    /**
     * Detect CSV delimiter (comma, semicolon, or tab).
     */
    protected function detectCsvDelimiter(string $filePath): string
    {
        $handle = fopen($filePath, 'r');
        if (!$handle) {
            return ',';
        }

        $firstLine = fgets($handle);
        fclose($handle);

        if (!$firstLine) {
            return ',';
        }

        if (substr_count($firstLine, ';') > substr_count($firstLine, ',')) {
            return ';';
        }

        if (substr_count($firstLine, "\t") > substr_count($firstLine, ',')) {
            return "\t";
        }

        return ',';
    }

    /**
     * Clean and normalize raw CSV header strings.
     */
    protected function cleanCsvHeaders(array $rawHeaders): array
    {
        $cleanHeaders = [];
        foreach ($rawHeaders as $idx => $h) {
            $clean = strtolower(trim(preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1F\x80-\xFF]/', '', (string)$h)));
            $clean = str_replace([' ', '_', '-', '.', '/', '(', ')'], '', $clean);
            $cleanHeaders[$idx] = $clean;
        }
        return $cleanHeaders;
    }

    /**
     * Safely parse numeric values from various localized formats (Indonesian, US, currency strings, floats).
     */
    protected function cleanNumeric($val, $default = 0): float
    {
        if ($val === null || $val === '') {
            return (float) $default;
        }

        if (is_numeric($val)) {
            return (float) $val;
        }

        $str = trim((string) $val);
        // Remove currency prefixes/letters and whitespace, keep digits, separators, signs, scientific notation
        $str = preg_replace('/[^\d.,\-+eE]/', '', $str);

        if ($str === '' || $str === '-' || $str === '+') {
            return (float) $default;
        }

        if (is_numeric($str)) {
            return (float) $str;
        }

        $hasDot = strpos($str, '.') !== false;
        $hasComma = strpos($str, ',') !== false;

        if ($hasDot && $hasComma) {
            $lastDot = strrpos($str, '.');
            $lastComma = strrpos($str, ',');
            if ($lastComma > $lastDot) {
                // Indonesian/EU style: 543.966.400,56 -> remove dots, change comma to dot
                $str = str_replace('.', '', $str);
                $str = str_replace(',', '.', $str);
            } else {
                // US style: 543,966,400.56 -> remove commas
                $str = str_replace(',', '', $str);
            }
        } elseif ($hasComma) {
            if (substr_count($str, ',') > 1) {
                $str = str_replace(',', '', $str);
            } else {
                $str = str_replace(',', '.', $str);
            }
        } elseif ($hasDot) {
            if (substr_count($str, '.') > 1) {
                $str = str_replace('.', '', $str);
            }
        }

        return is_numeric($str) ? (float) $str : (float) $default;
    }
}

================
File: app/Traits/LogsActivity.php
================
<?php

namespace App\Traits;

use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

trait LogsActivity
{
    public static function bootLogsActivity(): void
    {
        static::created(function ($model) {
            $module = static::getActivityModuleName();
            $label = static::getActivityModelLabel($model);

            ActivityLog::log(
                action: 'Tambah',
                module: $module,
                description: "Menambahkan data {$module} ({$label})",
                properties: [
                    'new' => static::filterActivityAttributes($model->getAttributes()),
                ]
            );
        });

        static::updated(function ($model) {
            $changes = $model->getChanges();
            $ignored = static::getIgnoredActivityAttributes();

            // Filter out ignored attributes & timestamps
            $changedKeys = array_filter(array_keys($changes), function ($key) use ($ignored) {
                return !in_array($key, $ignored);
            });

            if (empty($changedKeys)) {
                return;
            }

            $module = static::getActivityModuleName();
            $label = static::getActivityModelLabel($model);

            $oldValues = [];
            $newValues = [];

            foreach ($changedKeys as $key) {
                $oldValues[$key] = $model->getOriginal($key);
                $newValues[$key] = $changes[$key];
            }

            ActivityLog::log(
                action: 'Edit',
                module: $module,
                description: "Mengubah data {$module} ({$label})",
                properties: [
                    'old' => static::filterActivityAttributes($oldValues),
                    'new' => static::filterActivityAttributes($newValues),
                ]
            );
        });

        static::deleted(function ($model) {
            $module = static::getActivityModuleName();
            $label = static::getActivityModelLabel($model);

            ActivityLog::log(
                action: 'Hapus',
                module: $module,
                description: "Menghapus data {$module} ({$label})",
                properties: [
                    'old' => static::filterActivityAttributes($model->getAttributes()),
                ]
            );
        });
    }

    protected static function getActivityModuleName(): string
    {
        if (property_exists(static::class, 'logModuleName') && !empty(static::$logModuleName)) {
            return static::$logModuleName;
        }

        return Str::headline(class_basename(static::class));
    }

    protected static function getActivityModelLabel($model): string
    {
        if (method_exists($model, 'getActivityLabel')) {
            return $model->getActivityLabel();
        }

        return $model->name ?? $model->nama ?? $model->title ?? $model->kode ?? "ID: {$model->getKey()}";
    }

    protected static function getIgnoredActivityAttributes(): array
    {
        $defaultIgnored = ['password', 'remember_token', 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'deleted_at'];

        if (property_exists(static::class, 'dontLogAttributes') && is_array(static::$dontLogAttributes)) {
            return array_merge($defaultIgnored, static::$dontLogAttributes);
        }

        return $defaultIgnored;
    }

    protected static function filterActivityAttributes(array $attributes): array
    {
        $ignored = static::getIgnoredActivityAttributes();

        foreach ($ignored as $key) {
            unset($attributes[$key]);
        }

        return $attributes;
    }
}

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withRouting(
        web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
        api: __DIR__.'/../routes/api.php',
        commands: __DIR__.'/../routes/console.php',
        health: '/up',
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware): void {
        $middleware->redirectUsersTo('/admin');
    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions): void {
        $exceptions->shouldRenderJsonWhen(
            fn (Request $request) => $request->is('api/*') || $request->expectsJson(),
        );
    })->create();

    /*

    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    | running in. This may determine how you prefer to configure various
    | services the application utilizes. Set this in your ".env" file.
    |
    */

    'env' => env('APP_ENV', 'production'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Application Debug Mode
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When your application is in debug mode, detailed error messages with
    | stack traces will be shown on every error that occurs within your
    | application. If disabled, a simple generic error page is shown.
    |
    */

    'debug' => (bool) env('APP_DEBUG', false),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Application URL
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This URL is used by the console to properly generate URLs when using
    | the Artisan command line tool. You should set this to the root of
    | the application so that it's available within Artisan commands.
    |
    */

    'url' => env('APP_URL', 'http://localhost'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Application Timezone
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may specify the default timezone for your application, which
    | will be used by the PHP date and date-time functions. The timezone
    | is set to "UTC" by default as it is suitable for most use cases.
    |
    */

    'timezone' => env('APP_TIMEZONE', 'Asia/Jakarta'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Application Locale Configuration
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | The application locale determines the default locale that will be used

    | set to any locale for which you plan to have translation strings.

    'locale' => env('APP_LOCALE', 'en'),

    'fallback_locale' => env('APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE', 'en'),

    'faker_locale' => env('APP_FAKER_LOCALE', 'en_US'),

<?php

use App\Models\User;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Authentication Defaults
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option defines the default authentication "guard" and password
    | reset "broker" for your application. You may change these values
    | as required, but they're a perfect start for most applications.
    |
    */

    'defaults' => [
        'guard' => env('AUTH_GUARD', 'web'),
        'passwords' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_BROKER', 'users'),
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Authentication Guards
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Next, you may define every authentication guard for your application.
    | Of course, a great default configuration has been defined for you
    | which utilizes session storage plus the Eloquent user provider.
    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage
    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | Supported: "session"
    |
    */

    'guards' => [
        'web' => [
            'driver' => 'session',
            'provider' => 'users',
        ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | User Providers
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage
    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | If you have multiple user tables or models you may configure multiple
    | providers to represent the model / table. These providers may then
    | be assigned to any extra authentication guards you have defined.
    |
    | Supported: "database", "eloquent"
    |
    */

    'providers' => [
        'users' => [
            'driver' => 'eloquent',
            'model' => env('AUTH_MODEL', User::class),
        ],

        // 'users' => [
        //     'driver' => 'database',
        //     'table' => 'users',
        // ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Resetting Passwords
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | These configuration options specify the behavior of Laravel's password
    | reset functionality, including the table utilized for token storage
    | and the user provider that is invoked to actually retrieve users.
    |
    | The expiry time is the number of minutes that each reset token will be
    | considered valid. This security feature keeps tokens short-lived so
    | they have less time to be guessed. You may change this as needed.
    |
    | The throttle setting is the number of seconds a user must wait before
    | generating more password reset tokens. This prevents the user from
    | quickly generating a very large amount of password reset tokens.
    |
    */

    'passwords' => [
        'users' => [
            'provider' => 'users',
            'table' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_TABLE', 'password_reset_tokens'),
            'expire' => 60,
            'throttle' => 60,
        ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Password Confirmation Timeout
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may define the number of seconds before a password confirmation
    | window expires and users are asked to re-enter their password via the
    | confirmation screen. By default, the timeout lasts for three hours.
    |
    */

    'password_timeout' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_TIMEOUT', 10800),

];

<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Default Cache Store
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option controls the default cache store that will be used by the
    | framework. This connection is utilized if another isn't explicitly
    | specified when running a cache operation inside the application.
    |
    */

    'default' => env('CACHE_STORE', 'database'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Cache Stores
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may define all of the cache "stores" for your application as
    | well as their drivers. You may even define multiple stores for the
    | same cache driver to group types of items stored in your caches.
    |
    | Supported drivers: "array", "database", "file", "memcached",
    |                    "redis", "dynamodb", "storage", "octane",
    |                    "session", "failover", "null"
    |
    */

    'stores' => [

        'array' => [
            'driver' => 'array',
            'serialize' => false,
        ],

        'database' => [
            'driver' => 'database',
            'connection' => env('DB_CACHE_CONNECTION'),
            'table' => env('DB_CACHE_TABLE', 'cache'),
            'lock_connection' => env('DB_CACHE_LOCK_CONNECTION'),
            'lock_table' => env('DB_CACHE_LOCK_TABLE'),
        ],

        'file' => [
            'driver' => 'file',
            'path' => storage_path('framework/cache/data'),
            'lock_path' => storage_path('framework/cache/data'),
        ],

        'storage' => [
            'driver' => 'storage',
            'disk' => env('CACHE_STORAGE_DISK'),
            'path' => env('CACHE_STORAGE_PATH', 'framework/cache/data'),
        ],

        'memcached' => [
            'driver' => 'memcached',
            'persistent_id' => env('MEMCACHED_PERSISTENT_ID'),
            'sasl' => [
                env('MEMCACHED_USERNAME'),
                env('MEMCACHED_PASSWORD'),
            ],
            'options' => [
                // Memcached::OPT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT => 2000,
            ],
            'servers' => [
                [
                    'host' => env('MEMCACHED_HOST', '127.0.0.1'),
                    'port' => env('MEMCACHED_PORT', 11211),
                    'weight' => 100,
                ],
            ],
        ],

        'redis' => [
            'driver' => 'redis',
            'connection' => env('REDIS_CACHE_CONNECTION', 'cache'),
            'lock_connection' => env('REDIS_CACHE_LOCK_CONNECTION', 'default'),
        ],

        'dynamodb' => [
            'driver' => 'dynamodb',
            'key' => env('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'),
            'secret' => env('AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'),
            'region' => env('AWS_DEFAULT_REGION', 'us-east-1'),
            'table' => env('DYNAMODB_CACHE_TABLE', 'cache'),
            'endpoint' => env('DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT'),
        ],

        'octane' => [
            'driver' => 'octane',
        ],

        'failover' => [
            'driver' => 'failover',
            'stores' => [
                'database',
                'array',
            ],
        ],

    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Cache Key Prefix
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When utilizing the APC, database, memcached, Redis, and DynamoDB cache
    | stores, there might be other applications using the same cache. For
    | that reason, you may prefix every cache key to avoid collisions.
    |
    */

    'prefix' => env('CACHE_PREFIX', Str::slug((string) env('APP_NAME', 'laravel')).'-cache-'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Serializable Classes
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This value determines the classes that can be unserialized from cache
    | storage. By default, no PHP classes will be unserialized from your
    | cache to prevent gadget chain attacks if your APP_KEY is leaked.
    |
    */

    'serializable_classes' => false,

];

         * increase file size unless font subsetting is enabled. Before embedding a font please
         * review your rights under the font license.

         * Any font specification in the source HTML is translated to the closest font available
         * in the font directory.

         * The pdf standard "Base 14 fonts" are:

        'font_cache' => storage_path('fonts'),

         * Image DPI setting
         *
         * This setting determines the default DPI setting for images and fonts.  The
         * DPI may be overridden for inline images by explictly setting the
         * image's width & height style attributes (i.e. if the image's native
         * width is 600 pixels and you specify the image's width as 72 points,
         * the image will have a DPI of 600 in the rendered PDF.  The DPI of
         * background images can not be overridden and is controlled entirely
         * via this parameter.
         *
         * For the purposes of DOMPDF, pixels per inch (PPI) = dots per inch (DPI).
         * If a size in html is given as px (or without unit as image size),
         * this tells the corresponding size in pt.
         * This adjusts the relative sizes to be similar to the rendering of the
         * html page in a reference browser.

         * In pdf, always 1 pt = 1/72 inch
         *
         * Rendering resolution of various browsers in px per inch:
         * Windows Firefox and Internet Explorer:
         *   SystemControl->Display properties->FontResolution: Default:96, largefonts:120, custom:?

         * Take care about extra font/image zoom factor of browser.

         * the real image dimension in px for rendering.

File: database/factories/UserFactory.php

<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @extends Factory<User>
 */
class UserFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * The current password being used by the factory.
     */
    protected static ?string $password;

    /**
     * Define the model's default state.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => fake()->name(),
            'email' => fake()->unique()->safeEmail(),
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'password' => static::$password ??= Hash::make('password'),
            'remember_token' => Str::random(10),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Indicate that the model's email address should be unverified.
     */
    public function unverified(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'email_verified_at' => null,
        ]);
    }
}

File: database/migrations/2026_10_02_154834_fix_old_training_record_data.php
================
<?php

use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

return new class extends Migration
{
    /**
     * Run the migrations.
     */
    public function up(): void
    {
        // 1. Fix program_type in training_records
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('training_records')
            ->where('program_type', 'Non reguler')
            ->update(['program_type' => 'non_reguler']);

        // 2. Backfill tanggal_pelaksanaan in program_non_reguler
        $classes = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('daily_classes')->get();
        foreach ($classes as $c) {
            if (!$c->date) continue;

            $s = \Carbon\Carbon::parse($c->date);
            $e = $c->end_date ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($c->end_date) : $s;
            $t = $s->translatedFormat('d M Y');
            if ($c->end_date && $s->format('Y-m-d') !== $e->format('Y-m-d')) {
                $t .= ' - ' . $e->translatedFormat('d M Y');
            }

            $exists = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('program_non_reguler')
                ->where('id_nonreguler', $c->id)
                ->exists();

            if ($exists) {
                \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('program_non_reguler')
                    ->where('id_nonreguler', $c->id)
                    ->update([
                        'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => json_encode([$t]),
                    ]);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Reverse the migrations.
     */
    public function down(): void
    {
        // No reverse needed for data cleanup
    }
};

<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Console\Seeds\WithoutModelEvents;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;

class ResignedStaffSeeder extends Seeder
{
    /**
     * Run the database seeds.
     */
    public function run(): void
    {
        $clusters = ['Pindah perusahaan', 'Working Condition', 'Under perform', 'Keluarga', 'Efisiensi', 'Kasus', 'Pergi tanpa Keterangan', 'Habis Kontrak', 'Indisipliner'];
        $jabatans = ['Asisten Kebun', 'Askep', 'Manager Kebun', 'Asisten Bibitan', 'Group Manager Kebun', 'Plantation Controller'];
        $kebuns = ['Kebun KALE', 'Kebun SMM', 'Kebun ANJAS', 'Kebun ANJA', 'MSSP', 'KTBM', 'SAGM', 'USP', 'LS2', 'MKB2'];
        $regions = ['Riau', 'Kalbar', 'Kubar'];
        $jenis = ['Voluntary', 'Involuntary'];
        $alumnis = ['Alumni', 'Non Alumni'];

        $data = [];
        for ($i = 1; $i <= 100; $i++) {
            $year = rand(2025, 2026);
            $month = rand(1, 12);
            $day = rand(1, 28);
            $resignDate = sprintf('%04d-%02d-%02d', $year, $month, $day);
            $joinDate = sprintf('%04d-%02d-%02d', rand(2020, 2024), rand(1, 12), rand(1, 28));

            // Bias: Voluntary usually means Pindah Perusahaan, Working Condition. Involuntary usually Under Perform, Kasus, dll.
            $isVoluntary = (rand(1, 100) <= 70); // 70% voluntary
            $jenisResign = $isVoluntary ? 'Voluntary' : 'Involuntary';

            if ($isVoluntary) {
                $clusterKeys = ['Pindah perusahaan', 'Working Condition', 'Keluarga'];
                $cluster = $clusterKeys[array_rand($clusterKeys)];
            } else {
                $clusterKeys = ['Under perform', 'Efisiensi', 'Kasus', 'Indisipliner'];
                $cluster = $clusterKeys[array_rand($clusterKeys)];
            }

            $data[] = [
                'employee_id' => 'EMP' . rand(10000, 99999),
                'nama' => 'Dummy Staf ' . $i,
                'join_date' => $joinDate,
                'resign_date' => $resignDate,
                'jabatan' => $jabatans[array_rand($jabatans)],
                'kebun' => $kebuns[array_rand($kebuns)],
                'deskripsi_resign' => 'Deskripsi dummy resign',
                'jenis_resign' => $jenisResign,
                'cluster_resign' => $cluster,
                'alumni' => $alumnis[array_rand($alumnis)],
                'keterangan' => 'Keterangan dummy',
                'region' => $regions[array_rand($regions)],
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ];
        }

        \App\Models\Monitoring\ResignedStaff::insert($data);
    }
}

File: database/seeders/RoleSeeder.php

<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Console\Seeds\WithoutModelEvents;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role;

class RoleSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        // Reset cached roles and permissions
        app()[\Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar::class]->forgetCachedPermissions();

        // 1. Create Permissions
        $permissions = [
            'manage_articles',
            'manage_users',
            'manage_tv_display',
            'manage_events',
            'manage_roles',
            'access_administrasi',
            'view_cost',
            'edit_cost',
        ];

        foreach ($permissions as $permission) {
            \Spatie\Permission\Models\Permission::firstOrCreate(['name' => $permission]);
        }

        // 2. Create Roles and Assign Default Permissions

        // Superadmin bypasses everything, but we create it anyway
        Role::firstOrCreate(['name' => 'Superadmin']);

        // Admin E-Information gets specific default permissions
        $adminInfoRole = Role::firstOrCreate(['name' => 'Admin E-Information']);
        $adminInfoRole->syncPermissions(['manage_articles', 'manage_tv_display', 'manage_events']);

        // Administrasi role gets full access to Administrasi & Cost
        $administrasiRole = Role::firstOrCreate(['name' => 'Administrasi']);
        $administrasiRole->syncPermissions(['access_administrasi', 'view_cost', 'edit_cost']);

        // Staff role gets access to Administrasi and read-only access to Cost
        $staffRole = Role::firstOrCreate(['name' => 'Staff']);
        $staffRole->syncPermissions(['access_administrasi', 'view_cost']);

        // Top Management role gets full access to Administrasi & Cost
        $topMgmtRole = Role::firstOrCreate(['name' => 'Top Management']);
        $topMgmtRole->syncPermissions(['access_administrasi', 'view_cost', 'edit_cost']);

        // Other generic roles
        $otherRoles = [
            'Koordinator Mess',
            'Kepala TU',
            'Atasan',
            'Trainer',
        ];

        foreach ($otherRoles as $role) {
            Role::firstOrCreate(['name' => $role]);
        }
    }
}

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    <IfModule mod_negotiation.c>
        Options -MultiViews -Indexes
    </IfModule>

    RewriteEngine On

    # Handle Authorization Header
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:Authorization} .
    RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]

    # Handle X-XSRF-Token Header
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:x-xsrf-token} .
    RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_X_XSRF_TOKEN:%{HTTP:X-XSRF-Token}]

    # Redirect Trailing Slashes If Not A Folder...
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} (.+)/$
    RewriteRule ^ %1 [L,R=301]

    # Send Requests To Front Controller...
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
    RewriteRule ^ index.php [L]
</IfModule>

<?php

use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

define('LARAVEL_START', microtime(true));

// Determine if the application is in maintenance mode...
if (file_exists($maintenance = __DIR__.'/../storage/framework/maintenance.php')) {
    require $maintenance;
}

// Register the Composer autoloader...
require __DIR__.'/../vendor/autoload.php';

// Bootstrap Laravel and handle the request...
/** @var Application $app */
$app = require_once __DIR__.'/../bootstrap/app.php';

$app->handleRequest(Request::capture());

File: public/sw.js
================
const CACHE_NAME = 'trainee-pwa-cache-v2';
const urlsToCache = [
  '/manifest.json'
];

self.addEventListener('install', event => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME)
      .then(cache => {
        return cache.addAll(urlsToCache);
      })
  );
  self.skipWaiting();
});

self.addEventListener('activate', event => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then(cacheNames => {
      return Promise.all(
        cacheNames.map(cacheName => {
          if (cacheName !== CACHE_NAME) {
            return caches.delete(cacheName);
          }
        })
      );
    })
  );
  self.clients.claim();
});

self.addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  // Network First, fallback to cache
  event.respondWith(
    fetch(event.request).catch(() => {
      return caches.match(event.request);
    })
  );
});

        sessions: [
            { id: 1, title: 'Session A', date_start: '2026-09-11' },
            { id: 2, title: 'Session B', date_start: '2026-10-10' }
        ]
    }">
        <template x-for="(session, index) in sessions" :key="session.id">
            <div>
                <input type="text" x-model="sessions[index].title">
                <input type="date" x-model="sessions[index].date_start">
            </div>
        </template>
        <button @click="console.log(sessions)">Log</button>
    </div>
</body>
</html>

## About Laravel

Laravel is a web application framework with expressive, elegant syntax. We believe development must be an enjoyable and creative experience to be truly fulfilling. Laravel takes the pain out of development by easing common tasks used in many web projects, such as:

- [Simple, fast routing engine](https://laravel.com/docs/routing).
- [Powerful dependency injection container](https://laravel.com/docs/container).
- Multiple back-ends for [session](https://laravel.com/docs/session) and [cache](https://laravel.com/docs/cache) storage.
- Expressive, intuitive [database ORM](https://laravel.com/docs/eloquent).
- Database agnostic [schema migrations](https://laravel.com/docs/migrations).
- [Robust background job processing](https://laravel.com/docs/queues).
- [Real-time event broadcasting](https://laravel.com/docs/broadcasting).

Laravel is accessible, powerful, and provides tools required for large, robust applications.

## Learning Laravel

Laravel has the most extensive and thorough [documentation](https://laravel.com/docs) and video tutorial library of all modern web application frameworks, making it a breeze to get started with the framework.

In addition, [Laracasts](https://laracasts.com) contains thousands of video tutorials on a range of topics including Laravel, modern PHP, unit testing, and JavaScript. Boost your skills by digging into our comprehensive video library.

You can also watch bite-sized lessons with real-world projects on [Laravel Learn](https://laravel.com/learn), where you will be guided through building a Laravel application from scratch while learning PHP fundamentals.

## Agentic Development

Laravel's predictable structure and conventions make it ideal for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Install [Laravel Boost](https://laravel.com/docs/ai) to supercharge your AI workflow:

```bash
composer require laravel/boost --dev

php artisan boost:install
```

Boost provides your agent 15+ tools and skills that help agents build Laravel applications while following best practices.

## Contributing

Thank you for considering contributing to the Laravel framework! The contribution guide can be found in the [Laravel documentation](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions).

    @php
        $types = $programs->pluck('type')->unique()->values();
        $years = $programs->pluck('year')->unique()->sortDesc()->values();

        $defaultType = $types->first() ?? '';

        activeType: '{{ $defaultType }}',
        activeYear: '{{ $defaultYear }}',

            @endforeach

        classCounts: {
            @foreach($programs as $prog)
                '{{ $prog->id }}': {{ $dailyClasses->where('training_program_id', $prog->id)->count() }},
            @endforeach

        function openEditModal(classData) {
            document.getElementById('edit_training_program_id').value = classData.training_program_id;
            document.getElementById('edit_date').value = classData.date ? classData.date.substring(0, 10) : '';
            document.getElementById('edit_title').value = classData.title;
            document.getElementById('edit_trainer_name').value = classData.trainer_name;

            // Set action URL
            document.getElementById('editClassForm').action = `/training-reguler/daily-classes/${classData.id}`;

            document.getElementById('editDailyClassModal').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function closeEditModal() {
            document.getElementById('editDailyClassModal').classList.add('hidden');
        }
    </script>

    <!-- Script Preview Image -->
    <script>
        function previewImage(event) {
            const input = event.target;
            const container = document.getElementById('imagePreviewContainer');
            const preview = document.getElementById('imagePreview');

            if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
                const reader = new FileReader();

                reader.onload = function(e) {
                    preview.src = e.target.result;
                    container.classList.remove('hidden');
                }

                reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
            } else {
                container.classList.add('hidden');
                preview.src = '#';
            }
        }
    </script>

    <!-- AlpineJS CRUD Logic -->
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('crudModalMoa', (baseUrl, programs, trainers) => ({
                isOpen: false,
                isEdit: false,
                baseUrl: baseUrl,
                programs: programs,
                trainers: trainers,
                formAction: '',
                formData: {
                    training_program_id: '',
                    trainer_id: '',
                    week_start_date: '',
                    week_end_date: '',
                    status: 'draft',
                    notes: ''
                },
                openModal(data = null) {
                    this.isOpen = true;
                    if (data) {
                        this.isEdit = true;
                        this.formAction = this.baseUrl + '/' + data.id;
                        this.formData = { ...data };
                        // Convert dates if needed, usually Laravel passes YYYY-MM-DD strings so it should bind correctly
                    } else {
                        this.isEdit = false;
                        this.formAction = this.baseUrl;
                        this.formData = {
                            training_program_id: '',
                            trainer_id: '',
                            week_start_date: '',
                            week_end_date: '',
                            status: 'draft',
                            notes: ''
                        };
                    }
                }
            }));
        });
    </script>
</x-admin-layout>

        $types = $programs->pluck('type')->unique()->values();
        $defaultType = $types->first() ?? '';
    @endphp

    <div x-data="{
        activeType: '{{ $defaultType }}',
        activeProgram: null,
        programsData: [
            @foreach($programs as $prog)
                { id: '{{ $prog->id }}', name: '{{ addslashes($prog->name) }}', type: '{{ $prog->type }}' },
            @endforeach
        ],
        dailyClasses: [
            @foreach($dailyClasses as $class)
                { id: '{{ $class->id }}', training_program_id: '{{ $class->training_program_id }}' },
            @endforeach
        ],
        classCounts: {
            @foreach($programs as $prog)
                '{{ $prog->id }}': {{ $dailyClasses->where('training_program_id', $prog->id)->count() }},
            @endforeach
        },
        get filteredPrograms() {
            return this.programsData.filter(p => p.type === this.activeType);
        },
        getIconPath(name) {
            if (name.includes('Managerial')) return 'M21 13.255A23.931 23.931 0 0112 15c-3.183 0-6.22-.62-9-1.745M16 6V4a2 2 0 00-2-2h-4a2 2 0 00-2 2v2m4 6h.01M5 20h14a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z';

            if (name.includes('Traksi')) return 'M8 14H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V7a2 2 0 012-2h8a2 2 0 012 2v3m0 0l3-3h3v3.586a2 2 0 01-.586 1.414l-2 2A2 2 0 0116 15h-1m-4 0a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zm6 0a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z';

            if (name.includes('Administrasi')) return 'M9 5H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2M9 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2m-3 7h3m-3 4h3m-6-4h.01M9 16h.01';

        }
    }" x-init="
        if (filteredPrograms.length === 1) {
            activeProgram = filteredPrograms[0].id;
        }
        $watch('activeType', value => {
            if (filteredPrograms.length === 1) {
                activeProgram = filteredPrograms[0].id;
            } else {
                activeProgram = null;
            }
        });
    ">

        <script>
            function evaluationData() {
                return {
                    showEvalModal: false,
                    tab: 'summary', // summary, individual
                    evaluations: @json($evalArray),
                    questions: @json($questionTexts),
                    questionGroups: {
                        'A. Isi Materi Pelatihan': [1, 2, 3, 4],
                        'B. Instruktur / Trainer': [5, 6, 7, 8, 9],
                        'C. Fasilitas & Pelayanan': [10, 11, 12]
                    },
                    currentIndex: 0,
                    get currentEval() {
                        return this.evaluations[this.currentIndex] || {};

    <script>
        function copyToClipboard(elementId) {
            var copyText = document.getElementById(elementId);

            // Create a temporary textarea to hold the text
            var tempInput = document.createElement("textarea");
            tempInput.value = copyText.value;
            document.body.appendChild(tempInput);

            // Select and copy
            tempInput.select();
            document.execCommand("copy");

            // Remove the temporary element
            document.body.removeChild(tempInput);

            // Show feedback
            alert("Link Portal Peserta disalin ke clipboard!");
        }
    </script>

    <!-- AlpineJS CRUD Logic -->
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('crudModalMoa', (baseUrl, programs, trainers) => ({
                isOpen: false,
                isEdit: false,
                baseUrl: baseUrl,
                programs: programs,
                trainers: trainers,
                formAction: '',
                formData: {
                    training_program_id: '',
                    trainer_id: '',
                    week_start_date: '',
                    week_end_date: '',
                    status: 'draft',
                    notes: ''
                },
                openModal(data = null) {
                    this.isOpen = true;
                    if (data) {
                        this.isEdit = true;
                        this.formAction = this.baseUrl + '/' + data.id;
                        this.formData = { ...data };
                        // Convert dates if needed, usually Laravel passes YYYY-MM-DD strings so it should bind correctly
                    } else {
                        this.isEdit = false;
                        this.formAction = this.baseUrl;
                        this.formData = {
                            training_program_id: '',
                            trainer_id: '',
                            week_start_date: '',
                            week_end_date: '',
                            status: 'draft',
                            notes: ''
                        };
                    }
                }
            }));
        });
    </script>
</x-admin-layout>

                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-6">Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan. Data Trainee <span class="font-bold text-gray-800" x-text="deleteTitle"></span> akan dihapus permanen.</p>

                            <button type="button" @click="executeDelete()" class="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white bg-red-600 rounded-xl hover:bg-red-700 transition shadow-lg shadow-red-200">Ya, Hapus</button>
                        </div>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('crudModalTrainee', (baseUrl, programs) => ({
                showDeleteModal: false,
                deleteUrl: '',
                deleteTitle: '',
                confirmDelete(url, title) {
                    this.deleteUrl = url;
                    this.deleteTitle = title;
                    this.showDeleteModal = true;
                },
                executeDelete() {
                    if (this.deleteUrl) {
                        let form = document.createElement('form');
                        form.method = 'POST';
                        form.action = this.deleteUrl;
                        form.innerHTML = '@csrf @method("DELETE")';
                        document.body.appendChild(form);
                        form.submit();
                    }
                },
                isOpen: false,
                importOpen: false,
                importFile: null,
                importPreviewData: [],
                importPreviewHeaders: [],
                handleImportFile(event) {
                    const file = event.target.files[0];
                    this.importFile = file;
                    this.importPreviewData = [];
                    this.importPreviewHeaders = [];
                    if (!file) return;

                    if (typeof XLSX === 'undefined') {
                        console.warn('SheetJS library not loaded.');
                        return;
                    }

                    if(file.name.endsWith('.csv') || file.name.endsWith('.xls') || file.name.endsWith('.xlsx')) {
                        const reader = new FileReader();
                        reader.onload = (e) => {
                            const data = new Uint8Array(e.target.result);
                            const workbook = XLSX.read(data, {type: 'array'});
                            const firstSheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
                            const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[firstSheetName];
                            const json = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, {header: 1, defval: ''});

                            let headerIdx = 0;
                            while(headerIdx < json.length && json[headerIdx].length === 0) {
                                headerIdx++;
                            }
                            if(headerIdx < json.length) {
                                this.importPreviewHeaders = json[headerIdx];
                                this.importPreviewData = json.slice(headerIdx + 1, headerIdx + 4);
                            }
                        };
                        reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
                    }
                },
                isEdit: false,
                baseUrl: baseUrl,
                programs: programs,
                formAction: '',
                formData: {
                    nik: '', name: '', training_program_id: '', origin: '',
                    university: '', major: '', status: 'aktif',
                    birth_place: '', birth_date: '', resign_reason: '',
                    avg_inclass_score: '', inclass_rank: '',
                    avg_practice_score: '', practice_rank: ''
                },
                openModal(data = null) {
                    this.isOpen = true;
                    if (data) {
                        this.isEdit = true;
                        this.formAction = this.baseUrl + '/' + data.id;
                        this.formData = {
                            nik: data.nik || '',
                            name: data.name || '',
                            training_program_id: data.training_program_id || '',
                            origin: data.origin || '',
                            university: data.university || '',
                            major: data.major || '',
                            status: data.status || 'aktif',
                            birth_place: data.resignation?.birth_place || '',
                            birth_date: data.resignation?.birth_date || '',
                            resign_reason: data.resignation?.reason || '',
                            avg_inclass_score: data.resignation?.avg_inclass_score || '',
                            inclass_rank: data.resignation?.inclass_rank || '',
                            avg_practice_score: data.resignation?.avg_practice_score || '',
                            practice_rank: data.resignation?.practice_rank || ''
                        };
                    } else {
                        this.isEdit = false;
                        this.formAction = this.baseUrl;
                        this.formData = {
                            nik: '', name: '', training_program_id: '', origin: '',
                            university: '', major: '', status: 'aktif',
                            birth_place: '', birth_date: '', resign_reason: '',
                            avg_inclass_score: '', inclass_rank: '',
                            avg_practice_score: '', practice_rank: ''
                        };
                    }
                }
            }));
        });
    </script>
</x-admin-layout>

    $parseListLines = function ($text) {
        if (!$text) return collect();
        return collect(preg_split('/\r\n|\r|\n/', trim($text)))
            ->map(fn($line) => trim(preg_replace('/^(\d+\.\s*|[-•*]\s*)/', '', $line)))
            ->filter(fn($line) => $line !== '');
