<script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('editReportForm', (programs, initialTrainees, resigneesData, initialSubjects, initialQuizScores, initialRankings, initialRemedialNotes, existingPhotos, initialStripPreviews, allTrainees) => ({
                programs: programs,
          step: 1,
          weekStartDate: '{{ \Carbon\Carbon::parse($weeklyReport->week_start_date)->format("Y-m-d") }}',
          weekEndDate: '{{ \Carbon\Carbon::parse($weeklyReport->week_end_date)->format("Y-m-d") }}',
          nextStep() { if (this.step < 4) this.step++; },
          prevStep() { if (this.step > 1) this.step--; },
          submitWizard(){
                if(!this.selectedProgramId){alert('Bagian 1: Pilih Program Training!'); this.step=1; return;}
                if(!this.weekStartDate||!this.weekEndDate){alert('Bagian 1: Isi Tanggal Mulai dan Selesai!'); this.step=1; return;}
                const form = document.getElementById('wizard-form');
                if (!form.checkValidity()) {
                    form.reportValidity();
                    const firstInvalid = form.querySelector(':invalid');
                    if(firstInvalid) {
                        const stepDiv = firstInvalid.closest('[id^="wizard-step-"]');
                        if(stepDiv) {
                            const stepNum = parseInt(stepDiv.id.replace('wizard-step-', ''));
                            if(stepNum) this.step = stepNum;
                        }
                    }
                    return;
                }
                form.submit();
          },

                  selectedProgramId: {{ $weeklyReport->training_program_id }},
                trainees: initialTrainees || [],
                allTrainees: allTrainees || [],
                resignees: (resigneesData || []).map(r => ({ ...r, _uid: Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9) })),
                showQuizAndRanking: {{ $weeklyReport->quizScores->count() > 0 ? 'true' : 'false' }},
                subjects: initialSubjects || [],
                quizScores: initialQuizScores || {},
                rankings: initialRankings || {},
                remedialNotes: initialRemedialNotes || {},
                quizNotes: @json($weeklyReport->quiz_notes ?? ''),
                @php
                    $mappedSessions = $weeklyReport->trainingSessions->map(function($session) {
                        return [
                            'id' => $session->id,
                            'type' => $session->session_type,
                            'title' => $session->title,
                            'banner_right_text' => $session->banner_right_text ?? '',
                            'date_start' => $session->date_start ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($session->date_start)->format('Y-m-d') : '',
                            'date_end' => $session->date_end ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($session->date_end)->format('Y-m-d') : '',
                            'trainer_name' => $session->trainer_name ?? '',
                            'location' => $session->location ?? '',
                            'training_purpose' => $session->training_purpose ?? '',
                            'training_result' => $session->training_result ?? '',
                            'trainerPreview' => $session->trainer_photo_path ? '/storage/' . $session->trainer_photo_path : null,
                            'trainerFileName' => '',
                            'bannerPreviewLeft' => null,
                            'bannerPreviewRight' => null,
                            'docFiles' => [],
                            'docPreviews' => $session->photos->where('photo_type', 'dokumentasi')->map(function($p) {
                                return [
                                    'uid' => 'exist_' . $p->id,
                                    'url' => '/storage/' . $p->photo_path,
                                    'isExisting' => true,
                                    'id' => $p->id
                                ];
                            })->values()->toArray(),
                            'deleted_grid_photos' => [],
                            'existing_photos' => [
                                $session->photos->where('photo_type', 'banner_left')->first()->photo_path ?? null,
                                $session->photos->where('photo_type', 'banner_right')->first()->photo_path ?? null
                            ],
                            'showTujuan' => !empty($session->training_purpose),
                            'showHasil' => !empty($session->training_result),
                            'showTrainerPhoto' => !empty($session->trainer_photo_path),
                            'showDokumentasi' => $session->photos->count() > 0,
                            'showEval' => $session->evaluations->count() > 0,
                            'evaluations' => [
                                'baik_sekali' => [
                                    'materi' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Baik Sekali')->first()->materi_percentage ?? '',
                                    'trainer' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Baik Sekali')->first()->trainer_percentage ?? '',
                                    'fasilitas' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Baik Sekali')->first()->fasilitas_percentage ?? ''
                                ],
                                'baik' => [
                                    'materi' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Baik')->first()->materi_percentage ?? '',
                                    'trainer' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Baik')->first()->trainer_percentage ?? '',
                                    'fasilitas' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Baik')->first()->fasilitas_percentage ?? ''
                                ],
                                'cukup_baik' => [
                                    'materi' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Cukup Baik')->first()->materi_percentage ?? '',
                                    'trainer' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Cukup Baik')->first()->trainer_percentage ?? '',
                                    'fasilitas' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Cukup Baik')->first()->fasilitas_percentage ?? ''
                                ],
                                'kurang_baik' => [
                                    'materi' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Kurang Baik')->first()->materi_percentage ?? '',
                                    'trainer' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Kurang Baik')->first()->trainer_percentage ?? '',
                                    'fasilitas' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Kurang Baik')->first()->fasilitas_percentage ?? ''
                                ],
                                'tidak_baik' => [
                                    'materi' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Tidak Baik')->first()->materi_percentage ?? '',
                                    'trainer' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Tidak Baik')->first()->trainer_percentage ?? '',
                                    'fasilitas' => $session->evaluations->where('category', 'Tidak Baik')->first()->fasilitas_percentage ?? ''
                                ]
                            ],
                            'participants' => (object) $session->sessionParticipants->keyBy('trainee_id')->map(function($p) {
                                return [
                                    'participation_type' => $p->participation_type,
                                    'is_participating' => '1'
                                ];
                            })->toArray(),
                            'ojt' => (object) $session->ojtPlacements->keyBy('trainee_id')->map(function($o) {
                                return [
                                    'location_code' => $o->location_code,
                                    'region' => $o->region
                                ];
                            })->toArray(),
                            'showPeserta' => $session->sessionParticipants->count() > 0,
                            'showOjt' => $session->ojtPlacements->count() > 0
                        ];
                    });
                @endphp
                sessions: @json($mappedSessions),

                init() {
                    this.trainees.forEach(t => {
                        if (!this.quizScores[t.id]) {
                            this.quizScores[t.id] = {};
                        }
                     });
                      this.sessions.forEach(s => {
                          if(!s.ojt) s.ojt = {};
                          if(!s.participants) s.participants = {};
                          this.trainees.forEach(t => {
                              if(!s.ojt[t.id]) s.ojt[t.id] = { location_code: t.ojt_location_code || '', region: t.ojt_region || '' };
                              if(!s.participants[t.id]) s.participants[t.id] = { is_participating: false, participation_type: 'aktif' };
                          });
                      });
                    this.calculateRanks();
                },

                addResignee() {
                    this.resignees.push({
                        id: null,
                        _uid: Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
                        trainee_id: '',
                        traineeObj: null,
                        birth_place: '',
                        birth_date: '',
                        avg_inclass_score: '',
                        inclass_rank: '',
                        avg_practice_score: '',
                        practice_rank: '',
                        reason: '',
                        photoPreview: null
                    });
                },
                removeResignee(index) {
                    if(confirm('Hapus entri resign ini?')) {
                        this.resignees.splice(index, 1);
                    }
                },
                updateResigneeTrainee(index) {
                    const tId = this.resignees[index].trainee_id;
                    this.resignees[index].traineeObj = this.allTrainees.find(t => t.id == tId) || null;
                },
                handleResignPhoto(event, index) {
                    const file = event.target.files[0];
                    if (!file) return;
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = (e) => {
                        this.resignees[index].photoPreview = e.target.result;
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                },
                resignBannerPreview: existingPhotos.cp4 || null,
                handleResignBanner(event) {
                    const f = event.target.files[0];
                    if (!f) return;
                    const r = new FileReader();
                    r.onload = (e) => {
                        this.resignBannerPreview = e.target.result;
                    };
                    r.readAsDataURL(f);
                },
                clearResignBanner() {
                    this.resignBannerPreview = null;
                    const inp = document.getElementById('cover-photo-4');
                    if (inp) inp.value = '';
                },
                handleQuizPhoto(event) {
                    const file = event.target.files[0];
                    if (!file) return;
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = (e) => {
                        this.quizPhotoPreview = e.target.result;
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                },
                handleQuizPhoto2(event) {
                    const file = event.target.files[0];
                    if (!file) return;
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = (e) => {
                        this.quizPhotoPreview2 = e.target.result;
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                },

                addSubject() {
                    this.subjects.push('');
                },
                removeSubject(index) {
                    if (this.subjects.length > 1 && confirm('Hapus materi ujian ini?')) {
                        this.subjects.splice(index, 1);
                        Object.keys(this.quizScores).forEach(tId => {
                            for (let i = index; i < this.subjects.length; i++) {
                                this.quizScores[tId][i] = this.quizScores[tId][i+1];
                            }
                            delete this.quizScores[tId][this.subjects.length];
                        });
                        this.calculateRanks();
                    }
                },
                calculateRanks() {
                    let avgs = [];
                    this.trainees.forEach(t => {
                        let scores = this.quizScores[t.id] || {};
                        let sum = 0;
                        let count = 0;
                        this.subjects.forEach((subj, sIdx) => {
                            let val = parseFloat(scores[sIdx]);
                            if (!isNaN(val)) {
                                sum += val;
                                count++;
                            }
                        });
                        let avg = count > 0 ? (sum / count) : null;
                        avgs.push({ id: t.id, avg: avg });
                    });

                    let sorted = [...avgs].filter(a => a.avg !== null).sort((a, b) => b.avg - a.avg);

                    let newRankings = {};
                    sorted.forEach((item, index) => {
                        let rank = index + 1;
                        let group = '';
                        if (rank <= 3) group = 'Top';
                        else if (index >= sorted.length - 3) group = 'Bottom';

                        newRankings[item.id] = {
                            avg: item.avg.toFixed(2),
                            rank: rank,
                            group: group
                        };
                    });

                    avgs.filter(a => a.avg === null).forEach(item => {
                        newRankings[item.id] = { avg: null, rank: '', group: '' };
                    });

                    this.rankings = newRankings;
                },
                addSession() {
                    let newOjt = {};
                          let newParticipants = {};
                          this.trainees.forEach(t => {
                              newOjt[t.id] = { location_code: '', region: '' };
                              newParticipants[t.id] = { is_participating: false, participation_type: 'aktif' };
                          });
                          this.sessions.push({

                        id: Date.now(),
                        title: '',
                        banner_right_text: '',
                        trainerPreview: null,
                        trainerFileName: '',
                        bannerPreviewLeft: null,
                        bannerPreviewRight: null,
                        docFiles: [],
                        docPreviews: [],
                        deleted_grid_photos: [],
                        existing_photos: [],
                        showTujuan: false,
                        showHasil: false,
                        showTrainerPhoto: false,
                        showDokumentasi: true,
                        showEval: false,
                        showPeserta: false,
                        showOjt: false,
                        evaluations: {
                            baik_sekali: { materi: '', trainer: '', fasilitas: '' },
                            baik: { materi: '', trainer: '', fasilitas: '' },
                            cukup_baik: { materi: '', trainer: '', fasilitas: '' },
                            kurang_baik: { materi: '', trainer: '', fasilitas: '' },
                            tidak_baik: { materi: '', trainer: '', fasilitas: '' }
                        }
                    ,
                              ojt: newOjt,
                              participants: newParticipants
                          });
                },
                removeSession(index) {
                    if (confirm('Hapus sesi baru ini?')) this.sessions.splice(index, 1);
                },
                handleTrainerPhoto(event, index) {
                    const file = event.target.files[0];
                    if (!file) return;
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = (e) => { this.sessions[index].trainerPreview = e.target.result; this.sessions[index].trainerFileName = file.name; };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                },
                clearTrainerPhoto(index) {
                    this.sessions[index].trainerPreview = null;
                    this.sessions[index].trainerFileName = '';
                    document.querySelectorAll(`[name="sessions[${index}][trainer_photo]"]`).forEach(inp => inp.value = '');
                },
                handleBannerLeft(event, index) {
                    const file = event.target.files[0];
                    if (!file) return;
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = (e) => {
                        this.sessions[index].bannerPreviewLeft = e.target.result;
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                },
                handleBannerRight(event, index) {
                    const file = event.target.files[0];
                    if (!file) return;
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = (e) => {
                        this.sessions[index].bannerPreviewRight = e.target.result;
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                },
                addDocPhotos(event, index) {
                    // Clear previously selected NEW files since standard HTML input replaces them
                    this.sessions[index].docPreviews = this.sessions[index].docPreviews.filter(p => p.isExisting);
                    this.sessions[index].docFiles = [];

                    Array.from(event.target.files).forEach(file => {
                        this.sessions[index].docFiles.push(file);
                        const reader = new FileReader();
                        reader.onload = (e) => {
                            this.sessions[index].docPreviews.push({
                                uid: Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
                                url: e.target.result,
                                isExisting: false,
                                fileObj: file
                            });
                        };
                        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                    });
                },
                removeDocPhoto(index, pi) {
                    const preview = this.sessions[index].docPreviews[pi];
                    if (preview.isExisting) {
                        this.sessions[index].deleted_grid_photos.push(preview.id);
                    } else {
                        const fileIndex = this.sessions[index].docFiles.indexOf(preview.fileObj);
                        if (fileIndex > -1) {
                            this.sessions[index].docFiles.splice(fileIndex, 1);
                        }
                    }
                    this.sessions[index].docPreviews.splice(pi, 1);
                    this.$nextTick(() => this._rebuildDocInput(index));
                },
                _rebuildDocInput(index) {
                    const input = document.getElementById('doc-input-' + this.sessions[index].id);
                    if (!input) return;
                    const dt = new DataTransfer();
                    this.sessions[index].docFiles.forEach(f => dt.items.add(f));
                    input.files = dt.files;
                },

                // -------- Strip Photos (accumulative) --------
                stripFiles: [],
                stripPreviews: initialStripPreviews,
                covers: { 1: existingPhotos.cp1, 2: existingPhotos.cp2, 3: existingPhotos.cp3, 4: existingPhotos.cp4 },
                quizPhotoPreview: existingPhotos.cp5,
                quizPhotoPreview2: existingPhotos.cp6,
                coverMain: existingPhotos.cpMain,
                showPage2: (existingPhotos.cpMain !== null || initialStripPreviews.length > 0),
                handleCover(event, n) {
                    const f = event.target.files[0];
                    if (!f) return;
                    const r = new FileReader();
                    r.onload = (e) => { this.covers[n] = e.target.result; };
                    r.readAsDataURL(f);
                },
                clearCover(n) {
                    this.covers[n] = null;
                    const inp = document.getElementById('cover-photo-' + n);
                    if (inp) inp.value = '';
                },
                clearAllStrip() {
                    this.stripFiles = [];
                    this.stripPreviews = [];
                    this.$nextTick(() => { this._rebuildStripInput(); });
                },
                addStripPhotos(event) {
                    const newFiles = Array.from(event.target.files);
                    newFiles.forEach(file => {
                        const isDup = this.stripFiles.some(f => f.name === file.name && f.size === file.size && f.lastModified === file.lastModified);
                        if (!isDup) {
                            this.stripFiles.push(file);
                            const reader = new FileReader();
                            reader.onload = (e) => {
                                this.stripPreviews.push({
                                    uid: `${file.name}-${file.size}-${Date.now()}`,
                                    url: e.target.result,
                                    name: file.name
                                });
                            };
                            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                        }
                    });
                    this.$nextTick(() => { this._rebuildStripInput(); });
                    event.target.value = '';
                },
                removeStripPhoto(index) {
                    this.stripFiles.splice(index, 1);
                    this.stripPreviews.splice(index, 1);
                    this.$nextTick(() => { this._rebuildStripInput(); });
                },
                _rebuildStripInput() {
                    const input = document.getElementById('cover-strip');
                    if (!input) return;
                    const dt = new DataTransfer();
                    this.stripFiles.forEach(f => dt.items.add(f));
                    input.files = dt.files;
                }
            }))

        Alpine.data('coverPhotoManager', (existingPhotos, initialStripPreviews) => ({

                if (inp) inp.value = '';
            },
            clearAllStrip() {
                this.stripFiles = [];
                this.stripPreviews = [];

            },
            addStripPhotos(event) {

                    }

            },

                this.stripPreviews.splice(index, 1);
                this.$nextTick(() => { this._rebuildStripInput(); });
            },
            _rebuildStripInput() {

    window.handleAutoNumbering = function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            const el = e.target;
            const start = el.selectionStart;
            const end = el.selectionEnd;
            const text = el.value;
            const lines = text.substr(0, start).split('\n');
            const lastLine = lines[lines.length - 1];

            const matchNum = lastLine.match(/^\s*(\d+)([\.\)]?\s+)(.*)/);
            const matchBul = lastLine.match(/^\s*([-*•])(\s+)(.*)/);

            if (matchNum) {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (matchNum[3].trim() === '') {
                    const newText = text.substring(0, start - lastLine.length) + text.substring(end);
                    el.value = newText;
                    el.selectionStart = el.selectionEnd = start - lastLine.length;
                } else {
                    const nextNum = parseInt(matchNum[1]) + 1;
                    const insertText = '\n' + nextNum + matchNum[2];
                    el.value = text.substring(0, start) + insertText + text.substring(end);
                    el.selectionStart = el.selectionEnd = start + insertText.length;
                }
                el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            } else if (matchBul) {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (matchBul[3].trim() === '') {
                    const newText = text.substring(0, start - lastLine.length) + text.substring(end);
                    el.value = newText;
                    el.selectionStart = el.selectionEnd = start - lastLine.length;
                } else {
                    const insertText = '\n' + matchBul[1] + matchBul[2];
                    el.value = text.substring(0, start) + insertText + text.substring(end);
                    el.selectionStart = el.selectionEnd = start + insertText.length;
                }
                el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            }
        }
    };

        window.handleAutoNumberingFocus = function(e) {
            const el = e.target;
            if (el.value.trim() === '') {
                el.value = '1. ';
                el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            }
        };
</script>
</x-admin-layout>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('reportList', () => ({
                selected: [],
                showWizard: false,
                showDeleteModal: false,
                deleteId: null,
                deleteTitle: '',
                confirmDelete(id, title) {
                    this.deleteId = id;
                    this.deleteTitle = title;
                    this.showDeleteModal = true;
                },
                executeDelete() {
                    if (this.deleteId) {
                        document.getElementById('delete-form-' + this.deleteId).submit();
                    }
                },
                showUnmergeModal: false,
                unmergeId: null,
                unmergeTitle: '',
                confirmUnmerge(id, title) {
                    this.unmergeId = id;
                    this.unmergeTitle = title;
                    this.showUnmergeModal = true;
                },
                executeUnmerge() {
                    if (this.unmergeId) {
                        document.getElementById('unmerge-form-' + this.unmergeId).submit();
                    }
                },
                closeWizard() {
                    this.showWizard = false;
                },
                selectAll(e) {
                    if(e.target.checked) {
                        this.selected = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.report-checkbox')).map(cb => cb.value);
                    } else {
                        this.selected = [];
                    }
                }
            }))
        })
    </script>

@php
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
    $allPhotos = $weeklyReport->trainingSessions->flatMap(fn($s) => $s->photos);

    $parseListLines = function ($text) {
        if (!$text) return collect();
        return collect(preg_split('/\r\n|\r|\n/', trim($text)))
            ->map(fn($line) => trim(preg_replace('/^(\d+\.\s*|[-•*]\s*)/', '', $line)))
            ->filter(fn($line) => $line !== '');
    };

    {{-- JAVASCRIPT FOR MODAL FETCH & DIFF RENDER --}}
    <script>
        function openDetailModal(id) {
            const modal = document.getElementById('modalDetail');
            const loading = document.getElementById('modalLoading');
            const body = document.getElementById('modalBody');
            const subTitle = document.getElementById('modalSubTitle');
            const diffContainer = document.getElementById('diffContainer');

            modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            loading.classList.remove('hidden');
            body.classList.add('hidden');
            diffContainer.innerHTML = '';
            subTitle.textContent = '';

            fetch(`/administrasi/activity-logs/${id}`)
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(response => {
                    if (response.status === 'success') {
                        const log = response.data;
                        subTitle.textContent = `${log.action} pada modul ${log.module} oleh ${log.user_name} (${log.created_at})`;

                        const props = log.properties || {};
                        let html = '';

                        if (props.old && props.new) {
                            // EDIT ACTION: Side by side / changed keys comparison
                            html += `
                                <div class="font-semibold text-[#18181B] mb-2">Kolom Yang Diubah:</div>
                                <div class="overflow-x-auto border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-lg">
                                    <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                                        <thead class="bg-[#F9FAFB] text-[#71717A] uppercase font-bold border-b border-[#E5E7EB]">
                                            <tr>
                                                <th class="p-2.5">Field</th>
                                                <th class="p-2.5 text-rose-600 bg-rose-50/50">Nilai Lama</th>
                                                <th class="p-2.5 text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50/50">Nilai Baru</th>
                                            </tr>
                                        </thead>
                                        <tbody class="divide-y divide-[#E5E7EB]">
                            `;

                            const allKeys = Array.from(new Set([...Object.keys(props.old), ...Object.keys(props.new)]));

                            allKeys.forEach(key => {
                                const oldVal = formatVal(props.old[key]);
                                const newVal = formatVal(props.new[key]);

                                html += `
                                    <tr>
                                        <td class="p-2.5 font-semibold text-[#374151] bg-[#F9FAFB] font-mono">${key}</td>
                                        <td class="p-2.5 bg-rose-50/30 text-rose-800 break-words">${oldVal}</td>
                                        <td class="p-2.5 bg-emerald-50/30 text-emerald-800 break-words">${newVal}</td>
                                    </tr>
                                `;
                            });

                            html += `</tbody></table></div>`;
                        } else if (props.new) {
                            // CREATE ACTION: Display created attributes
                            html += `
                                <div class="font-semibold text-[#18181B] mb-2">Data Baru Ditambahkan:</div>
                                <div class="overflow-x-auto border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-lg">
                                    <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                                        <thead class="bg-[#F9FAFB] text-[#71717A] uppercase font-bold border-b border-[#E5E7EB]">
                                            <tr>
                                                <th class="p-2.5 w-1/3">Field</th>
                                                <th class="p-2.5 text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50/50">Nilai</th>
                                            </tr>
                                        </thead>
                                        <tbody class="divide-y divide-[#E5E7EB]">
                            `;

                            Object.keys(props.new).forEach(key => {
                                html += `
                                    <tr>
                                        <td class="p-2.5 font-semibold text-[#374151] bg-[#F9FAFB] font-mono">${key}</td>
                                        <td class="p-2.5 bg-emerald-50/20 text-[#18181B] break-words">${formatVal(props.new[key])}</td>
                                    </tr>
                                `;
                            });

                            html += `</tbody></table></div>`;
                        } else if (props.old) {
                            // DELETE ACTION: Display deleted attributes
                            html += `
                                <div class="font-semibold text-[#18181B] mb-2">Data Yang Dihapus:</div>
                                <div class="overflow-x-auto border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-lg">
                                    <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                                        <thead class="bg-[#F9FAFB] text-[#71717A] uppercase font-bold border-b border-[#E5E7EB]">
                                            <tr>
                                                <th class="p-2.5 w-1/3">Field</th>
                                                <th class="p-2.5 text-rose-600 bg-rose-50/50">Nilai Terhapus</th>
                                            </tr>
                                        </thead>
                                        <tbody class="divide-y divide-[#E5E7EB]">
                            `;

                            Object.keys(props.old).forEach(key => {
                                html += `
                                    <tr>
                                        <td class="p-2.5 font-semibold text-[#374151] bg-[#F9FAFB] font-mono">${key}</td>
                                        <td class="p-2.5 bg-rose-50/20 text-[#18181B] break-words">${formatVal(props.old[key])}</td>
                                    </tr>
                                `;
                            });

                            html += `</tbody></table></div>`;
                        } else {
                            html = `<pre class="bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded text-xs font-mono overflow-x-auto">${JSON.stringify(props, null, 2)}</pre>`;
                        }

                        diffContainer.innerHTML = html;
                        loading.classList.add('hidden');
                        body.classList.remove('hidden');
                        if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => {
                    loading.classList.add('hidden');
                    diffContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="p-3 bg-red-50 text-red-700 rounded-lg">Gagal mengambil detail log data.</div>`;
                    body.classList.remove('hidden');
                });
        }

        function closeDetailModal() {
            document.getElementById('modalDetail').classList.add('hidden');
        }

        function formatVal(val) {
            if (val === null || val === undefined) return '<span class="italic text-gray-400">null</span>';
            if (typeof val === 'object') return JSON.stringify(val);
            return String(val);
        }
    </script>
</x-admin-layout>

@push('scripts')
<script>
    const MONTHS = ['jan', 'feb', 'mar', 'apr', 'mei', 'jun', 'jul', 'agu', 'sep', 'okt', 'nov', 'des'];

    // Modal Helpers
    const openModal = (id) => document.getElementById(id)?.classList.remove('hidden');
    const closeModal = (id) => document.getElementById(id)?.classList.add('hidden');

    function openAddModal() {
        openModal('addModal');
        calculateSisa('add');
        updateMonthlySum('add');
    }

    function openNewYearModal() {
        openModal('newYearModal');
    }

    // Unified Calculations for Add & Edit
    function calculateSisa(prefix) {
        const hak = parseInt(document.getElementById(`${prefix}_hak_cuti`)?.value) || 0;
        const carryover = parseInt(document.getElementById(`${prefix}_carryover`)?.value) || 0;
        const taken = parseInt(document.getElementById(`${prefix}_cuti_diambil`)?.value) || 0;
        const sisa = hak + carryover - taken;

        const badge = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_sisa_cuti_badge`);
        if (badge) {
            badge.innerText = sisa;
            badge.className = 'px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-white font-extrabold text-xl shadow-xs ' +
                (sisa > 0 ? 'bg-emerald-600' : (sisa === 0 ? 'bg-gray-600' : 'bg-rose-600'));
        }
    }

    function updateMonthlySum(prefix) {
        const total = MONTHS.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (parseInt(document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${m}`)?.value) || 0), 0);
        const disp = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_total_bulan_display`);
        if (disp) disp.innerText = total;
    }

    function syncMonthlyToTotal(prefix) {
        const total = MONTHS.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (parseInt(document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${m}`)?.value) || 0), 0);
        const takenInput = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_cuti_diambil`);
        if (takenInput) {
            takenInput.value = total;
            calculateSisa(prefix);
        }
    }

    // Aliases for HTML event handlers
    const calculateAddSisa = () => calculateSisa('add');
    const calculateEditSisa = () => calculateSisa('edit');
    const updateAddMonthlySum = () => updateMonthlySum('add');
    const updateEditMonthlySum = () => updateMonthlySum('edit');
    const syncAddMonthlyToTotal = () => syncMonthlyToTotal('add');
    const syncEditMonthlyToTotal = () => syncMonthlyToTotal('edit');

    // Edit Modal Ajax
    function openEditModal(id) {
        fetch(`/administrasi/cuti/${id}`)
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(res => {
                if (res.success) {
                    const data = res.data;
                    document.getElementById('editForm').action = `/administrasi/cuti/${id}`;
                    document.getElementById('edit_modal_subtitle').innerText = `${data.nama} (${data.nik})`;

                    document.getElementById('edit_nik').value = data.nik;
                    document.getElementById('edit_nama').value = data.nama;
                    document.getElementById('edit_jabatan').value = data.jabatan !== '-' ? data.jabatan : '';
                    if (document.getElementById('edit_jenis_jabatan')) {
                        document.getElementById('edit_jenis_jabatan').value = data.jenis_jabatan !== '-' ? data.jenis_jabatan : 'Staf';
                    }
                    document.getElementById('edit_tmk').value = data.tmk_raw || '';
                    document.getElementById('edit_periode_hak_cuti').value = data.periode_hak_cuti;
                    document.getElementById('edit_hak_cuti').value = data.hak_cuti;
                    document.getElementById('edit_carryover').value = data.sisa_hak_cuti_carryover;
                    document.getElementById('edit_cuti_diambil').value = data.cuti_diambil;

                    MONTHS.forEach(m => {
                        const input = document.getElementById(`edit_${m}`);
                        if (input) input.value = data.monthly[m] || 0;
                    });

                    updateMonthlySum('edit');
                    calculateSisa('edit');
                    openModal('editModal');
                }
            })
            .catch(err => {
                console.error(err);
                alert('Gagal memuat data cuti untuk diedit.');
            });
    }

    // Detail Modal Ajax
    function showEmployeeDetail(id) {
        fetch(`/administrasi/cuti/${id}`)
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(res => {
                if (res.success) {
                    const data = res.data;
                    document.getElementById('detail_nama').innerText = data.nama;
                    document.getElementById('detail_nik').innerText = data.nik;
                    document.getElementById('detail_jabatan').innerText = data.jabatan;
                    if (document.getElementById('detail_jenis_jabatan')) {
                        document.getElementById('detail_jenis_jabatan').innerText = data.jenis_jabatan || '-';
                    }
                    if (document.getElementById('detail_kategori')) {
                        document.getElementById('detail_kategori').innerText = data.jenis_jabatan || '-';
                    }
                    document.getElementById('detail_tmk').innerText = data.tmk;

                    // Initials for avatar
                    const initials = data.nama.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).slice(0, 2).join('').toUpperCase();
                    document.getElementById('detail_avatar').innerText = initials || 'EM';

                    document.getElementById('detail_hak_cuti').innerText = data.hak_cuti;
                    document.getElementById('detail_periode_hak').innerText = data.periode_hak_cuti;
                    document.getElementById('detail_cuti_diambil').innerText = data.cuti_diambil;
                    document.getElementById('detail_sisa_cuti').innerText = data.sisa_cuti;
                    document.getElementById('detail_carryover').innerText = data.sisa_hak_cuti_carryover + ' Hari';
                    document.getElementById('detail_carryover_label').innerText = data.periode_sisa_carryover_label;
                    document.getElementById('detail_total_bulanan').innerText = data.total_bulanan + ' Hari';

                    // Sisa box styling
                    const sisaBox = document.getElementById('detail_sisa_box');
                    const sisaText = document.getElementById('detail_sisa_cuti');
                    if (data.sisa_cuti < 0) {
                        sisaBox.className = 'bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl p-3 text-center';
                        sisaText.className = 'text-xl font-extrabold text-rose-600 mt-0.5';
                    } else if (data.sisa_cuti === 0) {
                        sisaBox.className = 'bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-3 text-center';
                        sisaText.className = 'text-xl font-extrabold text-gray-700 mt-0.5';
                    } else {
                        sisaBox.className = 'bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl p-3 text-center';
                        sisaText.className = 'text-xl font-extrabold text-emerald-700 mt-0.5';
                    }

                    MONTHS.forEach(m => {
                        const el = document.getElementById(`detail_m_${m}`);
                        if (el) el.innerText = data.monthly[m] > 0 ? data.monthly[m] : '-';
                    });

                    openModal('detailModal');
                }
            })
            .catch(err => {
                console.error(err);
                alert('Gagal memuat detail karyawan.');
            });
    }

    // Delete Confirmation
    function confirmDelete(id, name, nik) {
        document.getElementById('deleteForm').action = `/administrasi/cuti/${id}`;
        document.getElementById('delete_emp_name').innerText = name;
        document.getElementById('delete_emp_nik').innerText = nik;
        openModal('deleteModal');
    }

    // Year Navigation & Tambah Tahun
    function scrollYearTabs(direction) {
        const container = document.getElementById('yearTabsContainer');
        if (!container) return;
        const scrollAmount = 240;
        container.scrollBy({ left: direction === 'left' ? -scrollAmount : scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    function openTambahTahunModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
        if (modal) {
            modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.focus(), 100);
        }
    }

    function openNewYearModal() {
        openTambahTahunModal();
    }

    function closeTambahTahunModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
        if (modal) modal.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function handleTambahTahun(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const year = document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.value;
        if (!year) return;
        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
        url.searchParams.set('year', year);
        window.location.href = url.toString();
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const activeTab = document.getElementById('year-tab-{{ $selectedYear }}');
        if (activeTab) {
            activeTab.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' });
        }
    });
</script>

@push('scripts')
<script>
    function scrollYearTabs(direction) {
        const container = document.getElementById('yearTabsContainer');
        if (!container) return;
        const scrollAmount = 240;
        container.scrollBy({ left: direction === 'left' ? -scrollAmount : scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    function openTambahTahunModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
        if (modal) {
            modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.focus(), 100);
        }
    }

    function closeTambahTahunModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
        if (modal) modal.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function handleTambahTahun(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const year = document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.value;
        if (!year) return;
        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
        url.searchParams.set('year', year);
        window.location.href = url.toString();
    }

    function openModal(id) {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeModal(id) {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function openAddModal() {
        openModal('addModal');
    }

    function openEditModal(jabatan) {
        const year = '{{ $selectedYear }}';
        const month = '{{ $selectedMonth }}';

        fetch(`/administrasi/mpp/get-by-jabatan?nama_jabatan=${encodeURIComponent(jabatan)}&tahun=${year}&bulan=${month}`)
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(res => {
                if (res.success) {
                    const data = res.data;
                    document.getElementById('edit_original_nama_jabatan').value = data.nama_jabatan;
                    document.getElementById('edit_nama_jabatan').value = data.nama_jabatan;
                    document.getElementById('edit_staff').value = data.counts.Staff || 0;
                    document.getElementById('edit_pbt').value = data.counts.PBT || 0;
                    document.getElementById('edit_kht').value = data.counts.KHT || 0;
                    document.getElementById('edit_khl').value = data.counts.KHL || 0;
                    openModal('editModal');
                }
            })
            .catch(err => {
                console.error(err);
                alert('Gagal memuat data MPP untuk diedit.');
            });
    }

    function confirmDelete(jabatan) {
        document.getElementById('delete_jabatan_name').innerText = jabatan;
        document.getElementById('delete_nama_jabatan').value = jabatan;
        openModal('deleteModal');
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const activeTab = document.getElementById('year-tab-{{ $selectedYear }}');
        if (activeTab) {
            activeTab.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' });
        }
    });
</script>
@endpush

</x-admin-layout>

@push('scripts')
<script>
function scrollYearTabs(direction) {
    const container = document.getElementById('yearTabsContainer');
    if (!container) return;
    const scrollAmount = 240;
    container.scrollBy({ left: direction === 'left' ? -scrollAmount : scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

function openTambahTahunModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
    if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.focus(), 100);
    }
}

function closeTambahTahunModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
    if (modal) modal.classList.add('hidden');
}

function handleTambahTahun(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const year = document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.value;
    if (!year) return;
    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    url.searchParams.set('year', year);
    window.location.href = url.toString();
}

function handleFileSelected(input) {
    if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
        document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay').innerText = input.files[0].name;
    }
}

function openEditModal(id) {
    fetch(`/administrasi/biaya-rekruit/${id}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(res => {
            if (!res.success) return;
            const d = res.data;
            document.getElementById('formEdit').action = `/administrasi/biaya-rekruit/${id}`;
            document.getElementById('edit_tanggal').value          = d.tanggal ? d.tanggal.substring(0, 10) : '';
            document.getElementById('edit_nama').value             = d.nama             || '';
            document.getElementById('edit_total_biaya').value      = d.total_biaya      || 0;
            document.getElementById('edit_jenis_rekruit').value    = d.jenis_rekruit    || '';
            document.getElementById('edit_penanggung_jawab').value = d.penanggung_jawab || '';
            document.getElementById('modalEdit').classList.remove('hidden');
        });
}

function openDeleteModal(id, name) {
    document.getElementById('delete_name_label').textContent = name;
    document.getElementById('formDelete').action = `/administrasi/biaya-rekruit/${id}`;
    document.getElementById('modalDelete').classList.remove('hidden');
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const activeTab = document.getElementById('year-tab-{{ $selectedYear }}');
    if (activeTab) {
        activeTab.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' });
    }
});
</script>
@endpush
</x-admin-layout>

            </div>
        </div>
        <p class="text-2xl font-bold text-[#18181B] tracking-tight">
            Rp {{ number_format($summary['totalRealisasi'], 0, ',', '.') }}

        </div>
    </div>

    {{-- Sisa RAB (Budget Balance) --}}
    @php
        $isOver = $summary['sisaRab'] < 0;

            <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-[#71717A] uppercase tracking-wider">Sisa Anggaran (Balance)</span>
            <div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl {{ $isOver ? 'bg-red-50 border border-red-100 text-red-600' : 'bg-green-50 border border-green-100 text-green-600' }} flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
                <i data-lucide="{{ $isOver ? 'alert-octagon' : 'piggy-bank' }}" class="w-4 h-4"></i>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="flex items-baseline gap-2">
            <p class="text-2xl font-bold {{ $isOver ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-green-600' }} tracking-tight">

</div>

function toggleTemplateMenu(e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    document.getElementById('templateMenu').classList.toggle('hidden');
    document.getElementById('exportMenu').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('addMenu').classList.add('hidden');
}

function toggleExportMenu(e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    document.getElementById('exportMenu').classList.toggle('hidden');
    document.getElementById('templateMenu').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('addMenu').classList.add('hidden');
}

function toggleAddMenu(e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    document.getElementById('addMenu').classList.toggle('hidden');
    document.getElementById('templateMenu').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('exportMenu').classList.add('hidden');
}

document.addEventListener('click', function() {
    const tm = document.getElementById('templateMenu');
    const em = document.getElementById('exportMenu');
    const am = document.getElementById('addMenu');
    if (tm) tm.classList.add('hidden');
    if (em) em.classList.add('hidden');
    if (am) am.classList.add('hidden');
});

// ============================================================
// MODAL CONTROLS: ADD RAB
// ============================================================
function openAddRabModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalAddRab').classList.remove('hidden');
}

function openAddRabModalPreset(lokasi) {
    if (lokasi === 'kantor') {
        const el = document.getElementById('add_rab_lokasi_kantor');
        if (el) el.checked = true;
    } else if (lokasi === 'mess') {
        const el = document.getElementById('add_rab_lokasi_mess');
        if (el) el.checked = true;
    }
    openAddRabModal();
}

function closeAddRabModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalAddRab').classList.add('hidden');
}

function calcAddRabTotal() {
    const qty = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_rab_qty')?.value) || 0;
    const harga = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_rab_harga')?.value) || 0;
    const total = qty * harga;
    const preview = document.getElementById('add_rab_total_preview');
    if (preview) preview.textContent = 'Rp ' + total.toLocaleString('id-ID');
}

// ============================================================
// MODAL CONTROLS: ADD REALISASI
// ============================================================
function openAddRealisasiModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalAddRealisasi').classList.remove('hidden');
}

function openAddRealisasiModalPreset(lokasi) {
    if (lokasi === 'kantor') {
        const el = document.getElementById('add_rel_lokasi_kantor');
        if (el) el.checked = true;
    } else if (lokasi === 'mess') {
        const el = document.getElementById('add_rel_lokasi_mess');
        if (el) el.checked = true;
    }
    openAddRealisasiModal();
}

function closeAddRealisasiModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalAddRealisasi').classList.add('hidden');
}

function onRabSelected(select) {
    const selectedOption = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
    if (!selectedOption || !selectedOption.value) return;

    const lokasi = selectedOption.getAttribute('data-lokasi');
    const kelompok = selectedOption.getAttribute('data-kelompok');
    const type = selectedOption.getAttribute('data-type');
    const harga = selectedOption.getAttribute('data-harga');

    if (lokasi === 'kantor') {
        const el = document.getElementById('add_rel_lokasi_kantor');
        if (el) el.checked = true;
    } else if (lokasi === 'mess') {
        const el = document.getElementById('add_rel_lokasi_mess');
        if (el) el.checked = true;
    }

    if (kelompok) document.getElementById('add_rel_kel_barang').value = kelompok;
    if (type && type !== '-') document.getElementById('add_rel_type').value = type;
    if (harga) {
        document.getElementById('add_rel_debit').value = harga;
        calcAddRelTotal();
    }
}

function calcAddRelTotal() {
    const debit = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_rel_debit')?.value) || 0;
    const kredit = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_rel_kredit')?.value) || 0;
    const total = debit - kredit;
    const preview = document.getElementById('add_rel_total_preview');
    if (preview) preview.textContent = 'Rp ' + total.toLocaleString('id-ID');
}

// ============================================================
// MODAL CONTROLS: EDIT RAB
// ============================================================
function openEditRabModal(id) {
    fetch(`/administrasi/capex/rab/${id}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(res => {
            if (!res.success) return;
            const d = res.data;

            document.getElementById('formEditRab').action = `/administrasi/capex/rab/${id}`;
            document.getElementById('edit_rab_tahun').value = d.tahun;

            if (d.lokasi === 'mess') {
                document.getElementById('edit_rab_lokasi_mess').checked = true;
            } else {
                document.getElementById('edit_rab_lokasi_kantor').checked = true;
            }

            document.getElementById('edit_rab_kel_barang').value = d.kel_barang_kapital || '';
            document.getElementById('edit_rab_type').value = d.type || '';
            document.getElementById('edit_rab_satuan').value = d.satuan || 'Unit';
            document.getElementById('edit_rab_qty').value = d.jumlah_unit || 1;
            document.getElementById('edit_rab_harga').value = d.harga_satuan || 0;
            document.getElementById('edit_rab_foto_barang').value = d.foto_barang || '';

            calcEditRabTotal();
            document.getElementById('modalEditRab').classList.remove('hidden');
        });
}

function closeEditRabModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalEditRab').classList.add('hidden');
}

function calcEditRabTotal() {
    const qty = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_rab_qty')?.value) || 0;
    const harga = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_rab_harga')?.value) || 0;
    const total = qty * harga;
    const preview = document.getElementById('edit_rab_total_preview');
    if (preview) preview.textContent = 'Rp ' + total.toLocaleString('id-ID');
}

// ============================================================
// MODAL CONTROLS: EDIT REALISASI
// ============================================================
function openEditRealisasiModal(id) {
    fetch(`/administrasi/capex/realisasi/${id}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(res => {
            if (!res.success) return;
            const d = res.data;

            document.getElementById('formEditRealisasi').action = `/administrasi/capex/realisasi/${id}`;
            document.getElementById('edit_rel_tahun').value = d.tahun;
            document.getElementById('edit_rel_rab_id').value = d.rab_id || '';

            if (d.lokasi === 'mess') {
                document.getElementById('edit_rel_lokasi_mess').checked = true;
            } else {
                document.getElementById('edit_rel_lokasi_kantor').checked = true;
            }

            document.getElementById('edit_rel_nama_barang').value = d.nama_barang || '';
            document.getElementById('edit_rel_kel_barang').value = d.kel_barang_kapital || '';
            document.getElementById('edit_rel_type').value = d.type || '';
            document.getElementById('edit_rel_tanggal').value = d.tanggal ? d.tanggal.substring(0, 10) : '';
            document.getElementById('edit_rel_debit').value = d.debit || 0;
            document.getElementById('edit_rel_kredit').value = d.kredit || 0;
            document.getElementById('edit_rel_foto_barang').value = d.foto_barang || '';

            calcEditRelTotal();
            document.getElementById('modalEditRealisasi').classList.remove('hidden');
        });
}

function closeEditRealisasiModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalEditRealisasi').classList.add('hidden');
}

function calcEditRelTotal() {
    const debit = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_rel_debit')?.value) || 0;
    const kredit = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_rel_kredit')?.value) || 0;
    const total = debit - kredit;
    const preview = document.getElementById('edit_rel_total_preview');
    if (preview) preview.textContent = 'Rp ' + total.toLocaleString('id-ID');
}

// MODAL: TAMBAH TAHUN & SCROLL

function scrollYearTabs(direction) {
    const container = document.getElementById('yearTabsContainer');
    if (!container) return;
    const scrollAmount = 240;
    container.scrollBy({ left: direction === 'left' ? -scrollAmount : scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

function openTambahTahunModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
    if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.focus(), 100);
    }
}

function closeTambahTahunModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
    if (modal) modal.classList.add('hidden');
}

function handleTambahTahun(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const year = document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.value;
    if (!year) return;
    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    url.searchParams.set('year', year);
    window.location.href = url.toString();
}

    if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') {
        lucide.createIcons();
    }
    const activeTab = document.getElementById('year-tab-{{ $selectedYear }}');
    if (activeTab) {
        activeTab.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' });
    }
});

                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                    @endcan
                </tr>
                @endforeach

                {{-- ================= SUBTOTAL ROW ================= --}}
                @php
                    $subTarget = $subtotalTahunan > 0 ? $subtotalTahunan : ($subtotalBudget > 0 ? $subtotalBudget : 0);
                    $subPct = $subTarget > 0 ? round(($subtotalReal / $subTarget) * 100, 1) : 0;

@push('scripts')
<script>
function openImportModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalImport').classList.remove('hidden');
}
function closeImportModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalImport').classList.add('hidden');
}

function openAddModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalAdd').classList.remove('hidden');
}
function closeAddModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalAdd').classList.add('hidden');
}

function openEditModal(id) {
    fetch(`/administrasi/cost/${id}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(res => {
            if (!res.success) return;
            const d = res.data;
            document.getElementById('formEdit').action = `/administrasi/cost/${id}`;
            document.getElementById('edit_tahun').value          = d.tahun || '{{ $selectedYear }}';
            document.getElementById('edit_bulan').value          = d.bulan || '';
            document.getElementById('edit_GL_ACCOUNT').value     = d.GL_ACCOUNT || '';
            document.getElementById('edit_jenis_cost').value     = d.jenis_cost || '';
            document.getElementById('edit_account_name').value   = d.account_name || '';
            document.getElementById('edit_budget').value         = d.budget || 0;
            document.getElementById('edit_realisasi').value      = d.realisasi || 0;
            document.getElementById('edit_budget_tahunan').value = d.budget_tahunan || 0;
            document.getElementById('modalEdit').classList.remove('hidden');
        });
}
function closeEditModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalEdit').classList.add('hidden');
}

function openDeleteModal(id, name) {
    document.getElementById('delete_name_label').textContent = name;
    document.getElementById('formDelete').action = `/administrasi/cost/${id}`;
    document.getElementById('modalDelete').classList.remove('hidden');
}
function closeDeleteModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalDelete').classList.add('hidden');
}

function openDeleteAllModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalDeleteAll').classList.remove('hidden');
}
function closeDeleteAllModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalDeleteAll').classList.add('hidden');
}

function scrollYearTabs(direction) {
    const container = document.getElementById('yearTabsContainer');
    if (!container) return;
    const scrollAmount = 240;
    container.scrollBy({ left: direction === 'left' ? -scrollAmount : scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

function openTambahTahunModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
    if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.focus(), 100);
    }
}

function closeTambahTahunModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
    if (modal) modal.classList.add('hidden');
}

function handleTambahTahun(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const year = document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.value;
    if (!year) return;
    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    url.searchParams.set('year', year);
    window.location.href = url.toString();
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const activeTab = document.getElementById('year-tab-{{ $selectedYear }}');
    if (activeTab) {
        activeTab.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' });
    }
});
</script>
@endpush
</x-admin-layout>

@push('scripts')
<script>
// ============================================================
// MODAL CONTROLLERS
// ============================================================
function openModal(id) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) {
        el.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
    }
}

function closeModal(id) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.classList.add('hidden');
}

function handleFileSelected(input) {
    if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
        document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay').innerText = input.files[0].name;
    }
}

// ============================================================
// ADD MODAL LIVE CALCULATION
// ============================================================
function calcAddKM() {
    const kmAwal = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_km_awal').value) || 0;
    const kmAkhir = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_km_akhir').value) || 0;
    if (kmAkhir > kmAwal) {
        document.getElementById('add_km').value = (kmAkhir - kmAwal).toFixed(2);
    }
    calcAddMetrics();
}

function calcAddMetrics() {
    const upah = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_upah').value) || 0;
    const bbm = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_bbm').value) || 0;
    const maint = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_maint').value) || 0;
    const lainnya = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_lainnya').value) || 0;
    const km = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_km').value) || 0;
    const bbmLiter = parseFloat(document.getElementById('add_bbm_liter').value) || 0;

    const totalBiaya = upah + bbm + maint + lainnya;
    const kmLiter = bbmLiter > 0 ? (km / bbmLiter) : 0;
    const vra = km > 0 ? (totalBiaya / km) : 0;

    document.getElementById('preview_add_total_biaya').innerText = 'Rp ' + Math.round(totalBiaya).toLocaleString('id-ID');
    document.getElementById('preview_add_km_liter').innerText = kmLiter.toFixed(2) + ' KM/L';
    document.getElementById('preview_add_vra').innerText = 'Rp ' + Math.round(vra).toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' / KM';
}

function openAddModal() {
    openModal('modalAdd');
    calcAddMetrics();
}

// ============================================================
// EDIT MODAL LIVE CALCULATION
// ============================================================
function calcEditKM() {
    const kmAwal = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_km_awal').value) || 0;
    const kmAkhir = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_km_akhir').value) || 0;
    if (kmAkhir > kmAwal) {
        document.getElementById('edit_km').value = (kmAkhir - kmAwal).toFixed(2);
    }
    calcEditMetrics();
}

function calcEditMetrics() {
    const upah = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_upah').value) || 0;
    const bbm = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_bbm').value) || 0;
    const maint = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_maint').value) || 0;
    const lainnya = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_lainnya').value) || 0;
    const km = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_km').value) || 0;
    const bbmLiter = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit_bbm_liter').value) || 0;

    const totalBiaya = upah + bbm + maint + lainnya;
    const kmLiter = bbmLiter > 0 ? (km / bbmLiter) : 0;
    const vra = km > 0 ? (totalBiaya / km) : 0;

    document.getElementById('preview_edit_total_biaya').innerText = 'Rp ' + Math.round(totalBiaya).toLocaleString('id-ID');
    document.getElementById('preview_edit_km_liter').innerText = kmLiter.toFixed(2) + ' KM/L';
    document.getElementById('preview_edit_vra').innerText = 'Rp ' + Math.round(vra).toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' / KM';
}

function openEditModal(id) {
    fetch(`/administrasi/vra/${id}`)
        .then(res => res.json())
        .then(response => {
            if (response.success && response.data) {
                const d = response.data;
                document.getElementById('formEdit').action = `/administrasi/vra/${id}`;
                document.getElementById('edit_nomor_polisi').value = d.nomor_polisi || '';
                document.getElementById('edit_kendaraan').value = d.kendaraan || '';
                document.getElementById('edit_budget_tahun').value = d.budget_tahun || 0;
                document.getElementById('edit_upah').value = d.upah || 0;
                document.getElementById('edit_bbm').value = d.BBM || 0;
                document.getElementById('edit_bbm_tahun').value = d.BBM_tahun || 0;
                document.getElementById('edit_maint').value = d.preventif_maintenance || 0;
                document.getElementById('edit_lainnya').value = d.biaya_lainnya || 0;
                document.getElementById('edit_km_awal').value = d.KM_awal || 0;
                document.getElementById('edit_km_akhir').value = d.KM_akhir || 0;
                document.getElementById('edit_km').value = d.KM || 0;
                document.getElementById('edit_bbm_liter').value = d.BBM_liter || 0;

                calcEditMetrics();
                openModal('modalEdit');
            }
        })
        .catch(err => console.error('Error fetching VRA detail:', err));
}

// ============================================================
// DETAIL MODAL
// ============================================================
function showDetailModal(id) {
    fetch(`/administrasi/vra/${id}`)
        .then(res => res.json())
        .then(response => {
            if (response.success && response.data) {
                const d = response.data;
                const monthNames = ['', 'Januari', 'Februari', 'Maret', 'April', 'Mei', 'Juni', 'Juli', 'Agustus', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Desember'];

                document.getElementById('detail_nopol').innerText = d.nomor_polisi || '-';
                document.getElementById('detail_kendaraan').innerText = d.kendaraan || '-';
                document.getElementById('detail_periode').innerText = (monthNames[d.bulan] || d.bulan) + ' ' + d.tahun;
                document.getElementById('detail_budget_tahun').innerText = Number(d.budget_tahun || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' KM';

                document.getElementById('detail_km_liter').innerText = Number(d.BBM_KM_liter || 0).toFixed(2) + ' KM/L';
                document.getElementById('detail_vra').innerText = 'Rp ' + Number(d.VRA || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' / KM';

                document.getElementById('detail_upah').innerText = 'Rp ' + Number(d.upah || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID');
                document.getElementById('detail_bbm').innerText = 'Rp ' + Number(d.BBM || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID');
                document.getElementById('detail_bbm_tahun').innerText = 'Rp ' + Number(d.BBM_tahun || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID');
                document.getElementById('detail_maint').innerText = 'Rp ' + Number(d.preventif_maintenance || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID');
                document.getElementById('detail_lainnya').innerText = 'Rp ' + Number(d.biaya_lainnya || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID');
                document.getElementById('detail_total_biaya').innerText = 'Rp ' + Number(d.total_biaya_bulan || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID');

                document.getElementById('detail_km_awal').innerText = Number(d.KM_awal || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' KM';
                document.getElementById('detail_km_akhir').innerText = Number(d.KM_akhir || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' KM';
                document.getElementById('detail_km').innerText = Number(d.KM || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' KM';
                document.getElementById('detail_bbm_liter').innerText = Number(d.BBM_liter || 0).toFixed(2) + ' Liter';

                openModal('modalDetail');
            }
        })
        .catch(err => console.error('Error fetching VRA detail:', err));
}

// ============================================================
// DELETE MODAL
// ============================================================
function openDeleteModal(id, nopol) {
    document.getElementById('delete_nopol_label').innerText = nopol;
    document.getElementById('formDelete').action = `/administrasi/vra/${id}`;
    openModal('modalDelete');
}

function scrollYearTabs(direction) {
    const container = document.getElementById('yearTabsContainer');
    if (!container) return;
    const scrollAmount = 240;
    container.scrollBy({ left: direction === 'left' ? -scrollAmount : scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

function openTambahTahunModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
    if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.focus(), 100);
    }
}

function closeTambahTahunModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('modalTambahTahun');
    if (modal) modal.classList.add('hidden');
}

function handleTambahTahun(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const year = document.getElementById('inputTahunBaru')?.value;
    if (!year) return;
    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    url.searchParams.set('year', year);
    window.location.href = url.toString();
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const activeTab = document.getElementById('year-tab-{{ $selectedYear }}');
    if (activeTab) {
        activeTab.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' });
    }
});
</script>
@endpush
