import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { CulledTable } from "../components/DataManagement/CulledTable";
import { CulledFormModal } from "../components/DataManagement/CulledFormModal";
import { AngkatanFormModal } from "../components/DataManagement/AngkatanFormModal";
import { ImportModal } from "../components/DataManagement/ImportModal";
import { useCulled } from "../hooks/useCulled";
import { useAngkatan } from "../hooks/useAngkatan";

export default function CulledEmployees() {
  const {
    data,
    angkatanList,
    loading,
    error,
    addCulled,
    updateCulled,
    deleteCulled,
    deleteAllCulled,
    importCulled,
    refetch: refetchCulled
  } = useCulled();
  const { addAngkatan } = useAngkatan();

  const [isFormOpen, setIsFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isImportOpen, setIsImportOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingEmployee, setEditingEmployee] = useState(null);

  const [isAngkatanModalOpen, setIsAngkatanModalOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOpenAngkatanModal = () => setIsAngkatanModalOpen(true);
    window.addEventListener('openAngkatanModal', handleOpenAngkatanModal);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('openAngkatanModal', handleOpenAngkatanModal);
  }, []);

  const handleAdd = () => {
    setEditingEmployee(null);
    setIsFormOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEdit = (employee) => {
    setEditingEmployee(employee);
    setIsFormOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    try {
      await deleteCulled(id);
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Gagal menghapus data: " + err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteAll = async () => {
    if (window.confirm("PERINGATAN: Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus SEMUA data peserta culled?\nSemua data peserta culled akan dikosongkan. Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan.")) {
      try {
        await deleteAllCulled();
        alert("Semua data peserta culled berhasil dihapus.");
      } catch (err) {
        alert("Gagal menghapus seluruh data: " + err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitForm = async (formData) => {
    let finalAlasan = formData.alasan || "";

    // Clean up any existing tags first to prevent duplicate/conflicting tags when editing
    finalAlasan = finalAlasan.replace(/\[(In Class|OJT)\]\s*/ig, "").trim();

    // Inject fase_program into alasan if applicable
    if (formData.kategori_status === "Culled" && formData.fase_program) {
      finalAlasan = `[${formData.fase_program}] ${finalAlasan}`.trim();
    }

    const payload = {
      nama: formData.nama,
      id_angkatan: formData.id_angkatan,
      kategori_status: formData.kategori_status,
      Jenis_culled: formData.Jenis_culled || (formData.fase_program === "OJT" ? "Resign_OJT" : "Resign_In_Class"),
      alasan: finalAlasan
    };

    if (editingEmployee) {
      await updateCulled(editingEmployee.id_culled, payload);
    } else {
      await addCulled(payload);
    }
  };

  const handleAddAngkatan = async (formData) => {
    try {
      await addAngkatan(formData);
      // Refetch culled data so the angkatanList gets updated in the dropdown
      await refetchCulled();
    } catch (err) {
      throw err;
    }
  };

  if (error) {
    return <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 text-red-600 rounded-xl">Error loading data: {error}</div>;
  }

  const handleExport = () => {
    window.location.href = "/administrasi/monitoring/api/culled/export";
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-full">
      <CulledTable
        data={(data || []).filter(item => item.nama !== 'Manual Entry')}
        loading={loading}
        title="Data Peserta Culled"
        description="Daftar peserta pelatihan FR Academy yang dikeluarkan atau tidak lulus."
        onAdd={handleAdd}
        onEdit={handleEdit}
        onDelete={handleDelete}
        onDeleteAll={handleDeleteAll}
        onOpenImport={() => setIsImportOpen(true)}
        onExport={handleExport}
      />

      <CulledFormModal
        isOpen={isFormOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsFormOpen(false)}
        onSubmit={handleSubmitForm}
        initialData={editingEmployee}
        angkatanList={angkatanList}
      />

      {/* Quick Add Angkatan Modal */}
      <AngkatanFormModal
        isOpen={isAngkatanModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAngkatanModalOpen(false)}
        onSubmit={handleAddAngkatan}
      />

      {/* Import Modal */}
      <ImportModal
        isOpen={isImportOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsImportOpen(false)}
        onImport={importCulled}
        title="Import Data Staff Culled"
        description="Unggah file Excel / CSV data peserta culled. Kolom yang diharapkan: nama, angkatan, kategori_status, jenis_culled, alasan."
        templateUrl="/administrasi/monitoring/api/culled/template"
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { AnalisaTab } from "../components/Dashboard/AnalisaTab";
import { EksisTab } from "../components/Dashboard/EksisTab";
import { TerminateTab } from "../components/Dashboard/TerminateTab";
import { RegionalKpi } from "../components/DataManagement/RegionalKpi";
import { BarChart3, Users, UserMinus, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useEmployees } from "../hooks/useEmployees";
import { useAngkatan } from "../hooks/useAngkatan";
import { useAfdeling } from "../hooks/useAfdeling";

export default function Dashboard() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("analisa");
  const [selectedProgram, setSelectedProgram] = useState("Semua");

  const PROGRAM_CATEGORIES = ["Semua", "FAT", "AAT", "PMT", "MAT", "DMT"];

  const getProgramCategory = (text = "") => {
    const str = String(text || "").toUpperCase();
    if (str.includes("FAT") || str.includes("FIELD ASSISTANT") || str.includes("ESTATE CADET") || str.includes("ECT")) {
      return "FAT";
    }
    if (str.includes("AAT") || str.includes("ADMIN ASSISTANT") || str.includes("ADMINISTRATION") || str.includes("ADMIN")) {
      return "AAT";
    }
    if (str.includes("MAT") || str.includes("MILL ASSISTANT")) {
      return "MAT";
    }
    if (str.includes("PMT") || str.includes("PROCESSING") || str.includes("PALM OIL MILL") || str.includes("PABRIK")) {
      return "PMT";
    }
    if (str.includes("DMT") || str.includes("DOWNSTREAM")) {
      return "DMT";
    }
    return "OTHER";
  };

  const matchesEmployeeProgram = (emp, cat) => {
    if (cat === "Semua") return true;
    const angkatan = emp["ANGKATAN FR ACADEMY"] || emp.ANGKATAN || emp.angkatan || "";
    return (
      getProgramCategory(angkatan) === cat ||
      getProgramCategory(emp.JABATAN) === cat ||
      getProgramCategory(emp.KATEGORI) === cat
    );
  };

  const matchesAngkatanProgram = (item, cat) => {
    if (cat === "Semua") return true;
    const name = item.angkatan || item.Angkatan || "";
    return getProgramCategory(name) === cat;
  };

  // Fetch ALL employees for the dashboard aggregations
  const { data, loading, error } = useEmployees();
  const { data: angkatanData, loading: angkatanLoading, error: angkatanError } = useAngkatan();
  const { data: afdelingData, loading: afdelingLoading, error: afdelingError, updateAfdeling } = useAfdeling();

  const filteredEmployees = (data || []).filter(emp => matchesEmployeeProgram(emp, selectedProgram));
  const filteredAngkatan = (angkatanData || []).filter(item => matchesAngkatanProgram(item, selectedProgram));

  const categoryCounts = PROGRAM_CATEGORIES.reduce((acc, cat) => {
    if (cat === "Semua") {
      acc[cat] = (data || []).length;
    } else {
      acc[cat] = (data || []).filter(emp => matchesEmployeeProgram(emp, cat)).length;
    }
    return acc;
  }, {});

  const tabs = [
    { id: "analisa", label: "Analisa", icon: <BarChart3 size={18} /> },
    { id: "eksis", label: "Eksis", icon: <Users size={18} /> },
    { id: "terminate", label: "Terminate", icon: <UserMinus size={18} /> },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col gap-6 overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header & Controls */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 shrink-0">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">Dashboard</h1>
            <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm mt-1">Ringkasan data analitik dan statistik karyawan FR Academy.</p>
          </div>

          {/* Tab Navigation */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-white p-1.5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm w-max max-w-full overflow-x-auto border border-gray-100 custom-scrollbar">
            {tabs.map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all duration-300 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${
                  activeTab === tab.id
                    ? "bg-[#2c8f42] text-white shadow-md shadow-green-900/20"
                    : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50"
                }`}
              >
                {tab.icon}
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Program Category Filter Pills */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-white p-2.5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-x-auto">
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider ml-1 mr-1 shrink-0">Filter Program:</span>
          {PROGRAM_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
            const isActive = selectedProgram === cat;
            const count = categoryCounts[cat] || 0;
            return (
              <button
                key={cat}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedProgram(cat)}
                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 ${
                  isActive
                    ? "bg-[#2c8f42] text-white shadow-sm shadow-[#2c8f42]/30 ring-2 ring-[#2c8f42]/20"
                    : "bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900 border border-gray-200/70"
                }`}
              >
                <span>{cat}</span>
                <span
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                    isActive ? "bg-white/20 text-white" : "bg-gray-200/80 text-gray-600"
                  }`}
                >
                  {count}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tab Content Area - Scrollable */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-2 pb-8 custom-scrollbar">
        {loading || angkatanLoading || afdelingLoading ? (
           <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-64 text-gray-400 gap-3">
             <Loader2 size={32} className="animate-spin text-[#2c8f42]" />
             <p className="text-sm font-bold">Memuat dan menghitung data analitik...</p>
           </div>
        ) : error || angkatanError || afdelingError ? (
           <div className="p-6 bg-red-50 text-red-600 rounded-2xl border border-red-100">
             Gagal memuat data: {error || angkatanError || afdelingError}
           </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {activeTab === "analisa" && (
              <>
                <AnalisaTab data={filteredEmployees} summaryData={filteredAngkatan} />
                <RegionalKpi data={filteredEmployees} summaryData={filteredAngkatan} afdelingData={afdelingData} onUpdateAfdeling={updateAfdeling} />
              </>
            )}
            {activeTab === "eksis" && <EksisTab data={filteredEmployees} />}
            {activeTab === "terminate" && <TerminateTab data={filteredEmployees} />}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";

export default function DatabaseData() {

  };

    if (str.includes("FAT") || str.includes("FIELD ASSISTANT") || str.includes("ESTATE CADET") || str.includes("ECT")) {
      return "FAT";
    }
    if (str.includes("AAT") || str.includes("ADMIN ASSISTANT") || str.includes("ADMINISTRATION") || str.includes("ADMIN")) {
      return "AAT";
    }
    if (str.includes("MAT") || str.includes("MILL ASSISTANT")) {
      return "MAT";
    }
    if (str.includes("PMT") || str.includes("PROCESSING") || str.includes("PALM OIL MILL") || str.includes("PABRIK")) {
      return "PMT";
    }
    if (str.includes("DMT") || str.includes("DOWNSTREAM")) {
      return "DMT";
    }
    return "OTHER";
  };

    if (cat === "Semua") return true;
    return (
      getProgramCategory(emp["ANGKATAN FR ACADEMY"]) === cat ||
      getProgramCategory(emp.JABATAN) === cat ||

    );
  };

    setIsFormOpen(true);

    setEditingEmployee(employee);
    setIsFormOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {

      try {
        await deleteEmployee(id);
      } catch (err) {
        alert("Gagal menghapus data: " + err.message);
      }
    }
  };

      try {
        await deleteAllEmployees();
        alert("Semua data karyawan berhasil dihapus.");
      } catch (err) {
        alert("Gagal menghapus seluruh data: " + err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitForm = async (formData) => {
    if (editingEmployee) {
      await updateEmployee(editingEmployee.ID_MONITORING, formData);
    } else {
      await addEmployee(formData);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500">Loading data...</div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-red-500">Error: {error}</div>;
  }

  // Get unique options
  const rawAngkatans = data.filter(emp => matchesEmployeeProgram(emp, programFilter));
  const angkatanOptions = Array.from(new Set(
    rawAngkatans.map(emp => (emp["ANGKATAN FR ACADEMY"] || "").trim()).filter(Boolean)
  )).sort();

  const regionOptions = Array.from(new Set(
    data.map(emp => (emp["REGION TERAKHIR"] || "").trim()).filter(Boolean)
  )).sort();

  const statusOptions = Array.from(new Set(
    data.map(emp => (emp["STATUS"] || "").trim()).filter(Boolean)
  )).sort();

  const categoryCounts = PROGRAM_CATEGORIES.reduce((acc, cat) => {
    if (cat === "Semua") {
      acc[cat] = data.length;
    } else {
      acc[cat] = data.filter(emp => matchesEmployeeProgram(emp, cat)).length;
    }
    return acc;
  }, {});

  // Filter Data
  const filteredData = data.filter(item => {
    const searchLower = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
    const matchesSearch = (
      (item.NAMA?.toLowerCase() || "").includes(searchLower) ||
      (item.NIK?.toLowerCase() || "").includes(searchLower) ||
      (item["PT TERAKHIR"]?.toLowerCase() || "").includes(searchLower) ||
      (item.STATUS?.toLowerCase() || "").includes(searchLower) ||
      (item.KATEGORI?.toLowerCase() || "").includes(searchLower)
    );

    const matchesProgram = matchesEmployeeProgram(item, programFilter);
    const matchesAngkatan = angkatanFilter === "Semua" ? true : (item["ANGKATAN FR ACADEMY"] || "").trim() === angkatanFilter;
    const matchesRegion = regionFilter === "Semua" ? true : (item["REGION TERAKHIR"] || "").trim() === regionFilter;
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === "Semua" ? true : (item["STATUS"] || "").trim() === statusFilter;

    return matchesSearch && matchesProgram && matchesAngkatan && matchesRegion && matchesStatus;
  });

  // Pagination Logic
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredData.length / rowsPerPage);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * rowsPerPage;
  const paginatedData = filteredData.slice(startIndex, startIndex + rowsPerPage);

  const handlePageChange = (newPage) => {
    if (newPage >= 1 && newPage <= totalPages) {
      setCurrentPage(newPage);
    }
  };

  const handleProgramChange = (cat) => {
    setProgramFilter(cat);
    setAngkatanFilter("Semua");
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-full h-auto bg-white rounded-[2rem] shadow-sm flex flex-col border border-gray-100/50">

      {/* Table Header & Controls */}
      <div className="p-6 md:p-8 border-b border-gray-100 flex flex-col gap-5">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Database size={24} className="text-[#2c8f42]" />
              Master Data Karyawan
            </h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
              Menampilkan seluruh {data.length} data karyawan dari database.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {/* Delete All Data Button */}
            {data.length > 0 && (
              <button
                onClick={handleDeleteAll}
                className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-200/80 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold hover:bg-red-100 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
                title="Hapus Seluruh Data Karyawan"
              >
                <Trash2 size={16} />
                Hapus Semua
              </button>
            )}

            {/* Import Data Button */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsImportOpen(true)}
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-50 text-[#2c8f42] border border-[#2c8f42]/30 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold hover:bg-emerald-100/70 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <Upload size={16} strokeWidth={2.5} />
              Import CSV
            </button>

            {/* Export Data Button */}
            <button
              onClick={handleExport}
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-50 text-[#2c8f42] border border-[#2c8f42]/30 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold hover:bg-emerald-100/70 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <Download size={16} strokeWidth={2.5} />
              Export Excel
            </button>

            {/* Add Data Button */}
            <button
              onClick={handleAdd}
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-[#2c8f42] text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-bold hover:bg-[#237535] transition-colors shadow-md shadow-[#2c8f42]/20 whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <Plus size={16} strokeWidth={3} />
              Tambah Data
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Filters and Search Bar */}
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-stretch lg:items-center justify-between gap-4 pt-2 border-t border-gray-50">

          {/* Program Category Pills */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mr-1">Program:</span>
            {PROGRAM_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
              const isActive = programFilter === cat;
              const count = categoryCounts[cat] || 0;
              return (
                <button
                  key={cat}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleProgramChange(cat)}
                  className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 ${
                    isActive
                      ? "bg-[#2c8f42] text-white shadow-sm shadow-[#2c8f42]/30 ring-2 ring-[#2c8f42]/20"
                      : "bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900 border border-gray-200/70"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>{cat}</span>
                  <span
                    className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                      isActive ? "bg-white/20 text-white" : "bg-gray-200/80 text-gray-600"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {count}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            {/* Angkatan Filter */}
            <select
              value={angkatanFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setAngkatanFilter(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2c8f42] outline-none transition-all cursor-pointer font-medium text-gray-600 max-w-[200px]"
            >
              <option value="Semua">Semua Angkatan</option>
              {angkatanOptions.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt} value={opt}>{opt}</option>
              ))}
            </select>

            {/* Region Filter */}
            <select
              value={regionFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setRegionFilter(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2c8f42] outline-none transition-all cursor-pointer font-medium text-gray-600"
            >
              <option value="Semua">Semua Region</option>
              {regionOptions.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt} value={opt}>{opt}</option>
              ))}
            </select>

            {/* Status Filter */}
            <select
              value={statusFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setStatusFilter(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2c8f42] outline-none transition-all cursor-pointer font-medium text-gray-600"
            >
              <option value="Semua">Semua Status</option>
              {statusOptions.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt} value={opt}>{opt}</option>
              ))}
            </select>

            {/* Search */}
            <div className="relative flex-1 sm:flex-initial">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" size={16} />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Cari NIK, Nama, PT..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setSearchTerm(e.target.value);
                  setCurrentPage(1);
                }}
                className="pl-9 pr-4 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2c8f42] outline-none w-full sm:w-56 transition-all"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table Content */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto min-h-[400px]">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse whitespace-nowrap">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-gray-50/80 text-gray-500 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider sticky top-0 z-10 backdrop-blur-sm">
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">NIK</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">NAMA</th>

              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">LEVEL JABATAN</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">ANGKATAN FR ACADEMY</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">KATEGORI</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">ALUMNI</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">SUKU</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">AGAMA</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">LOKASI TERAKHIR</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">REGION TERAKHIR</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">STATUS</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">DATE TERMINATE</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">BULAN TERMINATE</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">TAHUN TERMINATE</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">LAMA BEKERJA (BULAN)</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">LAMA BEKERJA (TAHUN)</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">LAMA BEKERJA</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">Alasan Resign</th>

              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">GM</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">MK</th>
              <th className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 sticky right-0 bg-gray-50/90 z-20 shadow-[-10px_0_15px_-5px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] text-center">AKSI</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="text-sm">
            {paginatedData.length > 0 ? (
              paginatedData.map((item, index) => (
                <tr key={index} className="border-b border-gray-50 hover:bg-[#f0f9f3]/40 transition-colors group">

                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-800 font-semibold">{item.NAMA || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item["JOIN DATE"] || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item.JABATAN || "-"}</td>

                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item["ANGKATAN FR ACADEMY"] || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item.KATEGORI || "-"}</td>

                  <td className="px-6 py-4">
                    <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-full ${
                      item.STATUS?.toLowerCase() === 'aktif' ? 'bg-[#eaf4ec] text-[#2c8f42]' :
                      item.STATUS?.toLowerCase() === 'terminate' ? 'bg-[#fdebe9] text-[#e35649]' :
                      item.STATUS?.toLowerCase() === 'resign' ? 'bg-[#fff4e5] text-[#f29339]' :
                      item.STATUS?.toLowerCase() === 'culled' ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700' :
                      'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'
                    }`}>
                      {item.STATUS || "-"}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item["DATE TERMINATE"] || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item["BULAN TERMINATE"] || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item["TAHUN TERMINATE"] || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item["LAMA BEKERJA (BULAN)"] || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item["LAMA BEKERJA (TAHUN)"] || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item["LAMA BEKERJA"] || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item["Alasan Resign"] || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item.Detail || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item["LOKASI AWAL PENEMPATAN"] || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item["REGION AWAL PENEMPATAN"] || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item.GM || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">{item.MK || "-"}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 sticky right-0 bg-white group-hover:bg-[#f0f9f3] transition-colors shadow-[-10px_0_15px_-5px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleEdit(item)}
                        className="p-1.5 text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                        title="Edit Data"
                      >
                        <Edit2 size={16} />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleDelete(item.ID_MONITORING)}
                        className="p-1.5 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-lg transition-colors"

              <tr>
                <td colSpan="26" className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-gray-400 bg-gray-50/30">
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <Database size={32} className="opacity-20" />

                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Pagination Footer */}
      <div className="p-4 border-t border-gray-100 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-gray-50/30">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>Tampilkan</span>
            <select
              value={rowsPerPage}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setRowsPerPage(Number(e.target.value));
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-2 py-1 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-md outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#2c8f42]"
            >
              <option value={10}>10</option>
              <option value={30}>30</option>
              <option value={50}>50</option>
              <option value={100}>100</option>
              <option value={150}>150</option>
            </select>
            <span>data per halaman</span>
          </div>
          <div className="hidden sm:block w-px h-4 bg-gray-300"></div>
          <div>
            Menampilkan <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">{filteredData.length > 0 ? startIndex + 1 : 0}</span> - <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">{Math.min(startIndex + rowsPerPage, filteredData.length)}</span> dari <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">{filteredData.length}</span> data
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-1 shadow-sm">
          <button
            onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage - 1)}
            disabled={currentPage === 1}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:hover:bg-transparent transition-colors"
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={16} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </button>

          <div className="px-3 text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 min-w-[3rem] text-center">
            {currentPage} / {totalPages || 1}
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage + 1)}
            disabled={currentPage === totalPages || totalPages === 0}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:hover:bg-transparent transition-colors"
          >
            <ChevronRight size={16} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Form Modal */}
      <EmployeeFormModal
        isOpen={isFormOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsFormOpen(false)}
        onSubmit={handleSubmitForm}
        initialData={editingEmployee}
      />

      {/* Import Modal */}
      <ImportModal
        isOpen={isImportOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsImportOpen(false)}
        onImport={importEmployees}
        title="Import Data Master Karyawan"
        description="Unggah file Excel / CSV data karyawan. Pastikan format kolom sesuai dengan template standar."
        templateUrl="/administrasi/monitoring/api/employees/template"
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { EmployeeTable } from "../components/DataManagement/EmployeeTable";
import { EmployeeFormModal } from "../components/DataManagement/EmployeeFormModal";
import { useEmployees } from "../hooks/useEmployees";

export default function EksisEmployees() {
  const { data, loading, error, addEmployee, updateEmployee, deleteEmployee } = useEmployees(["Eksis", "Aktif"]);
  const [isFormOpen, setIsFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingEmployee, setEditingEmployee] = useState(null);

  const handleAdd = () => {
    setEditingEmployee(null);
    setIsFormOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEdit = (employee) => {
    setEditingEmployee(employee);
    setIsFormOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    try {
      await deleteEmployee(id);
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Gagal menghapus data: " + err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitForm = async (formData) => {
    if (editingEmployee) {
      await updateEmployee(editingEmployee.ID_MONITORING, formData);
    } else {
      await addEmployee({ ...formData, STATUS: "Aktif" });
    }
  };

  if (error) {
    return <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 text-red-600 rounded-xl">Error loading data: {error}</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="h-full">
      <EmployeeTable
        data={data}
        loading={loading}
        title="Data Karyawan Aktif"
        description="Daftar karyawan FR Academy yang masih aktif bekerja."
        onEdit={handleEdit}
        onDelete={handleDelete}
      />

      <EmployeeFormModal
        isOpen={isFormOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsFormOpen(false)}
        onSubmit={handleSubmitForm}
        initialData={editingEmployee}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

  const handleEdit = (employee) => {

    setIsFormOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    try {
      await deleteEmployee(id);
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Gagal menghapus data: " + err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitForm = async (formData) => {
    if (editingEmployee) {
      await updateEmployee(editingEmployee.ID_MONITORING, formData);

    }
  };

  if (error) {

            { key: 'ipk', label: 'IPK (Skala 4.00)', type: 'number', step: '0.01' },
            { key: 'tahun_lulus', label: 'Tahun Kelulusan Kuliah', type: 'number' },
        ]
    },
    {
        id: 'rekrutmen',
        title: 'Rekrutmen & Program Training',
        icon: Briefcase,
        color: 'text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200',
        fields: [
            { key: 'asal_rekrut', label: 'Asal Rekrut / Lokasi', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'jalur_rekrutmen', label: 'Jalur Rekrutmen', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'program', label: 'Nama Program Training', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'batch', label: 'Batch / Gelombang', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'tanggal_mulai_training', label: 'Tanggal Mulai Training', type: 'date' },
            { key: 'tanggal_selesai_training', label: 'Tanggal Selesai Training', type: 'date' },
            { key: 'tahun_angkatan', label: 'Tahun Angkatan', type: 'number' },
        ]
    },
    {
        id: 'penilaian_seleksi',
        title: 'Penilaian Seleksi',
        icon: ShieldCheck,
        color: 'text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 border-amber-200',
        fields: [
            { key: 'nilai_psikotest', label: 'Nilai Psikotest', type: 'number', step: '0.01' },
            { key: 'nilai_interview_hr', label: 'Nilai Interview HR', type: 'number', step: '0.01' },
            { key: 'nilai_interview_user', label: 'Nilai Interview User', type: 'number', step: '0.01' },
            { key: 'status_mcu', label: 'Status / Hasil MCU', type: 'select', options: ['', 'Fit', 'Fit with Note', 'Unfit', 'Pending'] },
            { key: 'ranking_seleksi', label: 'Ranking Seleksi', type: 'number' },
        ]
    },
    {
        id: 'kelulusan_training',
        title: 'Progress & Kelulusan Training',
        icon: Award,
        color: 'text-purple-600 bg-purple-50 border-purple-200',
        fields: [
            { key: 'nilai_akademik', label: 'Nilai Akademik (Teori)', type: 'number', step: '0.01' },
            { key: 'nilai_praktek', label: 'Nilai Praktek (Lapangan)', type: 'number', step: '0.01' },
            { key: 'nilai_sikap', label: 'Nilai Sikap / Attitude', type: 'number', step: '0.01' },
            { key: 'nilai_akhir_training', label: 'Nilai Akhir Training', type: 'number', step: '0.01' },
            { key: 'status_kelulusan', label: 'Status Kelulusan', type: 'select', options: ['', 'Lulus', 'Tidak Lulus', 'Training', 'Resign'] },
            { key: 'tanggal_kelulusan', label: 'Tanggal Kelulusan', type: 'date' },
        ]
    },
    {
        id: 'penempatan_awal',
        title: 'Penempatan Awal (Setelah Training)',
        icon: Building2,
        color: 'text-cyan-600 bg-cyan-50 border-cyan-200',
        fields: [
            { key: 'jabatan_awal', label: 'Jabatan Awal (Setelah Training)', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'pt_penempatan', label: 'Penempatan PT', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'regional_penempatan_training', label: 'Regional (Penempatan Training)', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'unit_kerja_penempatan_training', label: 'Unit Kerja (Penempatan Training)', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'tanggal_sk_awal', label: 'Tanggal SK Awal', type: 'date' },
        ]
    },
    {
        id: 'kepegawaian_saatini',
        title: 'Kepegawaian Saat Ini',
        icon: UserCheck,
        color: 'text-[#4B6A34] bg-green-50 border-green-200',
        fields: [
            { key: 'status_karyawan', label: 'Status Karyawan', type: 'select', options: ['', 'PKWTT', 'PKWT', 'Trainee', 'Resign', 'PHK'] },
            { key: 'jabatan_terakhir', label: 'Jabatan Terakhir / Saat Ini', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'level_jabatan', label: 'Level / Golongan Jabatan', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'region_saat_ini', label: 'Region (Kepegawaian Saat Ini)', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'unit_kerja_saat_ini', label: 'Unit Kerja (Kepegawaian Saat Ini)', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'atasan_langsung', label: 'Atasan Langsung', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'tanggal_pengangkatan', label: 'Tanggal Pengangkatan Karyawan', type: 'date' },
        ]
    },
    {
        id: 'resign_ijazah',
        title: 'Resign & Ijazah',
        icon: UserX,
        color: 'text-rose-600 bg-rose-50 border-rose-200',
        fields: [
            { key: 'status_resign', label: 'Status Resign', type: 'select', options: ['', 'Aktif', 'Resign', 'PHK'] },
            { key: 'tanggal_resign', label: 'Tanggal Resign', type: 'date' },
            { key: 'alasan_resign', label: 'Alasan Resign', type: 'textarea' },
            { key: 'status_ijazah', label: 'Status Ijazah', type: 'select', options: ['', 'Ditahan', 'Sudah Diambil', 'Belum Diserahkan'] },
            { key: 'tanggal_pengambilan_ijazah', label: 'Tanggal Pengambilan Ijazah', type: 'date' },
            { key: 'no_tanda_terima_ijazah', label: 'No Tanda Terima Ijazah', type: 'text' },
        ]
    },
    {
        id: 'lainnya',
        title: 'Lainnya & Dokumen',
        icon: FileText,
        color: 'text-slate-600 bg-slate-50 border-slate-200',
        fields: [
            { key: 'no_bpjs_tk', label: 'No BPJS Ketenagakerjaan', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'no_bpjs_kes', label: 'No BPJS Kesehatan', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'npwp', label: 'Nomor NPWP', type: 'text' },
            { key: 'keterangan', label: 'Keterangan Status', type: 'select', options: ['', 'Aktif', 'Resign', 'Gagal'] },
        ]
    }
];

const INITIAL_FORM = ASISTEN_SECTIONS.reduce((acc, sec) => {
    sec.fields.forEach(f => {
        acc[f.key] = '';
    });
    return acc;
}, { no: '' });

export default function AsistenApp() {
    // State
    const [data, setData] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [summary, setSummary] = useState({
        total_asisten: 0,
        total_aktif: 0,
        total_resign: 0,
        total_gagal: 0
    });
    const [filterOptions, setFilterOptions] = useState({
        asal_rekrut: [],
        program: [],
        region_saat_ini: [],
        status_karyawan: [],
        level_jabatan: [],
        keterangan: []
    });

    // Filters
    const [selectedAsal, setSelectedAsal] = useState('all');
    const [selectedProgram, setSelectedProgram] = useState('all');
    const [selectedRegion, setSelectedRegion] = useState('all');
    const [selectedStatus, setSelectedStatus] = useState('all');
    const [selectedLevel, setSelectedLevel] = useState('all');
    const [selectedKeterangan, setSelectedKeterangan] = useState('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

    // Pagination & Sorting
    const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
    const [perPage, setPerPage] = useState(25);
    const [pagination, setPagination] = useState({ total: 0, last_page: 1 });
    const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState('no');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState('asc');

    // Modals
    const [detailModalOpen, setDetailModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const [selectedAsisten, setSelectedAsisten] = useState(null);
    const [formModalOpen, setFormModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const [formMode, setFormMode] = useState('create'); // 'create' | 'edit'
    const [formData, setFormData] = useState(INITIAL_FORM);
    const [activeFormTab, setActiveFormTab] = useState('identitas');
    const [formErrors, setFormErrors] = useState({});
    const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

    // Import / Export Modals
    const [importModalOpen, setImportModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const [importFile, setImportFile] = useState(null);
    const [importMode, setImportMode] = useState('append'); // 'append' | 'replace'
    const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);
    const [importResult, setImportResult] = useState(null);
    const [exportDropdownOpen, setExportDropdownOpen] = useState(false);

    // Delete Confirmation
    const [deleteConfirmOpen, setDeleteConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
    const [itemToDelete, setItemToDelete] = useState(null);

    // CSRF Token
    const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')?.getAttribute('content');

    // Fetch Data
    const fetchData = async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const params = new URLSearchParams({
                page: currentPage,
                per_page: perPage,
                sort_by: sortBy,
                sort_order: sortOrder,
                asal_rekrut: selectedAsal,
                program: selectedProgram,
                region_saat_ini: selectedRegion,
                status_karyawan: selectedStatus,
                level_jabatan: selectedLevel,
                keterangan: selectedKeterangan,
                search: searchQuery
            });

            const res = await fetch(`/administrasi/asisten/api/data?${params.toString()}`);
            const result = await res.json();

            if (result.status === 'success') {
                setData(result.data || []);
                setPagination(result.pagination || { total: 0, last_page: 1 });
                setSummary(result.summary || {});
                setFilterOptions(result.filters || {
                    asal_rekrut: [],
                    program: [],
                    region_saat_ini: [],
                    status_karyawan: [],
                    level_jabatan: [],
                    keterangan: []
                });
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error fetching asisten data:', err);
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        fetchData();
    }, [currentPage, perPage, sortBy, sortOrder, selectedAsal, selectedProgram, selectedRegion, selectedStatus, selectedLevel, selectedKeterangan]);

    // Handle search with debounce / enter
    const handleSearchSubmit = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setCurrentPage(1);
        fetchData();
    };

    const handleResetFilters = () => {
        setSelectedAsal('all');
        setSelectedProgram('all');
        setSelectedRegion('all');
        setSelectedStatus('all');
        setSelectedLevel('all');
        setSelectedKeterangan('all');
        setSearchQuery('');
        setCurrentPage(1);
    };

    // Sort Handler
    const handleSort = (column) => {
        if (sortBy === column) {
            setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            setSortBy(column);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    // Detail Modal Handlers
    const openDetailModal = async (item) => {
        setSelectedAsisten(item);
        setDetailModalOpen(true);
        try {
            const res = await fetch(`/administrasi/asisten/api/${item.id}`);
            const result = await res.json();
            if (result.status === 'success') {
                setSelectedAsisten(result.data);
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error fetching detail:', err);
        }
    };

    // Create / Edit Handlers
    const openCreateModal = () => {
        setFormMode('create');
        setFormData(INITIAL_FORM);
        setFormErrors({});
        setActiveFormTab('identitas');
        setFormModalOpen(true);
    };

    const openEditModal = (item) => {
        setFormMode('edit');
        const populated = { ...INITIAL_FORM };
        Object.keys(populated).forEach(k => {
            populated[k] = item[k] !== null && item[k] !== undefined ? item[k] : '';
        });
        populated.id = item.id;
        setFormData(populated);
        setFormErrors({});
        setActiveFormTab('identitas');
        setFormModalOpen(true);
    };

    const handleFormChange = (key, value) => {
        setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
        if (formErrors[key]) {
            setFormErrors(prev => {
                const next = { ...prev };
                delete next[key];
                return next;
            });
        }
    };

    const handleFormSubmit = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!formData.nama || formData.nama.trim() === '') {
            setFormErrors({ nama: ['Nama wajib diisi'] });
            setActiveFormTab('identitas');
            return;
        }

        setSubmitting(true);
        setFormErrors({});

        try {
            const url = formMode === 'create'
                ? '/administrasi/asisten/api/store'
                : `/administrasi/asisten/api/${formData.id}`;

            const method = formMode === 'create' ? 'POST' : 'PUT';

            const res = await fetch(url, {
                method: method,
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrfToken || '',
                    'Accept': 'application/json'
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(formData)
            });

            const result = await res.json();
            if (result.status === 'success') {
                setFormModalOpen(false);
                fetchData();
                if (detailModalOpen && selectedAsisten && selectedAsisten.id === formData.id) {
                    setSelectedAsisten(result.data);
                }
            } else if (result.errors) {
                setFormErrors(result.errors);
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error saving data:', err);
        } finally {
            setSubmitting(false);
        }
    };

    // Delete Handlers
    const confirmDelete = (item) => {
        setItemToDelete(item);
        setDeleteConfirmOpen(true);
    };

    const handleDelete = async () => {
        if (!itemToDelete) return;
        try {
            const res = await fetch(`/administrasi/asisten/api/${itemToDelete.id}`, {
                method: 'DELETE',
                headers: {
                    'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrfToken || '',
                    'Accept': 'application/json'
                }
            });
            const result = await res.json();
            if (result.status === 'success') {
                setDeleteConfirmOpen(false);
                setItemToDelete(null);
                if (detailModalOpen && selectedAsisten?.id === itemToDelete.id) {
                    setDetailModalOpen(false);
                }
                fetchData();
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error deleting:', err);
        }
    };

    // Import CSV Handler
    const handleImportSubmit = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!importFile) return;

        setImporting(true);
        setImportResult(null);

        const form = new FormData();
        form.append('file', importFile);
        form.append('mode', importMode);

        try {
            const res = await fetch('/administrasi/asisten/api/import', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrfToken || '',
                    'Accept': 'application/json'
                },
                body: form
            });

            const result = await res.json();
            setImportResult(result);
            if (result.status === 'success') {
                fetchData();
            }
        } catch (err) {
            setImportResult({
                status: 'error',
                message: 'Terjadi kesalahan saat mengunggah file.'
            });
        } finally {
            setImporting(false);
        }
    };

    // Export CSV Trigger
    const handleExport = (type) => {
        setExportDropdownOpen(false);
        const params = new URLSearchParams({
            type: type,
            asal_rekrut: selectedAsal,
            program: selectedProgram,
            region_saat_ini: selectedRegion,
            status_karyawan: selectedStatus,
            level_jabatan: selectedLevel,
            search: searchQuery
        });
        window.location.href = `/administrasi/asisten/api/export?${params.toString()}`;
    };

    return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
            {/* Header Banner */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-6 shadow-xs flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-1">
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 text-[#4B6A34] flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
                            <Users className="w-6 h-6" />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 tracking-tight">Database Asisten & Trainee</h1>
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">Manajemen data lengkap 56 kolom peserta & kepegawaian alumni training</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                    {/* Export Dropdown */}
                    <div className="relative">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setExportDropdownOpen(!exportDropdownOpen)}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white border border-gray-300 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 hover:border-gray-400 transition shadow-xs"
                        >
                            <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />
                            <span>Export Excel</span>
                            <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400" />
                        </button>

                        {exportDropdownOpen && (
                            <div className="absolute right-0 mt-1.5 w-60 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl shadow-lg z-30 py-1 text-sm animate-in fade-in">
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => handleExport('ringkas')}
                                    className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-gray-700 hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:text-[#4B6A34] flex items-center gap-2.5 font-medium transition"
                                >
                                    <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                                    <div>
                                        <p className="font-semibold text-xs">Ekspor Ringkas (8 Kolom)</p>
                                        <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">Kolom utama sesuai tampilan tabel</p>
                                    </div>
                                </button>
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => handleExport('lengkap')}
                                    className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-gray-700 hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:text-[#4B6A34] flex items-center gap-2.5 font-medium transition border-t border-gray-100"
                                >
                                    <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                                    <div>
                                        <p className="font-semibold text-xs">Ekspor Lengkap (56 Kolom)</p>
                                        <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">Seluruh atribut master data</p>
                                    </div>
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Import CSV */}
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                            setImportFile(null);
                            setImportResult(null);
                            setImportModalOpen(true);
                        }}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white border border-gray-300 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 hover:border-gray-400 transition shadow-xs"
                    >
                        <Upload className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />
                        <span>Import CSV</span>
                    </button>

                    {/* Add Single Data */}
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={openCreateModal}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#4B6A34] text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-[#3D572A] transition shadow-xs"
                    >
                        <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>Tambah Data</span>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* KPI Summary Cards (4 Cards) */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                {/* 1. Total Database */}
                <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-4 shadow-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Total Database</span>
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{summary.total_asisten?.toLocaleString('id-ID') || 0}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Seluruh asisten & trainee</p>
                </div>

                {/* 2. Aktif Bekerja / Eksis */}
                <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-4 shadow-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600 uppercase tracking-wider">Aktif Bekerja / Eksis</span>
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-700">{summary.total_aktif?.toLocaleString('id-ID') || 0}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-emerald-600/70 mt-0.5">Status karyawan aktif</p>
                </div>

                {/* 3. Resign / PHK */}
                <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-4 shadow-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600 uppercase tracking-wider">Resign / PHK</span>
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <UserX className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-rose-700">{summary.total_resign?.toLocaleString('id-ID') || 0}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600/70 mt-0.5">Asisten Resign</p>
                </div>

                {/* 4. Gagal */}
                <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-4 shadow-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-amber-600 uppercase tracking-wider">Gagal</span>
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-700">{summary.total_gagal?.toLocaleString('id-ID') || 0}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-600/70 mt-0.5">Asisten yang gagal</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Filter Bar */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-4 shadow-xs space-y-3">
                <form onSubmit={handleSearchSubmit} className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch md:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="relative flex-1">
                        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            value={searchQuery}
                            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Cari nama asisten, NIK, program, unit kerja, PT..."
                            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4B6A34] focus:bg-white transition"
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <button
                            type="submit"
                            className="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-900 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-gray-800 transition"
                        >
                            Cari
                        </button>
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={handleResetFilters}
                            className="px-3 py-2 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium hover:bg-gray-200 transition flex items-center gap-1.5"
                            title="Reset Filter"
                        >
                            <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>Reset</span>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </form>

                {/* Filter Dropdowns */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-gray-100">
                    <div>
                        <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Asal Rekrut</label>
                        <select
                            value={selectedAsal}
                            onChange={(e) => { setSelectedAsal(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                            className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#4B6A34] focus:outline-none"
                        >
                            <option value="all">Semua Asal Rekrut ({filterOptions.asal_rekrut?.length || 0})</option>
                            {filterOptions.asal_rekrut?.map((loc) => (
                                <option key={loc} value={loc}>{loc}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Program Training</label>
                        <select
                            value={selectedProgram}
                            onChange={(e) => { setSelectedProgram(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                            className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#4B6A34] focus:outline-none"
                        >
                            <option value="all">Semua Program ({filterOptions.program?.length || 0})</option>
                            {filterOptions.program?.map((prog) => (
                                <option key={prog} value={prog}>{prog}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Region Saat Ini</label>
                        <select
                            value={selectedRegion}
                            onChange={(e) => { setSelectedRegion(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                            className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#4B6A34] focus:outline-none"
                        >
                            <option value="all">Semua Region ({filterOptions.region_saat_ini?.length || 0})</option>
                            {filterOptions.region_saat_ini?.map((reg) => (
                                <option key={reg} value={reg}>{reg}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Status Karyawan</label>
                        <select
                            value={selectedStatus}
                            onChange={(e) => { setSelectedStatus(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                            className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#4B6A34] focus:outline-none"
                        >
                            <option value="all">Semua Status ({filterOptions.status_karyawan?.length || 0})</option>
                            {filterOptions.status_karyawan?.map((st) => (
                                <option key={st} value={st}>{st}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Level / Jabatan</label>
                        <select
                            value={selectedLevel}
                            onChange={(e) => { setSelectedLevel(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                            className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#4B6A34] focus:outline-none"
                        >
                            <option value="all">Semua Level ({filterOptions.level_jabatan?.length || 0})</option>
                            {filterOptions.level_jabatan?.map((lvl) => (
                                <option key={lvl} value={lvl}>{lvl}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Keterangan</label>
                        <select
                            value={selectedKeterangan}
                            onChange={(e) => { setSelectedKeterangan(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                            className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#4B6A34] focus:outline-none"
                        >
                            <option value="all">Semua Keterangan ({filterOptions.keterangan?.length || 0})</option>
                            {filterOptions.keterangan?.map((ket) => (
                                <option key={ket} value={ket}>{ket}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Main Table: Strictly 8 Columns */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
                <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800">Daftar Asisten & Trainee</span>
                        <span className="text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-semibold">
                            {pagination.total} Data Ditemukan
                        </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <label className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            Tampilkan:
                            <select
                                value={perPage}
                                onChange={(e) => { setPerPage(Number(e.target.value)); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                                className="px-2 py-1 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none"
                            >
                                <option value={10}>10</option>
                                <option value={25}>25</option>
                                <option value={50}>50</option>
                                <option value={100}>100</option>
                            </select>
                        </label>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                        <thead className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200 text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold select-none">
                            <tr>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-center w-12">No</th>
                                <th
                                    className="px-4 py-3.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition"
                                    onClick={() => handleSort('nama')}
                                >
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <span>Nama</span>
                                        {sortBy === 'nama' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" />)}
                                    </div>
                                </th>
                                <th
                                    className="px-4 py-3.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition"
                                    onClick={() => handleSort('asal_rekrut')}
                                >
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <span>Asal Rekrut</span>
                                        {sortBy === 'asal_rekrut' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" />)}
                                    </div>
                                </th>
                                <th
                                    className="px-4 py-3.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition"
                                    onClick={() => handleSort('program')}
                                >
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <span>Program</span>
                                        {sortBy === 'program' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" />)}
                                    </div>
                                </th>
                                <th
                                    className="px-4 py-3.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition"
                                    onClick={() => handleSort('jabatan_awal')}
                                >
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <span>Jabatan (Awal)</span>
                                        {sortBy === 'jabatan_awal' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" />)}
                                    </div>
                                </th>
                                <th
                                    className="px-4 py-3.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition"
                                    onClick={() => handleSort('level_jabatan')}
                                >
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <span>Level Jabatan</span>
                                        {sortBy === 'level_jabatan' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" />)}
                                    </div>
                                </th>
                                <th
                                    className="px-4 py-3.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition"
                                    onClick={() => handleSort('jabatan_terakhir')}
                                >
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <span>Jabatan (Saat Ini)</span>
                                        {sortBy === 'jabatan_terakhir' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" />)}
                                    </div>
                                </th>
                                <th
                                    className="px-4 py-3.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition"
                                    onClick={() => handleSort('pt_penempatan')}
                                >
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <span>Penempatan (PT)</span>
                                        {sortBy === 'pt_penempatan' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" />)}
                                    </div>
                                </th>
                                <th
                                    className="px-4 py-3.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition"
                                    onClick={() => handleSort('region_saat_ini')}
                                >
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <span>Region (Saat Ini)</span>
                                        {sortBy === 'region_saat_ini' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#4B6A34]" />)}
                                    </div>
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5">
                                    <span>Unit Kerja</span>
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5">
                                    <span>Keterangan</span>
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-center w-28">Aksi</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                            {loading ? (
                                <tr>
                                    <td colSpan={12} className="px-4 py-12 text-center text-gray-500">
                                        <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 text-[#4B6A34] animate-spin mx-auto mb-2" />
                                        <span>Memuat data asisten & trainee...</span>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            ) : data.length === 0 ? (
                                <tr>
                                    <td colSpan={12} className="px-4 py-12 text-center text-gray-400">
                                        <AlertCircle className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 text-gray-300" />
                                        <p className="font-semibold text-gray-600">Tidak ada data asisten yang sesuai kriteria.</p>
                                        <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-1">Coba sesuaikan kata kunci pencarian atau reset filter.</p>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            ) : (
                                data.map((item, idx) => {
                                    const rowNumber = (currentPage - 1) * perPage + (idx + 1);
                                    const unitDisplay = item.unit_kerja_display || '-';
                                    const isFallback = item.is_unit_kerja_fallback;

                                    return (
                                        <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50/80 transition-colors">
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center text-gray-400 font-mono text-[11px]">
                                                {rowNumber}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                <div className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-xs">{item.nama}</div>
                                                {item.nik && (
                                                    <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-mono">{item.nik}</div>
                                                )}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-700 font-medium">
                                                {item.asal_rekrut || '-'}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                <span className="font-semibold text-gray-800">{item.program || '-'}</span>
                                                {item.batch && (
                                                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 block">Batch {item.batch}</span>
                                                )}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-700">
                                                {item.jabatan_awal || '-'}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                {item.level_jabatan ? (
                                                    <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 border border-slate-200">
                                                        {item.level_jabatan}
                                                    </span>
                                                ) : (
                                                    <span className="text-gray-400">-</span>
                                                )}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-700 font-medium">
                                                {item.jabatan_terakhir || '-'}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-700 font-medium">
                                                {item.pt_penempatan || '-'}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-700">
                                                {item.region_saat_ini || '-'}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                <div className="font-semibold text-gray-800">{unitDisplay}</div>
                                                {isFallback && (
                                                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded mt-0.5">
                                                        [Penempatan Awal]
                                                    </span>
                                                )}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                {item.keterangan === 'Resign' ? (
                                                    <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200">
                                                        Resign
                                                    </span>
                                                ) : item.keterangan === 'Gagal' ? (
                                                    <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200">
                                                        Gagal
                                                    </span>
