<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Cost\BiayaRekruit;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\DatabaseTransactions;
use Tests\TestCase;

class BiayaRekruitTest extends TestCase
{
    use DatabaseTransactions;
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->authenticateUser();
        BiayaRekruit::query()->delete();

        BiayaRekruit::create([
            'tahun'            => 2026,
            'tanggal'          => '2026-08-05',
            'nama'             => 'Ticket Pekanbaru - Jakarta',
            'total_biaya'      => 3250000,
            'jenis_rekruit'    => 'REKRUT FAT II 2026',
            'penanggung_jawab' => 'HR Recruiter Lead',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_can_view_biaya_rekruit_page()
    {
        $response = $this->get('/administrasi/biaya-rekruit');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertSee('Biaya Rekruit');
        $response->assertSee('REKRUT FAT II 2026');
    }

    public function test_can_create_biaya_rekruit()
    {
        $payload = [
            'tanggal' => '2026-08-25',
            'nama' => 'Biaya Psikotes & Interview Batch 4',
            'total_biaya' => 4500000,
            'jenis_rekruit' => 'Regular Staff',
            'penanggung_jawab' => 'HR Talent Acquisition',
        ];

        $response = $this->post('/administrasi/biaya-rekruit', $payload);
        $response->assertRedirect('/administrasi/biaya-rekruit');

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('biaya_rekruit', [
            'nama' => 'Biaya Psikotes & Interview Batch 4',
            'total_biaya' => 4500000,
        ]);
    }

    public function test_can_show_and_update_biaya_rekruit()
    {
        $record = BiayaRekruit::first();

        // Show endpoint
        $showResponse = $this->getJson("/administrasi/biaya-rekruit/{$record->id_biaya_rekruit}");
        $showResponse->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonPath('data.nama', $record->nama);

        // Update endpoint
        $updateResponse = $this->put("/administrasi/biaya-rekruit/{$record->id_biaya_rekruit}", [
            'tanggal' => '2026-08-06',
            'nama' => 'Ticket Pekanbaru - Jakarta (Revisi)',
            'total_biaya' => 3800000,
            'jenis_rekruit' => 'Executive',
            'penanggung_jawab' => 'HR Senior Lead',
        ]);

        $updateResponse->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('biaya_rekruit', [
            'id_biaya_rekruit' => $record->id_biaya_rekruit,
            'nama' => 'Ticket Pekanbaru - Jakarta (Revisi)',
            'total_biaya' => 3800000,
        ]);
    }

    public function test_can_export_biaya_rekruit()
    {
        $response = $this->get('/administrasi/biaya-rekruit/export/report');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertHeader('Content-Disposition', 'attachment; filename="Biaya_Rekruit_Report_' . date('Y-m-d') . '.xlsx"');
    }

    public function test_can_download_template()
    {
        $response = $this->get('/administrasi/biaya-rekruit/template/download');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertHeader('Content-Disposition', 'attachment; filename="Template_Import_Biaya_Rekruit.xlsx"');
    }

    public function test_can_filter_by_month()
    {
        $responseAugust = $this->get('/administrasi/biaya-rekruit?year=2026&month=8');
        $responseAugust->assertStatus(200);
        $responseAugust->assertSee('Ticket Pekanbaru - Jakarta');

        $responseMay = $this->get('/administrasi/biaya-rekruit?year=2026&month=5');
        $responseMay->assertStatus(200);
        $responseMay->assertDontSee('Ticket Pekanbaru - Jakarta');
    }

    public function test_can_import_csv()
    {
        $csvContent = "cost_rekruit_id,tanggal,nama,pic_rekruiter,total_biaya\n"
                    . "999,2026-06-30,TEST IMPORT CSV BIAYA REKRUIT MCU,RS Prima Test,850000\n";

        $file = \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('biaya_rekruit.csv', $csvContent);

        $response = $this->post('/administrasi/biaya-rekruit/import', [
            'csv_file' => $file,
            'import_mode' => 'append',
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('biaya_rekruit', [
            'nama' => 'TEST IMPORT CSV BIAYA REKRUIT MCU',
            'penanggung_jawab' => 'RS Prima Test',
            'total_biaya' => 850000,
            'jenis_rekruit' => 'Medical Check Up (MCU) Calon Karyawan',
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Cost\BiayaRekruit;
use App\Models\Cost\CapexRab;
use App\Models\Cost\CapexRealisasi;
use App\Models\Cost\Cost;
use App\Models\Cost\Vra;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\DatabaseTransactions;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Tests\TestCase;

class CostTest extends TestCase
{
    use DatabaseTransactions;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->authenticateUser();
        Cost::create([
            'tahun'          => 2026,
            'GL_ACCOUNT'     => '135.80.00001',
            'jenis_cost'     => 'BIAYA KARYAWAN',
            'account_name'   => 'STAFF',
            'budget'         => 500000000,
            'realisasi'      => 400000000,
            'budget_tahunan' => 6000000000,
        ]);
        Cost::create([
            'tahun'          => 2026,
            'GL_ACCOUNT'     => '135.80.00001',
            'jenis_cost'     => 'BIAYA KARYAWAN',
            'account_name'   => 'NON STAFF',
            'budget'         => 50000000,
            'realisasi'      => 40000000,
            'budget_tahunan' => 600000000,
        ]);
    }

    public function test_can_view_cost_index_page()

        $response->assertSee('STAFF');
        $response->assertSee('NON STAFF');
    }

    public function test_can_create_cost_item()
    {
        $payload = [
            'tahun'          => 2026,
            'bulan'          => 6,
            'GL_ACCOUNT'     => '135.80.99999',
            'jenis_cost'     => 'BIAYA OPERASIONAL',
            'account_name'   => 'INTERNET & BANDWIDTH',
            'budget'         => 5000000,
            'realisasi'      => 4500000,
            'budget_tahunan' => 60000000,
        ];

        $response = $this->post('/administrasi/cost', $payload);
        $response->assertRedirect('/administrasi/cost?year=2026');

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('costs', [
            'account_name' => 'INTERNET & BANDWIDTH',
            'jenis_cost'   => 'BIAYA OPERASIONAL',
            'budget'       => 5000000,
        ]);
    }

    public function test_can_update_cost_item()

            'GL_ACCOUNT'     => $cost->GL_ACCOUNT,
            'jenis_cost'     => $cost->jenis_cost,
            'account_name'   => $cost->account_name . ' (Updated)',
            'budget'         => 999999,

    public function test_can_sync_auto_aggregation_from_sources()
    {
        // 1. Seed VRA
        Vra::create([
            'tahun' => 2026,
            'bulan' => 5,
            'nomor_polisi' => 'BM 1111 AA',
            'kendaraan' => 'Bus Operasional',
            'total_biaya_bulan' => 8191473.50,
            'KM' => 1000,
        ]);

        // 2. Seed Capex RAB & Realisasi
        CapexRab::create([
            'tahun'              => 2026,
            'lokasi'             => 'kantor',
            'kel_barang_kapital' => 'AC Split Inverter',
            'jumlah_unit'        => 5,
            'harga_satuan'       => 30000000,
            'total_rp'           => 150000000,
        ]);
        CapexRealisasi::create([
            'tahun'              => 2026,
            'lokasi'             => 'kantor',
            'kel_barang_kapital' => 'AC Split Inverter',
            'nama_barang'        => 'Beli AC Split',
            'tanggal'            => '2026-05-10',
            'debit'              => 25000000,
            'kredit'             => 0,
            'total_rp'           => 25000000,
        ]);

        // 3. Seed Biaya Rekruit
        BiayaRekruit::create([
            'tahun'         => 2026,
            'tanggal'       => '2026-05-15',
            'nama'          => 'Iklan Job Portal & Assessment',
            'jenis_rekruit' => 'Eksternal',
            'total_biaya'   => 1750000,
        ]);

        // Call sync
        $response = $this->post('/administrasi/cost/sync', [
            'year' => 2026,
        ]);
        $response->assertRedirect('/administrasi/cost?year=2026');

        // Assert VRA is aggregated
        $busCost = Cost::where('account_name', 'like', '%Bus%')->first();
        $this->assertNotNull($busCost);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $busCost->realisasi);

        // Assert Capex Kantor is aggregated
        $expectedRabKantor = (float) CapexRab::where('tahun', 2026)->where('lokasi', 'kantor')->sum('total_rp');
        $expectedRealKantor = (float) CapexRealisasi::where('tahun', 2026)->where('lokasi', 'kantor')->sum('total_rp');
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('costs', [
            'account_name'   => 'Capex Kantor',
            'budget_tahunan' => $expectedRabKantor,
            'realisasi'      => $expectedRealKantor,
        ]);

        // Assert Rekruit is aggregated
        $expectedRekruit = (float) BiayaRekruit::where('tahun', 2026)->sum('total_biaya');
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('costs', [
            'account_name' => 'REKRUT',
            'realisasi'    => $expectedRekruit,
        ]);
    }

    public function test_all_months_view_aggregates_sum_budget_and_realisasi()
    {
        // Create 2 monthly entries for the same account
        Cost::create([
            'tahun'        => 2026,
            'bulan'        => 1,
            'GL_ACCOUNT'   => '135.80.00777',
            'jenis_cost'   => 'BIAYA OPERASIONAL',
            'account_name' => 'KONSUMSI HARIAN',
            'budget'       => 1000000,
            'realisasi'    => 800000,
        ]);

        Cost::create([
            'tahun'        => 2026,
            'bulan'        => 2,
            'GL_ACCOUNT'   => '135.80.00777',
            'jenis_cost'   => 'BIAYA OPERASIONAL',
            'account_name' => 'KONSUMSI HARIAN',
            'budget'       => 1500000,
            'realisasi'    => 1200000,
        ]);

        $response = $this->get('/administrasi/cost?year=2026&month=all');
        $response->assertStatus(200);

        // In the aggregated 'all' view, budget should be SUM (1,000,000 + 1,500,000 = 2,500,000)
        // and realisasi should be SUM (800,000 + 1,200,000 = 2,000,000)
        $response->assertSee('2.500.000');
        $response->assertSee('2.000.000');
    }
}

    {

        $nik = 'TEST-IMPORT-CUTI';
        $csv = implode("\n", [
            'nik,nama,jabatan,tmk,tahun,hak_cuti,sisa_hak_cuti_carryover,cuti_diambil,jan,feb,mar,apr,mei,jun,jul,agu,sep,okt,nov,des,keterangan',

        ]);

        $response = $this->post('/administrasi/cuti/import', [
            'file' => UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('cuti.csv', $csv),
        ]);

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('cuti', [
            'nik' => $nik,
            'tahun' => 2026,
            'sisa_hak_cuti_carryover' => 0,
            'cuti_diambil' => 0,
            'jan' => 1,
            'mar' => 0,
        ]);

        Cuti::where('nik', $nik)->delete();
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Tests\TestCase;
use App\Models\Monitoring\MonitoringTalent;

class MonitoringOptimizationTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->authenticateUser();
    }

    public function test_main_dashboard_and_dashboard_realisasi_loads_successfully()
    {
        $mainResponse = $this->get('/');
        $mainResponse->assertStatus(200);

        $realisasiResponse = $this->get('/administrasi/dashboard-realisasi');
        $realisasiResponse->assertStatus(200);

        $realisasiFiltered = $this->get('/administrasi/dashboard-realisasi?region=Riau&program_type=non_reguler');
        $realisasiFiltered->assertStatus(200);
    }

    public function test_dashboard_monitoring_tahunan_loads_successfully()
    {
        $response = $this->get('/administrasi/dashboard-monitoring-tahunan');
        $response->assertStatus(200);

        $responseReguler = $this->get('/administrasi/dashboard-monitoring-tahunan?tab=reguler&month=FEB');
        $responseReguler->assertStatus(200);
    }

    public function test_monitoring_talent_crud_and_exports()
    {
        $response = $this->get('/administrasi/monitoring-talent');
        $response->assertStatus(200);

        $talentData = [
            'employee_id' => 'TEST999',
            'employee_name' => 'John Doe Test',
            'posisi_asal' => 'Asisten Kebun',
            'talent_to' => 'Askep',
            'unit' => 'EST1',
            'region' => 'Riau',
            'kategori' => 'TALENT ESTATE TAHUN 2026',
        ];

        $postResponse = $this->post('/administrasi/monitoring-talent/store', $talentData);
        $postResponse->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('monitoring_talents', [
            'employee_id' => 'TEST999',
            'employee_name' => 'John Doe Test',
        ]);

        $talent = MonitoringTalent::where('employee_id', 'TEST999')->first();
        $this->assertNotNull($talent);

        $talentData['employee_name'] = 'John Doe Updated';
        $putResponse = $this->put('/administrasi/monitoring-talent/' . $talent->id, $talentData);
        $putResponse->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('monitoring_talents', [
            'id' => $talent->id,
            'employee_name' => 'John Doe Updated',
        ]);

        $templateResponse = $this->get('/administrasi/monitoring-talent/template');
        $templateResponse->assertStatus(200);

        $exportResponse = $this->get('/administrasi/monitoring-talent/export');
        $exportResponse->assertStatus(200);

        $delResponse = $this->delete('/administrasi/monitoring-talent/' . $talent->id);
        $delResponse->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('monitoring_talents', ['id' => $talent->id]);
    }

    public function test_monitoring_dashboard_apis()
    {
        $empRes = $this->getJson('/administrasi/monitoring/api/employees');
        $empRes->assertStatus(200)->assertJson(['status' => 'success']);

        $storeEmp = $this->postJson('/administrasi/monitoring/api/employees', [
            'NIK' => 'NIK999',
            'NAMA' => 'Karyawan Test Monitoring',
            'JABATAN' => 'Staff IT',
            'STATUS' => 'Aktif',
        ]);
        $storeEmp->assertStatus(201)->assertJson(['status' => 'success']);
        $createdEmpId = $storeEmp->json('data.ID_MONITORING');

        $updateEmp = $this->putJson('/administrasi/monitoring/api/employees/' . $createdEmpId, [
            'NAMA' => 'Karyawan Test Monitoring Edit',
        ]);
        $updateEmp->assertStatus(200)->assertJson(['status' => 'success']);

        $delEmp = $this->deleteJson('/administrasi/monitoring/api/employees/' . $createdEmpId);
        $delEmp->assertStatus(200)->assertJson(['status' => 'success']);

        $angkatanRes = $this->getJson('/administrasi/monitoring/api/angkatan');
        $angkatanRes->assertStatus(200)->assertJson(['status' => 'success']);

        $culledRes = $this->getJson('/administrasi/monitoring/api/culled');
        $culledRes->assertStatus(200)->assertJson(['status' => 'success']);

        $afdelingRes = $this->getJson('/administrasi/monitoring/api/afdeling');
        $afdelingRes->assertStatus(200)->assertJson(['status' => 'success']);
    }

    public function test_monitoring_summarized_and_alumni_endpoints()
    {
        $summarizedView = $this->get('/administrasi/monitoring-summarized');
        $summarizedView->assertStatus(200);

        $alumniView = $this->get('/administrasi/monitoring-alumni');
        $alumniView->assertStatus(200);

        $dataRes = $this->getJson('/administrasi/monitoring-summarized/api/data?view_mode=aggregated');
        $dataRes->assertStatus(200)->assertJson(['status' => 'success']);

        $drilldownRes = $this->getJson('/administrasi/monitoring-summarized/api/drilldown?program=FAT');
        $drilldownRes->assertStatus(200)->assertJson(['status' => 'success']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Program\ProgramReguler;
use App\Models\Program\ProgramNonReguler;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ProgramBatchImportTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->authenticateUser();
    }

    public function test_regular_csv_accepts_null_numeric_values(): void
    {
        $csv = implode("\n", [
            'Program_id,Kategori_Program,Training_Program,Batch,Lokasi_training,Mulai_program,Selesai_program,jumlah_bulan_training,jumlah_hari,Total_training_days,Promosi_mandor,Fresh_Graduate,target_peserta,Uang_saku,jenis_program_reguler,Region,tanggal_pelaksanaan',
            '999999,REGULER,Test Program,I-2026,Jakarta,2026-01-01,2026-01-02,null,null,null,0,10,10,null,Training Reguler - Staf,Riau,null',
        ]);

        $response = $this->post('/administrasi/program-batch/import', [
            'file' => UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('program_batch_Reguler.csv', $csv),
        ]);

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('program_reguler', [
            'Program_reguler_id' => 999999,
            'jumlah_bulan_training' => 0,
            'jumlah_hari' => 0,
            'Total_training_days' => 0,
            'Uang_saku' => 0,
        ]);
        $this->assertSame(1, ProgramReguler::where('Program_reguler_id', 999999)->count());
        ProgramReguler::where('Program_reguler_id', 999999)->delete();
    }

    public function test_non_regular_csv_accepts_json_dates(): void
    {
        $csv = implode("\n", [
            'id_nonreguler,kategori_pelatihan,jenis_pelatihan,region,trainer,type_training,total_jam,total_hari,peserta_non_staf,peserta_ast,peserta_askep,peserta_mgr,peserta_gm,peserta_head,target_staf,target_non_staf,target_total,training_staf,training_non_staf,training_total,td_staf,td_non_staf,td_total,start_date,end_date,total_batch,lokasi_training,deskripsi,sub_kategori,tanggal_pelaksanaan,TARGET_BATCH,TARGET_PESERTA',
            '999999,Teknis,Test Non Reguler,Riau,Internal,Workshop,8,1,0,0,0,0,0,5,5,0,5,0,0,0,5,0,5,2026-01-01,2026-01-01,1,Jakarta,,Administrasi,"[""2026-01-01""]",1,5',
        ]);

        $response = $this->post('/administrasi/program-batch/import', [
            'file' => UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('batch_nonreguler.csv', $csv),
        ]);

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('program_non_reguler', [
            'id_nonreguler' => 999999,
            'jenis_pelatihan' => 'Test Non Reguler',
        ]);
        $this->assertSame(['2026-01-01'], ProgramNonReguler::find(999999)->tanggal_pelaksanaan);
        ProgramNonReguler::where('id_nonreguler', 999999)->delete();
    }

    public function test_regular_csv_with_alternate_headers_and_multiline(): void
    {
        $csv = implode("\n", [
            'Program_reguler_id,Nama_Program_reguler,Batch,Lokasi_training,Mulai_program,Selesai_program,jumlah_bulan_training,jumlah_hari,Total_training_days,Promosi_mandor,Fresh_Graduate,Total_orang,Uang_saku,jenis_program_reguler,Region,tanggal_pelaksanaan',
            '888888,"FAT Multi-Line' . "\n" . 'Program",I-2026,FRLC Kubang,2026-01-01,2026-02-27,6,180,1584,2,31,33,155000000,Training Reguler - Staf,Riau,"[""2026-01-01""]"',
        ]);

        $response = $this->post('/administrasi/program-batch/import', [
            'file' => UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('semua-data-program-training.csv', $csv),
        ]);

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('program_reguler', [
            'Program_reguler_id' => 888888,
            'Training_Program' => "FAT Multi-Line\nProgram",
            'target_peserta' => 33,
            'Region' => 'Riau',
        ]);
        ProgramReguler::where('Program_reguler_id', 888888)->delete();
    }

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Program\ProgramReguler;
use App\Models\Program\RealisasiVsBatch;
use App\Models\Program\TrainingRecord;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Tests\TestCase;

class RealisasiVsBatchTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->authenticateUser();
    }

    public function test_realization_uses_training_records_and_prevents_duplicates(): void
    {
        ProgramReguler::create([
            'Program_reguler_id' => 900001,
            'Training_Program' => 'Test Realisasi',
            'Mulai_program' => '2026-07-01',
            'Selesai_program' => '2026-07-31',
            'target_peserta' => 10,
            'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => ['2026-07-01'],
        ]);
        RealisasiVsBatch::create([
            'program_type' => 'reguler',
            'program_id' => 900001,
            'tahun' => 2026,
            'bulan' => 7,
            'legacy_realized_batch' => 0,
            'legacy_realized_participants' => 2,
        ]);
        TrainingRecord::create([
            'program_type' => 'reguler',
            'program_id' => 900001,
            'participant_identifier' => 'P-1',
            'training_date' => '2026-07-01',
            'status' => 'valid',
        ]);
        TrainingRecord::create([
            'program_type' => 'reguler',
            'program_id' => 900001,
            'participant_identifier' => 'P-2',
            'training_date' => '2026-07-02',
            'status' => 'valid',
        ]);

        $response = $this->get('/administrasi/realisasi-vs-batch?year=2026&month=7&type=reguler');

        $response->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Test Realisasi')
            ->assertSee('2 / 1')
            ->assertSee('20%');

        $this->post('/administrasi/realisasi-vs-batch', [
            'program_type' => 'reguler',
            'program_id' => 900001,
            'tahun' => 2026,
            'bulan' => 7,
        ]);
        $this->post('/administrasi/realisasi-vs-batch', [
            'program_type' => 'reguler',
            'program_id' => 900001,
            'tahun' => 2026,
            'bulan' => 7,
        ]);

        $this->assertSame(1, RealisasiVsBatch::where('program_id', 900001)->count());
    }

    public function test_legacy_csv_import_maps_month_names(): void
    {
        $csv = implode("\n", [
            'Realisasi_ID,Program_id,bulan,REALISASI_BATCH,% BATCH,REALISASI_PESERTA,% PESERTA',
            '1,900002,Juli,1,1,7,1',
        ]);

        $response = $this->post('/administrasi/realisasi-vs-batch/import', [
            'file' => UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('realisasi_reguler.csv', $csv),
        ]);

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('realisasi_vs_batch', [
            'program_type' => 'reguler',
            'program_id' => 900002,
            'tahun' => 2026,
            'bulan' => 7,
            'legacy_realized_participants' => 7,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Cost\Vra;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\DatabaseTransactions;
use Tests\TestCase;

class VraTest extends TestCase
{
    use DatabaseTransactions;
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->authenticateUser();
        Vra::query()->delete();

        $records = [
            [
                'vra_id' => 1,
                'nomor_polisi' => 'Hilux BM 8177 QG',
                'kendaraan' => 'Mobil Pool/Hilux',
                'tahun' => 2026,
                'bulan' => 5,
                'upah' => 4723210,
                'BBM' => 1122000,
                'BBM_tahun' => 3222000,
                'preventif_maintenance' => 2504820,
                'biaya_lainnya' => 6419500,
                'total_biaya_bulan' => 14769530,
                'KM_awal' => 58135,
                'KM_akhir' => 59661,
                'KM' => 1526,
                'BBM_liter' => 165,
                'BBM_KM_liter' => 9.24848484848485,
                'VRA' => 9679,
                'budget_tahun' => 3120,
            ],
            [
                'vra_id' => 2,
                'nomor_polisi' => 'Hilux BM 8177 QG',
                'kendaraan' => 'Mobil Pool/Hilux',
                'tahun' => 2026,
                'bulan' => 6,
                'upah' => 4818210,
                'BBM' => 1050200,
                'BBM_tahun' => 1050200,
                'preventif_maintenance' => 0,
                'biaya_lainnya' => 44000,
                'total_biaya_bulan' => 5912410,
                'KM_awal' => 59661,
                'KM_akhir' => 61292,
                'KM' => 1631,
                'BBM_liter' => 154.44,
                'BBM_KM_liter' => 10.5607355607356,
                'VRA' => 3625,
                'budget_tahun' => 3120,
            ],
        ];

        foreach ($records as $item) {
            Vra::create($item);
        }
    }

    public function test_can_view_vra_overall_page()
    {
        $response = $this->get('/administrasi/vra');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertSee('VRA (Vehicle Running Account)');
        $response->assertSee('Hilux BM 8177 QG');
        // Total Biaya Hilux (Mei + Jun): 14,769,530 + 5,912,410 = 20,681,940
        // Total KM Hilux (Mei + Jun): 1,526 + 1,631 = 3,157
        // VRA Overall = 20,681,940 / 3,157 = 6,551
        $response->assertSee('6.551');
    }

    public function test_can_view_vra_monthly_page()
    {
        $response = $this->get('/administrasi/vra?year=2026&period=5');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertSee('Data Rincian VRA');
        $response->assertSee('Hilux BM 8177 QG');
    }

    public function test_can_create_vra_record()
    {
        $payload = [
            'nomor_polisi' => 'BK 9999 ZZ',
            'kendaraan' => 'Ford Ranger Double Cabin',
            'tahun' => 2026,
            'bulan' => 5,
            'upah' => 4000000,
            'BBM' => 1500000,
            'BBM_tahun' => 18000000,
            'preventif_maintenance' => 500000,
            'biaya_lainnya' => 200000,
            'KM_awal' => 10000,
            'KM_akhir' => 12500,
            'KM' => 2500,
            'BBM_liter' => 250,
            'budget_tahun' => 30000,
        ];

        $response = $this->post('/administrasi/vra', $payload);
        $response->assertRedirect('/administrasi/vra?year=2026&period=5');

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('vra', [
            'nomor_polisi' => 'BK 9999 ZZ',
            'tahun' => 2026,
            'bulan' => 5,
            'total_biaya_bulan' => 6200000,
            'KM' => 2500,
            'BBM_KM_liter' => 10,
            'VRA' => 2480, // 6200000 / 2500 = 2480
        ]);
    }

    public function test_can_show_and_update_vra_record()
    {
        $vra = Vra::first();

        // Show endpoint
        $showResponse = $this->getJson("/administrasi/vra/{$vra->vra_id}");
        $showResponse->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonPath('data.nomor_polisi', $vra->nomor_polisi);

        // Update endpoint
        $updateResponse = $this->put("/administrasi/vra/{$vra->vra_id}", [
            'nomor_polisi' => $vra->nomor_polisi,
            'kendaraan' => 'Updated Vehicle Name',
            'upah' => 5000000,
            'BBM' => 1000000,
            'BBM_tahun' => 12000000,
            'preventif_maintenance' => 500000,
            'biaya_lainnya' => 100000,
            'KM_awal' => 5000,
            'KM_akhir' => 7000,
            'KM' => 2000,
            'BBM_liter' => 200,
            'budget_tahun' => 24000,
        ]);

        $updateResponse->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('vra', [
            'vra_id' => $vra->vra_id,
            'kendaraan' => 'Updated Vehicle Name',
            'total_biaya_bulan' => 6600000,
            'VRA' => 3300, // 6600000 / 2000
        ]);
    }

    public function test_can_export_report()
    {
        $response = $this->get('/administrasi/vra/export/report?year=2026&period=overall');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertHeader('Content-Disposition', 'attachment; filename="VRA_Report_2026_Overall.xlsx"');
    }

    public function test_can_download_template()
    {
        $response = $this->get('/administrasi/vra/template/download');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertHeader('Content-Disposition', 'attachment; filename="Template_Import_VRA.xlsx"');
    }

    public function test_can_import_csv()
    {
        $csvContent = "vra_id,nomor_polisi,kendaraan,bulan,upah,BBM,BBM_tahun,preventif_maintenance,biaya_lainnya,total_biaya_bulan,KM_awal,KM_akhir,KM,BBM_liter,BBM_KM_liter,VRA,budget_tahun\n"
                    . "99,Hilux Test Import,Mobil Test,5,4723210,1122000,3222000,2504820,6419500,14769530,58135,59661,1526,165,9.25,9679,3120\n";

        $file = \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('import.csv', $csvContent);

        $response = $this->post('/administrasi/vra/import', [
            'csv_file' => $file,
            'import_mode' => 'append',
            'year' => 2026,
            'period' => 5,
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('vra', [
            'nomor_polisi' => 'Hilux Test Import',
            'tahun' => 2026,
            'bulan' => 5,
            'total_biaya_bulan' => 14769530,
            'KM' => 1526,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\TestCase as BaseTestCase;

abstract class TestCase extends BaseTestCase
{
    protected function authenticateUser(): \App\Models\User
    {
        $role = \Spatie\Permission\Models\Role::firstOrCreate(['name' => 'Superadmin', 'guard_name' => 'web']);
        $user = \App\Models\User::firstOrCreate(
            ['email' => 'admin.test@domain.com'],
            ['name' => 'Test Superadmin', 'nik' => 'SUPERADMIN001', 'password' => bcrypt('password')]
        );
        if (!$user->hasRole('Superadmin')) {
            $user->assignRole($role);
        }
        $this->actingAs($user);
        return $user;
    }
}
